Closed court silk, light from the side tracing shoulder, waist, and hip through the cloth. Modest, covered. Quiet knowing look. FACE matches the portrait, Korean, dark eyes. Binyeo matches the pin. Black interior, bokeh. No text, no halo.

images.alt: Yushin and Dukman, palms on either side of one door
Yushin holds an umbrella over Dukman on the rainy steps
Young Yushin with his sword in the yard, Dukman watching from the rail
Yushin and Dukman by a fence under an old tree
Yushin and Dukman spin under falling blossom
Yushin and Chunchu on a rooftop under the moon
One brush stroke starts as a single line and forks into two.
images.prompt: Original sumi on white paper. No pasted men. Story: Yushin and Chunchu walk together then split. One brush stroke starts as a single line and forks into two. A small blue bleed on the left fork, a small magenta bleed on the right fork. No text, no seal.

blocks.html: A Queen? Ridiculous.
blocks.ko: 여왕? 웃기지도 않는군.

blocks.caption: Three kingdoms, one peninsula, and nobody happy with the lines.
blocks.ko: 세 나라, 한 반도, 그리고 그 선에 만족하는 이는 아무도 없다.

blocks.html: Everyone here knows exactly how high they were born.
blocks.ko: 여기선 다들 자기가 얼마나 높이 태어났는지 정확히 안다.

blocks.html: Munhee (26) is a young noblewoman, being attended by her low-rank servants. She is getting her hair done for an important event, while a servant takes care of her baby son Inmun (3).
blocks.ko: 젊은 귀족 여인 문희 (26)가 하급 시녀들의 시중을 받으며 큰 행사를 앞두고 머리를 매만지고 있다. 시녀 하나는 갓난 아들 인문 (3)을 돌보고 있다.

blocks.caption: Twenty-six, sharp-tongued, and married to the wrong man on purpose.
blocks.ko: 스물여섯, 입이 매섭고, 일부러 엉뚱한 남자에게 시집간 여자.

lines: 귀족 여인에게 영 어울리지 않는구나… 얘야, 더 나은 걸 못 찾겠니?
en: Totally unfit for a Noble woman… Come on, boy, can’t you find something better?

blocks.html: Her husband Chunchu is dressing too. He is twenty-nine, and already the most cunning man in Samhan. Only the quiet rooms know it yet. Their two children are getting under everyone's feet.
blocks.ko: 남편 춘추도 채비 중이다. 스물아홉, 벌써 삼한에서 가장 교활한 사내다. 아직은 조용한 방들만 그걸 안다. 두 아이는 어른들 발밑을 헤집고 다닌다.

blocks.caption: Spring and autumn. Also the name of the oldest chronicle Confucius ever edited. He means to be in the next one.
blocks.ko: 봄과 가을. 공자가 엮은 가장 오래된 역사책의 이름이기도 하다. 그는 다음 역사책에 들어갈 작정이다.

blocks.html: Bupmin is six. He finds his father and uncle on the hill where adults invent countries and sits down without being asked.
blocks.ko: 법민은 여섯이다. 어른들이 나라를 만드는 언덕에서 아버지와 외숙을 찾아, 부르기 전에 앉는다.

blocks.caption: Six years old, and already drafting laws for the people with no bones.
blocks.ko: 여섯 살. 벌써 뼈 없는 사람들을 위한 법을 짜고 있다.

en: When I’m king everyone has to listen to me.
Even the bone people.
…And the ones with no bone. Those most, there’s more of them.
lines: 나 임금 되면 다들 내 말 들어야 돼.
…뼈 없는 사람들도. 그 사람들이 더 많으니까 더 들어야 돼.

en: Listen to him.
He gets the sentences from you. The volume is his own.
lines: 저 아이 말 좀 들어 봐요.
문장은 당신한테서 가져가는데, 목청은 지 거예요.

en: …Keep that.
I may need to borrow it back when I am braver.
lines: 내가 더 용감해지면 다시 빌릴지도 모르니.

blocks.html: Before they dress for the hall he takes the two of them around the palace road. Gotaso sits in front of him on the same horse. Bupmin has his own, and will not share the saddle.
blocks.ko: 대전 옷을 입기 전에, 그는 둘을 궁길 한 바퀴 태운다. 고타소는 같은 말 안장 앞자리에 앉는다. 법민은 제 말이 있고, 안장을 나눠 타지 않는다.

blocks.caption: Chunchu’s daughter. Whatever it is, she wants it faster.
blocks.ko: 춘추의 딸. 무엇이든 더 빨리 가길 원한다.

en: Faster.
Father. Faster.
You'll bite your tongue.
Then you'll talk less, which — wait, that's the joke? Fine. Hold on.
lines: 그러면 말이 줄지 — 잠깐, 그게 농담이냐? 그래. 잡아.

en: I'm not racing.
I'm following. That's different.
That's a lawyer's horse, son.
Look at you. I'm going to tell your mother you invented a new kind of slow.
lines: 봐봐. 어머니한테 네가 느린 걸 새로 발명했다고 이를 거야.

blocks.html: King Jinpyung (65) is dead, after years of expanding Silla against Baekje.
blocks.ko: 백제에 맞서 신라를 넓혀 온 진평왕 (65)이 승하했다.

blocks.html: Silla runs on bone. Your rank is your birth, and your birth is your life. Six common ranks at the bottom. Above them, the nobles. Above them, the royals.
blocks.ko: 신라는 뼈로 돌아간다. 골품이 곧 태생이고, 태생이 곧 평생이다. 맨 아래 여섯 두품. 그 위에 진골. 그 위에 성골.

blocks.hanja: 骨品
blocks.html: Bone, as in the bone you were born with. Sacred Bone may wear the crown. True Bone may run the country. Everyone else may count the robes.
blocks.ko: 뼈. 타고난 그 뼈다. 성골은 왕관을 쓸 수 있다. 진골은 나라를 굴릴 수 있다. 나머지는 옷 색깔을 셀 수 있다.

blocks.html: In the hall the sleeves are the census. True Bone wears purple 자색. Head Rank Six wears scarlet 비색. Five wears blue 청색. Four and below wear yellow 황색. You can read a man before he speaks.
blocks.ko: 전각에서는 소매가 호적이다. 진골은 자색. 6두품은 비색. 5두품은 청색. 4두품 이하는 황색. 입을 열기 전에 사람을 읽는다.

blocks.caption: A True Bone elder who has sat through every kind of meeting. He still sits up straight.
blocks.ko: 온갖 회의를 다 견뎌 낸 진골 원로. 아직도 허리를 펴고 앉는다.

lines: 그 아래로는… 노비가 있지만, 그건 사람 수에 넣지 않습니다.
en: Below all of them are the slaves — but those are not counted as people.

lines: …사람을 사람 수에 넣지 않는 나라가, 어떻게 천 년을 가겠는가.
en: …A country that does not count people as people. How is that meant to last a thousand years?

blocks.html: Three royals are left. All three are the old king's daughters. Dukman, thirty-seven. Seungman, thirty-two. Chunmyung, fifty-two. That is the whole bloodline, and all of it is women.
blocks.ko: 남은 왕족은 셋. 셋 다 선왕의 딸이다. 덕만, 서른일곱. 승만, 서른둘. 천명, 쉰둘. 핏줄은 그게 전부고, 전부 여자다.

blocks.html: Which of the three it will be is settled the night before, in a pavilion off the pond, by six men and a brazier. By morning the palace has a name, and the name has to be dressed.
blocks.ko: 셋 중 누가 될지는 전날 밤, 연못가 작은 정자에서 여섯 사내와 화로 하나가 정한다. 아침이 되자 궁에는 이름이 하나 생기고, 그 이름에 옷을 입혀야 한다.

en: I put on this confident face,
but honestly — me, becoming king…
I wonder whether I can do it at all…

lines: 이 세상에서, 항상 공주님 편인 한 명이라도 있으면 좋지 않겠습니까?
en: Whether you do it well or badly —
that is what “no matter what” means.
In all this world, wouldn’t it be good to have one person always on your side, Princess?
Hwarang Kim Yushin.
I will serve you to the end.

blocks.html: And so she becomes the first Queen of Silla. They will call her Queen Sunduk, the Blue Moon of the Divine Country.
blocks.ko: 그렇게 그녀는 신라의 첫 여왕이 된다. 사람들은 그녀를 선덕여왕, 신국의 푸른 달이라 부를 것이다.

blocks.hanja: 聖骨男盡 故女王立
blocks.ko: 성골의 사내가 다하였으므로, 여왕이 섰다.
blocks.html: The sacred-bone males were exhausted, and therefore a queen was set up.
blocks.source: Samguk Yusa (三國遺事) bk. 1, Royal Chronology (王曆) — Queen Seondeok

blocks.html: Munhee's big brother is Yushin. He is thirty-seven, and he runs the yard. Horse, bow, gyuku: that is where boys learn whether they matter. People call him the Sword of Silla. He is also, everyone notices, very fond of the princess.
blocks.ko: 문희의 오라버니는 유신이다. 서른일곱, 연무장의 주인이다. 말, 활, 격구. 소년들은 거기서 제가 중요한 사람인지 배운다. 사람들은 그를 신라의 도검이라 부른다. 그리고 다들 눈치챘듯, 공주를 유난히 아낀다.

blocks.caption: Thirty-seven. Gaya blood, Silla rank, and the yard is his.
blocks.ko: 서른일곱. 가야의 피, 신라의 품계, 그리고 마당은 그의 것.

blocks.html: The capital’s daughters follow the Sword of Silla around the yard. He does not look at them. He looks only at the Queen.
blocks.ko: 도읍의 딸들이 마당에서 신라의 도검을 따라다닌다. 그는 그들을 보지 않는다. 여왕만 본다.

en: The marshal walked past.
I know. Don’t look.
…I’m looking.
The most popular man in Silla, and he will not even turn his head.
If he smiled once the colonnade would fall over.
lines: 신라에서 제일 인기 있는 남자인데, 고개도 안 돌리네요.
한 번만 웃으면 회랑이 쓰러질 거예요.

blocks.html: Then the yard-coat is open down the spine, and She sees the width of his back — muscle the court is not supposed to want — and the Queen’s face goes vermilion before she can pretend it is the lamp.
blocks.ko: 그러다 연무장 도포가 등줄기를 따라 열리고, 그녀는 그 등의 너비를 본다 — 조정이 원해서는 안 되는 근육 — 여왕의 얼굴이, 등불 탓으로 돌리기도 전에 주홍으로 오른다.

blocks.html: He and Chunchu had known each other since they were boys. There is a story about that, though neither of them tells it the same way twice.
blocks.ko: 그와 춘추는 소년 시절부터 아는 사이였다. 그에 얽힌 이야기가 하나 있는데, 두 사람 모두 할 때마다 조금씩 다르게 말한다.

blocks.html: Two boys on a hill above Surabol, lying on their backs, arguing about the sky.
blocks.ko: 서라벌이 내려다보이는 언덕. 두 소년이 드러누워 하늘을 두고 다투고 있다.

en: Brother. That star, in the east.
That one’s the brightest, isn’t it?

lines: 그건 별이 아니라 행성이다, 이 녀석아.
en: That is a planet, not a star, you idiot.

lines: 그럼 더 좋지요. 별들 사이에 섞여 있으면서 별이 아니잖습니까.
en: Even better. It sits among the stars without being one of them.
Just like you.

lines: 고려도, 백제도, 신라도 없이. 그냥… 사람들만.
그리고 그 위에, 모두를 위한 임금 하나.
en: Brother. Let us make Samhan one country.
No Goguryeo, no Baekje, no Silla. Just… people.
And over them, one king for all of them.
“A king for all.”
…You be that. I will stand beside you.
That is a promise, then.
Are you feeling alright, your majesty?
Hm? (startled)
Look at me.
Not the door. (smiles)

blocks.html: For a moment neither of them says anything. Then she straightens, and she is the Queen again.
blocks.ko: 잠시, 둘 다 아무 말도 하지 않는다. 이윽고 그녀는 등을 펴고, 다시 여왕이 된다.

en: …Once.
Once what.
Call me by name, not by title. / Today, since it is the last day for it.
…Yushin-ah.

blocks.html: Nobody in the room hears it. It is the last time in forty-one years that anyone calls him that, and he will still be able to hear it on the day he dies.
blocks.ko: 방 안의 누구도 듣지 못한다. 사십일 년 동안 누구도 그를 그렇게 부르지 않는다. 그리고 그는 죽는 날에도 그 소리를 들을 수 있을 것이다.

lines: 나는 새벽까지 앉아 있는 회의를 얻었고.
en: Lord Yushin.
My sister married for love and got a son out of it.
I got a council that sat until dawn.
…Your Majesty.
So from now on — «Your Majesty». Nothing else.
…That is what I have.

blocks.html: Then the young knights kneel and pledge themselves to the throne. Bidam kneels in front, already the yard's Second Blade. Pumsuk is fourteen, and trying very hard not to look it.
blocks.ko: 젊은 화랑들이 무릎 꿇고 왕좌에 충성을 맹세한다. 맨 앞은 비담, 연무장 장부에선 벌써 제이검이다. 품석은 열넷이고, 열넷처럼 안 보이려고 무진 애를 쓴다.

lines: 혁거세 성조의 빛에 걸고, 신라의 젊은 화랑들은 여왕 폐하께 영원한 충성을 맹세합니다!
en: By Hyukgosé’s light, we, the young Hwarang knights of Silla, pledge eternal allegiance to the Queen!

blocks.html: At the end of the ceremony, everyone chants for their new queen.
blocks.ko: 의식이 끝나고, 모두가 새 여왕을 연호한다.

blocks.html: May the heavenly White Horse bless this queen… Long live the Queen! Long live the Hwarang spirit! Long live Silla!
blocks.ko: 하늘의 백마여 이 여왕을 축복하소서… 여왕 폐하 만세! 화랑의 얼 만세! 신라 만세!

en: (market woman, to a child)
Remember where you live. The Divine Country. The Rooster Forest.
Kings change. Get the name right.
lines: 네가 어디 사는지 기억해라. 신국이다. 계림 땅이고.

blocks.html: Blue banners. A moon no one has to point at. In the capital they have already raised a tower to read the stars — Cheomseongdae.
blocks.ko: 푸른 기. 가리키지 않아도 아는 달. 도읍에는 이미 별을 읽는 탑 — 첨성대 — 이 서 있다.

blocks.html: A tower for reading the sky, in case the sky has opinions.
blocks.ko: 하늘에도 할 말이 있을지 몰라 세운 탑.

blocks.html: Silla sends envoys to the other kingdoms to let them know of their new queen.
blocks.ko: 신라는 각국에 사신을 보내 새 여왕의 즉위를 알린다.

blocks.caption: Baekje’s old king. He has buried a great many Silla plans and keeps the shovel handy.
blocks.ko: 백제의 늙은 임금. 신라의 계획을 수없이 묻었고, 삽은 늘 손 닿는 데 둔다.

lines: 그 진평이 늙은이가 드디어 죽었다고… 흥! 잘됐군. 그런데 딸을 앉혔다고, 어…?
en: So that old brat Jinpyung is finally dead… Bah! Good riddance. And they have seated a daughter, eh…?

blocks.caption: Goguryeo’s king. He builds walls, pays for peace, and enjoys other people’s councils.
blocks.ko: 고구려의 임금. 성을 쌓고, 평화에 값을 치르고, 남의 나라 회의 구경을 즐긴다.

lines: 그 회의라는 것이 얼마나 가는지 보자꾸나.
en: Let us see how long that Council of theirs lasts.

lines: 여자 임금이라… 동이 오랑캐들이 또 시작이군, 안 그러냐? 우! 곤룡포를 대령하라.
en: A woman king… those Samhan barbarians are at it again, aren’t they? Wu! Prepare my robes.
zh: 女主……東夷又在胡鬧了，是不是？武！備袞龍袍。
zhLatn: Nǚzhǔ… Dōngyí yòu zài húnào le, shì bu shì? Wǔ! Bèi gǔnlóngpáo.

blocks.html: He sends her a gift: a painting of peonies in three colours, and a packet of their seeds.
blocks.ko: 그는 선물을 보낸다. 세 가지 빛깔의 모란을 그린 그림 한 폭과, 그 씨앗 한 봉지.

en: …There are no butterflies on these flowers.
Your Majesty?

lines: …그리고 황제께서는, 내게 지아비가 없는 걸 알아채셨다고 내가 알아주기를 바라시는 게지.
en: It means no scent.
…And the Second Emperor would like me to know he has noticed I have no husband.

blocks.html: She has the seeds planted anyway. When they bloom, they have no scent. The court decides she is a sage. She knows she simply reads people.
blocks.ko: 그래도 씨앗은 심게 한다. 꽃이 피었을 때, 과연 향이 없었다. 조정은 그녀를 신령하다 여긴다. 그녀 자신은 그저 사람을 읽을 줄 아는 것뿐임을 안다.

blocks.caption: The king across the eastern sea. He collects envoys the way other kings collect swords.
blocks.ko: 동쪽 바다 건너의 왕. 남들이 칼을 모으듯 사신을 모은다.

lines: 처음엔 짐의 숙모님이시더니, 이제 신라까지…? 새 유행인가 보군.
en: First my aunt, and now Silla as well…? It must be a new trend.
ja: 初めは朕の叔母上、今度は新羅まで……？流行か。
jaLatn: Hajime wa chin no oba-ue, kondo wa Shiragi made…? Ryūkō ka.

blocks.html: Sun, for kindness.
Duk, for virtue.

blocks.name: Sunduk
blocks.ko: 선덕

blocks.html: Six men who hate the word “woman” crowned one anyway. How? Go back one night, to a brazier…!
blocks.ko: “여자”라는 말을 질색하는 사내 여섯이, 끝내 여자를 왕으로 세웠다. 어떻게? 하룻밤 전, 화로 하나 앞으로 돌아가 보자…!

images.at: The Royal blood, there remain only three… The woman king

DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. SEPARATION: subject and background never share a value — the lit subject sits in the one pool of light and everything behind it drops three or more steps to near-black (or, reversed, a dark figure against the single bright opening); foreground shapes almost black; the eye lands on the subject first. SHOT VARIETY AND NEGATIVE SPACE: across a set of stills alternate INTIMATE CLOSE-UPS (faces and hands filling the frame, the background a dark blur) with FAR WIDES (the figures small in a lower corner or third, 60% or more of the canvas left as quiet negative space — black hall, night sky, dark water, bare wall — that makes the small lit figures strike). RENAISSANCE CANVAS, CARTOON FIGURES: the world is composed and painted like a Renaissance / Baroque master (Leonardo’s sfumato, Titian’s glazes, Raphael’s pyramids, Caravaggio’s darkness), but every face stays a clean-lined webtoon / anime face — big expressive eyes, simple nose and mouth, smooth cel-like skin with one or two shadow tones — never photographic skin, pores or realistic facial anatomy. COLOR SYMBOLISM reads at a glance: each kingdom's colour lives in its banners and cloth (Silla blue, Baekje yellow, Goguryeo red, Tang vermilion and gold), each named person's hex in the key light on them, and the rest of the frame stays desaturated umber, slate and black so those few colours sing. FACES stay drawn: match the attached portrait's line weight, eye shape and simplification exactly — if a face starts to read as a photograph, flatten it back to ink line and wash; extras are drawn the same way, never photographic. HORSES are drawn to be admired: the whole body readable, arched neck, deep chest, round haunch, clean legs in a true gait, muscle modelled by the key with a bright edge along the topline. 2.5D painterly cinema — drawn webtoon faces, everything else brushed with visible strokes and canvas grain — not photoreal, not live-action, not a smooth digital airbrush or 3D render, not flat cel fill. Same film stock every still: a CAMERA in a real Korean place — anamorphic 2:1 movie frame, shallow DOF, creamy bokeh, rack-focus, film grain, crushed blacks, ONE hard key, long shadows, tenebrism. MOVIE FRAME of the scene a DP could stand in — NEVER a graphic poster, split-screen collage, 3D architectural visualization, black-triangle overlay, spotlight cone deleting the landscape, or neon outline. NO halo, bloom, glow aura, rim-aura, emissive skin, or god-ray envelope around people — character hex is the color of REAL LIGHT in the dark (key bounce, specular on silk/armor/wet stone, a lamp, a shaft, a floor reflection), never a body halo, never magic outline, never neon-painting the figure. FACE ONLY from the attached portrait — silk/hanbok may match; NEVER copy the portrait stance, clasped hands, 3/4 fashion lineup, or a standing clone. Invent a new DRAMATIC body every still (mid-stride, kneel, full-draw, turn, tumble, lean, count, dutch, worm’s-eye, lower-third). CINEMATOGRAPHY: name the shot — dutch angle, worm’s-eye, crane, over-shoulder, rack focus, shallow DOF / bokeh, chiaroscuro, mise-en-scène, long-shadow key. HIGH CONTRAST: crushed blacks + one hard key / long shadows / tenebrism — not even daylight wash, not a flat tourist postcard. ICONIC MINIMAL means one architectural device a lens can see (road, column, waterline, gate, hall axis) plus empty negative space — not deleting the world. COLOR SYMBOLISM: hex tints the hard key / catchlight / bounce — NEVER a glow aura, NEVER recolor the attached portrait’s garments (Sosuno stays dusty-rose hanbok, Geumwa stays red-burgundy court silk, not gold paint). FACE AND CLOTHES match the attached ch_*.png. One of each named person — NEVER clone or duplicate a character. People stand on packed earth at a well RIM — NEVER inside the well shaft. Jumong is fun-loving and laid-back: grin, laugh, wink, easy eyes — not a grim founder mask. BATTLE ARMOR: metallic GRAY steel lamellar (attached steel-armor ref); cloth peeks in the character hex — not gold-painted plate, not glowing armor, not a standing armor catalog. RING-POMMEL SWORDS: one-handed hip 환두대도 from attached sw_bidam.png — handle:blade 1:3; order is RING (pommel at heel of fist) → short grip → thin gold collar → long blade → point. Never reverse handle and blade. Never a tsuba disc in the middle. Never taller than the person. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only — do not attach it on full-blade stills. Ignore swords on face portraits. Two people = two garment-true figures against crushed black. Real Korean architecture or a locked dark room. No army. No readable text. No watermark. Copy: dynamic poses in a mythology-scale layout; dramatic poses in a mythology-scale one-device layout; one hard key / chiaroscuro; one gesture in empty space — iconic and simple. Never: white / pale studio void as a room; earth places stay real buildings, not color-plane furniture; no pasted portrait pose — new body every still; no floating logo — still must be a movie frame of the scene; unrealistic layout, reptitive; real bottle-shaped Cheomseongdae plus a story beat.

blocks.label: The Night Before
blocks.ko: 전날 밤

blocks.html: The Harmony Council meets to debate who the next king should be. Six nobles, one night. Nobody stands up until they all agree.
blocks.ko: 화백회의가 다음 왕을 누구로 할지 논한다. 귀족 여섯, 밤 하나. 뜻이 하나로 모이기 전엔 아무도 일어서지 못한다.

blocks.hanja: 和白
blocks.html: Hwabaek. It means “speaking in harmony,” which is the polite way of saying nobody goes home. It is older than the bone ranks, older than the Buddha in Silla, and it still picks the kings.
blocks.ko: 화백. ‘어울려 말한다’는 뜻이다. 아무도 집에 못 간다는 말을 점잖게 한 것이다. 골품보다 오래됐고, 신라에 부처가 오기보다 오래됐고, 지금도 임금을 고른다.

blocks.html: Night in a small pavilion off the pond. Someone lights the small brazier. The flame is red first.
blocks.ko: 연못가 작은 정자다. 누가 화로에 불을 붙인다. 불꽃은 먼저 붉다.

blocks.html: It runs hotter. The flame turns blue. Only then may the session start.
blocks.ko: 불이 더 뜨거워진다. 불꽃이 푸르게 바뀐다. 그제야 회의가 시작된다.

blocks.html: Each sleeve has a cup of tea and a wooden piece on a personal mat. They vote by setting the piece on either side of the cup.
blocks.ko: 소매마다 차 한 잔과 개인 자리보 위의 나무패가 있다. 잔의 좌우에 패를 놓는 것이 표다.

blocks.html: The Council decides by unanimity. One voice against is enough to stop a name. That is why it takes all night, and why the room fears the newest member almost as much as it fears a woman on the throne.
blocks.ko: 화백은 만장일치로 정한다. 반대 하나면 이름이 멈춘다. 그래서 밤이 새고, 그래서 방이 여왕만큼이나 새 일원을 두려워한다.

blocks.html: Every matter must be discussed by all of them together. They call it the Hwabaek, the Harmony Council. If one man dissents, the matter is dropped.
blocks.ko: 일은 반드시 여럿과 더불어 의논하니, 이를 '화백'이라 부른다. 한 사람이라도 뜻이 다르면 그만둔다.
blocks.hanja: 事必與衆議，號「和白」，一人異則罷。
blocks.source: Xin Tangshu (新唐書) bk. 220, Eastern Barbarians — Silla

blocks.html: The first count is three to three. A hung jury in silk. Initial vote, then deliberation, then a final vote that cannot move until every sleeve agrees.
blocks.ko: 초투표는 셋 대 셋이다. 비단 안의 미결 배심. 초투표, 숙고, 그리고 소매가 모두 맞을 때까지 못 움직이는 최종 투표.

blocks.html: Three pieces go to the yes side of the cup. Three go to the no side.
blocks.ko: 패 셋은 잔의 찬성 쪽, 셋은 반대 쪽.

blocks.title: Initial vote · 초투표 3:3
blocks.caption: Three sleeves for Dukman, three against a woman on the throne. Deliberation is the only door.
blocks.ko: 덕만을 드는 소매 셋, 여왕을 막는 소매 셋. 숙고만이 문이다.

lines: 여주로는 나라를 못 다스린다는 쪽이, 아직 반이오.
en: The first count is split.
Half this room still says a woman cannot rule.

blocks.html: How about Prince Chunchu…? Chunchu’s mother is a Royal, but his father is a Noble… In that case, the child becomes a Noble as well.
blocks.ko: 춘추 공은 어떠한가…? 춘추의 어머니는 성골이나 아버지가 진골이니… 그 아이도 진골이 아닌가.

blocks.html: Chunchu is nine. His father wakes him past midnight, which is normal, and walks him to the stream below the palace, which isn't. Kim Yongsu is the son of a king the Council threw out. The capital has a word for him that it only says after he leaves. He talks to the dark. He laughs a beat late. He adds a granary ledger faster than the clerk can read it.
blocks.ko: 춘추는 아홉 살이다. 자정 넘어 아버지가 그를 깨우는 건 흔한 일이고, 궁 아래 개울로 데려가는 건 흔치 않다. 김용수는 화백이 끌어내린 왕의 아들이다. 도성엔 그가 방을 나간 뒤에만 쓰는 말이 있다. 그는 어둠에 대고 말한다. 한 박자 늦게 웃는다. 곳간 장부는 서기가 읽는 것보다 빨리 머릿속으로 더한다.

blocks.html: Tonight he is laying flat stones across the water by lamplight, one at a time, as if someone on the far bank were waiting for the bridge to be finished before dawn.
blocks.ko: 오늘 밤 그는 등불 아래서 납작한 돌을 하나씩 물 위에 놓고 있다. 건너편 기슭의 누군가가 새벽 전에 다리가 끝나기를 기다리고 있기라도 한 것처럼.

lines: ……아니, 찾지 마. 쳐다보는 거 싫어해. 나처럼.
en: Shh. They’re working.
…No, don’t look for them. They hate being looked at. Like me.
Father… who is?

lines: 네 할아버지가 그 큰 자리에 네 해 앉았다. 세 번 세고 나서, 방이 도로 가져갔지.
그 방은 자길 즐겁게 해 주는 사람을 먹어.
그러니까— 그 방엔 들어가지 마. 다른 데 앉아. 다리 위에 앉든가.
en: Your grandfather sat in the big chair four years. Three counts, and the room took it back.
That room eats the men who amuse it.
So— stay out of that room. Sit anywhere else. Sit on the bridge.
…If not in the room, where does a person sit?
(laughs, a beat late)
Wherever the room has to come to you.

blocks.html: By morning there is a bridge of flat stones across the stream that nobody in the palace remembers ordering. The servants say goblins. Chunchu, who carried the lamp, says nothing at all, and finds he is good at it.
blocks.ko: 아침이 되자 개울 위에 납작한 돌다리가 놓여 있다. 궁에서 그걸 시킨 기억이 있는 사람은 없다. 하인들은 도깨비라고 한다. 등불을 들었던 춘추는 아무 말도 하지 않는다. 그리고 자기가 그걸 잘한다는 걸 안다.

blocks.html: How about the Kim of Gaya…? The Marshal’s blood is royal — in a country that no longer exists. Yes, and if we begin counting kingdoms that no longer exist, half this room is royal.
blocks.ko: 가야 김씨는 어떠한가…? 유신 장군의 피는 왕족이지 — 이제 없는 나라의 왕족이지만. 그래, 없어진 나라까지 세기 시작하면 이 방의 절반이 왕족일세.

blocks.html: The Royal blood, there remain only three… The woman king, finally we shall see…
blocks.ko: 성골의 피는 이제 셋뿐… 마침내 여왕을 보게 되는구나…

blocks.html: The newest member of the Council — a Hwarang barely seated among them — stands up.
blocks.ko: 회의의 가장 새로운 일원 — 겨우 자리를 얻은 젊은 화랑 하나가 일어선다.

blocks.caption: The youngest sleeve in the room. He has never once waited his turn.
blocks.ko: 방에서 가장 어린 소매. 한 번도 제 차례를 기다린 적이 없다.

lines: 어른들께서 오늘 밤 한 마디만 마흔 번 하셨습니다. «여자».
저는 덕만공주를 어릴 적부터 뵈어 왔습니다.
이 방 어느 분도, 그분이 답하지 못할 물음을 던져 보신 적이 없습니다.
성골이 셋뿐이라면, 저는 그 셋 중 가장 총명한 분을 택하겠습니다.
en: My lords have said one word forty times tonight. “Woman.”
I have known Princess Dukman since I was a boy.
Not one of you has ever put a question to her that she could not answer.
If only three of the Sacred Bone remain, then I choose the cleverest of the three.

lines: …총명하다는 걸로 왕을 고르면, 내일은 누구 말을 듣소.
en: …If cleverness picks a king, whose cleverness do we hear tomorrow.
Bone is the measure. Bone does not change.

lines: 바닥난 뼈로 나라를 버티는 게, 총명한 여왕보다 더 위험하지 않소.
en: The bone has run out.
Holding a country on empty bone is more dangerous than a clever woman.

lines: 한 밤의 연설로 삼백 년을 뒤집기엔, 이 방이 너무 오래됐소.
en: I still… cannot raise my hand.
This room is too old to be turned by one night’s speech.

lines: 답이 왔소. 이 방의 절반은 질문도 안 던져 보고 여자라는 단어만 반복했소.
숙고가 그래서 있는 거요. 초투표를 뒤집으라고.
en: I have put questions to her.
They were answered. Half this room never asked — they only repeated the word woman.
That is what deliberation is for. To overturn the first count.
…Alchun. Only your hand is left.
I have taken a tiger.
A tiger has no sex. It has teeth.
…I raise it. Final vote.

blocks.html: Then a great tiger burst in among the seats. The lords leapt up. Lord Alchun barely moved. He went on talking and laughing, caught the tiger by the tail, dashed it to the ground and killed it. Such was Alchun's strength that he took the head of the mat. Yet all the lords bowed to Yushin's authority.
blocks.ko: 그때 큰 호랑이가 자리 한가운데로 뛰어들었다. 여러 공이 놀라 일어났으나 알천공은 조금도 움직이지 않았다. 태연히 웃으며 이야기하다가 호랑이 꼬리를 잡아 땅에 메쳐 죽였다. 알천공의 완력이 이와 같아 윗자리에 앉았다. 그러나 여러 공은 모두 유신의 위엄에 복종하였다.
blocks.hanja: 時有大虎走入座間。諸公驚起。而閼川公略不移動。談笑自若。捉虎尾撲於地而殺之。閼川公膂力如此。處於席首。然諸公皆服庾信之威。
blocks.source: Samguk Yusa (三國遺事) bk. 1, Marvels (紀異) — the lords' council on Namsan's Ujiam rock

blocks.html: Alchun moves his piece. All six sit on the yes side.
blocks.ko: 알천이 패를 옮긴다. 여섯이 모두 찬성 쪽에 앉는다.

blocks.title: Final vote · 최종 투표 6:0
blocks.caption: Deliberation turns the hung room. Six sleeves. The gate opens.
blocks.ko: 숙고가 미결을 뒤집는다. 소매 여섯. 문이 열린다.

en: …That boy Bidam has no fear in him at all.

blocks.html: “A woman’s body is soiled; it is no vessel for the Dharma. How could it attain supreme awakening?” … The girl said, “Use your divine power, and watch me become a Buddha. It will be quicker still than this.”
blocks.ko: 「여자의 몸은 때 묻고 더러워 법의 그릇이 아니거늘, 어찌 위없는 깨달음을 얻을 수 있겠는가.」 …… 용녀가 말하였다. 「그대의 신통력으로 내가 성불하는 것을 보라. 이보다 더 빠르리라.」
blocks.hanja: 「女身垢穢，非是法器，云何能得無上菩提。」……女言：「以汝神力，觀我成佛，復速於此。」
blocks.source: Lotus Sutra (妙法蓮華經) ch. 12, Devadatta (提婆達多品), tr. Kumārajīva · T09n0262, p. 35c

blocks.html: Across the floor, Yushin catches the Second Blade's eye. He and Bidam have been trading wins since they were boys in the yard. The count stands at one hundred and eight apiece. Neither lets the other stay ahead for long.
blocks.ko: 마루 건너, 유신이 제이검과 눈을 맞춘다. 그와 비담은 연무장 소년 시절부터 승패를 주고받아 왔다. 수는 백팔 대 백팔. 어느 쪽도 상대를 오래 앞서 두지 않는다.

en: Well stood.
Tomorrow on the yard — the hundred-and-ninth is mine.
Come now, brother.
Today is the country’s business. The blade can wait till tomorrow.

blocks.html: Every sleeve in that room learned to fight in one dead king’s yard. Who was he? Back we go, to the Cloud King…!
blocks.ko: 그 방의 소매들은 모두 한 죽은 왕의 연무장에서 컸다. 그는 누구였나? 거슬러 올라가자. 구름왕에게로…!

images.alt: Jinheung the Crescent Moon as a monumental commander under a silver crescent halo, Hwarang bowing in a circle
images.prompt: Anime-painterly crescent-halo blocking, cool monochrome, flat night field, no clouds.

images.alt: The Hwarang — Surabol yard — flower youth, steel breath
A crescent moon floating in vast Silla blue sky above mountain silhouettes - symbol of destiny
images.prompt: Iconic minimal composition: A single crescent moon in brilliant white against vast midnight blue negative space (Silla blue #3E79E4)

images.alt: A golden crown floating in Silla blue space, illuminated by crescent moon - destiny awaits
images.prompt: Cinematic legend: A young king's crown floating alone in vast Silla blue negative space, illuminated by a crescent moon

blocks.html: Ask anyone in Surabol about the Cloud King and they'll tell you about his stones. Ask anyone in Sabi and they'll change the subject. You'll find out why. Not yet.
blocks.ko: 서라벌 사람에게 구름왕을 물으면 그의 비석 이야기를 할 것이다. 사비 사람에게 물으면 말을 돌릴 것이다. 왜인지는 알게 된다. 아직은 아니다.

blocks.caption: The Cloud King’s shade, and where it fell.
blocks.ko: 구름왕의 그늘, 그리고 그 그늘이 드리운 곳.

blocks.html: He was seven when they put the crown on him. It was too big, and nobody mentioned it. By the end, Silla had a river, a coastline and Gaya. He got there by being the best ally in Samhan, right up until the afternoon he wasn't.
blocks.ko: 왕관을 쓸 때 그는 일곱 살이었다. 왕관은 너무 컸고, 아무도 그 말을 하지 않았다. 마지막엔 신라가 강 하나, 해안 하나, 그리고 가야를 쥐고 있었다. 그는 삼한에서 가장 믿을 만한 동맹이라서 거기까지 갔다. 믿을 수 없게 된 그 오후까지는.

blocks.caption: The Cloud King. Wherever he rides, the border rides after him.
blocks.ko: 구름의 왕. 그가 말을 달리면 국경이 뒤따라 달린다.

blocks.html: He put up stones wherever he stopped — four of them, on mountains, at the edges of what he had taken — and the stones do not boast. They say who came, and when, and that the land is now inside the border. They are property deeds.
blocks.ko: 그는 멈추는 곳마다 비를 세웠다. 넷을. 산 위에, 제가 취한 것의 가장자리에. 그 비들은 뽐내지 않는다. 누가 언제 왔는지, 그리고 이 땅이 이제 국경 안이라는 것을 적었을 뿐이다. 등기 문서다.

en: There is no boasting on this stone at all.

lines: 자랑은 뺏길 걱정을 하는 사람이 하는 거야.
en: Boasting is for men who are worried about losing it.

blocks.html: On the twenty-first day of the eighth month, in the first year of Taechang, the Great King Jinheung toured the lands in his keeping, and had this cut into stone. … And so the borders were carried out on every side, and people and land were won far and wide. Neighbouring countries swore good faith, and envoys of peace came and went.
blocks.ko: 태창 원년 무자년 8월 21일 계미일, 진흥태왕이 다스리는 땅을 순수하고 돌에 새겨 기록한다. …… 이로써 사방으로 경계를 넓혀 백성과 땅을 널리 얻었고, 이웃 나라는 신의를 맹세하였으며 화친의 사신이 오갔다.
blocks.hanja: 太昌元年歲次戊子八月卄一日癸未，眞興太王巡狩管境，刊石銘記也。……因斯四方託境，廣獲民土，隣國誓信，和使交通。
blocks.source: Jinheung Stele (眞興王巡狩碑), Maunnyeong stone (磨雲嶺碑), front face (568)

blocks.html: Late in his reign he invents the Hwarang. Take the noblest boys and put them in one yard. Make them ride, sing and rank each other until the ranking feels like fate. Nearly every man who matters later comes out of that yard.
blocks.ko: 말년에 그는 화랑을 만든다. 가장 귀한 집 소년들을 한 마당에 모은다. 말 타고 노래하고 서로 순위를 매기게 한다. 순위가 운명처럼 느껴질 때까지. 훗날 중요해지는 사내는 거의 다 그 마당에서 나온다.

blocks.html: One class a year. The number sticks to a man for life. Almost every sleeve on the Council first slept in that hall.
blocks.ko: 한 해에 한 기수. 그 숫자는 평생 따라다닌다. 화백의 소매들은 거의 다 그 방에서 처음 잤다.

blocks.hanja: 花郞
blocks.html: “Flower youths.” Noble sons in powder and silk, taught to ride, to sing, and to die, in about that order. The name is a joke. The enemy stopped laughing at it in the second generation.
blocks.ko: ‘꽃 같은 사내’. 분 바르고 비단 입은 귀족 자제들이 말 타기, 노래, 죽는 법을 대략 그 순서로 배운다. 이름은 농담이다. 적들은 두 번째 기수쯤에서 웃기를 그만뒀다.

blocks.html: Chunchu. Yushin. Bidam. Pumsuk. Alchun. Gwanchang. Wonsul. They are all, in the end, one old man’s idea about what to do with teenage boys.
blocks.ko: 춘추. 유신. 비담. 품석. 알천. 관창. 원술. 결국 그들 모두는, 십대 사내아이들을 어찌할 것인가에 대한 한 늙은 임금의 착상이다.

blocks.html: So Kim Daemun's Annals of the Hwarang says: "Worthy ministers and loyal subjects flowered here; fine generals and brave soldiers were born of it."
blocks.ko: 그러므로 김대문의 『화랑세기』에 이르기를, "어진 재상과 충성스러운 신하가 여기서 빼어나고, 훌륭한 장수와 용감한 병사가 이로 말미암아 났다"고 하였다.
blocks.hanja: 故金大問『花郞世記』曰：「賢佐忠臣，從此而秀，良將勇卒，由是而生。」
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 4, Silla Annals — King Jinheung, yr. 37 (576)

blocks.html: Near the end he shaved his head. The king of the four mountain stones put on a monk's robe and took a new name: Dharma Cloud. His queen went into a nunnery beside him. The court kept calling him Majesty. He kept answering to the other thing.
blocks.ko: 말년에 그는 머리를 깎았다. 네 산에 비석을 세운 왕이 승복을 입고 새 이름을 받았다. 법운. 법의 구름. 왕비도 그 곁 절로 들어갔다. 조정은 계속 전하라 불렀다. 그는 계속 다른 이름에 대답했다.

blocks.html: Long after the stones are mossed over, the old men of the capital still argue about what to call him. Not in the official registers — those keep to temple names — but in the quiet after the wine.
blocks.ko: 비가 이끼로 덮인 뒤에도, 도읍의 늙은이들은 그를 무엇이라 부를지 여전히 다툰다. 공식 기록에서는 — 거기엔 묘호만 남는다 — 술자리가 잦아든 뒤에야.

blocks.speaker: elder
lines: 진흥… 우리는 그분을 구름왕이라 불렀지. 마지막에 받은 그 이름 따라서.
구름엔 경계가 없거든. 가고 싶은 데로 가고, 한나절은 그 아래 땅이 다 제 땅이야.
en: Jinheung… we called him the Cloud King. After the name he took at the end.
A cloud has no border, you see. It goes where it likes, and for an afternoon the ground underneath is its ground.
That sounds like praise.

blocks.speaker: elder
lines: 그러다 그늘이 어디 드리웠는지 보게 돼. 관산. 한강. 가야.
구름은 누구 밭에 비를 뿌리는지 묻지 않아.
en: It was, for about a year.
Then you look at where the shade fell. Gwansan. The Han. Gaya.
A cloud never asks whose field it’s raining on.

blocks.html: That rain fell on Baekje’s field. Baekje kept the grudge. Now meet the prince who will inherit it…!
blocks.ko: 그 비가 내린 밭은 백제의 것이었다. 백제는 그 원한을 간직했다. 이제 그 원한을 물려받을 왕자를 만나 보자…!

blocks.html: Thirty-two is late to be named crown prince. By the time his father gets around to it, Euija has more than fifteen sons. The clans have had years to decide which ones they own.
blocks.ko: 서른둘이면 태자 책봉으로는 늦다. 아버지가 겨우 결심했을 때, 의자에겐 이미 아들이 열다섯 넘게 있다. 가문들은 그중 누구를 제 것으로 할지 정할 시간이 넉넉했다.

blocks.caption: Righteous and merciful. His father chose it. The son will spend his life deciding which half to keep.
blocks.ko: 옳음과 자비. 아버지가 지어 준 이름이다. 아들은 평생 그중 어느 쪽을 남길지 고른다.

blocks.hanja: 事親以孝 與兄弟以友 時號海東曾子
blocks.ko: 어버이를 섬김에 효로써 하고, 형제와 더불어 우애하니, 그때 해동증자라 일컬었다.
blocks.html: He served his parents with filial piety and treated his brothers with fraternal love; in his time he was called the Zengzi of the East of the Sea.
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 28, Baekje Annals — King Uija, accession notice; Lee Byong-do ed., vol. 1, p. 380 · cf. Jiu Tangshu (舊唐書) bk. 199上, Baekje

blocks.html: In Sabi the clans read the stars the way other courts read ledgers. Loyalty is the word they use when the door between king and house is still closed; after it opens, they use other words.
blocks.ko: 사비의 가문들은 다른 조정이 장부를 읽듯 별을 읽는다. 충성이란, 임금과 가문 사이 문이 아직 닫혀 있을 때 쓰는 말이고 — 문이 열리면 다른 말을 쓴다.

blocks.html: The king lives here. So do eight families who think that’s a detail.
blocks.ko: 임금이 사는 곳. 그걸 사소한 일로 여기는 여덟 가문도 산다.

en: …Fifteen?

lines: 폐하께서 쉰이 넘으시니 — 삼신께서 사비 몫으로 밤샘을 하시는 게지. 태자께서는 아직 여유가 있으신 셈이지.
en: His Majesty has over fifty — Samsin must keep a night shift just for Sabi. The Crown Prince is still comfortably behind.

blocks.html: This is said admiringly. It is that kind of court.
blocks.ko: 감탄하며 하는 말이다. 그런 조정이다.

blocks.html: The young princes grow up already spoken for. Yung is the eldest. Pung is eight and has good handwriting. Each boy wears a clan's ring, hears a clan's tutor, and finds a clan's grudge folded into his allowance.
blocks.ko: 어린 왕자들은 자라기도 전에 임자가 정해져 있다. 맏이는 융. 여덟 살 풍은 글씨를 잘 쓴다. 저마다 가문의 반지를 끼고, 가문의 스승 말을 듣고, 용돈엔 가문의 원한이 접혀 들어 있다.

lines: 됐다. 이제 저것들이 너한테 먼저 절하고, 흉은 그다음에 볼 게다.
en: Crown Prince.
There. Now they have to bow to you first and complain about you second.

lines: 서른두 해 동안 흉부터 봤지요, 아바마마.
en: They complained first for thirty-two years, Father.
I’ll take the bow.

blocks.html: Prince Euija (32)
blocks.ko: 의자태자 (32)

blocks.html: Euija sneaks out of the palace to explore the life of the common people.
blocks.ko: 의자는 궁을 몰래 빠져나가 백성들의 삶을 들여다본다.

blocks.html: The boy is going back into the water. He has been at it since morning, and he is not a strong swimmer.
blocks.ko: 소년이 또 물로 들어간다. 아침부터 저러고 있다. 헤엄을 잘 치는 것도 아니면서.

en: How many times have you gone in?
Nineteen.
…You were counting?
At twenty I would not come back out. That is why I count.

lines: 아, 이 미친 새끼야!! 그렇게 빨리 염라대왕 앞에 끌려가고 싶은거냐?!
en: Are you insane?! In that much of a hurry to stand before Yumla?!
I gave my word.

blocks.html: It takes a while to get it out of him.
blocks.ko: 사연을 듣기까지는 시간이 좀 걸린다.

blocks.html: The houses go first. Silk burns faster than timber. He is still wearing the clothes they dressed him in for the morning meal.
blocks.ko: 집이 먼저 간다. 비단은 나무보다 빨리 탄다. 그는 아직 아침밥 때 입혀 준 옷을 입고 있다.

blocks.html: They tell him to run and not say the name. He says it once, into his sleeve, and then he does not.
blocks.ko: 뛰되 이름은 말하지 말라고 한다. 그는 소매 안에다 한 번 말하고, 그다음엔 말하지 않는다.

blocks.html: After that he begs. The noble collar is dirty enough that nobody bows.
blocks.ko: 그다음엔 구걸한다. 귀족의 깃이 더러우면, 아무도 절하지 않는다.

en: A fine young man… what is your name?
I have… no name.

lines: ...어? 백제 땅에서 이름이 없는 게 말이 된다고 생각해?
en: …What? You think it makes sense to have no name, here in Baekje?
It’s the name of a great man.
How about — “Gyebek”?

blocks.caption: A boy with no name until a prince lent him one. He means to pay it back.
blocks.ko: 왕자가 이름을 빌려주기 전까지 이름이 없던 아이. 그는 그 빚을 갚을 작정이다.

blocks.name: Gyebek
blocks.ko: 계백
blocks.note: A rung and an elder. A man with no clan, named for a ladder.
blocks.noteKo: 섬돌 하나, 맏이 하나. 가문 없는 사내가 사다리의 이름을 달았다.

blocks.html: It is the White River — the wide mouth below Sabi where clan barges quarrel over winter space, and where boys who cannot swim keep trying anyway.
blocks.ko: 그곳은 백강이다 — 사비 아래 넓은 하구. 겨울 자리를 두고 씨족 뱃짐이 다투고, 헤엄칠 줄 모르는 소년들이 그래도 스무 번을 시도하는 물.

blocks.html: Wide, slow, and fought over one berth at a time.
blocks.ko: 넓고 느리고, 선착장 한 칸씩 싸움이 붙는 강.

lines: …그 이름이 마음에 드십니까, 제가 마음에 드십니까?
en: …Do you like the name, or do you like me?
…People don’t usually ask that.
I have to ask, or I do not know.

blocks.html: Prince Yung is the favored one to win — oldest, strongest, and backed the way favorites are always backed: by houses that have already counted what he will owe them. In the succession the clans are not watching. They are holding the brackets.
blocks.ko: 가장 유력한 이는 맏이이자 가장 강한 융 왕자다 — 그리고 유력한 자가 늘 그렇듯 뒷배가 있다. 그가 갚아야 할 것을 이미 다 셈해 둔 가문들이다. 이 계승에서 가문들은 구경하지 않는다. 대진을 쥐고 있다.

blocks.html: Eight houses. Eight fighting styles. One king between them. And every house has already picked a prince…!
blocks.ko: 여덟 가문. 여덟 가지 싸움법. 그 사이에 왕 하나. 그리고 가문마다 이미 왕자를 하나씩 골라 두었다…!

HEEWON STYLE: a Korean WEBTOON figure painted into a hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL world, in a SIMPLE, MINIMAL, ICONIC layout — the benchmark is a lone man in magenta silk walking down a storm-lit grass ridge toward his tied horse with an empty saddle: one diagonal, two subjects, half the frame storm sky, one cloud-break. FIGURES are webtoon / anime: clean digital-ink linework, simplified webtoon faces with expressive eyes, the face and hands keep that clean ink line, but the body and garments are PAINTED, never digitally shaded — broad loaded brushstrokes and dry-brush drag that follow each fold, the shading stepped in three or four painted value planes with soft broken edges, paper-and-canvas grain running right across the silk — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, never a smooth airbrushed gradient, never a 3D render (2.5D, see FORM). THE WORLD is WATERCOLOR FIRST, OIL SECOND: skies and ground in granulated wet-in-wet washes and short broken-colour dabs (Turner), dry-brush grass, dust and stone texture, soft bleeding edges, faint paper grain; the accent colour of the scene blooms into the wash near one frame edge and the frame edges dissolve into bare paper; oil only deepens the darks with rich umber-indigo glazes and adds a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. INTERIORS AND NIGHT SCENES are the webtoon figure painted into a European OLD-MASTER CANVAS — a Renaissance / Baroque TENEBRIST oil painting (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt): broken-colour brushwork, glazed umber-to-black darks, sfumato falloff, a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight, over faint watercolor blooms and paper grain; walls, timber, stone, drapery and tables pulled out of the darkness by the one lamp, window or shaft. The same oil-on-canvas texture covers EVERYTHING in the frame, the figures’ silk included — mottled plaster, gritty stone, brushed robes — so the webtoon figures sit INTO that painted space, lit by the same key and sharing its shadows, never pasted onto a flat backdrop. LAYOUT is MINIMAL AND ICONIC, staged like a Romanticist painting (Friedrich, Turner, Delacroix, Géricault): ONE device carries the frame (a ridge diagonal, a road, a waterline, a hall axis, a table ring, a gate) with ONE or TWO subjects placed on the thirds; at least half the frame is quiet negative space (storm sky, empty field, dark floor, bare wall); distant detail stays tiny and dissolving (a line of banners or roofs in haze); no crowds, no clutter, nothing competing with the subject. Heroic diagonal or pyramid, small figures against a sublime sky or vast field, or a bold worm’s-eye / straight-down angle. BLOCKING IS THE RELATIONSHIP: when two people share a frame, the still reads like a history painting with the faces covered — who stands higher and who kneels, the distance or contact between them, whose hand rests on whom, where each one looks (at each other, past each other, the same way), and how their cast shadows meet on the wall or floor; one gesture between them carries the whole bond. LIGHT is movie tenebrism at full strength: 70–85% of the frame sinks into deep painted shadow (oil-glazed umber, indigo, black), an extreme value range with near-white highlights right beside inky black and almost no middle grey; big dark masses (storm cloud, shadowed slope, umber room, black floor) against ONE bright break — a single cloud-break, low sun shaft, lamp or window — that lands on the subject; inky darks right beside small near-white highlights, few middle greys in the subject; ONE hard directional key carves the subject out of the dark. FORM IS 2.5D — drawn webtoon line on the outside, sculpted painted volume on the inside (the interior benchmark: a bearded emperor in yellow silk standing at a stone relief, under-lit by an oil lamp set on the floor beside the lens, palm on the carved horse, his shadow climbing the wall): the key is a PRACTICAL light IN or just outside the frame, CLOSE to the subject, RAKING ACROSS the surfaces the camera sees from below or from the side — never from behind them. So every silk fold protrudes, built the way an oil painter builds it: the lit side of each fold laid in with one opaque loaded stroke, the turn into shadow a crisp painted edge, the shadow side a thin transparent umber glaze with a little warm floor-light dragged into it, brush direction following the fold; gold thread and the brightest ridges flicked in with impasto; cheekbones, beard, knuckles, armor plates and horse muscle are painted the same way. The subject is large in frame (medium or closer, worm’s-eye or low three-quarter) so the folds resolve, and the light falls off into black across the body — that falloff is the darkness. Never a garment filled with one flat colour; never a subject backlit into a flat silhouette with only an edge line (if the camera is behind someone, the key still comes from the side and models their back and shoulder); never a wall flat to the lens — walls and floors recede at an angle so cast shadows can climb them. A thin edge of the same real light may graze the far side of the silhouette to lift it off the background (never a glow outline); long raking shadows. TEXTURE IS TACTILE RELIEF — the raking key exists to reveal it: thick oil impasto that stands up off the canvas on the lit side of every surface, loaded-brush and palette-knife ridges the eye can almost touch. Cloth: heavy silk in deep ridged folds, raised gold embroidery and brocade threads catching pin-point specular, quilted collars, layered sleeves with real thickness, beads and pins as small sculpted volumes. Buildings and ground just as sculpted: carved, weathered timber grain on pillars and brackets, every giwa roof tile and end-cap a rounded relief with its own shadow, rough-cut stone blocks, cracked lime plaster, lattice in deep relief throwing crisp little shadows, packed earth with grit and footprints. Never a smooth flat wall, never a plain colour-fill robe. Default hour is dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat overcast, never even daylight, never a bright open sky filling the frame. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. SEPARATION: subject and background never share a value — the lit subject sits in the one pool of light and everything behind it drops three or more steps to near-black (or, reversed, a dark figure against the single bright opening); foreground shapes almost black; the eye lands on the subject first. SHOT VARIETY AND NEGATIVE SPACE: across a set of stills alternate INTIMATE CLOSE-UPS (faces and hands filling the frame, the background a dark blur) with FAR WIDES (the figures small in a lower corner or third, 60% or more of the canvas left as quiet negative space — black hall, night sky, dark water, bare wall — that makes the small lit figures strike). RENAISSANCE CANVAS, CARTOON FIGURES: the world is composed and painted like a Renaissance / Baroque master (Leonardo’s sfumato, Titian’s glazes, Raphael’s pyramids, Caravaggio’s darkness), but every face stays a clean-lined webtoon / anime face — big expressive eyes, simple nose and mouth, smooth cel-like skin with one or two shadow tones — never photographic skin, pores or realistic facial anatomy. COLOR SYMBOLISM reads at a glance: each kingdom's colour lives in its banners and cloth (Silla blue, Baekje yellow, Goguryeo red, Tang vermilion and gold), each named person's hex in the key light on them, and the rest of the frame stays desaturated umber, slate and black so those few colours sing. HORSES are drawn to be admired: the whole body readable, arched neck, deep chest, round haunch, clean legs in a true gait, muscle modelled by the key with a bright edge along the topline. 2.5D painterly cinema — drawn webtoon faces, everything else brushed with visible strokes and canvas grain — not photoreal, not live-action, not a smooth digital airbrush or 3D render, not flat cel fill. images.prompt: Minimal iconic 2:1 still composed like a symbolic old-master history painting — the AGEING FATHER AND THE AMBITIOUS, CYNICAL SON. FAR WIDE, low angle: the Sabi throne hall as a vast black space, the two figures small in the lower third. Old King Mu (grey topknot and beard, red robe, no crown) sits hunched on the lowest dais step reading a long unrolled register by a bronze brazier set on the floor, the only light. Above him at the top of the steps Euija (grey linen jeogori, yellow headband, light stubble) leans on a red pillar with his arms folded, looking down at his father with a crooked half-smile. ONE DEVICE: the brazier throws Euija’s shadow enormous up the dark wall toward the empty throne — the biggest shape in the picture. Negative space: the dark wall and black rafters filling the upper two-thirds. Faces drawn, matching the attached portraits. No text. CANON — KING MU — FACE and garments from attached /ch_mu.png (face only; invent a new pose). #b8862c as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. | BUYEO EUIJA — FACE and garments from attached /ch_euija_young.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Broad, bearded king; black hair in a topknot with a yellow-gold headband whose tails trail; heavy brows, cynical eyes. Dress: Crimson robe with a dark charcoal collar and gold trim; a steel lamellar pauldron peeking at one shoulder. Demeanor: Licensed wit: drinks, smirks, slumps on the throne, speaks in polished aphorisms. Fatalist. #e08a2e as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: heroic battle pose; smiling innocence. | PLACE Sabi (사비 (부여)) — attached board /pl_sabi_palace.png; keep this exact architecture and ground. Sabi palace on the Baengma river bluffs; Baekje giwa halls and pavilions. HEEWON STYLE: a Korean WEBTOON figure painted into a hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL world, in a SIMPLE, MINIMAL, ICONIC layout — the benchmark is a lone man in magenta silk walking down a storm-lit grass ridge toward his tied horse with an empty saddle: one diagonal, two subjects, half the frame storm sky, one cloud-break. FIGURES are webtoon / anime: clean digital-ink linework, simplified webtoon faces with expressive eyes, the face and hands keep that clean ink line, but the body and garments are PAINTED, never digitally shaded — broad loaded brushstrokes and dry-brush drag that follow each fold, the shading stepped in three or four painted value planes with soft broken edges, paper-and-canvas grain running right across the silk — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, never a smooth airbrushed gradient, never a 3D render (2.5D, see FORM). THE WORLD is WATERCOLOR FIRST, OIL SECOND: skies and ground in granulated wet-in-wet washes and short broken-colour dabs (Turner), dry-brush grass, dust and stone texture, soft bleeding edges, faint paper grain; the accent colour of the scene blooms into the wash near one frame edge and the frame edges dissolve into bare paper; oil only deepens the darks with rich umber-indigo glazes and adds a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. INTERIORS AND NIGHT SCENES are the webtoon figure painted into a European OLD-MASTER CANVAS — a Renaissance / Baroque TENEBRIST oil painting (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt): broken-colour brushwork, glazed umber-to-black darks, sfumato falloff, a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight, over faint watercolor blooms and paper grain; walls, timber, stone, drapery and tables pulled out of the darkness by the one lamp, window or shaft. The same oil-on-canvas texture covers EVERYTHING in the frame, the figures’ silk included — mottled plaster, gritty stone, brushed robes — so the webtoon figures sit INTO that painted space, lit by the same key and sharing its shadows, never pasted onto a flat backdrop. LAYOUT is MINIMAL AND ICONIC, staged like a Romanticist painting (Friedrich, Turner, Delacroix, Géricault): ONE device carries the frame (a ridge diagonal, a road, a waterline, a hall axis, a table ring, a gate) with ONE or TWO subjects placed on the thirds; at least half the frame is quiet negative space (storm sky, empty field, dark floor, bare wall); distant detail stays tiny and dissolving (a line of banners or roofs in haze); no crowds, no clutter, nothing competing with the subject. Heroic diagonal or pyramid, small figures against a sublime sky or vast field, or a bold worm’s-eye / straight-down angle. BLOCKING IS THE RELATIONSHIP: when two people share a frame, the still reads like a history painting with the faces covered — who stands higher and who kneels, the distance or contact between them, whose hand rests on whom, where each one looks (at each other, past each other, the same way), and how their cast shadows meet on the wall or floor; one gesture between them carries the whole bond. LIGHT is movie tenebrism at full strength: 70–85% of the frame sinks into deep painted shadow (oil-glazed umber, indigo, black), an extreme value range with near-white highlights right beside inky black and almost no middle grey; big dark masses (storm cloud, shadowed slope, umber room, black floor) against ONE bright break — a single cloud-break, low sun shaft, lamp or window — that lands on the subject; inky darks right beside small near-white highlights, few middle greys in the subject; ONE hard directional key carves the subject out of the dark. FORM IS 2.5D — drawn webtoon line on the outside, sculpted painted volume on the inside (the interior benchmark: a bearded emperor in yellow silk standing at a stone relief, under-lit by an oil lamp set on the floor beside the lens, palm on the carved horse, his shadow climbing the wall): the key is a PRACTICAL light IN or just outside the frame, CLOSE to the subject, RAKING ACROSS the surfaces the camera sees from below or from the side — never from behind them. So every silk fold protrudes, built the way an oil painter builds it: the lit side of each fold laid in with one opaque loaded stroke, the turn into shadow a crisp painted edge, the shadow side a thin transparent umber glaze with a little warm floor-light dragged into it, brush direction following the fold; gold thread and the brightest ridges flicked in with impasto; cheekbones, beard, knuckles, armor plates and horse muscle are painted the same way. The subject is large in frame (medium or closer, worm’s-eye or low three-quarter) so the folds resolve, and the light falls off into black across the body — that falloff is the darkness. Never a garment filled with one flat colour; never a subject backlit into a flat silhouette with only an edge line (if the camera is behind someone, the key still comes from the side and models their back and shoulder); never a wall flat to the lens — walls and floors recede at an angle so cast shadows can climb them. A thin edge of the same real light may graze the far side of the silhouette to lift it off the background (never a glow outline); long raking shadows. TEXTURE IS TACTILE RELIEF — the raking key exists to reveal it: thick oil impasto that stands up off the canvas on the lit side of every surface, loaded-brush and palette-knife ridges the eye can almost touch. Cloth: heavy silk in deep ridged folds, raised gold embroidery and brocade threads catching pin-point specular, quilted collars, layered sleeves with real thickness, beads and pins as small sculpted volumes. Buildings and ground just as sculpted: carved, weathered timber grain on pillars and brackets, every giwa roof tile and end-cap a rounded relief with its own shadow, rough-cut stone blocks, cracked lime plaster, lattice in deep relief throwing crisp little shadows, packed earth with grit and footprints. Never a smooth flat wall, never a plain colour-fill robe. Default hour is dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat overcast, never even daylight, never a bright open sky filling the frame. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. SEPARATION: subject and background never share a value — the lit subject sits in the one pool of light and everything behind it drops three or more steps to near-black (or, reversed, a dark figure against the single bright opening); foreground shapes almost black; the eye lands on the subject first. SHOT VARIETY AND NEGATIVE SPACE: across a set of stills alternate INTIMATE CLOSE-UPS (faces and hands filling the frame, the background a dark blur) with FAR WIDES (the figures small in a lower corner or third, 60% or more of the canvas left as quiet negative space — black hall, night sky, dark water, bare wall — that makes the small lit figures strike). RENAISSANCE CANVAS, CARTOON FIGURES: the world is composed and painted like a Renaissance / Baroque master (Leonardo’s sfumato, Titian’s glazes, Raphael’s pyramids, Caravaggio’s darkness), but every face stays a clean-lined webtoon / anime face — big expressive eyes, simple nose and mouth, smooth cel-like skin with one or two shadow tones — never photographic skin, pores or realistic facial anatomy. COLOR SYMBOLISM reads at a glance: each kingdom's colour lives in its banners and cloth (Silla blue, Baekje yellow, Goguryeo red, Tang vermilion and gold), each named person's hex in the key light on them, and the rest of the frame stays desaturated umber, slate and black so those few colours sing. FACES stay drawn: match the attached portrait's line weight, eye shape and simplification exactly — if a face starts to read as a photograph, flatten it back to ink line and wash; extras are drawn the same way, never photographic. HORSES are drawn to be admired: the whole body readable, arched neck, deep chest, round haunch, clean legs in a true gait, muscle modelled by the key with a bright edge along the topline. 2.5D painterly cinema — drawn webtoon faces, everything else brushed with visible strokes and canvas grain — not photoreal, not live-action, not a smooth digital airbrush or 3D render, not flat cel fill. Same film stock every still: a CAMERA in a real Korean place — anamorphic 2:1 movie frame, shallow DOF, creamy bokeh, rack-focus, film grain, crushed blacks, ONE hard key, long shadows, tenebrism. MOVIE FRAME of the scene a DP could stand in — NEVER a graphic poster, split-screen collage, 3D architectural visualization, black-triangle overlay, spotlight cone deleting the landscape, or neon outline. NO halo, bloom, glow aura, rim-aura, emissive skin, or god-ray envelope around people — character hex is the color of REAL LIGHT in the dark (key bounce, specular on silk/armor/wet stone, a lamp, a shaft, a floor reflection), never a body halo, never magic outline, never neon-painting the figure. FACE ONLY from the attached portrait — silk/hanbok may match; NEVER copy the portrait stance, clasped hands, 3/4 fashion lineup, or a standing clone. Invent a new DRAMATIC body every still (mid-stride, kneel, full-draw, turn, tumble, lean, count, dutch, worm’s-eye, lower-third). CINEMATOGRAPHY: name the shot — dutch angle, worm’s-eye, crane, over-shoulder, rack focus, shallow DOF / bokeh, chiaroscuro, mise-en-scène, long-shadow key. HIGH CONTRAST: crushed blacks + one hard key / long shadows / tenebrism — not even daylight wash, not a flat tourist postcard. ICONIC MINIMAL means one architectural device a lens can see (road, column, waterline, gate, hall axis) plus empty negative space — not deleting the world. COLOR SYMBOLISM: hex tints the hard key / catchlight / bounce — NEVER a glow aura, NEVER recolor the attached portrait’s garments (Sosuno stays dusty-rose hanbok, Geumwa stays red-burgundy court silk, not gold paint). FACE AND CLOTHES match the attached ch_*.png. One of each named person — NEVER clone or duplicate a character. People stand on packed earth at a well RIM — NEVER inside the well shaft. Jumong is fun-loving and laid-back: grin, laugh, wink, easy eyes — not a grim founder mask. BATTLE ARMOR: metallic GRAY steel lamellar (attached steel-armor ref); cloth peeks in the character hex — not gold-painted plate, not glowing armor, not a standing armor catalog. RING-POMMEL SWORDS: one-handed hip 환두대도 from attached sw_bidam.png — handle:blade 1:3; order is RING (pommel at heel of fist) → short grip → thin gold collar → long blade → point. Never reverse handle and blade. Never a tsuba disc in the middle. Never taller than the person. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only — do not attach it on full-blade stills. Ignore swords on face portraits. Two people = two garment-true figures against crushed black. Real Korean architecture or a locked dark room. No army. No readable text. No watermark. blocks.html: Satek. Yunbi. Jinmo. Mokli. Hae. Baek. Guk. Ahn.
blocks.ko: 사택. 연비. 진모. 목리. 해. 백. 국. 안.

blocks.html: The Eight Great Clans run this country, and one king sits between them. Satek fights with the king's sleeve. Yunbi fights with the coast road. The other six keep their techniques quiet.
blocks.ko: 여덟 대성이 이 나라를 쥐고, 그 사이에 왕 하나가 앉아 있다. 사택은 왕의 소매로 싸운다. 연비는 해안 길로 싸운다. 나머지 여섯은 제 수법을 입 밖에 내지 않는다.

blocks.html: The great surnames of the country are eight clans: Sa, Yeon, Hyeop, Hae, Jin, Guk, Mok and Baek.
blocks.ko: 나라 안의 큰 성씨는 여덟 족이니, 사씨·연씨·협씨·해씨·진씨·국씨·목씨·백씨이다.
blocks.hanja: 國中大姓有八族，沙氏、燕氏、刕氏、解氏、貞氏、國氏、木氏、苩氏。
blocks.source: Sui Shu (隋書) bk. 81, Eastern Barbarians — Baekje

blocks.hanja: 大姓八族
blocks.html: The eight great surnames. Not a council and not a party. Eight families, each older than most kings, each with a seat on the rock, a berth on the river and a grudge against at least two of the others. The royal Buyeo house sits above them. Usually.
blocks.ko: 여덟 큰 성씨. 회의도 아니고 당파도 아니다. 집안 여덟, 하나하나가 웬만한 임금보다 오래됐고, 저마다 바위 위의 자리, 강가의 부두, 그리고 적어도 둘에 대한 원한을 하나씩 가졌다. 그 위에 왕실 부여씨가 앉는다. 대개는.

blocks.hanja: 沙宅
blocks.html: The king’s sleeve. A Satek queen, a Satek premier, and a Satek tutor behind the eldest prince’s chair.
blocks.ko: 왕의 소매. 사택 왕비, 사택 상좌평, 그리고 맏왕자 의자 뒤에 선 사택 스승.

blocks.hanja: 燕比
blocks.html: The coast road, from Sabi to the salt. They rolled in from the north four hundred years ago, and the Satek have never let them forget it.
blocks.ko: 사비에서 소금밭까지, 해안 길. 사백 년 전 북쪽에서 굴러 들어왔고, 사택은 그걸 한 번도 잊게 두지 않았다.

blocks.hanja: 眞牟
blocks.html: The prestige house. Old money and high swords: a Jinmo boy lifts his blade over his head and dares you.
blocks.ko: 명문가. 오래된 돈, 높은 칼. 진모 소년은 칼을 머리 위로 들고 덤벼 보라 한다.

blocks.hanja: 木刕
blocks.html: Timber and the eastern berths. They look across the sea to Yamato more often than they look up at the throne.
blocks.ko: 목재와 동쪽 부두. 왕좌를 올려다보는 것보다 바다 건너 왜를 바라보는 일이 더 잦다.

blocks.hanja: 解
blocks.html: Coast salt, and the oldest name on the rock. Hae boys wrestle low and hook a leg before you know you’ve lost.
blocks.ko: 해안의 소금, 그리고 바위 위에서 가장 오래된 이름. 해씨 소년은 낮게 붙어, 진 줄 알기도 전에 다리를 건다.

blocks.hanja: 苩
blocks.html: A quiet house with a long memory. The last time a Baek lost patience with a king, the king did not survive it.
blocks.ko: 조용한 집안, 긴 기억. 백씨가 마지막으로 임금에게 참을성을 잃었을 때, 그 임금은 살아남지 못했다.

blocks.hanja: 國
blocks.html: Their name means “country,” and they never let a meeting forget it. Guk boys win with the hip.
blocks.ko: 이름이 ‘나라’라서, 어느 회의에서도 그걸 잊게 두지 않는다. 국씨 소년은 엉덩이로 이긴다.

blocks.hanja: 安
blocks.html: The smallest seat on the rock, and the hardest to buy. Every close vote in Sabi ends up at an Ahn door, and leaves it unpaid.
blocks.ko: 바위 위에서 가장 작은 자리, 그리고 가장 사기 어려운 자리. 사비의 아슬아슬한 표는 결국 안씨 집 문 앞에 닿고, 값을 못 치른 채 돌아간다.

blocks.html: Once a year, the court chalks a square grid in the palace yard. Four hard lines. No banners. The young men of each house step onto the grid in white. It's the same quarrel as the west bridge, only without the carts.
blocks.ko: 해마다 한 번, 궁은 마당에 네모난 격자를 분필로 긋는다. 단단한 선 넷. 깃발은 없다. 각 가문의 젊은이들이 흰옷을 입고 격자에 오른다. 서쪽 다리에서 하던 그 싸움이다. 수레만 없을 뿐.

en: White cloth. Wooden swords.
If anyone bleeds the wrong colour, the berth talks stop for a month.
lines: 엉뚱한 색으로 피 보면, 선석 얘기는 한 달 쉰다.

blocks.caption: Head of the Yunbi. The family business is knowing things first.
blocks.ko: 연비 가문의 어른. 이 집안의 생업은 남보다 먼저 아는 것이다.

en: Then keep your boys’ wrists honest.
The chalk does not care whose sleeve they hold.
lines: 그럼 너희 애들 손목을 바르게 두게.
분필은 누구 소매를 잡았는지 안 본다.

blocks.html: Swords first. Wooden ones, which still remember steel. A Jinmo boy holds his blade high. A Satek boy answers from the middle. On the call they both move. Blades skim the chalk. The white sleeves clap together so close that the steps gasp.
blocks.ko: 칼부터. 목검이다. 아직 쇠를 기억하는 나무. 진모 소년이 칼을 높이 든다. 사택 소년은 중단에서 받는다. 구령이 떨어지자 둘이 동시에 움직인다. 칼날이 분필 위를 스친다. 흰 소매가 맞부딪는 소리에 계단이 숨을 삼킨다.

en: That Jinmo boy?
Short wrists.
Feet faster than the Satek though.
Point to the white sleeve.

blocks.html: When the wooden points are tallied, the sand comes out. A circle of grit inside the same square. Ssireum — satba locked before they stand, knees in the grit, equal grips on waist and thigh, then up without letting go. No circling for a hold. The bout is the hold.
blocks.ko: 목검 점수가 쌓이면 모래가 나온다. 같은 네모 안에 모래 원. 씨름 — 일어서기 전에 샅바부터 잠근다. 무릎은 모래에, 허리와 허벅지 샅바를 같은 힘으로 잡고, 놓지 않은 채로 일어선다. 잡고 돌 틈이 없다. 붙잡은 것이 곧 시합이다.

blocks.html: A Hae boy hooks a leg. A Guk boy answers with his hip. He lifts, he turns, and the other boy's feet leave the earth. The yard goes quiet the way a dock goes quiet when a rope snaps. Sand takes the shoulder. The chalk does not argue.
blocks.ko: 해 소년이 다리를 건다. 국 소년이 엉덩이로 받는다. 들어 올리고, 돌리고, 상대의 발이 땅을 떠난다. 밧줄 끊긴 부두처럼 마당이 조용해진다. 모래가 어깨를 받는다. 분필은 따지지 않는다.

en: See?
Even Yunbi can fall without a cart.
Your boy’s knee touched first.
Ask the chalk.
Elders watch from the hall steps — they always do — and still count wrong when it is their sleeve.
lines: 원로들은 섬돌에서 본다 — 늘 보지 — 그래도 제 소매 일이면 잘못 센다.

blocks.html: By dusk the white is grey with chalk and grit. Nobody has settled four generations of anything. The throne likes it that way. The boys go home with a score instead of a funeral.
blocks.ko: 해 질 녘, 흰옷은 분필과 모래로 잿빛이 된다. 사대에 걸친 무엇 하나 결판나지 않았다. 왕좌는 그게 좋다. 소년들은 장례 대신 점수를 들고 집에 간다.

blocks.html: The Satek clan is currently the most powerful. Both the Queen and the Premier are from the Satek clan, making them a key rival to the royal Buyeo clan.
blocks.ko: 지금 가장 강한 가문은 사택씨다. 왕비도 재상도 사택씨 — 왕실 부여씨의 최대 맞수다.

blocks.html: On the ninth day of the first month of the gapin year, Satek Jijuk of Naegi Fortress, grieving that the body's days slip away so easily and that its months never come back, cut gold to build a precious hall and carved jade to raise a jewelled pagoda.
blocks.ko: 갑인년 정월 9일, 내기성의 사택지적은 몸의 날이 쉬이 가는 것을 슬퍼하고 몸의 달이 다시 돌아오기 어려움을 탄식하여, 금을 뚫어 진귀한 법당을 짓고 옥을 깎아 보배로운 탑을 세웠다.
blocks.hanja: 甲寅年正月九日柰祇城砂宅智積，慷身日之易往，慨體月之難還，穿金以建珍堂，鑿玉以立寶塔。
blocks.source: Sataek Jijeok Stele (砂宅智積碑), Buyeo (654)

blocks.html: Elder Satek
blocks.ko: 사택 원로

blocks.html: Minister Satek
blocks.ko: 사택 재상

blocks.html: Queen Satek
blocks.ko: 사택 왕후

blocks.html: Satek Chunbok
blocks.ko: 사택천복

blocks.html: In the Assembly they fight for power, each house holding a share of the king's sons. They fight in the street too. Same fight. The street version is older.
blocks.ko: 회의에서 그들은 권력을 두고 싸운다. 가문마다 왕의 아들 몇씩을 쥐고서. 거리에서도 싸운다. 같은 싸움이다. 거리 쪽이 더 오래됐다.

blocks.hanja: 政事巖
blocks.html: The Rock of Government. Long ago Baekje’s lords chose their premier by sealing three names in a box and leaving it on this rock overnight. Whichever name the rock had marked by morning got the chair. The rock still sweats before a vote. The votes still go to whoever paid for them.
blocks.ko: 정사를 보는 바위. 옛날 백제의 귀족들은 이름 셋을 함에 봉해 이 바위 위에 하룻밤 두었다. 아침에 바위가 표시해 둔 이름이 재상 자리에 앉았다. 바위는 지금도 표결 전에 땀을 흘린다. 표는 지금도 값을 치른 쪽으로 간다.

blocks.title: 정사암회의 · The Ministers’ Assembly
blocks.caption: The council that meets at the rock. One Prime Minister, the Senior Ministers beside him, the Junior Ministers below. Seats go by title. Titles go by clan.
blocks.ko: 바위에서 열리는 회의. 상좌평 하나, 그 곁에 좌평들, 아래에 달솔들. 자리는 관등을 따르고, 관등은 가문을 따른다.

blocks.html: Unlike Silla’s Harmony Council, the Assembly does not require every voice. A plurality of houses is enough — which is why the street fights matter. Votes can be bought in pieces. In Surabol they must be bought entire, or not at all.
blocks.ko: 신라 화백과 달리, 정사암회의는 모든 목소리를 요구하지 않는다. 가문의 다수면 족하다 — 그래서 저잣거리 싸움이 중요하다. 표는 조각으로 살 수 있다. 서라벌에서는 통째로 사거나, 아예 못 산다.

blocks.html: What the Assembly votes on, more often than war, is water. Who loads first. Whose ships winter in the river mouth. Who gets the orange levy, and who gets the silk berth. In this country, a clan without a harbour can't feed a fight.
blocks.ko: 회의가 전쟁보다 자주 표결하는 건 물이다. 누가 먼저 싣는가. 누구 배가 강어귀에서 겨울을 나는가. 귤 공물은 누가, 비단 선석은 누가 갖는가. 이 나라에서 항구 없는 가문은 싸움을 먹여 살리지 못한다.

en: Yunbi talks of blood.
We talk of berths.
Blood cools. A winter anchorage does not.
lines: 피는 식는다. 겨울 정박은 안 식는다.

en: You hold the king’s sleeve and call it a harbour.
We hold the coast road. Sabi to the salt. Every cart that fears rain pays us in quiet.
lines: 너희는 임금의 소매를 잡고 그걸 항구라 부르는군.
우리는 해안길을 잡는다. 사비에서 소금까지. 비를 무서워하는 수레는 하나같이 조용히 값을 치르고.

blocks.html: Satek and Yunbi have been at it for four generations. Nobody alive can say what started it. Everybody alive can list the last six things.
blocks.ko: 사택과 연비는 사대째 그러고 있다. 무엇 때문에 시작됐는지는 살아 있는 누구도 대지 못한다. 최근 여섯 건은 살아 있는 누구나 댄다.

lines: 연비네 애들이 어제 서시 다리에서 사택네 짐수레를 엎었다더라.
그럼 오늘 밤엔 사택네가 연비네 담을 넘겠구먼.
en: The Yunbi boys turned a Satek cart over at the west bridge yesterday.
Then tonight the Satek go over a Yunbi wall.
Same as the lantern festival last year.
Last year three of them died.

lines: 연비는 백제의 피가 아니오. 북에서 굴러들어 온 것들이지.
en: Yunbi is not Baekje blood. They rolled in from the north.

blocks.speaker: 🎗 Yunbi
en: We rolled in four hundred years ago.
Does that not make us Baekje by now?

lines: 사백 년 굴러들어 왔으면, 사백 년 굴러 나가면 되지.
en: Four hundred years rolling in. Four hundred rolling out.

blocks.speaker: 🎗 Yunbi
lines: 사택은 임금의 소매를 붙들고 사는 집안이오.
우리는 소매를 붙들지 않소. 팔을 붙들지.
en: Satek is a house that lives by holding the king’s sleeve.
We do not hold the sleeve. We hold the arm.

blocks.html: Neither house has ever won, and nothing about that is accidental: the throne needs both of them standing. A clan with no rival starts watching the throne.
blocks.ko: 어느 집안도 이긴 적이 없고, 거기에 우연은 조금도 없다. 왕좌는 둘이 다 서 있기를 바란다 — 미워할 상대가 없는 가문은 왕좌를 보기 시작한다.

blocks.html: The rivalry has a quieter register, too — the kind that never makes the street. Each house keeps a clerk in the other’s counting-room. Each house denies it. Every third Assembly, someone finds a cup under a floorboard that was not there when the session opened, and both sides pretend to be shocked.
blocks.ko: 다툼에는 더 조용한 층도 있다 — 저잣거리에 절대 안 나오는 종류. 양쪽 다 상대 가문의 회계방에 서리 하나를 심어 둔다. 양쪽 다 부인다. 정사암회의 세 번 중 한 번은, 열릴 때 없던 잔이 마루 밑에서 나오고, 양쪽이 다 놀란 척한다.

lines: 연비 쪽에서 사택 회의 내용을 벌써 안다더라.
그럼 둘 다 알고, 둘 다 모르는 척하는 거지.
en: They say Yunbi already knows what was said in the Satek meeting.
And Satek already knows the Yunbi one.
So both know, and both pretend not to.
That’s politics.

blocks.html: Once, both houses secretly agreed to kill a grain levy. It came to the Assembly anyway. The votes lined up as counted. Then Elder Satek, who had nodded all morning, turned his thumb down at the last call. The levy died. Yunbi's men stared. His own men stared harder. He never explained.
blocks.ko: 한번은 두 가문이 몰래 없애기로 한 곡세가 그대로 회의에 올라왔다. 표는 계산대로 갈렸다. 그런데 아침 내내 고개를 끄덕이던 사택 원로가 마지막 호명에서 엄지를 내렸다. 곡세는 죽었다. 연비 쪽이 쳐다봤다. 제 사람들이 더 세게 쳐다봤다. 그는 끝내 설명하지 않았다.

blocks.html: 👑 King Mu (71)

lines: 연비 공… 만나 뵙게 되어 영광이—
en: Lord Yunbi… an honour to—
Lord Satek… a new—

lines: 아버지... 이런 가문 싸움에 전 관심이 없습니다.
en: Father… I have no interest in these clan quarrels.
A king should be for the country—

lines: 얘야… 그래도 저들 이름은 외워 두어라.
…나도 좋아서 외운 게 아니다. 그래도 내가 먼저 부른다.
en: My child… learn their names anyway.
…I did not like mine either. I still say them first.

blocks.html: “Restore the reign of the thirteenth Eraha!” Every house in Sabi still chants it. To hear why, we go back three hundred years…!
blocks.ko: “열셋째 어라하의 치세를 다시 이루소서!” 사비의 가문들은 지금도 그 말을 외친다. 왜인지 들으려면 삼백 년을 거슬러 가야 한다…!

images.alt: Geunchogo as one gold-red rider on a ridge above real Pyongyang walls on the Taedong
images.at: Restore the reign of the thirteenth Eraha.
images.prompt: Cinematic historical still, 16:9. REAL Pyongyang on the Taedong. One rider. Face matches attached portrait. No kneeling crowd. Flat dusk sky, no clouds. Painterly cinema. No text, no watermark.

images.alt: Dutch: one fire on the Pyongyang wall — Geunchogo tiny on the near bank
images.prompt: Minimal iconic 16:9 still. DUTCH across a REAL Pyongyang wall/river — architecture from attached fortress and city place refs. ONE device: a single fire-plane on the stone wall as the only accent. Tiny Geunchogo mid-stride on the near bank — FACE from attached portrait, NEW body, not standing clone. Natural dusk sky. Crushed blacks, long shadows. No arrow rain. No army carpet. No text. No watermark. 2D animated cel-painterly cinema, not photoreal, not live-action, not 3D CGI. Same film stock: anamorphic movie frame, shallow DOF, creamy bokeh, rack-focus, film grain. A CAMERA in a real Korean place — NEVER a graphic poster, split-screen collage, 3D archviz, black-triangle overlay, spotlight cone deleting the landscape, or neon outline. NO halo, bloom, glow, rim-aura, or god-ray envelope around people — light is a plane or a hard key. FACE AND GARMENTS from the attached portrait — NEVER copy the portrait stance, clasped hands, 3/4 fashion lineup, or a standing clone. Invent a new DRAMATIC body every still (mid-stride, kneel, dutch, worm’s-eye, lower-third). CINEMATOGRAPHY: dutch, crane, worm’s-eye, over-shoulder, rack focus, shallow DOF / bokeh, chiaroscuro. HIGH CONTRAST: crushed blacks + one hard key + long shadows — not even daylight wash. ICONIC MINIMAL: ONE architectural device a lens can see; empty negative space; tiny figures or lower-third; the world stays in the shot. COLOR SYMBOLISM: hex is lighting / a plane / one accent — NEVER recolor portrait garments gold. Real Korean architecture: grey giwa, timber, packed earth. No army. No readable text. No watermark.

images.at: Restore the reign of the thirteenth Eraha.
images.alt: Empty Sabi street at dusk — one yellow banner, two or three tiny chanters
images.prompt: Cinematic historical still, 16:9. REAL Sabi market street. One yellow banner. Two or three tiny figures. No crowd. Flat dusk sky, no clouds. Painterly cinema. No text, no watermark.

blocks.html: Baekje’s thirteenth king marches north to Pyongyang. A Goguryeo king dies on his own wall. In seven hundred years, it never happens again.
blocks.ko: 백제의 열셋째 임금이 북쪽 평양으로 진군한다. 고구려 임금이 제 성벽 위에서 죽는다. 칠백 년 동안, 그런 일은 다시 없다.

blocks.caption: The king every later Baekje king quotes when he wants to sound brave.
blocks.ko: 후대 백제 임금들이 용감해 보이고 싶을 때마다 들먹이는 임금.

blocks.html: The north’s capital, and a long walk for anyone who wants it.
blocks.ko: 북쪽의 수도. 탐내는 자에겐 먼 길이다.

blocks.html: In winter the king and the crown prince led thirty thousand picked troops into Goguryeo and attacked Pyongyang. The Goguryeo king, Sayu, fought hard to hold them off, and was killed by a stray arrow.
blocks.ko: 겨울, 왕이 태자와 함께 정예병 3만을 이끌고 고구려에 쳐들어가 평양성을 공격하였다. 고구려 왕 사유가 힘써 싸우며 막다가 흐르는 화살에 맞아 죽었다.
blocks.hanja: 冬，王與太子帥精兵三萬，侵高句麗，攻平壤城。麗王斯由釗，力戰拒之，中流矢死。
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 24, Baekje Annals — King Geunchogo, yr. 26 (371)

blocks.html: Winter, tenth month. The king of Baekje came with thirty thousand men and attacked Pyongyang. The king led his troops out to meet them and was struck by a stray arrow. He died on the twenty-third day of that month.
blocks.ko: 겨울 10월, 백제 왕이 군사 3만을 이끌고 와서 평양성을 공격하였다. 왕이 군사를 내어 막다가 흐르는 화살에 맞았다. 이달 23일에 세상을 떠났다.
blocks.hanja: 冬十月，百濟王帥兵三萬，來攻平壤城。王出師拒之，為流矢所中。是月二十三日，薨。
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 18, Goguryeo Annals — King Gogugwon, yr. 41 (371)

blocks.caption: Baekje at its height.
blocks.ko: 백제의 전성기.

blocks.html: Baekje has the river, the coast and the sea roads east. The clans take the docks. The throne takes a cut. It is the richest kingdom in Samhan, and the strongest. Neither lasts.
blocks.ko: 백제는 강과 해안과 동쪽 뱃길을 쥐고 있다. 가문들은 부두를 갖고, 왕좌는 몫을 뗀다. 삼한에서 가장 부유하고 가장 강한 나라다. 둘 다 오래가지 않는다.

blocks.html: Year fifty-two, autumn, ninth month: Baekje's envoy Kuji and his party came with Chikuma Nagahiko, and presented one seven-branched sword, one seven-child mirror, and treasures of every kind.
blocks.ko: 52년 가을 9월 병자일, 구저 등이 지쿠마나가히코를 따라 와서 칠지도 한 자루와 칠자경 한 면, 그리고 갖가지 귀한 보물을 바쳤다.
blocks.hanja: 五十二年秋九月丁卯朔丙子、久氐等從千熊長彦詣之。則獻七枝刀一口・七子鏡一面、及種々重寶。
blocks.source: Nihon Shoki (日本書紀) bk. 9, Empress Jingū, yr. 52 (usually corrected to 372)

en: Restore the reign of the thirteenth Eraha.

blocks.html: They will still be chanting that sentence three centuries later, in a courtyard, to a clever king who has already decided that a country is a story. It is the sentence that gets Daeya burned.
blocks.ko: 삼백 년 뒤에도 사람들은 어느 마당에서 그 문장을 외치고 있을 것이다. 나라란 하나의 이야기라고 이미 결론 내린 영리한 임금 앞에서. 대야성을 불태우는 것이 바로 그 문장이다.

blocks.html: Goguryeo remembers it too, and differently, and for exactly as long.
blocks.ko: 고구려도 그것을 기억한다. 다르게, 그리고 꼭 그만큼 오래.

blocks.html: Back to the snow, and to Goguryeo’s most frightening commander. First question: do you know what happens to traitors…?
blocks.ko: 다시 눈 속으로, 고구려에서 가장 무서운 장수에게로. 첫 번째 질문이다. 반역자가 어떻게 되는지 아느냐…?

images.alt: King Bojang — hollow floating ring-crown
images.prompt: Minimal iconic 3:4 poster. NOT photoreal. NOT busy. King Bojang. ONE geometric device: floating hollow ring-crown of #8f4a44. Face matches the attached portrait. #8f4a44 as the plane. Flat charcoal-black void. No army. No text. No watermark. Graphic color-blocking, anime-painterly, monumental.

images.alt: Yeon Gesomun — five ring-pommel swords fanned, gold rings the only light
images.prompt: Minimal iconic 3:4 poster. Yeon Gesomun, Supreme Commander of Goguryeo. ONE geometric device: FIVE ring-pommel swords fanned as a hard radial behind him, the hollow GOLD RING POMMELS catching the only bright highlights. Extreme chiaroscuro.
