Gotaso runs past a standing stone

blocks.html: A young girl is going to do what she’s going to do.
blocks.ko: 어린 여자애는 하고 싶은 건 결국 하고 만다.

blocks.html: It begins two springs earlier, with a girl who is not where she is supposed to be.
blocks.ko: 두 해 전 봄에서 시작한다. 있어야 할 자리에 없는 여자아이에서.

blocks.html: Gotaso (16) goes out to the lantern market with two maids and does not come back with any. The maids are found first, by the river, in the morning.
blocks.ko: 고타소 (16)가 시녀 둘을 데리고 등 시장에 나갔다가, 아무도 없이 돌아오지 못한다. 시녀들이 먼저 발견된다. 강가에서, 아침에.

en: Husband.
…Husband.

blocks.html: Chunchu says nothing. This is the part the household remembers afterwards and none of them can describe properly: he does not shout, he does not ask a second question, he simply stops being the man who talks.
blocks.ko: 춘추는 아무 말도 하지 않는다. 뒷날 집안 사람들이 모두 기억하되 아무도 제대로 옮기지 못하는 대목이 이것이다. 소리치지 않고, 두 번 묻지 않고, 그저 말하는 사람이기를 그만둔다.

blocks.html: I did not know, then, that silence was the loudest vow I would ever make. I know it now.
blocks.ko: 그때는 몰랐다. 침묵이 내가 평생 할 맹세 중 가장 큰 소리라는 것을. 지금은 안다.

en: Chunchu. Sit down.
I already have men out.
…Chunchu.
How many horses do we have.

blocks.html: It is the only sentence he speaks for two days. Yushin will try to tell it later as a joke and will stop halfway through, every time.
blocks.ko: 이틀 동안 그가 입 밖에 낸 문장은 그것 하나다. 유신은 뒷날 그 이야기를 우스개로 꺼냈다가, 매번 중간에서 그만둔다.

blocks.html: They were not bandits, in the sense that bandits want money. No word came and nothing was asked for, which is worse, and Chunchu understood what it meant before anyone in the room said it aloud.
blocks.ko: 돈을 원한다는 뜻에서의 도적은 아니었다. 기별도 없고 요구도 없었다. 그편이 더 나쁘고, 춘추는 방 안의 누가 소리 내어 말하기 전에 그 뜻을 알아들었다.

blocks.html: They find the road on the second night. What Chunchu does at the ford is in no record, because the two men who could have written it down were at the ford.
blocks.ko: 이틀째 밤에 길을 찾는다. 여울에서 춘추가 한 일은 어느 기록에도 없다. 그것을 적을 수 있었을 두 사람이 그 여울에 있었기 때문이다.

en: Enough.
Chunchu. Enough.
…The child is watching.

blocks.html: He stops. He wipes his hands on the grass, carefully, both sides, the way a man does before he picks up something clean.
blocks.ko: 그는 멈춘다. 풀에 손을 닦는다. 양손을, 조심스럽게 — 깨끗한 것을 들어 올리기 전에 사내가 하는 방식으로.

en: …Gotaso.
Father… there is something on your coat.
So there is.
I will change it later.

blocks.html: He carries her the whole way home. It is nineteen li. He does not let anyone take a turn and he does not put her down to eat.
blocks.ko: 그는 돌아오는 길 내내 아이를 업는다. 십구 리다. 아무에게도 넘기지 않고, 밥을 먹으려고 내려놓지도 않는다.

en: …Put her down.
Your arms will come off.
A little longer.

lines: 자네가 그렇게 조용해지는 건 처음 봤네.
en: I have never seen you go quiet like that.
…Brother.
I have two sons and one daughter.
One daughter.

blocks.html: Before the wedding, there is a year that nobody writes down — except, privately, in the scorebooks of the spring gyuku match.
blocks.ko: 혼인 전에, 아무도 기록하지 않는 일 년이 있다 — 다만 사적으로, 봄 격구의 점수부에만.

blocks.html: At a spring gyuku match the Hwarang ride for the Queen. The stands smell of horse and expensive varnish. Servants carry club-boxes the way other households carry ancestral tablets. Princess Gotaso (16) is only meant to watch.
blocks.ko: 봄 격구에서 화랑들이 여왕 앞에서 달린다. 관중석에서는 말 냄새와 비싼 니스 냄새가 난다. 시종들은 다른 집이 신주를 모시듯 채 함을 모신다. 고타소 (16)는 보기만 하러 왔다.

lines: 저 나이 화랑이 저런 걸 들고 나오면… 집안이 보여.
en: Look at that club box.
Namsan cypress, Hwangnyong shade-dried.
A Hwarang that young carrying that… you can see the household.
I am not looking at the club.
Only the man.

blocks.html: Pumsuk (23) takes the ball on the off-side — a showy, illegal-looking, completely legal cut — and for half a breath too long catches her eye instead of the goal. His premium gyuku club flashes once in the sun: presentation-silk still on the headcover, five coloured rings on the shaft, vulgar as Surabol sport gets.
blocks.ko: 품석 (23)이 오프사이드에서 공을 받는다 — 허세 같고 반칙 같아 보이지만 완전히 합법인 컷 — 그리고 반 호흡만큼 너무 길게, 골이 아니라 그의 눈을 붙잡는다. 프리미엄 격구채가 햇살에 한 번 번쩍인다. 헤드커버엔 아직 진열용 비단, 자루엔 오방색 고리 다섯. 서라벌 경기가 천박해지는 지점이다.

blocks.caption: Kim Pumsuk. Rich, handsome, and legal by about an inch.
blocks.ko: 김품석. 돈 많고, 잘생겼고, 딱 한 뼘 차이로 반칙이 아니다.

en: …Who is that.
Mother.
Mother. I asked who that is.
Hwarang Kim Pumsuk. / Don’t stare.
I already did.
And he looked back. He did, he did.

lines: 저 이제 다른 사람은 안 볼 거예요.
en: I am never going to look at anyone else.
For the rest of my life.
…Sixteen years old, using the word “life.”
Sixteen is exactly when you are allowed to use it.
Later you get too embarrassed.

blocks.html: She looks at him the way a person looks at weather they have decided to live in — not bargaining, not counting rooms. Just the face.
blocks.ko: 그녀는 그를, 살기로 한 날씨를 보듯 본다 — 흥정하지 않고, 방을 세지 않고. 그저 그 얼굴.

blocks.html: They meet again under the flowering trees behind the training ground — not by accident the second time, and not the third.
blocks.ko: 수련장 뒤 꽃나무 아래에서 다시 만난다. 두 번째는 우연이 아니고, 세 번째도 아니다.

blocks.html: Under the flowering trees they forget to be a princess and a Hwarang.
blocks.ko: 꽃나무 아래에서 그들은 공주와 화랑이기를 잊는다.

en: I shouldn’t… see Your Highness here.
Then why do you come every day.
I come every day.
Yesterday I came twice.
…I don’t know. / Knowing I shouldn’t.

lines: 그럼 왜… 아직 제 손목을 놓지 않으세요.
en: And I’m not supposed to… touch your hand either?
Then why… won’t you let go of my wrist.
You mustn’t.
…And yet you’re holding it.
And… I cannot take it back.

blocks.html: Rain finds them once on the palace steps. Neither of them moves to go inside.
blocks.ko: 비는 궁 섬돌에서 한 번 그들을 붙잡는다. 둘 다 안으로 들어갈 생각을 하지 않는다.

en: You’re soaked.
…Why are you smiling.
Ah. / Is it my hair… on your sleeve?

blocks.html: They wear no powder and no brow-black. Most wind their beautiful hair around the head and dress it with pearls and coloured silk.
blocks.ko: 분을 바르거나 눈썹을 그리지 않고, 대개 아름다운 머리카락을 머리에 감아 올려 구슬과 색 비단으로 꾸민다.
blocks.hanja: 不粉黛，率美髮以繚首，以珠彩飾之。
blocks.source: Xin Tangshu (新唐書) bk. 220, Eastern Barbarians — Silla, on Silla women

lines: 공주님 머리카락이… 제 소매에 붙어 있어서요.
en: Your hair is… caught on my sleeve.
I should free it.
My hand won’t move.
Neither will my feet.

lines: 저는 이 소매 옆에 평생 서 있을 수도 있어요.
en: Then leave it.
Leave it there.
The sleeve. The hair.
I could stand beside this sleeve for the rest of my life.
No — closer.
My lady.
If this goes on… I will come apart.
Here. On the steps.
So will I.
So I settled all of it last night.
Four children. I have named them.
I am telling my parents today.
…Four?
You don’t want them?
…I want to know the names.

blocks.html: Four children, already named. Now the boy has to ask her father. And her father wants a vow…!
blocks.ko: 아이 넷, 이름까지 다 지어 두었다. 이제 그 사내가 아버지께 청할 차례다. 그리고 아버지는 맹세를 원한다…!

images.at: One more step and I do not stop.
images.alt: In the emptied wedding hall Sunduk and Yushin stand a breath apart, flushed and wanting; on the red pillar behind them their shadows have already met
images.prompt: Minimal iconic 2:1 still composed like a symbolic old-master history painting — A LOVE THAT CANNOT BE, MUTUAL AND WANTING. Night in the emptied Silla hall after the wedding feast, low three-quarter angle. BLOCKING: Queen Sunduk stands on the dais step, Yushin on the floor just below; the step makes their faces level and a breath apart. Her fingertips have just drawn back from his mouth and still hover; her lips are parted, colour rising up her throat, eyes wet and wanting. His face is tipped toward hers, jaw clenched, flushed, both fists closed at his sides, every muscle holding still. Neither crosses. ONE DEVICE: on the red pillar behind them their two cast shadows have already met — the shadows kiss, mouth to mouth, though the two of them do not. One oil lamp on the floor between them rakes up across both faces, her crimson brocade and his blue-trimmed robe, throwing those shadows large up the pillar. Carved pillar timber grain, the lacquered step edge catching a thin line of light. Foreground: lamp-flame bokeh. Faces large, close, charged. Faces drawn, matching the attached portraits. No text. CANON — QUEEN SUNDUK — FACE and garments from attached /ch_sunduk.png (face only; invent a new pose). Hair ornament matches attached /bn_sunduk.png when the head is visible. Look: Pale oval face, dark calm eyes; black hair in a full coiled updo; when crowned, the gold Silla tree-and-antler crown hung with jade gogok. Dress: Crimson court robe with gold phoenix brocade, blue embroidered cape-collar, a red ribbon bow at the chest. Demeanor: Composed, faint smile, wit in the eyes; looks up at the sky (Cheomseongdae). Never weepy, never cowed. #E8552B as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: Tang empress costume; fantasy tiara in place of the Silla gold crown. | KIM YUSHIN — FACE and garments from attached /ch_kim_yushin.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Tall, broad-shouldered, long black hair in a high topknot-ponytail with trailing Silla-blue cloth tails; level hard brows, deep-set eyes. Dress: Silla-blue po and trousers, plum-violet sash knotted at the waist, white inner collar, dark wrapped forearms. Off duty: plain blue po, no jewelry. Now: Marshal: full black beard and moustache; a blue ribbon in the topknot instead of the headband. Demeanor: Confucian: he STANDS — never sits in lotus. Weighs, counts, frowns at sums; tight jaw, rare dry half-smile. Grief shows as stillness, not tears. The most feared warrior in all of Samhan: a line goes quiet when the tall Silla helm and the white horse appear. Massive, deliberate, terrifying at a walk; by Hwangsan (65) heavier and slower than Gyebek but still the man armies are built around. #2A5FB8 as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: sitting in lotus or holding prayer beads; katana, tsuba or curved blade (ignore the sword drawn on his portrait); two swords at once; blue glow aura. HEEWON STYLE: a Korean WEBTOON figure painted into a hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL world, in a SIMPLE, MINIMAL, ICONIC layout — the benchmark is a lone man in magenta silk walking down a storm-lit grass ridge toward his tied horse with an empty saddle: one diagonal, two subjects, half the frame storm sky, one cloud-break. FIGURES are webtoon / anime: clean digital-ink linework, simplified webtoon faces with expressive eyes, the face and hands keep that clean ink line, but the body and garments are PAINTED, never digitally shaded — broad loaded brushstrokes and dry-brush drag that follow each fold, the shading stepped in three or four painted value planes with soft broken edges, paper-and-canvas grain running right across the silk — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, never a smooth airbrushed gradient, never a 3D render (2.5D, see FORM). THE WORLD is WATERCOLOR FIRST, OIL SECOND: skies and ground in granulated wet-in-wet washes and short broken-colour dabs (Turner), dry-brush grass, dust and stone texture, soft bleeding edges, faint paper grain; the accent colour of the scene blooms into the wash near one frame edge and the frame edges dissolve into bare paper; oil only deepens the darks with rich umber-indigo glazes and adds a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. INTERIORS AND NIGHT SCENES are the webtoon figure painted into a European OLD-MASTER CANVAS — a Renaissance / Baroque TENEBRIST oil painting (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt): broken-colour brushwork, glazed umber-to-black darks, sfumato falloff, a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight, over faint watercolor blooms and paper grain; walls, timber, stone, drapery and tables pulled out of the darkness by the one lamp, window or shaft. The same oil-on-canvas texture covers EVERYTHING in the frame, the figures’ silk included — mottled plaster, gritty stone, brushed robes — so the webtoon figures sit INTO that painted space, lit by the same key and sharing its shadows, never pasted onto a flat backdrop. LAYOUT is MINIMAL AND ICONIC, staged like a Romanticist painting (Friedrich, Turner, Delacroix, Géricault): ONE device carries the frame (a ridge diagonal, a road, a waterline, a hall axis, a table ring, a gate) with ONE or TWO subjects placed on the thirds; at least half the frame is quiet negative space (storm sky, empty field, dark floor, bare wall); distant detail stays tiny and dissolving (a line of banners or roofs in haze); no crowds, no clutter, nothing competing with the subject. Heroic diagonal or pyramid, small figures against a sublime sky or vast field, or a bold worm’s-eye / straight-down angle. BLOCKING IS THE RELATIONSHIP: when two people share a frame, the still reads like a history painting with the faces covered — who stands higher and who kneels, the distance or contact between them, whose hand rests on whom, where each one looks (at each other, past each other, the same way), and how their cast shadows meet on the wall or floor; one gesture between them carries the whole bond. LIGHT is movie tenebrism at full strength: 70–85% of the frame sinks into deep painted shadow (oil-glazed umber, indigo, black), an extreme value range with near-white highlights right beside inky black and almost no middle grey; big dark masses (storm cloud, shadowed slope, umber room, black floor) against ONE bright break — a single cloud-break, low sun shaft, lamp or window — that lands on the subject; inky darks right beside small near-white highlights, few middle greys in the subject; ONE hard directional key carves the subject out of the dark. FORM IS 2.5D — drawn webtoon line on the outside, sculpted painted volume on the inside (the interior benchmark: a bearded emperor in yellow silk standing at a stone relief, under-lit by an oil lamp set on the floor beside the lens, palm on the carved horse, his shadow climbing the wall): the key is a PRACTICAL light IN or just outside the frame, CLOSE to the subject, RAKING ACROSS the surfaces the camera sees from below or from the side — never from behind them. So every silk fold protrudes, built the way an oil painter builds it: the lit side of each fold laid in with one opaque loaded stroke, the turn into shadow a crisp painted edge, the shadow side a thin transparent umber glaze with a little warm floor-light dragged into it, brush direction following the fold; gold thread and the brightest ridges flicked in with impasto; cheekbones, beard, knuckles, armor plates and horse muscle are painted the same way. The subject is large in frame (medium or closer, worm’s-eye or low three-quarter) so the folds resolve, and the light falls off into black across the body — that falloff is the darkness. Never a garment filled with one flat colour; never a subject backlit into a flat silhouette with only an edge line (if the camera is behind someone, the key still comes from the side and models their back and shoulder); never a wall flat to the lens — walls and floors recede at an angle so cast shadows can climb them. A thin edge of the same real light may graze the far side of the silhouette to lift it off the background (never a glow outline); long raking shadows. TEXTURE IS TACTILE RELIEF — the raking key exists to reveal it: thick oil impasto that stands up off the canvas on the lit side of every surface, loaded-brush and palette-knife ridges the eye can almost touch. Cloth: heavy silk in deep ridged folds, raised gold embroidery and brocade threads catching pin-point specular, quilted collars, layered sleeves with real thickness, beads and pins as small sculpted volumes. Buildings and ground just as sculpted: carved, weathered timber grain on pillars and brackets, every giwa roof tile and end-cap a rounded relief with its own shadow, rough-cut stone blocks, cracked lime plaster, lattice in deep relief throwing crisp little shadows, packed earth with grit and footprints. Never a smooth flat wall, never a plain colour-fill robe. Default hour is dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat overcast, never even daylight, never a bright open sky filling the frame. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. SEPARATION: subject and background never share a value — the lit subject sits in the one pool of light and everything behind it drops three or more steps to near-black (or, reversed, a dark figure against the single bright opening); foreground shapes almost black; the eye lands on the subject first. SHOT VARIETY AND NEGATIVE SPACE: across a set of stills alternate INTIMATE CLOSE-UPS (faces and hands filling the frame, the background a dark blur) with FAR WIDES (the figures small in a lower corner or third, 60% or more of the canvas left as quiet negative space — black hall, night sky, dark water, bare wall — that makes the small lit figures strike). RENAISSANCE CANVAS, CARTOON FIGURES: the world is composed and painted like a Renaissance / Baroque master (Leonardo’s sfumato, Titian’s glazes, Raphael’s pyramids, Caravaggio’s darkness), but every face stays a clean-lined webtoon / anime face — big expressive eyes, simple nose and mouth, smooth cel-like skin with one or two shadow tones — never photographic skin, pores or realistic facial anatomy. COLOR SYMBOLISM reads at a glance: each kingdom's colour lives in its banners and cloth (Silla blue, Baekje yellow, Goguryeo red, Tang vermilion and gold), each named person's hex in the key light on them, and the rest of the frame stays desaturated umber, slate and black so those few colours sing. FACES stay drawn: match the attached portrait's line weight, eye shape and simplification exactly — if a face starts to read as a photograph, flatten it back to ink line and wash; extras are drawn the same way, never photographic. HORSES are drawn to be admired: the whole body readable, arched neck, deep chest, round haunch, clean legs in a true gait, muscle modelled by the key with a bright edge along the topline. 2.5D painterly cinema — drawn webtoon faces, everything else brushed with visible strokes and canvas grain — not photoreal, not live-action, not a smooth digital airbrush or 3D render, not flat cel fill. Same film stock every still: a CAMERA in a real Korean place — anamorphic 2:1 movie frame, shallow DOF, creamy bokeh, rack-focus, film grain, crushed blacks, ONE hard key, long shadows, tenebrism. MOVIE FRAME of the scene a DP could stand in — NEVER a graphic poster, split-screen collage, 3D architectural visualization, black-triangle overlay, spotlight cone deleting the landscape, or neon outline. NO halo, bloom, glow aura, rim-aura, emissive skin, or god-ray envelope around people — character hex is the color of REAL LIGHT in the dark (key bounce, specular on silk/armor/wet stone, a lamp, a shaft, a floor reflection), never a body halo, never magic outline, never neon-painting the figure. FACE ONLY from the attached portrait — silk/hanbok may match; NEVER copy the portrait stance, clasped hands, 3/4 fashion lineup, or a standing clone. Invent a new DRAMATIC body every still (mid-stride, kneel, full-draw, turn, tumble, lean, count, dutch, worm’s-eye, lower-third). CINEMATOGRAPHY: name the shot — dutch angle, worm’s-eye, crane, over-shoulder, rack focus, shallow DOF / bokeh, chiaroscuro, mise-en-scène, long-shadow key. HIGH CONTRAST: crushed blacks + one hard key / long shadows / tenebrism — not even daylight wash, not a flat tourist postcard. ICONIC MINIMAL means one architectural device a lens can see (road, column, waterline, gate, hall axis) plus empty negative space — not deleting the world. COLOR SYMBOLISM: hex tints the hard key / catchlight / bounce — NEVER a glow aura, NEVER recolor the attached portrait’s garments (Sosuno stays dusty-rose hanbok, Geumwa stays red-burgundy court silk, not gold paint). FACE AND CLOTHES match the attached ch_*.png. One of each named person — NEVER clone or duplicate a character. People stand on packed earth at a well RIM — NEVER inside the well shaft. Jumong is fun-loving and laid-back: grin, laugh, wink, easy eyes — not a grim founder mask. BATTLE ARMOR: metallic GRAY steel lamellar (attached steel-armor ref); cloth peeks in the character hex — not gold-painted plate, not glowing armor, not a standing armor catalog. RING-POMMEL SWORDS: one-handed hip 환두대도 from attached sw_bidam.png — handle:blade 1:3; order is RING (pommel at heel of fist) → short grip → thin gold collar → long blade → point. Never reverse handle and blade. Never a tsuba disc in the middle. Never taller than the person. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only — do not attach it on full-blade stills. Ignore swords on face portraits. Two people = two garment-true figures against crushed black. Real Korean architecture or a locked dark room. No army. No readable text. No watermark. Copy: dynamic poses in a mythology-scale layout; dramatic poses in a mythology-scale one-device layout; one hard key / chiaroscuro; one gesture in empty space — iconic and simple. Never: white / pale studio void as a room; earth places stay real buildings, not color-plane furniture; no pasted portrait pose — new body every still; no floating logo — still must be a movie frame of the scene; unrealistic layout, reptitive; real bottle-shaped Cheomseongdae plus a story beat.

images.alt: Yushin kneels across the empty hall from Dukman
Yushin and Dukman’s hands meet over a candle
Dukman by a lamp in the dark corridor
Pumsuk holds Gotaso, cheek to cheek

blocks.html: Princess Gotaso (16) has fallen in love with the Hwarang Pumsuk (23), and the whole court can see it before either of them admits the word. The maids keep score of the accidental meetings. The guards move their posts to give the flowering trees more privacy than any regulation requires. The entire palace is, quietly, on her side.
blocks.ko: 고타소 (16)는 화랑 품석 (23)과 사랑에 빠진다. 둘 중 누가 그 말을 입 밖에 내기 전에, 궁 안이 먼저 안다. 시녀들은 그 ‘우연한’ 마주침의 횟수를 세고 있다. 위병들은 어떤 규정에도 없는 만큼 꽃나무 뒤에 그늘을 내어 주려 초소를 옮긴다. 온 궁이, 조용히, 그녀의 편이다.

blocks.html: Her parents Chunchu (38) and Munhee (35) bless the marriage. Then, over his wife’s one quiet objection, the father asks the boy for a vow — a vow no father should make his daughter hear.
blocks.ko: 부모인 춘추 (38)와 문희 (35)는 혼인을 축복한다. 그리고 아내의 조용한 반대 한 마디를 넘겨 두고, 아버지는 사위에게 맹세를 청한다 — 딸이 듣게 하면 안 되는 맹세를.

en: Don’t make him swear.
…Why not.

lines: 지키면 당연한 것이고, 못 지키면 그이가 죽습니다.
en: If he keeps it, it was owed anyway. If he cannot, it kills him.

blocks.html: He makes him swear. It is the only time in this record that Chunchu misreads a room, and it is the room with his daughter in it.
blocks.ko: 그는 맹세를 시킨다. 이 기록을 통틀어 춘추가 방을 잘못 읽은 유일한 순간이고, 그 방에는 그의 딸이 있었다.

lines: 그 아이한테 무슨 일이 생기면, 내가 자네를 죽일 거라는 건 알지? 하하…
en: If anything happens to her, you know I’m going to kill you, right? Haha...

lines: 제 목숨을 걸고 고타소 양을 보호하겠습니다!
en: On my life, I will protect Lady Gotaso!

blocks.html: At the back of the hall, the Queen watches her niece marry for love.
blocks.ko: 식장 뒤편에서, 여왕은 조카딸이 사랑하는 사람과 혼인하는 것을 지켜본다.

blocks.html: The girl-child arriving: again the white, again only Samsin and Munhee. Pink silk already too sure of itself in a void that has no furniture to flatter it.
blocks.ko: 여자아이가 온다. 다시 흰 빛, 다시 삼신과 문희뿐. 분홍 비단이 가구 없는 허공에서 벌써 너무 자신 있다.

blocks.html: Munhee does not watch the vows. She watches the doorway and remembers a different night in the same house: the girl-child arriving, pink silk already too sure of itself, Chunchu’s hand huge around a wrist that would never learn to be still. They named her Gotaso when the lantern-band was the same shape it is tonight.
blocks.ko: 문희는 서약을 보지 않는다. 문간을 본다. 같은 집의 다른 밤을 기억한다. 계집아이가 도착하던 밤. 분홍 비단이 벌써 제 일을 아는 밤. 춘추의 손이, 끝내 가만히 있는 법을 배우지 못할 손목을 크게 감싸던 밤. 등불의 띠가 오늘 밤과 같은 모양일 때, 이름을 고타소라 붙였다.

lines: 저 문간을 지나간 게 이 집안에서만 벌써 셋일세.
en: …Your son’s girl.
That doorway has taken three of this house now.
Four. If Your Majesty counts honestly.
…I count honestly.
We will be happy forever!

blocks.html: Their wedding rites are only wine and food, more or less according to wealth. On the wedding night the bride bows first to her husband's parents, and then to her husband.
blocks.ko: 혼인의 예는 술과 음식뿐이며, 그 많고 적음은 빈부에 따른다. 혼인하는 날 저녁, 신부는 먼저 시부모에게 절하고 다음에 남편에게 절한다.
blocks.hanja: 婚嫁之禮，唯酒食而已，輕重隨貧富。新婚之夕，女先拜舅姑，次即拜夫。
blocks.source: Sui Shu (隋書) bk. 81, Eastern Barbarians — Silla

en: …My lady. Your hands are cold.
But the back of your neck… is hot.

lines: 그리고… 품석 공 손이 너무 뜨거워서요.
en: Because I am shaking.
And… because yours are too warm.
The hand at my waist.
Don’t take it away.
Are you frightened?
If I… come closer.

lines: 빨리 아무도 없는 데로 가고 싶어서요.
저를 한 번 더 봐 주세요.
en: No.
Because I want to be somewhere with nobody in it.
Look at me once more.

blocks.html: Behind the doors the feast falls away.
blocks.ko: 문 너머로 잔치가 멀어진다.

blocks.html: The new couple move to Daeya Fortress, where Pumsuk has just been named Guardian. She waves from the cart until the capital is out of sight; he rides beside the wheel the whole way. Daeya is a border post. Nobody at the wedding said the word border out loud.
blocks.ko: 신혼부부는 품석이 막 도독으로 부임한 대야성으로 떠난다. 그녀는 서라벌이 보이지 않을 때까지 수레에서 손을 흔들고, 그는 내내 바퀴 옆에서 말을 몬다. 대야성은 국경의 성이다. 혼례에서 국경이라는 말을 입 밖에 낸 사람은 아무도 없었다.

blocks.html: A border post with a fine view of Baekje. The view works both ways.
blocks.ko: 백제가 훤히 보이는 국경 초소. 저쪽에서도 훤히 보인다.

blocks.html: The hall empties. The Queen does not leave, and neither does the Marshal. Neither of them has ever been the first to leave a room.
blocks.ko: 대청이 빈다. 여왕은 일어서지 않고, 장군도 그렇다. 둘 다 한 번도 먼저 방을 나선 적이 없다.

blocks.html: She has had twenty years to learn the back of his neck: the place the armour strap has worn shiny, the two grey hairs at his temple that were not there before the last campaign. Tonight the hall is empty and nobody is writing anything down, so she looks at all of it.
blocks.ko: 그의 목덜미를 익힐 시간이 이십 년 있었다. 갑옷 끈에 쓸려 반들거리는 자리, 지난 원정 전에는 없던 관자놀이의 흰 머리 두 올. 오늘 밤은 대전이 비었고 아무도 아무것도 적지 않으므로, 여왕은 그 전부를 본다.

blocks.html: Color rises along her throat. She keeps her mouth closed so the breath will not give her away. He does not turn. That is the only mercy left in the room.
blocks.ko: 빛이 목선을 따라 오른다. 숨이 자기를 팔지 못하게 입을 다문다. 그는 돌아보지 않는다. 그 방에 남은 유일한 자비다.

en: Your Majesty.
…Not that word. Not tonight.
Then what am I to call you.
Don’t call me anything.

blocks.html: He takes one step. It is the smallest thing he does in this entire record and it costs him longer than any battle in it.
blocks.ko: 그가 한 걸음 다가선다. 이 기록을 통틀어 그가 한 가장 작은 일이고, 이 기록의 어떤 전투보다 오래 걸린다.

lines: 오늘 조카딸이 사랑하는 사내와 혼인하는 것을 보셨습니다.
저는 내내 폐하 얼굴만 보고 있었습니다.
en: Today you watched your niece marry the man she loves.
I watched your face the entire time.
Your Majesty—
Yushin.
…You said my name.
So stop.

lines: 한 마디만 하겠습니다. 딱 한 마디만.
말 두 필이면 됩니다. 오늘 밤이면 됩니다.
국경까지 사흘이고, 사흘 뒤면 우리는 아무도 아닙니다.
en: One sentence. Let me have one.
Two horses. Tonight would be enough.
Three days to the border. After three days we are nobody at all.

blocks.html: She reaches up. He is very still, the way a man is still when he has already decided not to be the one who moves. Her fingers find his mouth before the rest of the sentence can.
blocks.ko: 여왕이 손을 든다. 유신은 아주 가만히 서 있다 — 먼저 움직이지 않기로 이미 정한 사내의 방식으로. 남은 말이 나오기 전에, 손끝이 먼저 그의 입에 닿는다.

lines: 말이 되어 버리면, 내가 그걸 평생 듣고 살아야 하네.
en: Don’t say it.
If you say it, I have to hear it for the rest of my life.
Then hear it for the rest of your life.

blocks.html: For a moment she does not answer, and the moment is long enough that both of them will spend years deciding what it meant.
blocks.ko: 잠시 여왕은 대답하지 않는다. 그 잠시는, 두 사람이 뒷날 여러 해 동안 무슨 뜻이었는지 정하며 보낼 만큼 길다.

blocks.html: Her fingers are still on his mouth. He does not take the next step. The lamp between them does the looking. When she speaks again she is already Queen.
blocks.ko: 손끝은 아직 그의 입에 있다. 그는 다음 걸음을 떼지 않는다. 둘 사이의 등잔이 본다. 다시 말할 때 그녀는 이미 여왕이다.

lines: …자네가 없으면 이 나라가 반년을 못 가.
en: …Without you this country does not last half a year.
You are talking about the country.

lines: 나라 얘기밖에 할 수 있는 게 없으니까.
en: Because the country is the only thing I am permitted to talk about.

blocks.html: She is close enough now to count what it is costing him. She counts it. Then she takes her hand back and puts it where a queen’s hand goes.
blocks.ko: 이제는 그것이 그에게 얼마를 치르게 하는지 셀 수 있을 만큼 가깝다. 여왕은 정말로 센다. 그러고는 손을 거두어, 여왕의 손이 있어야 할 자리에 둔다.

lines: 한 발만 더 오면 내가 못 멈추네.
en: One more step and I do not stop.
…Then I will not take it.
Thank you.

lines: 그건 폐하께서 이기셨을 때 나는 소리입니다.
en: Don’t thank me.
That is the sound you make when you have won.
…Then neither of us has.

blocks.html: He steps back into the shape of a subject. It fits, because he has worn it twenty years. It has never once fit.
blocks.ko: 그는 신하의 모양으로 물러선다. 이십 년을 입은 옷이라 몸에 맞는다. 한 번도 몸에 맞은 적이 없다.

en: Your Majesty.
…Yes. That will do.

blocks.html: Neither of them mentions that night again. Thirty-two years later, on the last day of his life, he is asked whether he ever wanted anything for himself, and the record notes only that he took some time to answer.
blocks.ko: 두 사람은 그날 밤을 다시 입에 올리지 않는다. 삼십이 년 뒤, 생의 마지막 날에 그는 스스로를 위해 바란 것이 있었느냐는 물음을 받는다. 기록은 그가 대답하기까지 시간이 조금 걸렸다는 것만 적어 두었다.

blocks.html: Outside the hall, two lantern-sellers argue the way Surabol argues anything that matters — by nickname first.
blocks.ko: 전각 밖에서 등불 장수 둘이 서라벌이 중요한 일을 논하듯 다툰다 — 이름보다 별명을 먼저.

en: The Legend of the Hwarang — Bidam — still sits at one hundred and eight with the Last Son of Gaya.
And the most cunning man in Samhan packed his daughter’s wedding like a campaign. Watch the roads, not the vows.
lines: 화랑의 전설 — 비담 — 이 가야의 마지막 아들과 아직도 백팔 대 백팔이래.
그리고 삼한에서 가장 교활한 자가 딸 혼인을 원정처럼 꾸렸지. 서약보다 길을 보라니까.

blocks.html: At the feast's edge, a southern merchant named Haesang pours a story instead of wine. He has seen harbours where the ships have eyes painted on the prow. He has bought glass from men who swore it came from past the edge of every map. He never boasts. He doesn't have to.
blocks.ko: 잔치 가장자리에서 해상이라는 남쪽 상인이 술 대신 이야기를 따른다. 뱃머리에 눈을 그린 배들이 드나드는 항구를 봤다. 어느 지도 끝보다 더 먼 데서 왔다는 유리를 사 봤다. 자랑은 하지 않는다. 할 필요가 없다.

en: In the south they greet a guest before they ask his rank.
I recommend it. Rank keeps. Guests leave.
lines: 남쪽에선 손님 맞이하고 나서야 신분을 묻습니다.

en: Your southern wine came late. The carter blamed the Yellow Mountain road.
Then he blamed the White River mouth. Then he blamed both blades.
Every harbour tavern from Funan back has that fight — the Sword of the Divine Country, or Hundred-Victories out of the Land of the Heavenly Deer.
Nobody has ever settled it. Which is why the wine is late.
lines: 남쪽 술이 늦었지요. 마부는 황산길 탓을 하더군요.
그다음엔 백강 하구 탓을. 그다음엔 칼 두 자루 탓을.
푸난에서 여기까지, 항구 주점마다 그 싸움입니다 — 신국의 검이냐, 천록의 나라 백승이냐.
아직 아무도 결판을 못 냈고요. 그래서 술이 늦습니다.

blocks.html: “Dear… have you already forgotten how we met?” Munhee hasn’t. It involves a dream, a skirt, and a coat torn on purpose…!
blocks.ko: “여보… 우리가 어떻게 만났는지는 벌써 까먹었나?” 문희는 잊지 않았다. 꿈 하나, 치마 하나, 그리고 일부러 찢긴 저고리 하나…!

images.alt: Intimate domestic: Munhee and newborn Bupmin in a low lantern-band; Chunchu at the edge
images.prompt: Intimate cinematic CLOSE-UP still, 16:9. Bupmin’s birth. NOT epic void. Same composition: at the corner of a plastered wall with a tiled coping, a young man holding a paper lantern leans toward a woman whose head is hooded in a long green jangot cloak; she turns shyly aside. The man is young KIM CHUNCHU (attached portrait: face, magenta #D8258C coat); the woman is MUNHEE (attached portrait: face, pink skirt under the green jangot). The blank space top-right where the original has a poem is left as empty paper. PARODY RULES: always a hand-made PAINTING, never photoreal. blocks.label: How They Met
blocks.ko: 첫 만남

lines: 여보.... 우리가 어떻게 만났는지는 벌써 까먹었나?
en: Dear… have you already forgotten how we met?

blocks.html: It starts with a dream, and the dream is sold.
blocks.ko: 꿈에서 시작한다. 그리고 그 꿈은 팔린다.

lines: 어젯밤에… 남산에 올라가서 오줌을 눴는데, / 서라벌이 전부 잠겼어. / 온 도성이.
en: Last night… I climbed Namsan and I relieved myself, / and all of Surabol drowned. / The entire capital.
Sister. Sell me that dream.
…For what?
My silk skirt.

blocks.html: Bohee takes the skirt. It is the single worst trade in Silla’s thousand years, and the two of them will both live long enough to know it.
blocks.ko: 보희는 치마를 받는다. 신라 천 년을 통틀어 가장 손해 본 거래이고, 두 사람 다 그것을 알 만큼 오래 산다.

lines: 언니가 잠기게 한 도성은, / 이제 내 거야.
en: The capital you drowned / is mine now.

blocks.html: Five days later Yushin brings a young nobleman home from the gyuku field — still dusty, still arguing about a disputed foul — and on the yard, mid-demonstration of a “proper True Bone grip,” steps on the hem of the man’s coat on purpose. The tie comes away.
blocks.ko: 닷새 뒤 유신이 격구장에서 젊은 귀공자 하나를 데려온다 — 아직 먼지가 묻은 채, 파울 판정을 놓고 아직도 다투며. 마당에서 «진골다운 그립»을 시범하다, 일부러 그의 옷자락을 밟는다. 옷고름이 뜯긴다.

lines: 어이쿠. / 이거 실례를. / 누가 좀 꿰매 드려라.
en: Oh dear. / My apologies. / Somebody sew that for the gentleman.
…How could I approach a nobleman over so small a thing.
I will do it.

blocks.html: He has to take the coat off for her to mend it. Magenta silk leaves his shoulders. He sits disrobed in her brother’s hall with a True Bone’s embarrassment and nowhere to put his hands. She knits the tear standing close enough to feel the heat off his skin — and that is all, the first time. Needle. Breath. The slow fact of a man without his coat.
blocks.ko: 고쳐 주려면 겉옷을 벗어야 한다. 자홍 비단이 어깨에서 내린다. 오라비 집에서 벗은 채로 앉아, 진골의 민망함과 손 둘 곳이 없다. 그녀는 찢어진 곳을 꿰매며 그의 피부 열을 느낄 만큼 가까이 선다. 그게 전부다, 첫날은. 바늘. 숨. 겉옷 없는 남자라는 느린 사실.

blocks.html: The elder sister had some reason not to come forward, so the younger came and sewed it. Light make-up, light clothes, and a radiance that lit up the room. Chunchu saw her and was delighted…
blocks.ko: 그 언니는 일이 있어 나오지 않고, 그 아우가 앞으로 나와 꿰매었다. 옅은 화장에 가벼운 옷차림이었으나 빛나는 고움이 사람을 비추었다. 춘추가 보고 기뻐하였다……
blocks.hanja: 其姊有故不進，其季進前縫綴。淡粧輕服，光艶炤人。春秋見而悅之……
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 6, Silla Annals — opening account of Bupmin's parents

lines: 나는… 이렇게 앉아 본 적이 없소.
en: …Your hands are quick.
I have… not sat like this.
Sit.
I will put the coat back on you.
Today… only that.

blocks.html: He comes back the next day, needing nothing sewn, and again the day after that. Each visit she finds a new place on the garment — and they sit closer. The needle slows. His breath learns the back of her hand. They do not leap. They accumulate.
blocks.ko: 다음 날 다시 온다. 꿰맬 것은 없다. 그다음 날도. 올 때마다 옷의 다른 곳을 찾는다. 더 가까이 앉는다. 바늘이 느려진다. 그의 숨이 손등을 배운다. 뛰어오르지 않는다. 쌓인다.

blocks.html: On a later visit the coat is off again. She stands behind him, needle forgotten, staring at the breadth of his shoulders as if the knitting were only an excuse to keep looking. Magenta silk has slipped. She does not tell him to cover it. When the needle pauses it is because her mouth has found the place above his pulse — and Yushin is careful to be looking somewhere else the entire time.
blocks.ko: 나중 방문에 또 겉옷을 벗는다. 뒤에 서서 바늘을 잊고, 어깨 너비를 본다. 뜨개질은 계속 보기 위한 핑계일 뿐인 것처럼. 자홍 비단이 흘렀다. 가리라고 하지 않는다. 바늘이 멈추는 것은 입이 맥 위를 찾아서다. 유신은 그 시간 내내 다른 곳을 보도록 조심한다.

en: …Why.
At this rate… I will tear the coat myself.
Because you have not left yet.
Before you leave…
your hand belongs at my waist.
Until the sewing is done.
And what is torn today?
Or… what shall I tear for you.
…Nothing.
No —
Here.
Where your mouth… was yesterday.
Shall I tear something for you, then?
Only the coat.
Or… your restraint as well.
…If you say it like that.
I won’t be able to leave tonight.
I am already… coming apart at the door.
Then don’t.
The sewing… can wait until morning.
Spend the night… mending me.

blocks.html: He stays. The household learns the sound of a door that is not meant to open until dawn.
blocks.ko: 그는 남는다. 집안은 새벽까지 열리지 않을 문의 소리를 배운다.

blocks.html: By midsummer the household staff have stopped announcing him.
blocks.ko: 한여름이 되자 집안 사람들은 그가 왔다고 알리는 일을 그만둔다.

en: N-no, why bring up that memory again…

blocks.html: Yushin invites him back onto the gyuku field. Chunchu is not especially good at gyuku — his club is respectable Mid-Bone pine, which the Hwarang notice immediately — and Yushin knows it.
blocks.ko: 유신이 그를 다시 격구장으로 부른다. 춘추는 격구를 잘하지 못한다 — 채는 무난한 중골 소나무라, 화랑들이 단번에 알아본다 — 유신도 그것을 안다.

en: Pregnant, with no husband to name… what disgrace is this!

blocks.html: Yushin builds the pyre in the yard where they played gyuku, which is not lost on anyone, and sets green wood on it so that it smokes instead of burning.
blocks.ko: 유신은 격구를 하던 그 마당에 장작을 쌓는다. 아무도 그 뜻을 놓치지 않는다. 그리고 젖은 나무를 올려 불이 붙는 대신 연기가 나게 한다.

blocks.html: The smoke goes straight up. It is visible from Namsan. It is visible from the terrace where a princess happens to be standing with the young nobleman who has gone the colour of paper.
blocks.ko: 연기가 곧게 오른다. 남산에서 보인다. 공주가 마침 서 있는 누대에서도 보인다. 그 곁에는 얼굴이 종잇장처럼 하얗게 질린 젊은 귀공자가 있다.

en: What is that smoke?
I-it’s me!

lines: 자네가 내 누이를 택한 게 아니라,
en: …Chunchu.
You did not choose my sister.
I chose you.
Brother.

lines: 가야의 피와 신라의 왕족을 한 침상에 눕히는 데,
en: Do you know how many years it took me
to lay Gaya blood and Silla royalty in the same bed.

lines: 형님이 왕을 하시면 될 걸 그랬습니다.
삼한에서 제일 강한 사내가 왕이 되는 게 이치 아닙니까.
en: You should have simply become king yourself.
Surely the strongest man in Samhan ought to be the one who rules.
(laughing) Chunchu. You know exactly why not.
…I do.

blocks.html: Neither of them says the word. It sits between them anyway, the way it always has: Gaya. His grandfather bought the family a rank. Ranks are not the same as blood.
blocks.ko: 둘 다 그 말을 입에 올리지 않는다. 그래도 그 말은 늘 그랬듯 두 사람 사이에 놓여 있다. 가야. 할아버지가 집안을 위해 신분을 샀다. 신분은 피와 같지 않다.

en: Lord… Chunchu?

lines: ㄱ-그 아기의 아버지... 문희 양의.. 그..
en: Th-the father of that child… Lady Munhee’s… I mean…
It’s me!

blocks.html: Chunchu & Munhee are married — the burnt-skirt rumour becomes a wedding, and the wedding becomes a household that is openly fond of itself.
blocks.ko: 춘추와 문희는 혼인한다 — 치마를 태웠다는 소문은 혼례가 되고, 혼례는 제 자신을 아끼는 살림이 된다.

blocks.label: The Closed Months
blocks.ko: 닫힌 달들

blocks.html: The wedding itself is quiet. Magenta silk and pink silk share a cup. What the court will later call a clever match is, in the room, simply two adults who have already learned each other’s breath.
blocks.ko: 혼례 자체는 조용하다. 자홍 비단과 분홍 비단이 잔을 나눈다. 조정이 나중에 영리한 혼사라고 부를 것은, 그 방 안에서는 서로의 숨을 이미 배운 두 어른일 뿐이다.

blocks.html: They shut the door on the yard and do not open it again for a long time. The minutes will later invent one decorous wedding night. What actually happens is weeks of it — her on him, him on her, the magenta and the pink in a heap by the door — until the meals go cold and Surabol learns to wait.
blocks.ko: 마당을 향해 문을 닫고, 한참을 다시 열지 않는다. 훗날 기록은 점잖은 첫날밤 하나를 지어낼 것이다. 실제로 있었던 일은 몇 주다 — 그녀가 위에, 그가 위에, 자홍과 분홍이 문가에 한 더미로 — 밥이 식고 서라벌이 기다리는 법을 배울 때까지.

blocks.html: The first time he is still trying to be gentle. She is not. She takes his hand and puts it where she wants it, and the sound that leaves her is not a toast. He lasts like a man who has been polite too long, which is to say not long, and says her name at the end as if he were apologising for it. She laughs, because that was the point, and does not let him go anywhere. The bedding. The chest. The floor, when the bedding is too far away. When he reaches for the water jug she pulls him back by the wrist.
blocks.ko: 처음엔 그가 아직 살살 하려 한다. 그녀는 아니다. 그의 손을 잡아 원하는 곳에 놓고, 그녀에게서 나오는 소리는 축배가 아니다. 너무 오래 예의 바르게 굴었던 사내답게 그는 오래 가지 못하고 — 말하자면 금방이다 — 끝에 그녀의 이름을 사과하듯 부른다. 그녀는 웃는다. 바로 그걸 원했으니까. 그리고 그를 아무 데도 보내지 않는다. 침상. 궤. 침상이 멀면 바닥. 그가 물주전자로 손을 뻗으면 손목을 잡아 끌어당긴다.

en: Again…?
Today… don’t even try to count.
Save counting for outside.
I… cannot count.
Munhee.
I have… already lost.
And… I will lose again.

blocks.html: For weeks they do not leave the bedding except to drink, to laugh, to start again. She wakes with him still beside her and starts again before the laugh is finished. She rides him until her thighs shake and asks for more the way she would ask for a sum he is good at. A strategist who can forecast a betrayal a generation out cannot forecast his own stamina, and does not care.
blocks.ko: 몇 주 동안 침상을 떠나지 않는다. 물을 마시고, 웃고, 다시 시작할 때만 잠깐. 깨어 보면 그는 아직 곁에 있고, 그녀는 웃음이 끝나기도 전에 다시 시작한다. 허벅지가 떨릴 때까지 그 위에 있다가, 그가 잘하는 셈을 청하듯 한 번 더를 청한다. 한 세대 뒤의 배신을 내다보는 책사가 제 기력은 내다보지 못하고, 개의치도 않는다.

blocks.html: The neighbors on both walls learn their names the wrong way — through plaster, through 다시, through a rhythm that does not stop when the lamp does. Servants stop knocking. Someone on the east side moves a sleeping mat farther from the shared timber and blames the draft.
blocks.ko: 양쪽 담장 너머 이웃은 둘의 이름을 틀린 길로 배운다 — 회벽을 통해, 다시라는 소리를 통해, 등불이 꺼져도 멈추지 않는 박자를 통해. 하인들은 문 두드리기를 그만둔다. 동쪽 누군가는 잠자리를 공용 들보에서 멀리 옮기고 외풍 탓을 한다.

blocks.html: At night the courtyard looks up and learns worse. The paper window glows — warm lamp inside, blue-black street outside — and on the 창호지 the shadows are unmistakable: one figure straddling the other; two bodies pressed to the lattice; upright, tangled, a lift that makes a silhouette into a confession. No faces needed. The pose is the gossip.
blocks.ko: 밤이면 마당이 위를 보고 더 심한 것을 배운다. 창호지에 불이 비친다 — 안은 따뜻한 등잔, 밖은 청흑의 골목 — 그 창호지 위 그림자는 틀림없다. 한쪽이 다른 쪽을 타고 앉은 꼴. 살창에 밀착된 두 몸. 세로로 엉킨 채, 그림자를 자백으로 만드는 들어올림. 얼굴은 필요 없다. 자세가 소문이다.

blocks.html: A neighbor freezes mid-step under the eaves, looks up at the shadow on the lattice, and looks away too late. By the third night half the lane has an opinion, and none of it is about politics.
blocks.ko: 처마 아래 이웃이 걸음을 멈추고 살창 위의 그림자를 올려다보다가, 너무 늦게 눈을 돌린다. 사흘째가 되면 골목 절반이 의견을 갖고, 그중 정치 이야기는 하나도 없다.

en: They say… they heard us through the wall.
And saw… the paper window.
Even our names.
Then the wall… is on our side.
And the paper window.
If Surabol hears…
let it.

blocks.html: They fit. Not the polite fit of a well-arranged marriage: when he is all the way with her she makes a noise like someone who has been waiting years for exactly that, and then laughs into it, because he is already moving again. Neither pretends to be shy. Later the household will call it love, which is also true. In the bed she only says again, and don’t you dare stop.
blocks.ko: 둘이 맞는다. 잘 짜인 혼사의 예의 바른 맞춤이 아니다. 그가 온전히 그녀에게 닿으면 그녀는 몇 해를 바로 그것만 기다린 사람 같은 소리를 내고, 이내 그 소리 속으로 웃는다. 그가 벌써 다시 움직이고 있으니까. 둘 다 수줍은 척하지 않는다. 훗날 집안은 사랑이라 부를 테고, 그것도 맞다. 침상에서 그녀는 그저 또, 그리고 멈추기만 해 봐요, 한다.

blocks.html: Morning finds them still tangled — lattice light on flushed faces, her thigh over his hip, the pink silk she never put back on crumpled under them. He wants her again before he is properly awake. She laughs into his mouth and lets him, slowly this time, which is somehow worse. He kisses the place above her pulse the way she once kissed his. The strategist’s cleverness has nowhere to go but her.
blocks.ko: 아침이 와도 아직 엉켜 있다 — 상기된 얼굴 위에 살창 빛, 그의 허리에 걸친 그녀의 허벅지, 다시 입지 않은 분홍 비단이 몸 아래 구겨져 있다. 그는 제대로 깨기도 전에 또 그녀를 원한다. 그녀는 그의 입 안으로 웃으며 그러게 둔다. 이번엔 천천히, 그래서 더 심하다. 그는 언젠가 그녀가 자기에게 그랬듯 맥 뛰는 자리 위에 입을 맞춘다. 책사의 총명은 그녀 말고는 갈 곳이 없다.

en: Dear.
Outside… later.
For now, count only me.
That…
is the one sum I am good at.

blocks.html: Months pass before either of them remembers the yard. When they finally open the door she walks like someone who has been thoroughly loved and does not mind the lane knowing it, and they look at each other like people who have won a private war — still in love, still hungry, and willing, for one afternoon, to put clothes back on.
blocks.ko: 둘 중 누구든 마당을 다시 떠올리기까지 몇 달이 걸린다. 마침내 문을 열었을 때 그녀는 실컷 사랑받았고 골목이 그걸 알아도 상관없다는 사람처럼 걷고, 둘은 사사로운 전쟁에서 이긴 사람처럼 서로를 본다 — 여전히 사랑하고, 여전히 배고프고, 오후 한나절쯤은 옷을 다시 입어 줄 마음이 든 채로.

blocks.html: When they reappear, the marriage is already a fact the city has stopped gossiping about — replaced by the quieter envy of people who heard the walls, saw the glowing lattice, and wished their own houses were that lucky.
blocks.ko: 그들이 다시 모습을 드러냈을 때, 혼인은 이미 도성이 수군거리기를 그만둔 사실이 되어 있다 — 담장을 듣고, 빛나는 살창을 보고, 제 집도 그처럼 복되기를 바란 사람들의 더 조용한 선망으로 바뀌어.

blocks.label: Bupmin’s Birth
blocks.ko: 법민의 탄생

blocks.html: Samsin is there the way she is always there when a breath starts — and no one else. Pitch white. Mother and midwife. The rest of the house can wait outside the light.
blocks.ko: 삼신은 숨이 열릴 때 늘 있는 방식으로 있다. 다른 사람은 없다. 새하얀 빛. 어머니와 산파. 집의 나머지는 그 빛 밖에서 기다리면 된다.

blocks.html: Years later the same house keeps a different quiet. Munhee holds the boy against her collarbone. They will call him Bupmin. The lantern makes a low band of light across the bedding and leaves the rest of the rooms uncounted. Chunchu sits where a husband sits when he has not yet learned what the child will steal from him.
blocks.ko: 몇 해 뒤, 같은 집이 다른 고요를 지킨다. 문희가 사내아이를 쇄골에 붙들고 있다. 이름을 법민이라 부를 것이다. 등불이 침구 위에 낮은 빛띠를 만들고, 나머지 방은 세지 않은 채로 둔다. 춘추는, 이 아이가 자신에게서 무엇을 훔칠지 아직 모르는 남편이 앉는 자리에 앉는다.

blocks.html: The household fills with Bupmin, who walks early, and Gotaso, who talks early and never stops.
blocks.ko: 그 살림은 걸음이 빨랐던 법민과, 말이 빨랐고 그 뒤로 멈춘 적 없는 고타소로 채워진다.

blocks.html: After that, Chunchu stopped going to the hill.
blocks.ko: 그 뒤로 춘추는 언덕에 오르지 않았다.

lines: 자네, 요즘 회의에 통 안 나오더군.
en: You have not been coming to Council lately.

lines: 형님. 저는 아들이 둘이고 딸이 하나입니다.
en: Brother. I have two sons and a daughter now.
The east star… I think I will let it just be a star.
So you will.

blocks.html: In Surabol, one father puts down his star. In Pyongyang, another marches his son to school without taking off his boots…!
blocks.ko: 서라벌에서 한 아버지가 별을 내려놓는다. 평양에서는 다른 아버지가 아들을 학당으로 끌고 간다. 신발도 벗지 않은 채로…!

images.alt: Three sons at a feast table — Gulgul outside with an empty bowl, watching the door
images.prompt: Cinematic historical illustration of Yeon Gesomun’s three young sons feasting at a low table while a fourth ragged boy Gulgul stands outside in the dark courtyard with an empty bowl, Goguryeo night interior, painterly digital art, warm lantern vs cold courtyard, no text, no watermark, --ar 10:3

images.at: The three teachings are like the legs of a tripod
images.alt: Yeon Gesomun slaps a palm on the three-legged bronze cauldron in the Academy yard while his small son looks up.
images.prompt: HEEWON STYLE. Minimal iconic 2:1 movie still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. Low three-quarter WORM'S-EYE from the swept flagstones of the Taehak, the Grand Academy courtyard in Pyongyang at dusk. ONE device: a squat three-legged bronze incense cauldron (ding) in the left third of the foreground, its three legs a hard dark shape against the pale swept stone. Yeon Gesomun, FACE ONLY from the attached portrait, mid-stride in muddy riding boots on the swept stone, one palm slapped down on the cauldron's rim, leaning in, mouth open mid-sentence with a crude half-grin, unarmed today. Beside him, small, his seven-year-old son in a plain child's scholar robe looks up at him, seen from behind three-quarter, face mostly turned away. Far across the courtyard, in soft bokeh, a monk with a broom has stopped sweeping and stares. Behind: the lecture hall's red pillars, giwa eaves and lit lattice doors melting into dusk haze. Key: a low red sunset shaft raking across the bronze, his face and the silk folds; the rest umber and slate. CANON — YEON GESOMUN — FACE and garments from attached /ch_yeon_gesomun.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Massive, broad-chested; black hair in a tight topknot tied with red cord; thick black beard trimmed close to the jaw, heavy brows, glaring eyes. Dress: Dark charcoal robe and trousers under red-edged armor, a red cape falling off the shoulders. Headwear: the jougwan (see HEADWEAR). Demeanor: Arrogant, theatrical, loud; looks down at people (worm's-eye suits him). Laughs while fighting. #d0362f as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: gold-plated armor; beardless face (except a flashback to youth). | HEADWEAR: JOUGWAN (조우관, feather cap) — copy the SHAPE from the attached hat boards and ignore their Korean labels, museum photos, paper-craft gems and dragon medallion: a small black lacquered gauze cap (변형모, a peaked or square-topped crown no bigger than the topknot it covers) set high on the crown of the head over a small knot of gathered hair (any loose hair the portrait shows still falls beneath it); a thin black band round the head with a small square opening at the front; black cords tied under the chin; two long barred pheasant tail feathers (tan with umber bars), or a spray of bird plumes, rising straight up or sweeping back from either side of the cap, much taller than the cap itself. It replaces any other hat or cap on the portrait; headbands and ribbons stay. Real lacquer and feathers lit by the scene key, never a glow. | COSTUME CHARTS (attached): cut, collar, sleeve, sash, trouser and skirt shapes of every Samhan figure follow the chart for their kingdom; it is a style chart, so ignore its labels, captions, maps, poses and faces. Named people keep their portrait face and colours; extras and soldiers dress like the chart (a commoner like its commoners, an official like its officials, a soldier like its soldiers). Goguryeo: attached /ref_hanbok_goguryeo.png. HEEWON STYLE: a Korean WEBTOON figure painted into a hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL world, in a SIMPLE, MINIMAL, ICONIC layout — the benchmark is a lone man in magenta silk walking down a storm-lit grass ridge toward his tied horse with an empty saddle: one diagonal, two subjects, half the frame storm sky, one cloud-break. FIGURES are webtoon / anime: clean digital-ink linework, simplified webtoon faces with expressive eyes, the face and hands keep that clean ink line, but the body and garments are PAINTED, never digitally shaded — broad loaded brushstrokes and dry-brush drag that follow each fold, the shading stepped in three or four painted value planes with soft broken edges, paper-and-canvas grain running right across the silk — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, never a smooth airbrushed gradient, never a 3D render (2.5D, see FORM). THE WORLD is WATERCOLOR FIRST, OIL SECOND: skies and ground in granulated wet-in-wet washes and short broken-colour dabs (Turner), dry-brush grass, dust and stone texture, soft bleeding edges, faint paper grain; the accent colour of the scene blooms into the wash near one frame edge and the frame edges dissolve into bare paper; oil only deepens the darks with rich umber-indigo glazes and adds a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. INTERIORS AND NIGHT SCENES are the webtoon figure painted into a European OLD-MASTER CANVAS — a Renaissance / Baroque TENEBRIST oil painting (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt): broken-colour brushwork, glazed umber-to-black darks, sfumato falloff, a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight, over faint watercolor blooms and paper grain; walls, timber, stone, drapery and tables pulled out of the darkness by the one lamp, window or shaft. The same oil-on-canvas texture covers EVERYTHING in the frame, the figures’ silk included — mottled plaster, gritty stone, brushed robes — so the webtoon figures sit INTO that painted space, lit by the same key and sharing its shadows, never pasted onto a flat backdrop. LAYOUT is MINIMAL AND ICONIC, staged like a Romanticist painting (Friedrich, Turner, Delacroix, Géricault): ONE device carries the frame (a ridge diagonal, a road, a waterline, a hall axis, a table ring, a gate) with ONE or TWO subjects placed on the thirds; at least half the frame is quiet negative space (storm sky, empty field, dark floor, bare wall); distant detail stays tiny and dissolving (a line of banners or roofs in haze); no crowds, no clutter, nothing competing with the subject. Heroic diagonal or pyramid, small figures against a sublime sky or vast field, or a bold worm’s-eye / straight-down angle. BLOCKING IS THE RELATIONSHIP: when two people share a frame, the still reads like a history painting with the faces covered — who stands higher and who kneels, the distance or contact between them, whose hand rests on whom, where each one looks (at each other, past each other, the same way), and how their cast shadows meet on the wall or floor; one gesture between them carries the whole bond. LIGHT is movie tenebrism at full strength: 70–85% of the frame sinks into deep painted shadow (oil-glazed umber, indigo, black), an extreme value range with near-white highlights right beside inky black and almost no middle grey; big dark masses (storm cloud, shadowed slope, umber room, black floor) against ONE bright break — a single cloud-break, low sun shaft, lamp or window — that lands on the subject; inky darks right beside small near-white highlights, few middle greys in the subject; ONE hard directional key carves the subject out of the dark. FORM IS 2.5D — drawn webtoon line on the outside, sculpted painted volume on the inside (the interior benchmark: a bearded emperor in yellow silk standing at a stone relief, under-lit by an oil lamp set on the floor beside the lens, palm on the carved horse, his shadow climbing the wall): the key is a PRACTICAL light IN or just outside the frame, CLOSE to the subject, RAKING ACROSS the surfaces the camera sees from below or from the side — never from behind them. So every silk fold protrudes, built the way an oil painter builds it: the lit side of each fold laid in with one opaque loaded stroke, the turn into shadow a crisp painted edge, the shadow side a thin transparent umber glaze with a little warm floor-light dragged into it, brush direction following the fold; gold thread and the brightest ridges flicked in with impasto; cheekbones, beard, knuckles, armor plates and horse muscle are painted the same way. The subject is large in frame (medium or closer, worm’s-eye or low three-quarter) so the folds resolve, and the light falls off into black across the body — that falloff is the darkness. Never a garment filled with one flat colour; never a subject backlit into a flat silhouette with only an edge line (if the camera is behind someone, the key still comes from the side and models their back and shoulder); never a wall flat to the lens — walls and floors recede at an angle so cast shadows can climb them. A thin edge of the same real light may graze the far side of the silhouette to lift it off the background (never a glow outline); long raking shadows. TEXTURE IS TACTILE RELIEF — the raking key exists to reveal it: thick oil impasto that stands up off the canvas on the lit side of every surface, loaded-brush and palette-knife ridges the eye can almost touch. Cloth: heavy silk in deep ridged folds, raised gold embroidery and brocade threads catching pin-point specular, quilted collars, layered sleeves with real thickness, beads and pins as small sculpted volumes. Buildings and ground just as sculpted: carved, weathered timber grain on pillars and brackets, every giwa roof tile and end-cap a rounded relief with its own shadow, rough-cut stone blocks, cracked lime plaster, lattice in deep relief throwing crisp little shadows, packed earth with grit and footprints. Never a smooth flat wall, never a plain colour-fill robe. Default hour is dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat overcast, never even daylight, never a bright open sky filling the frame. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. SEPARATION: subject and background never share a value — the lit subject sits in the one pool of light and everything behind it drops three or more steps to near-black (or, reversed, a dark figure against the single bright opening); foreground shapes almost black; the eye lands on the subject first. SHOT VARIETY AND NEGATIVE SPACE: across a set of stills alternate INTIMATE CLOSE-UPS (faces and hands filling the frame, the background a dark blur) with FAR WIDES (the figures small in a lower corner or third, 60% or more of the canvas left as quiet negative space — black hall, night sky, dark water, bare wall — that makes the small lit figures strike). RENAISSANCE CANVAS, CARTOON FIGURES: the world is composed and painted like a Renaissance / Baroque master (Leonardo’s sfumato, Titian’s glazes, Raphael’s pyramids, Caravaggio’s darkness), but every face stays a clean-lined webtoon / anime face — big expressive eyes, simple nose and mouth, smooth cel-like skin with one or two shadow tones — never photographic skin, pores or realistic facial anatomy. COLOR SYMBOLISM reads at a glance: each kingdom's colour lives in its banners and cloth (Silla blue, Baekje yellow, Goguryeo red, Tang vermilion and gold), each named person's hex in the key light on them, and the rest of the frame stays desaturated umber, slate and black so those few colours sing. FACES stay drawn: match the attached portrait's line weight, eye shape and simplification exactly — if a face starts to read as a photograph, flatten it back to ink line and wash; extras are drawn the same way, never photographic. HORSES are drawn to be admired: the whole body readable, arched neck, deep chest, round haunch, clean legs in a true gait, muscle modelled by the key with a bright edge along the topline. 2.5D painterly cinema — drawn webtoon faces, everything else brushed with visible strokes and canvas grain — not photoreal, not live-action, not a smooth digital airbrush or 3D render, not flat cel fill. Same film stock every still: a CAMERA in a real Korean place — anamorphic 2:1 movie frame, shallow DOF, creamy bokeh, rack-focus, film grain, crushed blacks, ONE hard key, long shadows, tenebrism. MOVIE FRAME of the scene a DP could stand in — NEVER a graphic poster, split-screen collage, 3D architectural visualization, black-triangle overlay, spotlight cone deleting the landscape, or neon outline. NO halo, bloom, glow aura, rim-aura, emissive skin, or god-ray envelope around people — character hex is the color of REAL LIGHT in the dark (key bounce, specular on silk/armor/wet stone, a lamp, a shaft, a floor reflection), never a body halo, never magic outline, never neon-painting the figure. FACE ONLY from the attached portrait — silk/hanbok may match; NEVER copy the portrait stance, clasped hands, 3/4 fashion lineup, or a standing clone. Invent a new DRAMATIC body every still (mid-stride, kneel, full-draw, turn, tumble, lean, count, dutch, worm’s-eye, lower-third). CINEMATOGRAPHY: name the shot — dutch angle, worm’s-eye, crane, over-shoulder, rack focus, shallow DOF / bokeh, chiaroscuro, mise-en-scène, long-shadow key. HIGH CONTRAST: crushed blacks + one hard key / long shadows / tenebrism — not even daylight wash, not a flat tourist postcard. ICONIC MINIMAL means one architectural device a lens can see (road, column, waterline, gate, hall axis) plus empty negative space — not deleting the world. COLOR SYMBOLISM: hex tints the hard key / catchlight / bounce — NEVER a glow aura, NEVER recolor the attached portrait’s garments (Sosuno stays dusty-rose hanbok, Geumwa stays red-burgundy court silk, not gold paint). FACE AND CLOTHES match the attached ch_*.png. One of each named person — NEVER clone or duplicate a character. People stand on packed earth at a well RIM — NEVER inside the well shaft. Jumong is fun-loving and laid-back: grin, laugh, wink, easy eyes — not a grim founder mask. BATTLE ARMOR: metallic GRAY steel lamellar (attached steel-armor ref); cloth peeks in the character hex — not gold-painted plate, not glowing armor, not a standing armor catalog. RING-POMMEL SWORDS: one-handed hip 환두대도 from attached sw_bidam.png — handle:blade 1:3; order is RING (pommel at heel of fist) → short grip → thin gold collar → long blade → point. Never reverse handle and blade. Never a tsuba disc in the middle. Never taller than the person. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only — do not attach it on full-blade stills. Ignore swords on face portraits. Two people = two garment-true figures against crushed black. Real Korean architecture or a locked dark room. No army. No readable text. No watermark. Copy: dynamic poses in a mythology-scale layout; dramatic poses in a mythology-scale one-device layout; one hard key / chiaroscuro; one gesture in empty space — iconic and simple. Never: white / pale studio void as a room; earth places stay real buildings, not color-plane furniture; no pasted portrait pose — new body every still; no floating logo — still must be a movie frame of the scene; unrealistic layout, reptitive; real bottle-shaped Cheomseongdae plus a story beat.

blocks.html: Yeon's wife has given him three sons. They could not be more different.
blocks.ko: 연의 아내는 아들 셋을 낳았다. 셋이 이보다 다를 수가 없다.

blocks.html: Namseng (7) is the careful one — the heir, eager to be approved of.
blocks.ko: 남생 (7)은 신중한 맏이 — 인정받고 싶어 하는 후계자다.

blocks.caption: Yeon’s eldest. He would very much like to be told he did well.
blocks.ko: 연의 맏아들. 잘했다는 말을, 정말로 듣고 싶다.

blocks.html: Namgun (4) is the fierce one, who never backs down first.
blocks.ko: 남건 (4)은 사나운 둘째 — 먼저 물러서는 법이 없다.

blocks.caption: The second son. Nobody ever had to teach him to push.
blocks.ko: 둘째. 밀어붙이는 법은 누구도 가르칠 필요가 없었다.

blocks.html: Namsan (2) is the quiet one, watching his brothers.
blocks.ko: 남산 (2)은 조용한 막내 — 형들을 지켜본다.

blocks.html: There is a fourth boy at that table who is not counted, because counting him would require a word nobody in the house wants to use. Gulgul eats after the others and says nothing, and Namsan — who watches everything — is the only one who notices that he never sits with his back to a door.
blocks.ko: 그 상에는 세지 않는 네 번째 아이가 있다. 세려면 그 집 누구도 쓰고 싶어 하지 않는 낱말이 필요하기 때문이다. 걸걸은 남들이 다 먹은 뒤에 먹고 아무 말도 하지 않는다. 모든 것을 보는 남산만이, 그 아이가 한 번도 문을 등지고 앉지 않는다는 것을 알아챈다.

blocks.label: The Taehak
blocks.ko: 태학

blocks.html: The Grand Academy is old. It came over the river in the same season as the first Buddhas. Ever since, the school and the temple have shared Goguryeo's noble sons. Classics in the morning. Sutras after lunch. Archery whenever the masters lose their voices.
blocks.ko: 태학은 오래됐다. 첫 불상과 같은 철에 강을 건너왔다. 그 뒤로 학당과 절은 고구려 귀족 아들들을 나눠 가져 왔다. 아침엔 경전. 점심 뒤엔 불경. 선생들 목이 쉬면 활쏘기.

blocks.html: Second year, summer, sixth month. Fu Jian, king of Qin, sent envoys and the monk Sundo with Buddha images and sutras. The king sent envoys back with thanks and local tribute. He founded the Taehak, the Grand Academy, to teach the sons of good families.
blocks.ko: 2년 여름 6월, 진나라 왕 부견이 사신과 승려 순도를 보내 불상과 경문을 보내왔다. 왕이 사신을 보내 답례하고 토산물을 바쳤다. 태학을 세워 자제들을 가르쳤다.
blocks.hanja: 二年，夏六月，秦王苻堅，遣使及浮屠順道，送佛像、經文。王遣使廻謝，以貢方物。立大學，敎育子弟。
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 18, Goguryeo Annals — King Sosurim, yr. 2 (372)

blocks.html: Yeon brings Namseng (7) to the gate himself, in riding boots, and does not take them off on the swept stone.
blocks.ko: 연은 남생 (7)을 직접 문 앞까지 데려온다. 말 탈 때 신는 장화 그대로, 쓸어 놓은 돌바닥 위에서도 벗지 않는다.

blocks.speaker: Taehak Master
lines: 대가. 오부의 자제들은 논어와 법화경으로 시작합니다.
en: Commander. The sons of the five commanderies begin with the Analects and the Lotus Sutra.
As your own father did, if I remember the register.

lines: 논어는 됐어. 사내라면 절하는 법은 알고 나서 안 할지 정해야지.
en: The Analects, fine. A boy should know how to bow before he decides not to.
The sutra he can skip.
Father.
Is the Buddha not allowed?

lines: 부처는 괜찮다. 살찌고 조용하고, 나한테 뭘 달란 적이 없지.
내가 싫은 건 그 땅 주인들이다.
en: The Buddha’s fine. Fat, quiet, never asked me for anything.
It’s his landlords I mind.

blocks.html: The landlords are not a figure of speech. Half the good valley land belongs to monasteries. The monasteries belong to the great houses whose second sons run them. None of it pays for the wall. Every spring Yeon writes to the Summit about this. Every spring the Summit thanks him for his piety.
blocks.ko: 지주는 말장난이 아니다. 좋은 골짜기 땅의 절반이 절 것이다. 절은 둘째 아들들을 주지로 앉힌 큰 집안들 것이다. 그 땅은 성 쌓는 데 한 푼도 내지 않는다. 연은 봄마다 제가회의에 그 이야기를 써 보낸다. 제가회의는 봄마다 그의 신심에 감사한다.

blocks.html: What he wants instead is the Way of Laozi, which is an odd thing for him to want, because the Tang emperors claim Laozi as their ancestor. Yeon has heard this and does not care. He has a sentence for it, the only one he ever repeats word for word.
blocks.ko: 그가 대신 원하는 것은 노자의 도다. 그에게는 이상한 바람이다. 당 황실이 노자를 제 조상이라 우기니까. 연도 그 말을 들었고, 상관하지 않는다. 그에게는 이 일에 쓰는 문장이 하나 있다. 그가 토씨 하나 안 바꾸고 되풀이하는 유일한 말이다.

lines: 공자가 하나, 부처가 둘. 셋째가 없으니 솥이 불 속으로 기울지.
en: A pot stands on three legs.
Confucius is one. The Buddha’s two. We’re missing the third, and the pot’s tipping into the fire.

blocks.speaker: Taehak Master
lines: 그 셋째 다리가… 당의 도사들이란 말씀입니까, 대가?
en: The third leg would be… Tang priests, Commander?

lines: 셋째 다리는 농장 없는 놈이면 뭐든 된다.
en: The third leg is whatever doesn’t own a farm.

blocks.html: The three teachings are like the legs of a tripod: you cannot do without one. Now Confucianism and Buddhism both flourish, but the Way has not prospered. That is not what you would call having all the arts of the world.
blocks.ko: 세 가르침은 솥의 세 발과 같아 하나라도 빠져서는 안 된다. 지금 유교와 불교는 나란히 일어섰으나 도교는 아직 성하지 않으니, 천하의 도술을 갖추었다 할 수 없다.
blocks.hanja: 三敎譬如鼎足，闕一不可。今儒釋並興，而道敎未盛，非所謂備天下之道術者也。
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 21, Goguryeo Annals — Yeon Gaesomun's petition on the Three Teachings

blocks.html: Across the courtyard a monk named Bodeok has stopped sweeping. He is from the monastery at Banryong, which owns a great deal of farm, and he will remember the sentence longer than anyone else who hears it.
blocks.ko: 마당 건너편에서 보덕이라는 승려가 비질을 멈췄다. 그는 반룡사 사람이고, 반룡사는 농장을 아주 많이 가졌다. 그날 그 말을 들은 누구보다 그가 오래 그 문장을 기억할 것이다.

blocks.html: The complaint reaches the High Commander’s table before Yeon has ridden home. Gusesa reads it at supper, between courses.
blocks.ko: 연이 집에 닿기도 전에 그 불평은 막리지의 상에 올라간다. 구세사는 저녁상에서, 요리와 요리 사이에 그것을 읽는다.

lines: (손가락을 닦으며, 부드럽게) 연가가 중들한테 뭘 가지라 마라 하는군.
내 조카는 남들이 말 모으듯 적을 모아. 말은 그나마 덜 먹는데.
en: (mild, wiping his fingers) A Yeon telling monks what to own.
My nephew collects enemies the way other men collect horses. At least horses eat less.

blocks.html: Namseng is enrolled anyway. He learns the Analects first and best, and on the days the sutra master is ill he reads his father’s copy of the Daodejing, which has never been opened past the first page.
blocks.ko: 남생은 어쨌든 입학한다. 그는 논어를 제일 먼저, 제일 잘 익히고, 불경 스승이 앓아누운 날에는 아버지의 도덕경을 읽는다. 첫 장 너머로는 한 번도 펼쳐진 적 없는 책이다.

blocks.html: By custom they love books. Even the households of the poor and of servants each build a large hall on the street, called a gyeongdang, where their sons read and practise archery day and night until they marry.
blocks.ko: 풍속이 책을 좋아하여, 가난한 집이나 천한 일을 하는 집에 이르기까지 저마다 거리에 큰 집을 짓고 이를 경당이라 부르며, 자제들이 혼인하기 전까지 밤낮으로 여기서 책을 읽고 활쏘기를 익힌다.
blocks.hanja: 俗愛書籍，至於衡門廝養之家，各於街衢造大屋，謂之扃堂，子弟未婚之前，晝夜于此讀書習射。
blocks.source: Jiu Tangshu (舊唐書) bk. 199上, Eastern Barbarians — Goguryeo

blocks.html: Field trip. Yeon takes the boys to see a very big rock. The rock has a list on it, and a question…!
blocks.ko: 소풍이다. 연이 아들들을 데리고 아주 큰 바위를 보러 간다. 바위에는 목록이 하나 새겨져 있고, 질문이 하나 숨어 있다…!

blocks.html: Yeon takes his sons to see the Great King's stone. It lists everything he ever took.
blocks.ko: 연이 아들들을 데리고 대왕의 비석을 보러 간다. 그 왕이 가져간 것이 전부 적혀 있다.

blocks.html: The old capital, where the Great King’s stone still does the bragging.
blocks.ko: 옛 수도. 자랑은 아직도 대왕의 비석이 대신 한다.

lines: 에이… 이게 다예요? 그냥 큰 돌인데?
en: Aw… that’s it? A big rock?

blocks.html: Every Goguryeo boy is raised on him. He kept the west shut, and he made it look easy.
blocks.ko: 고구려 사내아이라면 누구나 그를 듣고 자란다. 서쪽을 닫아걸었고, 그걸 쉬워 보이게 했다.

lines: 저 돌에 성이 예순넷 적혀 있다.
글 읽게 되거든, 네가 나한테 읽어 봐라.
…그러고 나서 물어라. 예순넷을 뺏은 나라가 어쩌다 해마다 두 번씩 장안에 절을 하게 됐는지.
en: Sixty-four fortresses are written on that rock.
When you can read, you will read them to me.
…And then you can ask how a country that took sixty-four came to bow to Chang’an twice a year.

blocks.html: In all, the fortresses he attacked and broke: sixty-four. Villages: one thousand four hundred.
blocks.ko: 무릇 쳐서 깨뜨린 성이 64곳, 마을이 1,400곳이다.
blocks.hanja: 凡所攻破城六十四，村一千四百。
blocks.source: Gwanggaeto Stele (廣開土王碑), conquest record (414)

blocks.html: Spring, second month. The king sent the crown prince Hwangwon to Tang with tribute. The Second Emperor welcomed him and loaded him with gifts. The king also sent young men of good family to Tang and asked that they be admitted to the imperial academy.
blocks.ko: 봄 2월, 세자 환권을 당에 보내 조공하였다. 태종이 위로하고 매우 후하게 물건을 내렸다. 왕이 자제들을 당에 보내 국학에 들어가기를 청하였다.
blocks.hanja: 春二月，遣世子桓權，入唐朝貢。太宗勞慰，賜賚之特厚。王遣子弟入唐，請入國學。
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 20, Goguryeo Annals — King Yeongnyu, yr. 23 (640)

blocks.html: In the fourteenth year he sent his crown prince Hwangwon to court with local tribute, and the Second Emperor made a great deal of him.
blocks.ko: 14년, 그 태자 환권을 보내 입조하고 아울러 토산물을 바치니, 태종이 극진히 위로하였다.
blocks.hanja: 十四年，遣其太子桓權來朝，並貢方物，太宗優勞甚至。
blocks.source: Jiu Tangshu (舊唐書) bk. 199上, Eastern Barbarians — Goguryeo, Zhenguan 14 (640)

blocks.html: Late in the year, old Dosuryu walks in without taking off his boots. In thirty years he has never once done that…!
blocks.ko: 그해 저물녘, 도수류 영감이 신을 신은 채로 들어온다. 삼십 년 동안 한 번도 없던 일이다…!

images.alt: Gesomun, blades strapped across his back, throws his head back laughing before a great wall map of the Three Kingdoms
images.prompt: Cinematic historical illustration of kingdoms crest map, Three Kingdoms of Samhan / Tang era (641), scene: Yeon’s Three Sons, painterly digital art, dramatic natural light, rich period costume, no modern elements, no text, no watermark, --ar 3:2 --stylize 250

images.alt: Dosuryu alone under the dark eaves, bent over a geomungo, the bamboo pick in his hand and his long beard over the strings
images.at: stands a long time in the yard
images.prompt: Minimal iconic 16:9 movie still, 2D cel-painterly webtoon, not photoreal. DRAMATIC CHIAROSCURO: crushed black timber hall, one hard warm shaft, long shadows, not a flat seated portrait. Dutch angle. The geomungo is a long low wooden wedge across the bottom third, the one device, tassels catching the light. Dosuryu sits behind it, small against empty dark posts. FACE, long beard, orange-brown robe, black collar, and black cap with two upright wheat pins from the attached portrait. Instrument matches the attached geomungo: frets, six strings, pegs with dark tassels, struck with a thin bamboo stick in the right hand, left hand on the frets. Quiet stern face, mouth closed, eyes on the strings, restrained, not a scowl-cartoon. Thick creamy bokeh in the foreground (blurred floorboards) and giwa roofs behind. One lamp is the only key on the wood and one cheek. No glow aura. No text. No watermark.

blocks.html: Late in the year Dosuryu comes in without knocking, which he has done since Gesomun was small enough to lift by the collar, and without taking his boots off, which he has never done.
blocks.ko: 그해 늦게 도수류가 문도 두드리지 않고 들어온다. 개소문이 멱살 잡아 들어 올릴 만큼 작았을 때부터 늘 그랬다. 장화도 벗지 않는다. 그건 처음이다.

en: Oi. Old man. Boots.

lines: 아니, 서 있어. 넌 서 있을 때 말을 더 잘 듣더라.
en: Shut up and sit down.
No — stay standing. You listen better standing.

lines: 폐하하고 네 숙부. 이번 달에만 세 번이다. 알현전 뒤 그 작은 방.
딴 사람은 아무도 없었어. 술 따르는 아이조차.
en: His Majesty and your uncle. Three times this month, the same little room behind the audience hall.
Nobody else in it. Not even a boy to pour.
So they drink together. Good for them.

lines: 네가 제가회의에서 박차고 나간 뒤로 그 방에서 네 이름이 나와. 봄에 너를 장성 끝자락으로 보낼 작정이다. 그리고 거기서 안 돌아오게 할 작정이고.
en: They don’t drink. That’s what’s wrong with it.
Ever since you walked out of the Summit, your name comes up in that room. They mean to send you to the far end of the wall in the spring. And have you not come back from it.

blocks.html: The king ordered Gaesomun, Great Man of the Eastern Division, to oversee the work on the long wall.
blocks.ko: 왕이 동부 대인 개소문에게 명하여 장성 쌓는 일을 감독하게 하였다.
blocks.hanja: 王命東部大人蓋蘇文，監長城之役。
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 20, Goguryeo Annals — King Yeongnyu, yr. 25 (642)

en: HAHAHAHAHAHA
Kill me? Yeon Gesomun?

lines: 네 아버지는 열두 해를 제가회의 보고 웃다가 머리가 하얘져서 돌아왔다. 넌 열두 해 없어. 봄까지야.
en: Laugh. Go on.
Your father laughed at the Summit for twelve years and came home grey. You haven’t got twelve years. You’ve got till spring.

blocks.html: Yeon stops laughing. He does it all at once, the way a door shuts.
blocks.ko: 연이 웃음을 멈춘다. 문이 닫히듯, 한 번에.

blocks.html: Once he had succeeded to his father's post he was violent, cruel and lawless, so the great men and the king plotted in secret to kill him. The plan leaked…
blocks.ko: 자리를 이은 뒤 흉포하고 잔인하며 도리가 없으니, 여러 대인이 왕과 은밀히 의논하여 죽이려 하였다. 일이 새어 나갔다……
blocks.hanja: 嗣位而凶殘不道，諸大人與王密議欲誅。事洩……
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 49, Biographies — Yeon Gaesomun

blocks.html: After Gaesomun took up the office he committed offences, and the high ministers conferred with the king, Geonmu*, on killing him. The plan leaked…
blocks.ko: 개소문이 직무를 맡은 뒤 죄를 범하니, 여러 대신이 건무*와 의논하여 그를 죽이려 하였다. 일이 새어 나갔다……
blocks.hanja: 蓋蘇文攝職有犯，諸大臣與建武議欲誅之。事泄……
blocks.source: Jiu Tangshu (舊唐書) bk. 199上, Eastern Barbarians — Goguryeo

notes.html: Geonmu (建武) was the king’s own name. This book calls him King Yeongnyu, the name the court gave him after he died.
notes.ko: 건무는 왕의 이름이다. 이 책은 죽은 뒤에 받은 이름, 영류왕으로 부른다.

en: How many names on their list.

lines: …왜 그렇게 웃어? 그만둬. 너 그렇게 웃는 거 질색이다.
en: One that I know of. Yours.
…Why are you smiling like that? Stop it. I hate it when you do that.
Then I’ll make a list too.
Mine’ll be longer.

blocks.html: Dosuryu goes out the way he came in, boots and all, and stands a long time in the yard before he can make himself mount. He has known the boy for thirty years. He knows exactly what kind of list it will be.
blocks.ko: 도수류는 들어올 때처럼 장화 신은 채로 나가서, 한참을 마당에 서 있다가 겨우 말에 오른다. 그 아이를 안 지 서른 해다. 그게 어떤 명단일지 그는 정확히 안다.

blocks.html: Meanwhile in Sabi, Euija is king at last. On his coronation morning, several hundred people see a dragon…!
blocks.ko: 한편 사비에서는 마침내 의자가 왕이 된다. 즉위하던 날 아침, 수백 명이 용을 본다…!
