blocks.label: STEAM
blocks.ko: 김

blocks.html: Before Daeya — before the year that will stain his hands — the Sword of Silla rides alone to a small cavern lake in the hills: a bowl of black water under stone, cold enough to teach the bones manners. He has heard of the place the way a son hears of a hill his father once named a spring. His father came until the hill learned his walk. He comes the same way. Water. One question. The name.
blocks.ko: 대야 전 — 손을 더럽힐 해 전 — 신라의 도검은 홀로 산중의 작은 동굴 호수로 간다. 돌 아래 검은 물의 사발, 뼈에 예의를 가르치는 냉기. 아버지가 샘이라 이름 붙인 언덕을 아들이 듣듯 그곳은 들어 보았다. 아버지는 언덕이 걸음을 배울 때까지 왔다. 같은 길로 온다. 물. 질문 하나. 이름.

blocks.html: Black water, warm stone, and not as empty as it looks.
blocks.ko: 물은 검고 바위는 따뜻하다. 보이는 것만큼 비어 있지 않다.

blocks.html: The marshal’s robe falls at the rock lip before the steam has a name for him. Confucian blue on wet stone. He does not look up; looking up would be a request.
blocks.ko: 원수의 도포가 바위 끝에서 내린다. 김이 아직 그의 이름을 부르기 전에. 유교의 푸른빛이 젖은 돌 위에 있다. 올려다보지 않는다. 올려다보는 것은 청이 되니까.

blocks.html: Steam lifts. They are already on the far rock: Narim with her ankles crossed like an elder sister who has seen this entrance before; Golhwa legs spread wide in the mist, chima hiked, as if the mist owed her heat; Hyullé a half-step behind them, knees pressed, eyes down on the water, not yet on him.
blocks.ko: 김이 오른다. 저쪽 바위에 이미 있다. 나림은 이 등장을 여러 번 본 언니처럼 발목을 꼬고 있고, 골화는 다리를 넓게 벌리고 치마를 걷은 채 연기가 제게 열을 빚진 것처럼 앉아 있으며, 혈레는 반 걸음 뒤에 — 무릎은 모으고 눈은 아직 그가 아니라 물에.

blocks.caption: The eldest. Moss, roots, and the rules nobody else keeps.
blocks.ko: 맏언니. 이끼와 뿌리, 그리고 아무도 안 지키는 규칙.

blocks.caption: Fire in the stone. She has been bored for a very long time.
blocks.ko: 돌 속의 불. 아주 오래 심심했다.

blocks.caption: The water sister. She says nothing and misses nothing.
blocks.ko: 물을 맡은 동생. 아무 말도 안 하고, 아무것도 놓치지 않는다.

en: You have his shoulders.

blocks.html: Kim Seohyeon has been riding since dawn, the bright-blue robe stuck between his shoulders, and wants water more than a shrine. When heat breathes out of the hillside he names it a spring. Then he hears a laugh from no village he knows. He should turn the horse. He does not.
blocks.ko: 김서현은 새벽부터 말을 달려 밝은 푸른 도포가 어깨 사이에 들러붙었고, 지금은 사당보다 물이 급하다. 산비탈에서 열이 입김처럼 새어 나오자 그걸 샘이라 부른다. 그러다 그가 아는 어느 마을 것도 아닌 웃음소리가 들린다. 말을 돌려야 한다. 돌리지 않는다.

blocks.caption: Kim Seohyeon, long before anyone called him Yushin’s father. Mostly, he is thirsty.
blocks.ko: 아직 누구의 아버지도 아닌 김서현. 지금은 그저 목이 마르다.

blocks.html: Under the hill, three sisters have gone centuries without a man to look at. Golhwa keeps the heat in the stone, Hyullé the water, and Narim, the eldest, the moss and the roots and the rules. Golhwa has the warmest rock and is bored enough to bite it. Then the hill tells them about hooves on the road above.
blocks.ko: 언덕 아래 세 자매는 몇 백 년째 쳐다볼 남자 하나 없이 산다. 돌 속의 열은 골화가, 물은 혈레가, 이끼와 뿌리와 규칙은 맏이 나림이 맡는다. 골화는 제일 따뜻한 바위를 차지하고도 그걸 깨물고 싶을 만큼 심심하다. 그때 언덕이 위쪽 길의 말발굽 소리를 일러 준다.
blocks.art: Postures as in the opening of Daeya Fortress: Golhwa sprawled wide on the warm rock, Hyullé knees together and eyes down, Narim upright with her ankles crossed. Ember light, dripping water, floating leaves.

blocks.html: The news does not get Golhwa off the rock. She rides its warm ridge with her chima bunched at the hip, talking to it as if a man were already under her. Hyullé watches through the steam and pretends to be watching the steam. Narim calls it undignified and does not look away.
blocks.ko: 그 소식에도 골화는 바위에서 내려오지 않는다. 치마를 허리께에 뭉쳐 쥔 채 따뜻한 능선을 타면서, 밑에 벌써 남자가 있는 것처럼 바위에 대고 말을 한다. 혈레는 김 너머로 그걸 보면서 김을 보는 척한다. 나림은 꼴사납다고 하면서도 눈을 떼지 않는다.

en: Golhwa.
The rock is not a man. Sit up.
We can be anything…
A fox. A crone. Let whoever comes take the water and go. I don’t want to want him already.
lines: 여우도. 노파도. 오는 사람한테 물 주고 보내. 벌써 원하고 싶지 않은데.

en: I haven’t even seen his stomach and my thighs are — sorry.
Then we try. Foxes first. If he laughs we change.
I pick the last face.
lines: 그럼 해 봐. 여우부터. 웃으면 바꿔.

blocks.html: For a breath they are foxes, three tails writing in the steam: one ember-red, one dripping, one with leaves caught in it. Golhwa likes it too much. Hyullé’s ears go flat. Narim shakes the fur off like a bad pin.
blocks.ko: 한숨 동안 그들은 여우다. 꼬리 셋이 김에 글을 쓴다. 하나는 불씨처럼 붉고, 하나는 물이 듣고, 하나엔 잎이 걸렸다. 골화는 너무 좋아한다. 혈레의 귀가 납작 눕는다. 나림은 나쁜 비녀 빼듯 털을 털어 낸다.

en: I look like a fox. I like it.
He would run. Fine. Old ladies.

blocks.html: Then three crones at a well that is not a well, an ember in one sleeve, water at one hem, moss on one pair of shoulders. Golhwa hates the stoop. Hyullé almost stays; wanting is quieter in a crone’s face.
blocks.ko: 그다음엔 우물 아닌 우물가의 노파 셋. 한 소매엔 불씨가, 한 치맛단엔 듣는 물이, 한 어깨엔 이끼가 있다. 골화는 굽은 등이 싫다. 혈레는 거의 이대로 있고 싶다. 노파의 얼굴에서는 원하는 게 덜 티 나니까.

en: He’ll take the water and bless us and leave.
Younger, then. Not crones. The face a man stays for and calls mother.
lines: 물만 떠 가고, 축복하고, 가 버리겠지.
그럼 좀 젊게. 노파는 말고. 남자가 머물면서 어머니라고 부르는 얼굴.

blocks.html: Then women old enough to have raised him, mouths kind and hungry at once. Narim almost keeps it; she has been an eldest that long.
blocks.ko: 그다음엔 그를 키웠을 만한 나이의 여자들. 입은 착하면서 동시에 굶주렸다. 나림은 거의 그걸로 정한다. 맏이로 산 세월이 그만큼 길다.
blocks.art: Elements stay readable: ember light on Golhwa’s silk, Hyullé’s hem dripping, leaves caught in Narim’s hair.

en: He’ll want a mother. He’ll walk out of a mother.
Young. Sit so the silk sticks.
lines: 어머니를 원하겠지. 그러고는 어머니한테서 걸어 나가.

en: Young.

blocks.html: They take the last shapes the way a hand takes a pin: white jeogori over olive, coral and pale blue. Three beautiful women on the far rock.
blocks.ko: 마지막 모습은 손이 비녀를 집듯 고른다. 흰 저고리에 올리브, 산호, 옅은 파랑 치마. 맞은편 바위에 아름다운 여자 셋.

blocks.html: He is still calling it a spring when the hill opens under his foot, and he comes up in a bowl of black water under stone.
blocks.ko: 아직 샘이라 부르는 중에 언덕이 발밑에서 열리고, 그는 돌 아래 검은 물 사발에서 올라온다.

blocks.html: Wet through, he lets the robe fall, and the bright blue lies on the stone. He thinks he is alone, and walks into the steam.
blocks.ko: 흠뻑 젖은 그는 도포를 떨어뜨리고, 밝은 푸른빛이 돌 위에 놓인다. 혼자인 줄 알고, 김 속으로 걸어 들어간다.

blocks.html: They have never seen a Kim. They look at his back first, then the jaw, the hands, the shoulders, and then, all three at once, back to the shoulders.
blocks.ko: 셋 다 김씨를 본 적이 없다. 등을 먼저 보고, 그다음 턱, 손, 어깨, 그리고 셋이 동시에 다시 어깨로 돌아간다.
blocks.art: Reaction panels: three faces freeze, heart pupils, motion lines in the steam.

blocks.html: Then their eyes go lower, past the wet chest to the dark water at his hips, which hides less than he thinks, and stay there. Golhwa’s mouth opens and does not close. Hyullé forgets to breathe. Narim hears herself swallow.
blocks.ko: 그다음 눈이 아래로 간다. 젖은 가슴을 지나, 그가 생각하는 것보다 덜 가려 주는 허리께의 검은 물까지 가서, 거기 머문다. 골화의 입이 벌어진 채 다물어지지 않는다. 혈레는 숨 쉬는 걸 잊는다. 나림은 제가 침 삼키는 소리를 듣는다.

blocks.html: Golhwa squints at him the way a painter squints at a wall, and talks to her sisters out of the side of her mouth.
blocks.ko: 골화는 화공이 벽을 재듯 눈을 가늘게 뜨고 그를 보며, 입 한쪽으로 언니들에게 말한다.

blocks.html: Put him in a panel. Chest. The water at his hips. I will look at that and nothing else.
blocks.ko: 패널에 넣어. 가슴. 허리의 물. 그것만 볼래.
blocks.art: Spoken aloud to her sisters, not a thought balloon.

blocks.html: Don’t look. Looking makes the sound come out. A sound leaks out of her anyway.
blocks.ko: 보지 마. 보면 소리가 나와. 그래도 소리가 샌다.
blocks.art: Thought balloon for the first two sentences; the last is a caption.

en: Who…
Who lives here. I was looking for water.
lines: 여긴 누가 사는 곳이오. 물을 찾았소.

en: We do. You fell.
Sit—
Sit down before you fall in again.

blocks.html: He looks at her as if she were kind, and Narim forgets what she was saying. A thousand years of practice, and she blames the steam.
blocks.ko: 그가 친절한 사람을 보듯 그녀를 보자, 나림은 하던 말을 잊는다. 천 년을 연습해 놓고, 김 탓을 한다.

blocks.html: Sit down before I ask you to lay me on the rock, she does not say. She is the eldest.
blocks.ko: 앉아요, 내가 바위에 눕혀 달라고 조르기 전에. 그 말은 하지 않는다. 맏이니까.

blocks.html: Golhwa steps in front of Hyullé like a door closing, Narim catches her wrist, and somehow Golhwa is already in the water up to her knees.
blocks.ko: 골화가 문 닫듯 혈레 앞을 막아서고, 나림이 그 손목을 잡는데, 어느새 골화는 무릎까지 물에 들어가 있다.

en: You already— wait. Hi. I’m Golhwa. That’s unnie. That’s Hyullé, she won’t say it unless you look at her first, which you should, but maybe don’t look at me like that or I am going to say the stupid thing.
lines: 벌써— 잠깐. 안녕. 골화야. 저쪽이 언니. 저쪽이 혈레, 네가 먼저 봐야 말하거든, 보는 게 맞는데, 나를 그렇게 보면 바보 같은 말 할 것 같아.

en: Fuck—
Sorry. Hi.
I was going to.
Hello.
Kim Seohyeon.
Are you… I mean. People.
Today. We are the mouths the hill uses when it is tired of being stone.
Not a village bath. I’m Narim.
lines: 오늘은요. 돌이기를 지친 언덕이 쓰는 입이에요.

en: Kim.
Say it again. No, I heard you. It just… sticks. Same sound as the steam. I like it.
lines: 다시. 아니, 들었어. 그냥… 붙어. 김이랑 같은 소리. 좋아.

en: I should — the horse is up there.
I was going to say the ledge is warmer.

lines: 그 위에, 내 다리 사이에 널 두고 싶다고 하려 했고.
en: I was going to say I want you on it, between my legs.
The far ledge stays warm.
If you sit I can…

lines: 무릎은 붙이고 있을게요. 거짓말이에요. 더 따뜻한 데. 제 위요.
en: I’ll keep my knees together. That’s a lie. Somewhere warmer. On me.
I have officers. I don’t need —

blocks.html: The comedy goes out of the cave. Narim’s next words are not a woman’s. The hill answers.
blocks.ko: 동굴에서 장난이 빠진다. 나림의 다음 말은 여자의 것이 아니다. 언덕이 답한다.

en: Stand where you are. Do not climb the rock. Do not ask who we are.
One question. Spoken once, from the water. About what you will do — not what you want to hear.
The name is the offering. Kim.
lines: 거기 서요. 바위에 오르지 말아요. 우리가 누구냐고 묻지 말아요.
질문 하나. 물에서, 한 번만. 듣고 싶은 말이 아니라 — 당신이 할 일.

en: …Will the road take me home.
The road will take you home. The house will not stay there.
Keep the name in the palm they cannot see. A country will take your house and call the taking love.
lines: 길은 당신을 집으로 데려가요. 집은 거기 머물지 않아요.
그들이 못 보는 손바닥에 이름을 두어요. 나라가 당신 집을 가져가고, 그 가져감을 사랑이라 부를 거예요.

en: The boy will need the name when they say he was never of them.
lines: 그들이 자기네 사람이 아니라 할 때, 아이에게 그 이름이 필요할 거예요.

en: Leave before you ask a second. The second wears a crown.
…Sorry. That was the hill. This is me.
lines: 두 번째를 묻기 전에 가요. 두 번째는 왕관을 써요.

en: I have a son. A few weeks. Yushin.
I don’t know what I would ask for him.
lines: 그를 위해 뭘 물어야 할지도 모르겠소.

blocks.html: They go still, and all three pairs of eyes go solid: green, cyan, ember.
blocks.ko: 셋이 멈추고, 눈 셋이 통째로 물든다. 초록, 청록, 불씨.

blocks.html: Seohyeon forgets he is naked. His son’s name is still in his mouth, and the hill has already spent it.
blocks.ko: 서현은 벗은 줄도 잊는다. 아들 이름이 아직 입에 있는데, 언덕이 벌써 써 버렸다.

blocks.speaker: The Hill
en: The child will be the measure two countries cannot share.
They will call him a blade and mean a border.
When they say he was never of them, the blade will still be Kim.
He will cut more than he is given. Don’t ask who bleeds.
lines: 그 아이는 두 나라가 나눠 갖지 못하는 자가 될 거예요.
그들이 자기네 사람이 아니라 할 때에도, 그 칼은 김으로 남을 거예요.
받은 것보다 더 자를 거예요. 누가 피를 흘리는지는 묻지 말아요.

en: That wasn’t a second. The hill was generous. This is me.
lines: 두 번째가 아니야. 언덕이 후했어. 이건 나야.

blocks.html: Narim turns a river stone in her fingers, ordinary and grey and too warm for the cave, and puts it in his palm.
blocks.ko: 나림이 손가락 사이로 강돌 하나를 굴린다. 평범한 회색 돌인데 동굴치고는 너무 따뜻하다. 그걸 그의 손바닥에 얹는다.

en: If it goes cold, you did not come as a petitioner.
If it stays warm, the hill will open. Same way. Water. One question. The name. Come back every time it is warm. Until you cannot climb. Then send the name.
lines: 따뜻하면 언덕이 열려요. 같은 길. 물. 질문 하나. 이름. 따뜻할 때마다 다시 와요. 오르지 못할 때까지. 그다음엔 이름을 보내요.

en: That is a lot to put on a boy who cannot sit up yet.
lines: 아직 앉지도 못하는 아이에게 과한 말씀이오.

en: Come back though.
Then go.

blocks.html: He climbs out wearing nothing but water and the stone, and nobody on the far rock has the manners to look away.
blocks.ko: 물과 돌 하나만 걸치고 올라오는데, 맞은편 바위의 누구도 눈을 돌려 줄 예의가 없다.
blocks.art: Wet muscle in the steam-shadow, rim-lit.

en: He looked at me first.
…He looked at the water.
…Which is worse.
Next time he’s mine. Not yours.
lines: 다음엔 내 거야. 네 거 아니야.

en: If he does… I want the face next time.
I’ll hide. I’ll look anyway.

blocks.html: Hyullé’s footprint takes a long time to fade from the rock he did not sit on. Golhwa’s foot swings. Narim’s smile is small, and tired.
blocks.ko: 그가 앉지 않은 바위에서 혈레의 발자국은 오래 지워지지 않는다. 골화의 발이 까딱거린다. 나림의 미소는 작고, 지쳐 있다.

blocks.html: He rides home with three names and a stone that will not cool, and tells the next post it was a spring. Then he keeps coming back, more eagerly than any son will, until the hill learns his walk.
blocks.ko: 이름 셋과 식지 않는 돌 하나를 품고 돌아가, 다음 진에는 샘이었다고 말한다. 그러고는 어떤 아들보다도 서둘러 자꾸 돌아오고, 마침내 언덕이 그의 걸음을 배운다.

blocks.html: Years later he is grey at the temples, and the counsel has not changed: one question from the water, one name. When it is done he does not reach for the robe, and this time he sits on the warm ledge.
blocks.ko: 몇 해 뒤 그는 관자놀이가 희끗하고, 조언은 그대로다. 물에서 질문 하나, 이름 하나. 조언이 끝나도 그는 도포에 손을 뻗지 않고, 이번에는 따뜻한 턱에 앉는다.

en: You three are going to kill an old man.
I came back anyway. The horse knows the way better than I do.
lines: 그래도 왔소. 말이 나보다 길을 잘 아오.

en: Grey already, First Kim?
The hill remembers a younger walk.
Tonight we will see what is left.
…Hm.

blocks.html: Golhwa does not stay on her rock. She reaches him first and kisses him like a woman who has waited decades for it, and he kisses her back as if he had waited just as long.
blocks.ko: 골화는 제 바위에 머물지 않는다. 제일 먼저 그에게 닿아 몇십 년을 기다린 여자처럼 입을 맞추고, 그도 꼭 그만큼 기다린 사람처럼 입맞춤을 돌려준다.

blocks.html: She settles into his lap on the warm ledge with her coral silk bunched at the hip and takes him in slowly, then not slowly at all, and the quiet of the spring does not survive it. She came to mock an old man. His arms are still iron under the wet skin, and he sets the pace without asking.
blocks.ko: 그녀는 산호빛 비단을 허리께에 뭉친 채 따뜻한 턱 위 그의 무릎에 내려앉아, 처음엔 천천히, 곧 전혀 천천히가 아니게 그를 받아들이고, 샘의 고요는 거기서 끝난다. 늙은이를 놀리러 왔다. 그런데 젖은 살갗 아래 그의 팔은 아직 쇠고, 그는 묻지도 않고 속도를 정한다.

blocks.html: When it breaks over her she is loud about it, and he follows a breath later, holding her so she does not fall wrong. Afterwards she lies against his wet shoulder, trembling, hair everywhere, until the cry turns into breath and the breath into a ruined laugh.
blocks.ko: 절정이 덮쳐 오자 그녀는 거리낌 없이 소리를 지르고, 그는 한 숨 늦게 뒤따르며 그녀가 잘못 쓰러지지 않게 붙든다. 그 뒤로 그녀는 머리를 온통 헝클어뜨린 채 그의 젖은 어깨에 기대어 떨고, 비명은 숨이 되고 숨은 망가진 웃음이 된다.

blocks.html: Grey at the temples and he is still under me. I screamed. He stayed. Kiss. Inside. Ride. He filled me. Mine.
blocks.ko: 관자놀이에 회색인데도 밑에 있어. 소리쳤어. 그는 남았어. 키스. 안. 타기. 채워 줬어. 내 거.
blocks.art: Thought balloon.

blocks.html: Jealousy turns into sharing the way steam turns into weather, all at once and wet. The sisters leave their rock. Narim means to sit like an eldest and lasts one breath. Hyullé climbs into his lap last, without a word, and when her silence breaks it breaks against his chest.
blocks.ko: 질투가 나눔으로 바뀌는 건 김이 날씨로 바뀌는 것과 같다. 한순간에, 축축하게. 자매들이 제 바위를 떠난다. 나림은 맏이답게 앉겠다고 했다가 한 숨도 못 버틴다. 혈레는 맨 나중에, 말없이 그의 무릎에 오르고, 그 침묵은 깨질 때도 그의 가슴에 대고 깨진다.

blocks.html: Dawn finds the four of them asleep on the warm ledge, tangled in wet silk: Golhwa still where she won first, her throat raw, Narim with her mouth almost on his lined cheek, Hyullé curled against his side.
blocks.ko: 새벽이 오면 넷은 젖은 비단에 뒤엉킨 채 따뜻한 턱 위에서 잠들어 있다. 골화는 처음 이긴 자리에 목이 쉰 채로, 나림은 주름진 뺨에 입술이 닿을락 말락 하게, 혈레는 그의 옆구리에 몸을 웅크리고.

blocks.html: In the morning he leaves before the road remembers him. The stone stays warm until the year he can no longer climb, and then, as he was told, he sends the name.
blocks.ko: 아침이 되면 그는 길이 그를 알아보기 전에 떠난다. 돌은 그가 더는 오르지 못하게 되는 해까지 식지 않고, 그해에 그는 들은 대로 이름을 보낸다.

blocks.html: Now the name stands waist-deep in the same black water, scrubbing the road off his forearms.
blocks.ko: 이제 그 이름이 같은 검은 물에 허리까지 잠겨, 팔뚝에 묻은 길 먼지를 문질러 씻는다.

blocks.html: Golhwa’s legs stay spread wide on the wet rock, chima hiked. She is wet enough to take him from here. A thread of it finds her lip and she does not wipe it. His father’s shoulders. Worse. Hyullé’s knees stay pressed, eyes down, silk soaked through between them, and she answers nothing because if she opens her mouth it will be a sound. Narim’s silk clings and her next breath is late. Kim. Ours. Fuck him. The marshal looks once and the spring does not hide much — he is rock-hard in the black bowl and pretends the water is a wall. His father would have teased. He quotes the queen.
blocks.ko: 골화의 다리는 젖은 바위에서 넓게 벌어진 채고 치마는 걷혀 있다. 여기서 바로 받아도 될 만큼 젖었다. 그 실이 입술에 붙고 닦지 않는다. 아버지 어깨. 더 나빠. 혈레의 무릎은 모아져 있고 눈은 아래, 사이 비단은 다 젖었고, 입을 열면 소리가 나올 거라 아무 말도 안 한다. 나림의 비단이 붙고, 다음 숨이 늦다. 김. 우리 거야. 박아. 원수가 한 번 보고 샘이 감춰 주는 게 없다 — 검은 사발 안에서 이미 돌처럼 서 있고, 물을 벽인 척한다. 아버지라면 농을 했을 것이다. 그는 여왕을 인용한다.

en: Kim Yushin. You wash like a man who thinks dirt is the only thing that sticks.
It isn’t. The water’s on your stomach and I haven’t looked away.
lines: 김유신. 때만이 붙는 줄 아는 사람처럼 씻는군요.
아니에요. 물이 배 위에 있는데, 저 한 번도 눈을 못 뗐어요.

en: Leave the sermon, unnie. He’s naked. We can be honest.
Come closer, Yushin— I want that on my tongue before she makes it a lesson.
lines: 가까이 와, 유신— 언니가 교훈으로 만들기 전에 혀에 올리고 싶어.

blocks.html: She has been on that rock since his father left, moaning at nobody, picturing him under her. She wants him to grab her and fuck her into the stone. If he stays put she will come across. The most popular man in Silla, and he came back to their water. Hyullé’s eyes go to the waterline and stay. Narim forgets the sermon for one breath.
blocks.ko: 아버지 가고부터 그 바위에 올라앉아, 없는 사람한테 신음해 왔다. 밑에 그가 있다고 그리면서. 세게 잡아 바닥에 박아 줬으면. 그대로 서 있으면 내가 건너간다. 신라에서 제일 인기 있는 남자인데, 그들의 물에 돌아왔다. 혈레의 눈이 수선에 가서 머문다. 나림은 설교를 한숨 잊는다.

blocks.html: She goes in like a tiger. Wink. Knees open. Steam that looks like it is coming off her skin.
blocks.ko: 호랑이처럼 들어간다. 윙크. 무릎이 열린다. 살에서 나는 것처럼 보이는 김.

en: Don’t stand there like that. I can see all of you and you’re just letting me.
I will come across. Open your knees. I’m not swimming over to talk.
lines: 그렇게 서지 마. 다 보이는데 그냥 보여 주는 거잖아.
내가 건너갈 거야. 무릎 벌려. 이야기하러 헤엄치는 거 아니야.

en: …Golhwa.
He came to rest.

lines: 그래도 입에 대고 싶어요. 미안해요. 미안하지 않아요.
en: I still want my mouth on him. I’m sorry. I’m not.
…Who are you three.
If this is a dream, make it shorter. I have a border to cut.
lines: 꿈이면 짧게 해 주시오. 자를 국경이 있소.

blocks.html: The comedy goes out of the cave again. He asked who they are. That is not a question they answer.
blocks.ko: 동굴에서 다시 장난이 빠진다. 그가 누구냐고 물었다. 그건 답하는 질문이 아니다.

en: That is not a question we answer. Stand where you are. One question. What you will do.
You came as your father came. The flirting is free. The hill is not.
Take Baekje’s forts if you must. Do not take Baekje’s hurry.
And stop standing there wet, like you don’t know what that does to the three of us.
lines: 그건 답하는 질문이 아니에요. 거기 서요. 질문 하나. 당신이 할 일.
아버지처럼 왔군요. 농은 공짜예요. 언덕은 아니고요.
백제의 성은 가져도 돼요. 백제의 서두름은 가지지 말고.
그리고 젖은 채로 그렇게 서 있지 마세요. 우리 셋한테 무슨 짓인지 모르는 척하지 마시고요.

en: And… if a man from the north offers you a door…
…look who holds the latch on the other side.
Sorry. I — I was staring at your chest. The latch too. I meant both.
lines: 미안해요. 전 — 가슴을 보고 있었어요. 빗장도. 둘 다요.

en: She meant it. Don’t apologise for being right, Hyullé.
Also — your friend with the pink name. Chunchu.
He will kneel in rooms you would burn. That is not weakness. It cuts later.
lines: 그 말 맞아요. 맞다고 사과하지 마, 혈레.
그리고 — 분홍빛 이름 가진 친구. 춘추.
당신은 태울 방에서 그는 무릎을 꿇을 거예요. 약함이 아니야. 나중에 베니까.
너는. 무릎 꿇을 거면 여기 꿇어. 내가 느끼게.
en: You, though. If you’re going to kneel, kneel here, where I can feel it.
I hear you.
But Her Majesty —
Ugh…
“Her Majesty.” “Her Majesty.”
What does that mortal have that we don’t? A chair.
lines: 그 인간한테 우리한테 없는 게 뭐가 있는데? 의자.
난 다리 벌리고 있는데 너는 아직도 그 이름을 불러.
en: I’ve got my legs open and you’re still saying her name.
Stay with us, Yushin~~
Stay— in my lap. Don’t make me beg when my legs are already open.
lines: 있어— 내 무릎 위에. 이미 다리 벌렸는데 빌게 하지 마.

blocks.html: She wants him in her, not bowing. The title can keep the forts. Unnie can keep the sermon.
blocks.ko: 절하지 말고 들어와 줬으면. 존호는 성을 가져도 돼. 설교는 언니가 해.

en: Golhwa.
When they ask if a woman can hold the west, do not answer for her. Take the forts on her count. Slow. She will look like she planned it.
And when the count is done, come back dripping. I am not finished with you.
lines: 여자가 서쪽을 지킬 수 있냐고 묻거든, 대신 답하지 말아요. 성을 그 수대로 가져요. 천천히. 계획한 것처럼 보일 테니까.
셈이 끝나면 젖은 채로 돌아와요. 저 아직 안 끝났어요.

en: …The binyeo is pretty. The face is tired.
…He can go.

lines: 전 단지 — 길 나서기 전에 허벅지로 감고 싶었어요. 따뜻하다는 말은 점잖은 거였어요.
en: I only — wanted my thighs around him before the road. Warm was the polite word.
Forts. Slow. Her count. I have it.
Dedication is not a flirtation you three get to bill me for.
…But the water helps. Already.
lines: 충성이 당신들이 청구할 수 있는 농염은 아니오.

en: Hear that? He thanked the water. Not us.
Fine. Go play marshal. Next time, leave the armour — and that mortal — outside the cave.
lines: 그래. 가서 장군 놀아. 다음엔 갑옷이랑 — 그 인간도 — 동굴 밖에 두고 와.

en: Leave the hard part in here.
Golhwa. Hyullé.
The warm ledge around the bend — and the herbs in the cleft. Both of you.
Go on. The marshal still has ears for counsel… and I still have a mouth for it.
lines: 굽이 너머 따뜻한 턱이랑 — 틈새의 약초. 둘 다.
가. 대장군은 아직 조언 들을 귀가 있고… 나한테는 그걸 받을 입이 있어.

en: I’m going to use the mouth.
Herbs? For a bath?
…Unnie. If you’re about to sermon him alone, I’m billing you for boredom. If you’re about to sit on him, I’m billing you for theft.
lines: …언니. 혼자 설교할 거면 심심해서 청구할 거야. 그 위에 앉을 거면 도둑질로 청구할 거고.

en: …Yes, unnie.
We’ll — we’ll be quick.

lines: 제가 듣기 전에 끝내 버리면 안 돼요.
en: Don’t you dare finish him before I hear it.

blocks.html: They go. Mist takes the younger two the way water takes a thrown stone — a bright disturbance, then nothing. Yushin is alone with Narim, and for the first time he understands that being alone with any of them is not the same as being safe.
blocks.ko: 간다. 안개가 동생 둘을 가져간다 — 물에 던진 돌처럼, 잠깐 반짝이고, 이내 없음. 유신은 나림과 단둘이 남고, 비로소 안다. 그중 누구와도 단둘이 있는 것은 안전한 것과 다르다는 것을.

en: You thanked the water.
I am not water.
Come here, Kim Yushin

lines: — 국경이 거절을 가르치기 전에 제 입에 넣어요.
en: — I want you in my mouth before the border teaches you how to refuse.
Narim—
You just told them we are steam.
I told them.
The counsel was real. So is this.
Stay. Not for the queen. Not for the road.
lines: 남아요. 여왕 때문도, 길 때문도 아니에요.
지금 선 그거 때문에. 김에 입이 없는 척하지 마요.
en: For the part of you that’s hard, pretending the steam has no mouth.

blocks.html: She crosses the black water as if it owes her a path. Close enough that the steam becomes her breath on his mouth. Her palm finds the wet line of his collarbone — not Golhwa’s tease, not Hyullé’s apology — a quiet claim, and when she kisses him there is laughter under it, and hunger, and the patience of someone who has been watching him undress for longer than this visit.
blocks.ko: 검은 물을 건너온다. 물이 길을 빚진 것처럼. 김이 그의 입 위에서 그녀의 숨이 될 만큼 가깝다. 손바닥이 젖은 쇄골을 찾는다 — 골화의 장난도, 혈레의 사과도 아닌 — 조용한 차지. 입을 맞출 때 그 밑에 웃음이 있고, 굶주림이 있고, 이번 방문보다 오래 그가 벗는 것을 보아 온 사람의 참을성이 있다.

en: …This is not counsel.
And I — I still have to leave.
lines: 그리고 나 — 나는 아직도 떠나야 하오.

en: Of course you do.
Mainland boys always do.
So kiss me like someone who will be late for the border
lines: 그러니까 국경에 늦을 사람처럼 입 맞춰요
— 아직 될 때 비단 밑에 손을 넣고요.
en: — and put your hand under the silk while you still can.

blocks.html: He does. Or she makes him. Hard to tell, in water that warm. Her mouth opens under his; her thigh finds his hip against the rock; for a few breaths the marshal of Silla is only a guest who has drifted too far from shore — and likes it, disastrously.
blocks.ko: 한다. 아니면 그녀가 시킨다. 이렇게 따뜻한 물에선 구분이 어렵다. 입이 그의 아래에서 열리고, 허벅지가 바위에 대고 그의 엉덩이를 찾고 — 몇 호흡 동안 신라의 대장군은 그저 뭍에서 너무 멀리 떠내려온 손님일 뿐이다. 그리고 그걸, 망할 만큼, 좋아한다.

en: There.
Deeper. The steam won’t tell.
…Unless my sisters do. Don’t you dare be gentle.
lines: …동생들이 하기 전엔. 살살 할 생각 하지 마요.

en: The herbs were already— unnie, his mouth is on you. I can see it. Move.
lines: 약초는 이미— 언니, 입이 그 위에 있잖아. 보여. 비켜.

blocks.html: Mist tears. Golhwa first, arms full of nothing useful; Hyullé a half-step behind, eyes huge. Narim’s hand is still on him. Nobody moves for one long, ridiculous second — then the cavern remembers how to be loud.
blocks.ko: 안개가 찢어진다. 골화가 먼저, 쓸모없는 것을 팔에 안고; 혈레는 반 걸음 뒤, 눈이 커다랗다. 나림의 손은 아직 그 위에 있다. 길고 우스운 한동안 아무도 움직이지 않는다 — 그제야 동굴이 시끄러워지는 법을 기억한다.

en: UNNIE.
You sent us for herbs so you could—?!
What does that mortal have that we don’t — wait. What do you have that we don’t?!
lines: 그 인간한테 우리한테 없는 게 뭐야 — 잠깐. 언니가 우리한테 없는 게 뭐야?!

en: Him. In you. Get off, or share.
…Unnie.
You said we were his steam.
Steam doesn’t… hold like that.

lines: 제가 하려고 했어요. 무릎 붙잡고 참았는데, 언니가 먼저 앉았어요.
en: I was going to. I kept my knees together so I wouldn’t, and you sat down first.
Put the herbs down.
And close your mouths before the marshal remembers he can still dress.
…Hyullé. The ledge. Warm it anyway — he will run, and he will pretend this was weather.
lines: 그리고 입 다물어. 대장군이 아직 옷 입을 수 있다는 걸 기억하기 전에.
…혈레. 턱. 그래도 데워 둬 — 뛸 거고, 이걸 날씨였다고 우길 테니.
내가 있던 자리는 아직 맛볼 수 있어.
en: You can still taste where I was.
…I should go.
The Queen will need me before the year turns.
lines: 여왕께서 해가 바뀌기 전에 나를 필요로 할 테니.

en: Oh now he thanks the exit.
Fine. Next time nobody leaves the rock. I mean it.
lines: 좋아. 다음엔 아무도 바위 못 떠나. 진심이야.
왕비 셈이 머리에서 빠질 때까지 얼굴에 앉을 거야.
en: I’ll sit on his face until the queen’s numbers fall out.
Stay with us, Yushin~~

lines: — 아니면 적어도 언니가 먼저 먹지 못하게 해.
en: — or at least stop letting unnie eat first.
…The ledge is still warm.
If you want. Before the road.
I won’t — look. Much.
I’ll look lower.
I’m sorry. Come here anyway.

blocks.html: He dresses in the cold with three pairs of eyes on him and one mouth still tasting of forest. When he looks again they are back on the far rock — as if nothing happened — except Golhwa’s foot swings harder, and Hyullé’s footprint takes longer to fade, and Narim’s smile is the smallest, most dangerous thing in the cave. He rides south with counsel under his ribs… and an invitation he can no longer pretend not to have answered.
blocks.ko: 추위 속에서 옷을 입는다. 눈 세 쌍이 그를 보고, 입 하나는 아직 숲 맛이 난다. 다시 보면 저쪽 바위에 돌아와 있다 — 아무 일 없었다는 듯이 — 다만 골화의 발은 더 세게 흔들리고, 혈레의 발자국은 더 늦게 지워지며, 나림의 미소는 동굴에서 가장 작고 가장 위험한 것이다. 갈비 밑에 조언을 품고 남으로 달린다… 그리고 더 이상 대답하지 않았다고 우길 수 없는 초대 하나를.

blocks.label: BOTH ROADS
blocks.ko: 두 길

blocks.html: They ask him to choose. Gaya blood or Silla marshal. Fortress count or cavern counsel. The yard’s perfection or the one room that does not ask him for a victory.
blocks.ko: 사람들은 고르라 한다. 가야의 피인가, 신라의 원수인가. 성의 숫자인가, 동굴의 조언인가. 연병장의 완벽인가, 승리를 요구하지 않는 유일한 방인가.

blocks.html: He refuses the fork they keep drawing for him. Gaya blood or Silla marshal. Fortress count or cavern counsel. He rides from the cliff-fortress with the horse still smelling of the border, shaves at the cave mouth because the sisters keep that rule, and sits where the dark water meets the bright valley — three faint spirits at his back, a kingdom that still doubts his loyalty ahead.
blocks.ko: 사람들이 그어 놓은 갈림길을 고르지 않는다. 가야의 피인가, 신라의 원수인가. 성의 숫자인가, 동굴의 조언인가. 국경 냄새 남은 말을 타고 절벽 성에서 내려와, 셋이 지키는 규칙대로 동굴 입구에서 면도를 하고, 검은 물이 밝은 골짜기를 만나는 자리에 앉는다 — 등 뒤에는 희미한 세 신령, 앞에는 아직도 그의 충성을 의심하는 나라.

en: You do not have to pick a country to wash in.
Wash. Then go be useful to whichever one still needs you. If you get hard on the road, that was my mouth. Don’t thank the water for it.
lines: 어느 나라를 고르지 않아도 씻을 수 있어요.
씻어요. 그다음, 아직 당신이 필요한 쪽을 위해 쓸모 있으세요. 길에서 서면, 제 입이에요. 그거 물한테 고맙다고 하지 마세요.

en: …Both need me.
That is the trouble.

blocks.label: THE MARSHAL’S STEAM
blocks.ko: 원수의 김

blocks.html: Yushin does not bring everyone to the lake. He brings Chunchu — once — because a man who will invent rooms the Council never votes on should learn what steam does to cleverness.
blocks.ko: 유신은 호수에 아무나 데려오지 않는다. 춘추를 — 단 한 번 — 데려온다. 화백이 표결하지 않는 방을 발명할 사람은, 김이 영리함에 무엇을 하는지 알아야 하니까.

blocks.html: At the mouth he borrows a razor and makes a mess of dignity. Magenta silk leaves his shoulders. He walks in with nothing on but water. He still thinks a lake cannot surprise a man who invents rooms.
blocks.ko: 입구에서 빌린 면도칼로 체면을 망친다. 자홍 비단이 어깨에서 내린다. 물만 걸치고 들어간다. 방을 발명하는 남자를 호수가 놀라게 할 수 없다고 아직 생각한다.

blocks.html: They smell the name before they finish his face. Steam off Golhwa’s skin; her legs stay spread. Water down Hyullé’s chin; her knees stay pressed, eyes down. A leaf that will not fall beside Narim. He keeps the black bowl as a wall. The spring does not hide much — letter or sword, he is already standing in the water the way every Kim does when he looks at them. They do not ask his rank.
blocks.ko: 얼굴을 다 보기 전에 이름을 맡는다. 골화의 살에서 김이 난다. 다리는 벌어진 채. 혈레의 턱으로 물이 내린다. 무릎은 모으고 눈은 아래. 나림 곁에 떨어지지 않는 잎. 그는 검은 사발을 벽으로 쓴다. 샘이 감춰 주는 게 없다 — 편지든 칼이든, 셋을 보면 김은 누구나 물 속에서 선다. 셋은 신분을 묻지 않는다.

en: Oh — a soft one.
Yushin, you brought us a letter instead of a sword. Hi. I’m Golhwa. Don’t look at me like that or I’ll say what I want to do with the soft one.
lines: 유신, 칼 대신 편지를 데려왔네. 안녕. 나 골화. 그렇게 보지 마. 보면 그 애한테 하고 싶은 걸 말해 버려.

en: Come closer— I want to feel if the letter made you shy or hard.
lines: 가까이 와— 편지가 널 수줍게 했는지, 서게 했는지, 만져 보게.

blocks.html: She has been on the rock picturing a letter-soft mouth. Soft ones last. She cannot sit. She wants him to pin her until she goes insane.
blocks.ko: 편지처럼 부드러운 입을 그리며 바위에 허리를 갈대였다. 부드러운 쪽이 더 오래 가. 앉아 있질 못하겠어. 미쳐버릴 때까지 눌러 줬으면.

en: I am inventing a kingdom.
…Preferably with fewer surprises in the water.
Sit—
Sit down before you invent it standing. I’m Narim. We are the mouths the hill uses. Wisdom, if you ask once, from the water. The marshal already knows the door. I would like to know your mouth.
lines: 서서 지어내기 전에 앉아요. 나림이에요. 언덕이 쓰는 입이에요. 지혜요, 물에서 한 번만 물으면. 원수는 이미 문을 알아요. 저는 당신 입을 알고 싶어요.

blocks.html: He looks at her like she is a clerk who can be managed. Narim cannot finish the first Sit. Out of breath. Sit down before I ask you to put that clever mouth on me, she does not say. Fuck. She is the eldest. Hyullé says nothing. In her head he is already on her. She looks like she will explode.
blocks.ko: 그는 다룰 수 있는 서기를 보듯 본다. 나림은 첫 앉—을 끝내지 못한다. 숨이 가쁘다. 앉아요, 그 영리한 입을 내게 대기 전에 — 그 말은 안 한다. 씨발. 언니다. 혈레는 말이 없다. 머리 속에서는 이미 그가 위에 있다. 터질 것처럼 보인다.

en: Hello. I’m already wet. Don’t make me say why.
lines: 안녕. 나 이미 젖었어. 왜인지는 말하게 하지 마.

en: Will a room the Council never votes on hold.
That is the only question I have that is not a joke.

blocks.html: The comedy goes out of the cave. All three pairs of eyes go solid — green, cyan, ember. One voice. Three mouths.
blocks.ko: 동굴에서 장난이 빠진다. 눈 셋이 통째로다 — 초록, 청록, 불씨. 목소리 하나. 입 셋.

blocks.speaker: THE HILL
en: Build the room. Do not put your name on the door.
A country will take a house and call the taking love. You already know that sentence. Use it.
lines: 방을 지어요. 문에 이름을 쓰지 말아요.
나라가 집을 가져가고 그 가져감을 사랑이라 부를 거예요. 그 문장은 이미 알아요. 쓰세요.

en: That was the hill. This is me.
Come closer anyway. Soft ones last. I can’t sit. My legs won’t close while you’re looking.
lines: 그래도 가까이 와. 부드러운 애는 오래 가. 나 못 앉아. 네가 보면 다리가 안 모여.

blocks.html: He leaves with nothing on but water until the mouth. The magenta is still on the stone. He looks at the path as if it were a map he intends to redraw. One sister watches him go. Another cannot speak. He never asks to return. He never entirely forgets the steam.
blocks.ko: 입구까지 물만 걸치고 나온다. 자홍은 아직 돌 위에 있다. 길을 바라본다 — 다시 그릴 지도처럼. 한 신은 그가 가는 것을 보고, 다른 신은 말을 못 한다. 돌아오자고 청하지는 않는다. 김을 아주 잊지도 않는다.

blocks.label: DAEYA FORTRESS
blocks.ko: 대야성

blocks.html: King Euija (42) reads Silla’s border the way he reads everything — patiently, and only once. Daeya is young at the top and hollow underneath. He sends the General Yunchung with ten thousand men, and in Surabol nobody’s dreams change, because the people who should be dreaming badly are at a wedding’s afterglow.
blocks.ko: 의자왕 (42)은 신라의 국경을, 모든 것을 읽듯이 읽는다 — 참을성 있게, 그리고 단 한 번만. 대야성은 윗자리가 어리고 그 밑이 비어 있다. 그는 장군 윤충에게 군사 만 명을 주어 보낸다. 서라벌에서는 누구의 꿈자리도 사나워지지 않는다. 꿈자리가 사나워야 할 사람들이 아직 혼례의 여운 속에 있기 때문이다.

blocks.html: Pumsuk (24) is the head general of Daeya, despite his young age, because he is a Noble.
blocks.ko: 품석 (24)은 어린 나이에도 대야성의 도독이다 — 진골이기 때문이다.

blocks.caption: A yellow-sleeve officer. He does the work, and the purple sleeve signs it.
blocks.ko: 누런 소매의 관리. 일은 그가 하고, 서명은 자줏빛 소매가 한다.

lines: 아니, 이런 귀에 피도 안 마른 놈을 국경에 놓는 게 말이 되나?
en: Putting a boy this green in charge of the border — does that make any sense?

lines: 아, 여기가 무슨 나란지 까먹었나? 우린 결국 흙만도 못한 것들이여~
진골이라고 하면 하늘이 알아서 쫙 열리는 그런 나라라구~~
en: Ah, forgotten what country this is? To them we’re not even dirt~
Say “True Bone” and the heavens part on their own~~

lines: 아니~~ 난 또 왜 이런 망할 나라에서 태어나서 이런 고생을 하고 있네!!
en: Why was I even born in this wretched country, to suffer like this!!

blocks.html: Silla uses men by bone rank. If you are not of the right lineage, then however great your talent and however outstanding your deeds, you cannot rise past it.
blocks.ko: 신라는 사람을 쓸 때 골품을 따지니, 그 족속이 아니면 비록 큰 재주와 뛰어난 공이 있어도 넘어설 수 없다.
blocks.hanja: 新羅用人論骨品，苟非其族，雖有鴻才傑功，不能踰越。
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 47, Biographies — Seol Gyedu (621)

blocks.html: Maehwa is the poorest woman in Daeya and the one every eye in it finds first. She is thirty-one. She stopped pretending not to know what happens to a room when she walks into it a long time ago, and the fortress has never forgiven her for it.
blocks.ko: 매화는 대야에서 가장 가난한 여자이고, 성 안의 모든 눈이 가장 먼저 찾는 여자다. 서른하나. 자기가 들어서면 방이 어떻게 되는지 모르는 척하기를 그만둔 지 오래고, 이 성은 그것을 한 번도 용서한 적이 없다.

blocks.caption: Maehwa. Plum blossom: the flower that does not wait for spring.
blocks.ko: 매화. 봄을 기다리지 않는 꽃.

lines: 이 성에 있는 사내들 말이야. 다 똑같은 냄새가 나. / 흙이랑 술이랑… 그리고 자꾸만 곁눈질하는 냄새.
en: The men in this fortress. They all smell the same. / Dirt, drink… and looking when they think I won’t notice.
Cover yourself when you go out.

lines: 옷을 사 주시든가요. / 있는 거라곤 몸에 안 맞는 것뿐인데.
en: Buy me clothes, then. / Everything I own refuses to fit.
…You know what I am paid.

lines: 알죠. / 그래서 사람들이 다 보는 겁니다.
en: I do. / Which is why everyone looks.

blocks.html: By noon the packed-earth yard splits. Porters, smiths, the boys who haul grain cluster at the well-post as if the work had always been there. Maehwa crosses alone — teal-sage silk, one red sash, celebrity distance. They do not come closer. She does not invite them.
blocks.ko: 정오가 되면 다진 흙마당이 갈라진다. 짐꾼, 대장장이, 곡식을 나르는 애들 — 우물 기둥에 몰린다, 일이 원래 거기 있었던 것처럼. 매화만 혼자 건넌다. 청록 비단, 붉은 허리끈 하나, 유명인의 거리. 그들은 다가오지 않는다. 그녀도 부르지 않는다.

en: Look at that hem…
No — the waist. The waist.
That's Gumil's wife.
I know. That's why it's worse—

blocks.html: She hears every unfinished sentence. Bored chin, and the men keep looking anyway — dirt under the nails, the same sour drink on the breath. Lower class, all of them, and she is tired of being their festival. Tired, and still walking as if the yard were built around her.
blocks.ko: 끝나지 않은 문장을 다 듣는다. 턱은 올려 둔 채, 사내들은 그래도 본다 — 손톱 밑의 흙, 같은 신 술 냄새. 낮은 것들이다. 그들의 잔치가 되는 일에 지쳤다. 지쳤으면서도, 마당이 자기 때문에 생긴 것처럼 걷는다.

en: That is a road.
Do not stand in it.

blocks.html: One of them forgets to close his mouth. She turns just enough. The hem stays a breath too long — teal silk telling on the hip, the wooden sprig pin catching the light — and she lets him have that second like a coin she can afford to drop. Then the silk falls back. She will not let him close.
blocks.ko: 한 놈이 입을 다물 것을 잊는다. 그녀는 조금만 돌아본다. 자락이 한 숨 더 머문다 — 청록 비단이 허리를 말하고, 나무 비녀가 빛을 받고 — 그 한 초를, 떨어뜨려도 되는 동전처럼 준다. 그리고 비단이 다시 내려온다. 가까이 오라고는 하지 않는다.

en: Just now—
I saw. I saw.
…She didn't even say anything.

blocks.html: She leaves them wrecked on the packed earth and almost smiles — a small, private thing, gone before the well-post. The yard is about the curve she takes with her.
blocks.ko: 그들을 다진 흙 위에 망가진 채로 두고 간다. 거의 웃는다 — 작은, 제 것만인 웃음. 우물 기둥 앞에서 사라진다. 마당의 일은 그녀가 가져가는 그 곡선이다.

blocks.label: INSIDE THE FORTRESS
blocks.ko: 성 안

blocks.html: Before the True Bone’s horse is even a rumour, the inside of Daeya already has a weather, and the weather is her. The well-post learns her hip first. Packed earth. Timber eaves. Men turn their heads as she passes. The wives they brought watch her instead of the water.
blocks.ko: 진골의 말이 소문도 되기 전에, 대야 안에는 이미 날씨가 있고, 그 날씨는 그녀다. 우물 기둥이 허리를 먼저 배운다. 다진 흙. 나무 처마. 지나갈 때 사내들이 고개를 돌린다. 데려온 아내들은 물이 아니라 그녀를 본다.

en: That chest— no, the waist.
Both. It’s both.
That’s Gumil’s wife. Why is she built like—

blocks.html: She does not look at them. She places a hand on the red sash as if it had slipped, and it has not slipped. The storehouse door is a dark mouth. Yellow sleeves in the shadow forget they have wives standing next to them. The wives do not forget. Thirty-one. The silk is poor. The body is not.
blocks.ko: 그들을 보지 않는다. 붉은 끈이 흘러내린 것처럼 손을 올리는데, 흘러내린 적이 없다. 창고 문이 어두운 입이다. 그늘의 노란 소매들이, 옆에 선 아내가 있는 줄을 잊는다. 아내들은 잊지 않는다. 서른하나. 비단은 가난하다. 몸은 아니다.

en: Watch the hand. That’s on purpose.
Don’t look at her.
I can’t. That’s the problem.

blocks.html: On the inner stair she lets the jeogori fall another finger. The post takes the silhouette. Men turn on the steps. Wives on the landing go still. They will tell themselves they were looking at the stair. They were looking at the curve under the ochre.
blocks.ko: 안쪽 계단에서 저고리를 손가락 하나만큼 더 내린다. 기둥이 실루엣을 받는다. 계단의 사내들이 고개를 돌린다. 참의 아내들이 멈춘다. 계단을 봤다고 할 것이다. 황토 아래 곡선을 본 것이다.

blocks.html: The night before the True Bone arrives, the room is only a lamp and the two of them. Maehwa’s teal silk opens at the shoulder. Gumil’s yellow sleeve comes off as if the month’s pay had never been the argument. They still know how to find each other. They will not know how tomorrow.
blocks.ko: 진골이 도착하기 전날 밤, 방에는 등 하나와 두 사람뿐이다. 매화의 청록 비단이 어깨에서 열린다. 검일의 노란 소매가, 월봉이 한 번도 다툼이 아니었던 것처럼 벗어진다. 아직 서로를 찾는 법을 안다. 내일은 모를 것이다.

en: Tomorrow the boy arrives.
Today… only today.
Keep your hand on my waist.
It does not have to be a True Bone hand.
I know.
I know.
…Leave tomorrow for tomorrow.

blocks.html: They stop talking. The lamp is too small for manners. The red sash comes off the way it always does in this room — one impatient pull — and the teal silk follows it onto the boards. His yellow sleeve is already gone. Thirty-one, and she still puts him where she wants him: on his back, her hand around him, then sitting until he is in to the hilt, the way winter has always started in this house.
blocks.ko: 말은 그만둔다. 등잔은 예절을 담기엔 너무 작다. 붉은 허리끈이 이 방에서 늘 그러하듯 참을성 없이 한 번에 풀리고, 청록 비단이 마루로 내려간다. 노란 소매는 이미 없다. 서른하나. 그래도 원하는 자리에 눕힌다: 등을 깔고, 손으로 잡고, 끝까지 앉는다. 이 집에서 겨울은 늘 그렇게 시작한다.

en: Tomorrow can wait.
Tonight you stay under me.
Don’t use a name. / Just… stay.

blocks.html: She knows his body the way a person knows a door they have opened every winter. When he nuts it is with her name, not a rank — a familiar load, nothing stupid-young about it, and she keeps him in until it is finished and then a little after, rolling her hips so none of it goes to waste. They sleep facing the same wall. In the morning the silk will go back on as if the night had been ordinary. It never is.
blocks.ko: 겨울마다 연 문처럼 그의 몸을 안다. 쌀 때 부르는 것은 품계가 아니라 이름이다 — 익숙한 한 방, 바보 같은 젊음은 없고, 다 쌀 때까지 안에 두고 조금 더, 허리를 굴려 흘리지 않는다. 같은 벽을 보고 잔다. 아침이면 비단이, 밤이 평범했다는 듯이 다시 올라갈 것이다. 한 번도 평범하지 않다.

blocks.html: Then a True Bone takes the fortress — twenty-four, clean hands, and a wife whose father is the most important man in Silla.
blocks.ko: 그리고 진골이 성을 맡는다. 스물넷. 깨끗한 손. 아내의 아버지는 신라에서 가장 중요한 사람이다.

blocks.html: At the feast the wine finds Pumsuk first. Clean ice-blue silk. Crescent band. A cup he is not tasting. Then the lamp-line is hers — Maehwa walking the cheap hanging lamps like she built them, dirtied green jeogori, ochre chima washed too many times, the red sash tied by habit. Poor cloth against a dark hall. His clothes stay clean. Hers do not.
blocks.ko: 연회에서 술이 품석을 먼저 찾는다. 깨끗한 얼음빛 비단. 초승달 띠. 맛보지 않는 잔. 그리고 등잔 줄은 그녀 것이다 — 매화가 싼 등잔을 자기가 세워 둔 것처럼 걷는다. 때 묻은 초록 저고리, 너무 많이 빤 황토 치마, 습관으로 맨 붉은 끈. 어두운 전각에 가난한 옷. 그의 옷은 깨끗하다. 그녀의 옷은 아니다.

blocks.html: He talks to the cup. It does not help. The training is a joke tonight. Heart-pupils. A thread of drool he will not wipe. She is only a green shape in the lamp behind him, and that is enough.
blocks.ko: 잔에 말한다. 안 된다. 오늘 밤 훈련은 농담이다. 눈 안에 하트. 닦지 않는 침 한 줄. 등잔 뒤로는 초록 실루엣뿐인데, 그걸로 충분하다.

blocks.html: The feast is not a private room. It is every man in Daeya and the families they brought. She walks the aisle. Bowls stop. Necks turn. The wives watch her, not the food, and the watching is already a fight. He looks at her instead of his own table. The families are still eating. She is already working.
blocks.ko: 잔치는 밀실이 아니다. 대야의 사내들과 데려온 식구들이다. 그녀가 통로를 걷는다. 그릇이 멈춘다. 고개가 돈다. 아내들은 밥이 아니라 그녀를 보고, 그 눈이 이미 싸움이다. 그는 제 상 대신 그녀를 본다. 식구들은 아직 먹고 있다. 그녀는 이미 일하고 있다.

blocks.html: She does it in public the way she does it in a dark room. A plum from a tray. A hand on her own hip, then on the sash, then — as if by accident — at the inner thigh where the ochre splits when she sits. She has practised this. The boy in ice-blue counts without meaning to. Twenty-four. The training does not cover a woman who knows where to put her hands.
blocks.ko: 어두운 방에서 하듯 사람들 앞에서 한다. 쟁반의 자두. 제 허리에 손, 끈에 손, 그리고 — 실수인 척 — 앉으면 황토가 갈라지는 허벅지 안쪽에. 연습한 것이다. 얼음빛 소년이 세고 있다, 셀 생각이 없는데. 스물넷. 훈련은 손 둘 곳을 아는 여자를 다루지 않는다.

en: The plum— ah, it’s the mouth, not the cup.
The hand? Here. I meant that.
Twenty-four and you can see all of it.

blocks.html: I should look at my own table. I am looking at her chest. At the split of the chima. At the place a general is not supposed to name. I like women built like that. I have always liked it. I am going to hate myself in a bed that is not hers.
blocks.ko: 제 상을 봐야 한다. 가슴을 보고 있다. 치마가 갈라진 곳을. 장군이 이름 붙이면 안 되는 곳을. 저런 몸매의 여자가 좋다. 원래 좋았다. 그 여자 것이 아닌 침상에서 나를 미워할 것이다.

blocks.html: He does the correct thing. He stands. He bows to a feast that has not asked him to leave. He goes to sleep like a man with a pink room waiting. The pallet does not take him.
blocks.ko: 옳은 일을 한다. 일어선다. 나가라고 하지 않은 잔치에 절한다. 분홍 방이 기다리는 사람처럼 자러 간다. 침상이 받지 않는다.

blocks.html: One dying lamp. One cold pallet. One feast still lit down the hall. How long can a True Bone lie still…?
blocks.ko: 꺼져 가는 등잔 하나. 차가운 잠자리 하나. 복도 끝엔 아직 불 밝힌 잔치. 진골은 얼마나 오래 누워 버틸 수 있을까…?

The siege of Daeya Fortress, autumn 642: the real stone seongmun of the attached Daeya board — weathered grey block walls, crenellations, a curved giwa gate pavilion, heavy iron-bossed timber doors — above a valley road. Baekje banners yellow, Silla banners blue, their marks illegible brush strokes. Night. Low from inside the gate passage: the heavy timber leaf swung open, General Yunchung riding through the hongye arch straight at the lens on a dark horse, helm on, sword drawn low in one hand, the red war-paint across his eyes; behind him the approach road filling with a river of Baekje spearmen under yellow banners. To one side inside the walls the granary roof is already burning, its flat vermilion ribbon flames and orange-lit smoke rolling over the wall. Device: the dark arch framing the rider. HEEWON BATTLE STYLE — this is a battle frame, and every still of this battle shares ONE look so the set plays as one film. Copy the BRUSHWORK AND STYLIZATION of the two attached style_battle boards ONLY — never their ships, flags, figures or composition (the painted board shows 19th-century steam and sailing ships; this battle is 7th-century East Asia). The look is the background art of a hand-painted 2D animated epic crossed with an East Asian woodblock battle scroll. SMOKE AND CLOUD are the big shapes: towering sculpted columns and rolling banks painted as broad soft gouache masses, lit warm orange from the fires underneath and cooling to slate and charcoal at the top; where they curl they break into stylised scroll-cloud spirals outlined in thin ink, like a painted screen. WATER is Hokusai: heavy slate-teal swells with claw-like cream-white foam crests drawn in ink line, spray as stippled dots. FIRE is flat curling ribbons of vermilion and orange with darker red edges licking up hulls, sails and banners — never photographic flame. BANNERS are long silk ribbons whipping in the wind, kingdom colour only, their marks illegible brush strokes. FIGURES are many small drawn silhouettes — soldiers packed in boats, oars, spears, shields — read as massed shapes, the nearest ones dark against the bright smoke; named heroes are drawn larger with clean webtoon faces. DEPTH is layered like stage flats: dark foreground waves, boats and figures; midground ships or ranks in clear silhouette; background smoke, haze and a pale sky that fades like cream paper; a few seabirds or embers. PALETTE is fixed for the whole battle: cream-paper sky, slate blue-grey and teal water, charcoal smoke, vermilion-and-orange fire, ink black, plus each kingdom's banner colour — no purple sunset, no neon, no other hues. Painted texture everywhere (gouache grain, dry-brush, ink line on waves and clouds); not photoreal, not 3D, not a map or satellite view, not a manga speed-line panel. SHIPS are 7th-century only: Tang multi-storey louchuan tower-ships with stacked timber cabins, rows of oars and battened junk sails; Yamato and Baekje open oared war-boats with a single mast — never European hulls, cannon, funnels or square-rigged masts. OVERRIDES of the house rules below for battle frames: massed hosts and fleets are allowed as silhouetted masses; daylight through smoke is allowed (the dark masses are the smoke, the bright break is the pale sky or the fire); still ONE device (a waterline, a smoke column, a ring of hulls, a ford) and big quiet areas of smoke or sky. CANON — YUNCHUNG — FACE and garments from attached /ch_yunchung.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Hard-bitten Baekje frontier general in his forties: full black beard, heavy scowling brows, a band of red war-paint smeared across both eyes, long black hair falling from under a dented round steel helm with a cracked crown and a short red-black plume knob. Dress: Grey steel lamellar with red-edged shoulder guards over an ochre-yellow robe, a broad red sash with a round bronze boss, red-and-black striped bracers; a ring-pommel sword in a red-lacquered scabbard. Demeanor: Plain speech is also a weapon: says the ugly thing without a cushion under it, and does exactly what he says he will. Armor: Baekje kit: steel lamellar, rounded Baekje helm with neck guard; yellow cloth peeking, red sash/skirt accent — never a yellow metal cuirass. Battle armor: plates are METALLIC GRAY STEEL lamellar copied from the attached lamellar ref, cloth peeking at collar, sleeves, skirt, sash and plume-cord in the wearer's color only. Ignore labels and watermarks on armor refs. Not Japanese kabuto, not fantasy plate, not a gold-painted suit. #c9932a as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. | PLACE Daeya (대야성 (합천)) — attached board /pl_daeya_fortress.png; keep this exact architecture and ground. Daeya seongmun: weathered stone wall with crenellations, curved giwa pavilion over a hongye arch, heavy iron-bossed timber doors. | COSTUME CHARTS (attached): cut, collar, sleeve, sash, trouser and skirt shapes of every Samhan figure follow the chart for their kingdom; it is a style chart, so ignore its labels, captions, maps, poses and faces. Named people keep their portrait face and colours; extras and soldiers dress like the chart (a commoner like its commoners, an official like its officials, a soldier like its soldiers). Baekje: attached /ref_hanbok_baekje_gaya.png. | Kingdom banners: copy field colour and emblem from the attached flag_*.png ref onto period silk war-banners — tall poles behind each side, long streamers, small pennants on spear-tips and saddle-backs. Painted silk, wind-whipped, torn and smoke-stained in battle; never a flat modern flag graphic. Each side's banner colour is the clearest colour on its half of the frame, so the kingdom reads at a glance. Baekje banners: warm yellow silk with a darker gold door-lintel and three gold stars. Attached flag /flag_baekje.png. SWORD ANATOMY: Copy attached sw_bidam.png. The ONLY circle on the sword is the small hollow RING at the pommel. When the blade hangs down: RING is UP (heel of the fist, little-finger side) → short gold band → palm-length diamond GRIP (one fist, not two-handed) → thin gold BAND (a collar, never a round tsuba, never a second ring) → long steel BLADE down toward the ankle → point. Handle:blade = 1:3 locked (handle = one quarter of the whole; blade = three quarters). Hip scale: hilt at hip, tip near ankle — never taller than the person, never a polearm. NEVER put the ring between the hand and the steel. NEVER point a giant blade at the camera as a graphic. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only. HEEWON STYLE: a Korean WEBTOON figure painted into a hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL world, in a SIMPLE, MINIMAL, ICONIC layout — the benchmark is a lone man in magenta silk walking down a storm-lit grass ridge toward his tied horse with an empty saddle: one diagonal, two subjects, half the frame storm sky, one cloud-break. FIGURES are webtoon / anime: clean digital-ink linework, simplified webtoon faces with expressive eyes, the face and hands keep that clean ink line, but the body and garments are PAINTED, never digitally shaded — broad loaded brushstrokes and dry-brush drag that follow each fold, the shading stepped in three or four painted value planes with soft broken edges, paper-and-canvas grain running right across the silk — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, never a smooth airbrushed gradient, never a 3D render (2.5D, see FORM). THE WORLD is WATERCOLOR FIRST, OIL SECOND: skies and ground in granulated wet-in-wet washes and short broken-colour dabs (Turner), dry-brush grass, dust and stone texture, soft bleeding edges, faint paper grain; the accent colour of the scene blooms into the wash near one frame edge and the frame edges dissolve into bare paper; oil only deepens the darks with rich umber-indigo glazes and adds a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. INTERIORS AND NIGHT SCENES are the webtoon figure painted into a European OLD-MASTER CANVAS — a Renaissance / Baroque TENEBRIST oil painting (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt): broken-colour brushwork, glazed umber-to-black darks, sfumato falloff, a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight, over faint watercolor blooms and paper grain; walls, timber, stone, drapery and tables pulled out of the darkness by the one lamp, window or shaft. The same oil-on-canvas texture covers EVERYTHING in the frame, the figures’ silk included — mottled plaster, gritty stone, brushed robes — so the webtoon figures sit INTO that painted space, lit by the same key and sharing its shadows, never pasted onto a flat backdrop. LAYOUT is MINIMAL AND ICONIC, staged like a Romanticist painting (Friedrich, Turner, Delacroix, Géricault): ONE device carries the frame (a ridge diagonal, a road, a waterline, a hall axis, a table ring, a gate) with ONE or TWO subjects placed on the thirds; at least half the frame is quiet negative space (storm sky, empty field, dark floor, bare wall); distant detail stays tiny and dissolving (a line of banners or roofs in haze); no crowds, no clutter, nothing competing with the subject. Heroic diagonal or pyramid, small figures against a sublime sky or vast field, or a bold worm’s-eye / straight-down angle. BLOCKING IS THE RELATIONSHIP: when two people share a frame, the still reads like a history painting with the faces covered — who stands higher and who kneels, the distance or contact between them, whose hand rests on whom, where each one looks (at each other, past each other, the same way), and how their cast shadows meet on the wall or floor; one gesture between them carries the whole bond. LIGHT is movie tenebrism at full strength: 70–85% of the frame sinks into deep painted shadow (oil-glazed umber, indigo, black), an extreme value range with near-white highlights right beside inky black and almost no middle grey; big dark masses (storm cloud, shadowed slope, umber room, black floor) against ONE bright break — a single cloud-break, low sun shaft, lamp or window — that lands on the subject; inky darks right beside small near-white highlights, few middle greys in the subject; ONE hard directional key carves the subject out of the dark. FORM IS 2.5D — drawn webtoon line on the outside, sculpted painted volume on the inside (the interior benchmark: a bearded emperor in yellow silk standing at a stone relief, under-lit by an oil lamp set on the floor beside the lens, palm on the carved horse, his shadow climbing the wall): the key is a PRACTICAL light IN or just outside the frame, CLOSE to the subject, RAKING ACROSS the surfaces the camera sees from below or from the side — never from behind them. So every silk fold protrudes, built the way an oil painter builds it: the lit side of each fold laid in with one opaque loaded stroke, the turn into shadow a crisp painted edge, the shadow side a thin transparent umber glaze with a little warm floor-light dragged into it, brush direction following the fold; gold thread and the brightest ridges flicked in with impasto; cheekbones, beard, knuckles, armor plates and horse muscle are painted the same way. The subject is large in frame (medium or closer, worm’s-eye or low three-quarter) so the folds resolve, and the light falls off into black across the body — that falloff is the darkness. Never a garment filled with one flat colour; never a subject backlit into a flat silhouette with only an edge line (if the camera is behind someone, the key still comes from the side and models their back and shoulder); never a wall flat to the lens — walls and floors recede at an angle so cast shadows can climb them. A thin edge of the same real light may graze the far side of the silhouette to lift it off the background (never a glow outline); long raking shadows. TEXTURE IS TACTILE RELIEF — the raking key exists to reveal it: thick oil impasto that stands up off the canvas on the lit side of every surface, loaded-brush and palette-knife ridges the eye can almost touch. Cloth: heavy silk in deep ridged folds, raised gold embroidery and brocade threads catching pin-point specular, quilted collars, layered sleeves with real thickness, beads and pins as small sculpted volumes. Buildings and ground just as sculpted: carved, weathered timber grain on pillars and brackets, every giwa roof tile and end-cap a rounded relief with its own shadow, rough-cut stone blocks, cracked lime plaster, lattice in deep relief throwing crisp little shadows, packed earth with grit and footprints. Never a smooth flat wall, never a plain colour-fill robe. Default hour is dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat overcast, never even daylight, never a bright open sky filling the frame. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. SEPARATION: subject and background never share a value — the lit subject sits in the one pool of light and everything behind it drops three or more steps to near-black (or, reversed, a dark figure against the single bright opening); foreground shapes almost black; the eye lands on the subject first. SHOT VARIETY AND NEGATIVE SPACE: across a set of stills alternate INTIMATE CLOSE-UPS (faces and hands filling the frame, the background a dark blur) with FAR WIDES (the figures small in a lower corner or third, 60% or more of the canvas left as quiet negative space — black hall, night sky, dark water, bare wall — that makes the small lit figures strike). RENAISSANCE CANVAS, CARTOON FIGURES: the world is composed and painted like a Renaissance / Baroque master (Leonardo’s sfumato, Titian’s glazes, Raphael’s pyramids, Caravaggio’s darkness), but every face stays a clean-lined webtoon / anime face — big expressive eyes, simple nose and mouth, smooth cel-like skin with one or two shadow tones — never photographic skin, pores or realistic facial anatomy. COLOR SYMBOLISM reads at a glance: each kingdom's colour lives in its banners and cloth (Silla blue, Baekje yellow, Goguryeo red, Tang vermilion and gold), each named person's hex in the key light on them, and the rest of the frame stays desaturated umber, slate and black so those few colours sing. FACES stay drawn: match the attached portrait's line weight, eye shape and simplification exactly — if a face starts to read as a photograph, flatten it back to ink line and wash; extras are drawn the same way, never photographic. HORSES are drawn to be admired: the whole body readable, arched neck, deep chest, round haunch, clean legs in a true gait, muscle modelled by the key with a bright edge along the topline. 2.5D painterly cinema — drawn webtoon faces, everything else brushed with visible strokes and canvas grain — not photoreal, not live-action, not a smooth digital airbrush or 3D render, not flat cel fill. Same film stock every still: a CAMERA in a real Korean place — anamorphic 2:1 movie frame, shallow DOF, creamy bokeh, rack-focus, film grain, crushed blacks, ONE hard key, long shadows, tenebrism. MOVIE FRAME of the scene a DP could stand in — NEVER a graphic poster, split-screen collage, 3D architectural visualization, black-triangle overlay, spotlight cone deleting the landscape, or neon outline. NO halo, bloom, glow aura, rim-aura, emissive skin, or god-ray envelope around people — character hex is the color of REAL LIGHT in the dark (key bounce, specular on silk/armor/wet stone, a lamp, a shaft, a floor reflection), never a body halo, never magic outline, never neon-painting the figure. FACE ONLY from the attached portrait — silk/hanbok may match; NEVER copy the portrait stance, clasped hands, 3/4 fashion lineup, or a standing clone. Invent a new DRAMATIC body every still (mid-stride, kneel, full-draw, turn, tumble, lean, count, dutch, worm’s-eye, lower-third). CINEMATOGRAPHY: name the shot — dutch angle, worm’s-eye, crane, over-shoulder, rack focus, shallow DOF / bokeh, chiaroscuro, mise-en-scène, long-shadow key. HIGH CONTRAST: crushed blacks + one hard key / long shadows / tenebrism — not even daylight wash, not a flat tourist postcard. ICONIC MINIMAL means one architectural device a lens can see (road, column, waterline, gate, hall axis) plus empty negative space — not deleting the world. COLOR SYMBOLISM: hex tints the hard key / catchlight / bounce — NEVER a glow aura, NEVER recolor the attached portrait’s garments (Sosuno stays dusty-rose hanbok, Geumwa stays red-burgundy court silk, not gold paint). FACE AND CLOTHES match the attached ch_*.png. One of each named person — NEVER clone or duplicate a character. People stand on packed earth at a well RIM — NEVER inside the well shaft. Jumong is fun-loving and laid-back: grin, laugh, wink, easy eyes — not a grim founder mask. BATTLE ARMOR: metallic GRAY steel lamellar (attached steel-armor ref); cloth peeks in the character hex — not gold-painted plate, not glowing armor, not a standing armor catalog. RING-POMMEL SWORDS: one-handed hip 환두대도 from attached sw_bidam.png — handle:blade 1:3; order is RING (pommel at heel of fist) → short grip → thin gold collar → long blade → point. Never reverse handle and blade. Never a tsuba disc in the middle. Never taller than the person. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only — do not attach it on full-blade stills. Ignore swords on face portraits. Two people = two garment-true figures against crushed black. Real Korean architecture or a locked dark room. No army. No readable text. No watermark. Copy: dynamic poses in a mythology-scale layout; dramatic poses in a mythology-scale one-device layout; one hard key / chiaroscuro; one gesture in empty space — iconic and simple. Never: white / pale studio void as a room; earth places stay real buildings, not color-plane furniture; no pasted portrait pose — new body every still; no floating logo — still must be a movie frame of the scene; unrealistic layout, reptitive; real bottle-shaped Cheomseongdae plus a story beat.

Daeya fortress gate exactly as the attached place image: weathered stone, crenellations, curved giwa pavilion, heavy wooden doors.
images.prompt: Epic zoomed-out 16:9 movie frame. Daeya fortress gate exactly as the attached place image: weathered stone, crenellations, curved giwa pavilion, heavy wooden doors. Do not invent a different gate. Crushed storm light, one red seam of light in the door crack as the only accent. Two tiny spear-guards. Webtoon-painterly, high contrast, real Korean architecture. No army. No text, no watermark, no halo.

images.alt: Two heavy black vertical strokes are the gate leaves, almost meeting.
images.prompt: Original sumi on white paper. No pasted figures. Story: the red omen is a seam in the gate. Two heavy black vertical strokes are the gate leaves, almost meeting. Between them one thin cinnabar stroke runs top to bottom, the omen, with bristles and a dry tail. A tiny guard is two ink flicks at the bottom of the seam. The red is only that seam. No building, no text, no seal.

images.alt: TWO tall vertical black brushstrokes standing apart like gate posts, dry-brush flying white, bristle marks.
images.prompt: Minimal East Asian ink painting. Off-white paper, vast empty. TWO tall vertical black brushstrokes standing apart like gate posts, dry-brush flying white, bristle marks. Between them one thin vertical seam of cinnabar red only. At the base, two tiny spear-guard marks. No roof, no bricks, no seal, no red stamp, no signature, no calligraphy, no characters anywhere in the image.

blocks.label: THE NEXT MORNING
blocks.ko: 다음날 아침

blocks.html: Grey in the door-slit. The feast is a cold hall. Gumil comes back from the stores and finds his wife where the True Bone left her — dirtied green still open, last night still on the boards. He does not ask if she is hurt. He asks for the story.
blocks.ko: 문틈의 회색. 잔치는 차가운 전각이다. 검일이 창고에서 돌아와 진골이 두고 간 자리에 아내를 본다 — 때 묻은 초록은 아직 열려 있고, 지난밤은 아직 마루에 있다. 다쳤느냐고 묻지 않는다. 이야기를 묻는다.

en: From the start.
All of it.
Don’t leave any out.
The lamp-line.
Sit. The plum.
After that… the floor.
After that.
The name.
How many times.

blocks.html: She does not wait for the rest of the questions. Same pine. Same wrecked ochre. She is still in milf mode — the voice she used on the boy, the hands on the chest, the hike. She pulls the yellow sleeve down, puts him in, and does not let go. He is already overwhelmed. Her. The smell. Last night still wet on her. Three strokes. He always was three strokes.
blocks.ko: 나머지 질문을 기다리지 않는다. 같은 마루. 같은 망가진 황토. 아직 아줌마 모드다 — 그 아이에게 쓰던 목소리, 가슴의 손, 걷어 올린 것. 노란 소매를 내리고, 넣고, 안 놓는다. 이미 압도됐다. 그녀. 냄새. 지난밤이 아직 젖어. 세 번. 원래 세 번이었다.

en: Stay still. Let me.
Gumil. Like that— yes. Good boy.
Don’t pull out. We’re not done.
Haa— Maehwa— wait—
Already— I can’t— AUUAAAAUAGGH—

blocks.html: He cums. Fast. A small, overwhelmed sound into her neck, hnngh, and it is over for him. She keeps the hips down. Milf. She rides the twitch until there is nothing left and then she still does not lift. He is shaking. She is not. This is why she was starved. This is why the boy’s loads felt like a country.
blocks.ko: 싼다. 빨리. 목덜미에 작은, 압도된 소리, 으응, 그걸로 그는 끝. 허리는 내린 채. 아줌마. 더 나올 게 없을 때까지 타고, 그래도 안 일어난다. 그는 떤다. 그녀는 아니다. 그래서 굶었다. 그래서 그 아이 한이 나라처럼 느껴졌다.

lines: 아직 안에 있어. 내가 안 놓으니까.
en: Already.
I know. You always are.
You’re still in. Because I’m not letting go.

blocks.html: I came. She is still on me. I cannot look at her tits without finishing. I have never lasted. She knows. She is telling me the boy lasted all night.
blocks.ko: 쌌다. 아직 타고 있다. 젖만 봐도 끝이다. 오래 가 본 적이 없다. 그녀가 안다. 그 아이는 밤새 갔다고 말하고 있다.

blocks.html: She tells it. The walk. The knot. The scream the screen did not hide. She thought it was over after the first, and after the second, and it was not — he looked at her and it started again, load after load, and the clean silk that never stained. She tells him she said the wife’s name, and that is when the boy got angry, and that is when she liked it most — stealing a noble lady’s husband out loud. She tells him by the lamp she was the one being owned. He makes her say the leaving last — that the boy stood up, did not look, and walked out of the feast as if the room were already empty.
blocks.ko: 말한다. 걸음. 매듭. 병풍이 가리지 못한 소리. 첫 번 다음에 끝난 줄 알았고, 두 번째 다음에도, 아니었다 — 그 아이가 봐서 또 시작됐고, 그 안에 몇 번, 그리고 더러워지지 않은 비단. 아내 이름을 말했다고 하고, 그때 그 아이가 화났다고 하고, 그때가 제일 좋았다고 한다 — 진골 아씨 남편을 소리 내어 훔친 것. 등잔 옆에서는 소유당한 쪽이 자기였다고 한다. 떠나는 것을 마지막에 말하게 한다 — 그 아이가 일어서서, 보지 않고, 방이 이미 빈 것처럼 잔치를 나갔다고.

en: He didn’t speak.
He just left.
I… stayed on the floor.
A half is better.
Than mine.
You said that too. Did you.

lines: 당신 부하들도. 이 성벽도. 이 나라도.
en: I did.
Because everyone in this fortress is trash.
Your men. These walls. This country.
…Right.
But you are here too.
You are trash as well.

blocks.html: They stand in the door-slit of morning and do not touch. The heat from the feast is gone. What is left is the count of what she said, and the count of what he made her say, and a marriage that has already finished speaking.
blocks.ko: 그들은 아침 문틈에 서서 서로 닿지 않는다. 잔치의 열기는 없다. 남은 것은 그녀가 한 말의 셈과, 그가 말하게 한 말의 셈과, 이미 말하기를 끝낸 혼인이다.

blocks.html: That is the last thing they ever say to each other.
blocks.ko: 두 사람이 서로에게 한 마지막 말이다.

blocks.html: Three weeks later Yunchung’s fire through the gate is the first thing the inner court sees — ten thousand men, and the wall still theoretically Silla’s.
blocks.ko: 삼 주 뒤, 내성이 먼저 보는 것은 문을 가르는 윤충의 불이다 — 군사 만 명. 성벽은 이론상 아직 신라의 것이다.

blocks.html: Mochuk lifts the bar. The leaf swings. The approach road fills. He does not look at the men coming in. He looks at the man who asked him to.
blocks.ko: 모척이 빗장을 든다. 문이 열린다. 진입로가 찬다. 들어오는 사람들을 보지 않는다. 열어 달라 한 사람을 본다.

blocks.html: Then Gumil puts the torch to the stores he counted, and opens the granary gate to Yunchung, and it is not for Baekje and it is not for money.
blocks.ko: 그리고 검일은 제가 세던 군량에 횃불을 대고, 윤충에게 곳간 문을 연다. 백제를 위해서가 아니고, 돈을 위해서도 아니다.

en: Why are you doing this. Truly.
Because everyone in this fortress is trash.

blocks.html: He is quoting her. He will keep quoting her for the eighteen years he has left, until a king in Sabi has him killed.
blocks.ko: 아내의 말을 옮기는 것이다. 남은 십팔 년 동안 그는 계속 그 말을 옮길 것이고, 사비의 왕이 그를 죽일 때까지 그럴 것이다.

en: *gulp*…

blocks.html: In the inner room Gotaso understands before anyone says the word. The fortress is finished. Her husband is finished. She is seventeen and the forever she promised at the wedding has run out of road.
blocks.ko: 안방에서 고타소는 누가 그 말을 꺼내기 전에 알아차린다. 성이 끝났다. 남편이 끝났다. 열일곱이고, 혼례에서 약속한 영원은 길이 다했다.

en: Husband…
If you are going to do it — look at me.

blocks.html: A man who was not in the fortress is suddenly in the fortress, ledger under one arm, crow-dark robe, standing the polite distance of a messenger. The underworld’s. Whose king is Yumla.
blocks.ko: 성에 없던 사내가 갑자기 성 안에 있다. 한쪽 팔에 명부, 까마귀빛 도포, 사신처럼 한 걸음 물러선 거리. 저승에서 온 것이다. 임금은 염라다.

blocks.html: It keeps a ledger, and it is never late.
blocks.ko: 명부를 쥐고 있고, 늦는 법이 없다.

blocks.html: Kangrim reads her name aloud three times before he asks anything — Gotaso. Gotaso. Gotaso. — the underworld's way of making sure the ledger has opened the right door.
blocks.ko: 강림은 무엇을 묻기 전에 그녀의 이름을 세 번 크게 부른다 — 고타소. 고타소. 고타소. — 명부가 올바른 문을 열었는지 확인하는 저승의 방식이다.

blocks.caption: The underworld’s fetch. He asks one question at the door, and he waits for the answer.
blocks.ko: 저승차사. 문 앞에서 질문 하나를 묻고, 대답을 기다린다.

en: Lady Gotaso.
One question, then we walk.
When you chose forever — did you choose the man, or the vow?
lines: 영원을 고르실 때 — 그 사람을 고르신 겁니까, 맹세를 고르신 겁니까?

en: Who… are you?
I don’t know your face. I don’t know your house.
Are you Baekje? Are you—
Neither. I collect.
You do not need to know me. Almost nobody does, until they do.
The question stands.
lines: 둘 다 아닙니다. 저는 거둬 갑니다.
저를 아실 필요 없습니다. 알기 전까지는 거의 아무도 모릅니다.

en: …Both.
Is that allowed?
…When he came for me there was something on his coat. He said he would change it later.
lines: …저를 찾으러 오셨을 때, 아버지 옷에 뭐가 묻어 있었어요. 이따 갈아입겠다고 하셨고.

en: Honest. Rare.
Come. Nobody where we are going will ask you to swear anything.
lines: 갑시다. 우리가 갈 곳에서는 아무도 낭자께 맹세를 시키지 않습니다.

blocks.html: She goes with him surprised to the last — not by dying, but by discovering there was a door she had never been told about.
blocks.ko: 그녀는 끝까지 놀라며 그와 함께 간다 — 죽는 것 때문이 아니라, 아무도 알려 주지 않은 문이 있었다는 발견 때문에.

blocks.html: He reads the husband's name three times next — Pumsuk. Pumsuk. Pumsuk. — the same ledger habit, a second door in the same fortress.
blocks.ko: 그는 이어 남편의 이름을 세 번 부른다 — 품석. 품석. 품석. — 같은 명부의 버릇, 같은 성 안의 두 번째 문.

en: Hwarang Pumsuk.
…No. Not for you.
…Ask me.
I wanted the love and the oath to be one thing.
They were not. Ask me.

blocks.html: A messenger brings the news home. The Queen receives it seated, because queens receive everything seated. Munhee is already looking at Chunchu. Chunchu is looking at nothing at all. Bupmin asks the messenger to say it again, in the voice of a boy who thinks a sentence can be wrong twice.
blocks.ko: 전령이 소식을 들고 온다. 여왕은 앉은 채로 받는다. 여왕은 무엇이든 앉아서 받으니까. 문희는 벌써 춘추를 보고 있다. 춘추는 아무것도 보지 않는다. 법민이 전령에게 다시 말해 보라고 한다. 같은 문장이 두 번은 틀릴 수 있다고 믿는 소년의 목소리로.

en: If you swear to spare us all, I will surrender.

lines: 만일 그렇게 한다면 공과 나에게 모두 좋은 일이 될 것이요. 저 밝은 해를 두고 맹세하리다.
en: If you do, it will go well for both you and me. I swear it on that bright sun.

lines: 대야성이 함락되고... 품석 화랑, 고타소 양은 염라대왕 앞으로 가셨다 합니다...!
en: Daeya has fallen… They say Hwarang Pumsuk and Lady Gotaso have gone before Yumla…!
…What was it that girl said at her wedding.
“We will be happy forever.”

blocks.hanja: 吾父名我以竹竹者 使我歲寒不彫 可折而不可屈 豈可畏死而生降乎
blocks.ko: 내 아버지께서 나를 죽죽이라 이름 지으신 것은, 추운 철에도 시들지 말고 꺾일지언정 굽히지 말라 하심이다. 어찌 죽음이 두려워 살아서 항복하겠는가?
blocks.html: My father named me Jukjuk so that I would not wither in the cold season, and might be broken but never bent. How should I fear death and live by surrendering?
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 47, Biographies — Jukjuk; Lee Byong-do ed., vol. 2, p. 448

blocks.html: Chunchu (39) does not shout. He asks, very calmly, for the names of everyone who was inside the fortress.
blocks.ko: 춘추 (39)는 소리치지 않는다. 아주 차분하게, 그 성 안에 있던 사람들의 이름을 모두 적어 오라 이른다.

blocks.html: The Baekje general Yunchung led troops, attacked, and took Daeya Fortress. The dodok Ichan Pumsuk, and the saji Jukjuk and Yongseok, died there.
blocks.ko: 백제 장군 윤충이 군사를 이끌고 대야성을 쳐서 함락하니, 도독 이찬 품석과 사지 죽죽·용석 등이 죽었다.
blocks.hanja: 百濟將軍允忠領兵攻拔大耶城 都督伊飡品釋 舍知竹竹 龍石等死之
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 5, Silla Annals — Queen Seondeok, yr. 11 (642), 8th month; Lee Byong-do ed., vol. 1, p. 118

blocks.caption: One summer. Daeya was the door, and the capital sits right behind it.
blocks.ko: 한 여름. 대야성은 문이었고, 도성은 바로 그 뒤에 있다.

lines: 자네 딸을 지키겠다고 맹세한 건 품석이었네.
en: Chunchu.
It was Pumsuk who swore to protect your daughter.
Not you.
Brother.
I am the one who made him swear it.

blocks.html: That night his mother finds him in the empty audience hall, sitting on the floor below the dais the way he used to sit there when he was small enough to be overlooked. Princess Chunmyung is sixty-two. She gave up a throne to marry his father and has never once brought it up. She lowers herself down beside him slowly, one hand on his shoulder for the knees, and does not ask how he is.
blocks.ko: 그날 밤 어머니는 텅 빈 정전에서 그를 찾아낸다. 어좌 단 아래 바닥에 앉아 있다. 눈에 띄지 않을 만큼 작았을 때 거기 앉곤 하던 그대로. 천명 공주는 예순둘이다. 그의 아버지와 혼인하려고 왕위를 내려놓았고, 그 얘기를 꺼낸 적은 한 번도 없다. 그녀는 무릎 때문에 아들 어깨에 한 손을 짚고 천천히 그 옆에 앉는다. 괜찮으냐고 묻지 않는다.

lines: 바둑에선 돌 하나 잃으면, 그게 얼마짜리 집이었는지 세요.
en: Mother.
In go, when you lose a stone, you count the territory it cost.
This one… I can’t find the edge of it.

lines: 아홉 살 때부터 세고 있잖니. 네 아버지가 가르쳤고, 난 내버려 뒀지.
……머리 대. 오늘 밤만. 이 방에선 아직 내가 너보다 크다.
en: Then stop counting.
You’ve been counting since you were nine. Your father taught you, and I let him.
…Put your head down. Just tonight. In this hall I’m still bigger than you.

blocks.html: He does. The most cunning man in Samhan sleeps an hour with his head on his mother’s knee, and in the morning he asks the Queen for a road north.
blocks.ko: 그는 그렇게 한다. 삼한에서 가장 교활한 사내가 어머니 무릎을 베고 한 시진을 잔다. 그리고 아침에 여왕께 북으로 가는 길을 청한다.

blocks.html: In Surabol Bupmin waits at the gate the way a boy waits for a sister who promised forever. Munhee does not send him inside. She lets him see the empty road. Some educations are cruel on purpose.
blocks.ko: 서라벌에서 법민은 영원히를 약속한 누나를 기다리듯 문 앞에서 기다린다. 문희는 그를 들여보내지 않는다. 빈 길을 보게 둔다. 어떤 교육은 일부러 잔인하다.

en: Look at the road. Don’t look away.
You said you would be king for everyone.
Everyone includes the ones who do not come back.
…I will make a country where sisters come home.
Good. Start by surviving your father.
lines: 좋아. 일단 아버지 옆에서 살아남는 것부터.

blocks.label: STEAM, AGAIN
blocks.ko: 다시, 김

blocks.html: After Daeya, the Sword of Silla does not sleep in the capital. He rides to the cavern and strips at the lip of the rock without looking up. Narim, Golhwa, Hyullé. The same three who named themselves to him before the fortress fell.
blocks.ko: 대야 뒤, 신라의 도검은 도읍에서 자지 않는다. 동굴로 달려가, 올려다보지도 않고 바위 끝에서 옷을 벗는다. 나림, 골화, 혈레. 성이 무너지기 전에 제 이름을 알려 준 바로 그 셋.

blocks.html: They do not look at his face first. They smell the year on him. Hyullé’s thighs press the rock she saved for him. He came back. I kept the ledge. Golhwa swallows. Narim’s voice, when it comes, is half an octave down.
blocks.ko: 얼굴을 먼저 보지 않는다. 그에게서 그 해를 맡는다. 혈레의 허벅지가 그를 위해 남겨 둔 바위를 누른다. 돌아왔어. 턱을 데워 뒀어. 골화가 삼킨다. 나림의 목소리는, 나올 때, 반 옥타브 아래다.

en: You’re early. How flattering.
Or desperate. I like both on you. Desperate looks better with nothing on. Take the rest off.
lines: 아니면 필사적이거나. 둘 다 마음에 들어. 필사적인 얼굴은 아무것도 안 입었을 때 더 예뻐. 남은 것도 벗어.

en: Come here— I want you between my knees before unnie remembers she’s eldest.
lines: 이리 와— 언니가 자기가 언니인 걸 기억하기 전에 내 무릎 사이로 와.

blocks.html: She has been on that rock all year waiting, moaning at nobody. She wants him to grab her and fuck her into the stone. The queen can have the forts.
blocks.ko: 일 년 내내 그 바위에 올라앉아 기다렸다. 없는 사람한테 신음하면서. 세게 잡아 바닥에 박아 줬으면. 여왕한테는 성을 줘.

en: Golhwa — he buried a niece’s fortress this month.
Let him enter the water before you enter his ribs. …Then you may. I’m not made of stone tonight.
lines: 골화 — 이번 달에 조카의 성을 묻었어.
갈비에 손대기 전에 물에 들어가게 해. …그다음엔 해도 돼. 나도 오늘 밤은 돌이 아니야.

en: …Here.
The far ledge is warmer. If you want. I’ll keep my knees together until you ask me not to.
lines: 저쪽 턱이 더 따뜻해요. 원하시면. 그러지 말라고 하실 때까지는 무릎 붙이고 있을게요.

en: I came for quiet.
And for whatever you three pretend is not counsel.
lines: 그리고 당신들이 조언이 아니라 우기는 것을.

en: Then hear it plain.
Yeon in the north is about to finish becoming what he was always going to be.
Do not go to his door as a guest who expects to leave as a guest.
And don’t look at Hyullé’s mouth while I’m saying it. She’ll soak the stone.
lines: 북쪽의 연은 늘 될 사람이 되는 일을 막 끝내려 하고 있어요.
손님으로 문 앞에 서지 말아요. 손님으로 나올 거라 기대하면서.
그리고 제가 말하는 동안 혈레 입은 보지 마세요. 돌이 젖어요.

en: Or stay.
Skip the north. Skip the queen’s errands.
We keep the steam hot. Hyullé keeps looking at your mouth when you talk about duty — don’t pretend you haven’t noticed, Yushin. I keep looking lower. Notice that too.
lines: 김은 우리가 뜨겁게 해 둬. 혈레는 네가 의무 얘기할 때 입을 봐 — 모르는 척하지 마, 유신. 나는 더 아래를 봐. 그것도 알아차려.

en: I don’t —
…Golhwa, please. He’ll hear that I want him. I do. Stop helping.
lines: …골화, 부탁해요. 제가 원하는 거 들릴 거예요. 원해요. 그만 도와줘요.

en: But Her Majesty sent word through Chunchu.
There are rooms in Goryeo that still have doors.
lines: 허나 폐하께서 춘추를 통해 말씀을 내리셨소.
고려엔 아직 문이 있는 방이 있소.

en: Ugh…
“Her Majesty.” Again.
What does that mortal have that we don’t? Say it while I’m this wet and I’ll bite you.
Stay with us, Yushin~~
lines: 그 인간한테 우리한테 없는 게 뭐가 있는데? 나 이렇게 젖었는데 말하면 물어 버릴 거야.

en: Stay— on the rock, between my legs, until the list falls out of your head.
lines: 있어— 바위 위에, 내 다리 사이에, 그 목록이 머리에서 빠질 때까지.

blocks.html: The title again. The rock again. She wants him in her more than the north wants a marshal.
blocks.ko: 또 존호. 또 바위. 북쪽보다 내가 더 급해. 들어와 줬으면.

en: He won’t.
Let the court say the queen counted. Not that the queen begged. Send Chunchu west the way she already means to — with a list, not a plea.
Hyullé — warm the ledge anyway. He’ll take it on the way out, even if he won’t say so. And if he gets hard in the doorway, Hyullé, that’s yours. I already had the mouth.
lines: 조정은 여왕이 세었다고 하게 해요. 여왕이 빌었다고 하지 말고. 춘추를 이미 보내려는 대로 서쪽으로 — 목록으로, 애원이 아니라.
혈레 — 그래도 턱은 데워 둬. 말은 안 해도 나가면서 쓸 테니. 문간에서 서면, 혈레, 그건 네 거야. 입은 내가 이미 썼어.

blocks.html: He sits where Hyullé pointed until the cold leaves his shoulders. Golhwa complains to the steam. Narim counts how long he stays without asking him to stay. When he dresses, none of them say goodbye — which is how he knows the counsel was real.
blocks.ko: 혈레가 가리킨 자리에 앉아 어깨에서 추위가 빠질 때까지 있는다. 골화는 김에게 투덜대고, 나림은 남아 달라 하지 않은 채 그가 얼마나 오래 있는지 센다. 옷을 입을 때 아무도 작별하지 않는다 — 그래서 조언이 진짜였음을 안다.

blocks.html: In Pyongyang, Yeon has spent all summer bowing. Now he is throwing a party, and everyone important is invited…!
blocks.ko: 평양에서 연은 여름 내내 고개를 숙였다. 이제 그가 잔치를 연다. 중요한 사람은 빠짐없이 초대받았다…!
