FACE matches the attached Yeon Gesomun portrait, drawn in the mural's simplified line. Aged plaster texture, chips and cracks, faded earth colours. Not photoreal, not 3D. No text, no hanja, no watermark. No halo or glow aura.

images.alt: One horse-shaped ink mass standing, not running, all four legs planted, bristles in the mane.
images.prompt: Original sumi on white paper. No pasted general. Story: Gesomun's promise, the horse held still. One horse-shaped ink mass standing, not running, all four legs planted, bristles in the mane. A small cinnabar bleed on the shoulder. Empty white around it. No text, no seal.

blocks.html: Yeon's father dies in the spring, in his own bed in the east. The seal should pass to the son. The Summit takes the whole summer to admit it. When it finally does, Yeon decides to host a banquet. The king is in attendance.
blocks.ko: 봄에 연의 아버지가 동쪽 제 집 자리에서 숨을 거둔다. 인장은 아들에게 가야 마땅하다. 제가회의는 그걸 인정하는 데 여름 한 철을 다 쓴다. 마침내 인정하자, 연은 연회를 열기로 한다. 왕도 자리한다.

blocks.html: All summer he has bowed. He went to every seat at the Summit one at a time and asked for his father’s seal like a younger son asking for an inheritance. Among themselves they have already agreed that he will have it for one winter, out on the border forts, and not come back.
blocks.ko: 여름 내내 그는 고개를 숙였다. 제가회의의 자리를 하나하나 찾아가, 막내아들이 유산을 청하듯 아버지의 인장을 청했다. 그들끼리는 이미 정해 두었다. 인장은 주되, 한 겨울만. 변경의 성 쌓는 데로 보내고, 돌아오지 못하게.

blocks.html: October cold sits under the eaves. The lamps are already lit when the Five Commanderies take their seats — wine first, then meat, then the old joke that Pyongyang never runs out of either. Each commander wears a ring-pommel sword at his hip, the three-legged crow stamped in the ring. The hall smells of sesame oil and autumn horse-sweat brought in on Eastern boots.
blocks.ko: 시월의 냉기가 처마 아래 앉아 있다. 오부가 자리에 들 때 등불은 이미 켜져 있다 — 술 먼저, 고기 다음, 그리고 평양엔 둘 다 마르지 않는다는 낡은 농담. 욕살마다 허리에 환두대도를 찼고, 고리에는 삼족오가 찍혀 있다. 전각에서는 참기름 냄새와, 동부의 군화가 들여온 가을 말땀 냄새가 난다.

lines: 아, 그 명망 높은 개소문도 이제 고개 숙일 줄을 아는구나…
en: Ah — so even the renowned Gesomun has learned to bow…
Your father would have liked to see it.
Good — everyone is here.
We settle the succession today.
Gesomun! So you kneel at last!
Ah—

lines: 제가... 이제 신의 운명은 신이 책임지려 합니다...!
en: I… will take responsibility for my own fate from now on…!
May Your Majesty live ten thousand years….!

blocks.html: Every door in the hall closes at once, from the outside.
blocks.ko: 전각의 문이 바깥에서 한꺼번에 닫힌다.

blocks.html: The side doors were never for servants. When they open again, Yeon’s soldiers come through every one of them. Tables overturn. Wine becomes a darker color before anyone names it. For hours, blood and tears fill the banquet hall as hundreds of officials and generals are killed. Yeon does not shout orders — he walks the length of the room the way a man walks a border he has already decided to keep, and he takes each commander’s blade himself.
blocks.ko: 옆문은 원래 하인을 위한 것이 아니었다. 다시 열릴 때, 그 문마다 연의 군사들이 들이닥친다. 상이 뒤집힌다. 술이, 누가 이름 붙이기 전에, 더 어두운 색이 된다. 몇 시간 동안 연회장은 피와 눈물로 가득 찬다. 수백의 관리와 장수가 죽는다. 연은 명령을 외치지 않는다 — 이미 지키기로 한 국경을 걷듯 전각을 가로지르며, 욕살의 칼은 제 손으로 거둔다.

blocks.html: First the Southern Commander. He wanted the next levy for Yushin’s passes, and called Eastern fighting easy work.
blocks.ko: 먼저 남부 욕살. 유신의 고개를 막겠다며 다음 징발을 달라 했고, 동부의 싸움은 쉬운 일이라 하던 자.

en: Yeon…!
Samhan… the Samhan His Majesty named—
Son Daeha.
You asked for men, not speeches.
I am taking the men.

blocks.html: He draws the Southern ring-pommel from a belt that no longer needs it. One crow. One weight on the spine to come.
blocks.ko: 더 이상 필요하지 않은 허리띠에서 남부의 환두를 뽑는다. 삼족오 하나. 앞으로 등에 올릴 무게 하나.

blocks.html: Then the Northern Commander. He would not freeze another winter while the capital counted his remounts twice.
blocks.ko: 다음은 북부 욕살. 중앙이 보충 말을 두 번 세는 동안 또 한 겨울을 얼고 싶지는 않다던 자.

en: The horses… still in… the warehouses…
blocks.art: In his own blood, still counting.

en: Go Ul.
…The three villages. I remember them.

blocks.html: The Northern crow joins the first. Outside, a horse screams in the yard and then does not.
blocks.ko: 북부의 삼족오가 첫 번째에 더해진다. 바깥 마당에서 말이 울다 만다.

blocks.html: The Western Commander had warned that this would gift the Tang a road. He dies looking west, as if the road might still be argued shut.
blocks.ko: 서부 욕살은 이러다 당에게 길을 선물하게 된다고 경고했었다. 그는 서쪽을 보며 죽는다. 그 길을 아직 말로 닫을 수 있다는 듯이.

en: The Liao…
The Emperor’s drums…
You were right about the road.

blocks.html: Three crows. The hall’s lamps lean as if listening.
blocks.ko: 삼족오 셋. 전각의 등불이 듣는 것처럼 기울다.

blocks.html: Lee Gaesa is not a commandery banner, but he was the Summit’s mouth the day the word traitor was first set on Yeon’s name. Tonight the mouth has wine in it, and then nothing.
blocks.ko: 이가사는 부의 깃발은 아니다. 그러나 제가회의에서 연의 이름에 처음으로 역적을 얹은 입이었다. 오늘 밤 그 입에는 술이 있고, 이윽고 아무것도 없다.

en: Traitor…!
That day… I…
Lee Gaesa.
You gave me the word.
I am keeping it.

blocks.html: Four. The word he was given becomes metal he can wear.
blocks.ko: 넷. 그에게 씌운 말이, 멜 수 있는 쇠가 된다.

blocks.html: Last of the banners: his uncle. The soft voice that told a nephew to sit down, because the Summit does not run on prophecies.
blocks.ko: 깃발의 마지막은 숙부다. 제가회의는 예언으로 돌아가지 않는다며 조카에게 앉으라 하던, 그 부드러운 목소리.

en: Nephew…
A feast… like this…
blocks.art: Almost kindly, which hurts more.

en: Uncle.
You told me to sit down.
A Yeon takes this one from a Yeon.

blocks.html: Five ring-pommels. Five crows. Yeon wipes none of them clean.
blocks.ko: 환두 다섯. 삼족오 다섯. 연은 하나도 닦지 않는다.

blocks.html: He finally approaches King Youngryu for the final blow. The crown has slid. The Samhan dream is still in the king’s mouth, too late to be a budget.
blocks.ko: 마침내 영류왕 앞에 선다 — 마지막 일격. 면류관이 비뚤어져 있다. 삼한의 꿈은 아직 왕의 입에 남아, 예산이 되기엔 너무 늦다.

en: Gesomun…
With gold… decades…
The King for All…

lines: 금으로 될 일이 아니었습니다. 그자는 이미 폐하의 목값을 매겨 두었으니.
en: Your Majesty.
The gold was never going to be enough. He had already priced your head.
May You live ten thousand years.

blocks.html: Yeon places each of the Five Blades onto his own back.
blocks.ko: 연은 다섯 자루의 칼을 모두 제 등에 짊어진다.

blocks.html: He wore five swords on his body, and no one around him dared look up at him. Every time he mounted or dismounted, he made nobles and generals lie on the ground and stepped on them.
blocks.ko: 몸에 칼 다섯 자루를 차니, 좌우가 감히 우러러보지 못하였다. 말에 오르내릴 때마다 늘 귀인과 무장을 땅에 엎드리게 하고 그를 밟았다.
blocks.hanja: 身佩五刀，左右莫敢仰視。每上下馬，常令貴人、武將伏地而履之。
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 49, Biographies — Yeon Gaesomun

blocks.html: Somun's surname is Qian*. His beard and face are very fine and his frame is towering. He wears five swords, and no one around him dares look up at him.
blocks.ko: 소문의 성은 전씨*이다. 수염과 얼굴이 매우 훌륭하고 몸집이 우람하며, 몸에 칼 다섯 자루를 차니 좌우가 감히 우러러보지 못한다.
blocks.hanja: 蘇文姓錢氏，須貌甚偉，形體魁傑，身佩五刀，左右莫敢仰視。
blocks.source: Jiu Tangshu (舊唐書) bk. 199上, Eastern Barbarians — Goguryeo

notes.html: The family name was Yeon (淵), “deep water”. Tang could not write that character, because it belonged to the dynasty’s founder, so its books swap in 泉, “spring”, or here 錢.
notes.ko: 그의 성은 연(淵)이다. 당은 고조 이연의 이름자인 淵을 쓸 수 없어, 泉이나 여기처럼 錢으로 바꿔 적었다.

blocks.html: He steps into the doorway with the blades on his back. Red-wing chalgap fills the door.
blocks.ko: 그가 칼들을 등에 진 채 문간에 선다. 붉은 날개 찰갑이 문을 가득 채운다.
blocks.art: Worm’s-eye from the hall floor: Yeon in the doorway, steel lamellar and red-wing shoulder cloth filling the frame.

lines: 고구려의 충신들은 이 연개소문의 말을 들으시오!
서쪽에서는 황제가 나라를 하나씩 도륙하며 이리로 오고 있소!
그동안 무능한 임금과 썩은 신하들은 눈을 감고, 이 나라를 망국의 길로 끌고 갔소!!
오늘은 신라와 동쪽, 내일은 백제, 그다음은 당이오!
en: Loyal men of Goguryeo — hear the words of Yeon Gesomun!
In the south, Baekje and Silla covet us,
and in the west the Second Emperor comes this way, butchering nation after nation!
And all the while an incompetent king and rotten ministers shut their eyes to the world and lead this country down the road to ruin!!
Silla and the East, then Baekje the next day, then the Tang!

lines: 그러면 백성은 어찌 되오? 우리는 갈 데가 없소!
이 땅에서 살고 이 땅에서 죽고, 저들이 올 때마다 피 흘리는 건 우리요!
세상은 우리를 미쳤다 할 것이오! 그렇겠지 — 제 운명을 제 손으로 쥐는 일은 언제나 세상 눈에 미친 짓이었으니!
en: But what of the people? We have nowhere else to go!
We live on this land, we die on it, and we are the ones who bleed every time they come!
The world will call us mad! Of course — to take your own fate in your own hands has always looked like madness to the world!

lines: 우리를 구하러 오는 자는 없소!! 오직 우리가, 우리 손으로 해야 하오!!
en: No one is coming to save us!! Only we can do it — with our own hands!!

blocks.html: In the aftermath, Yeon enthrones the king’s nephew as King Bojang and creates a new position for himself, as the Supreme Commander.
blocks.ko: 연은 왕의 조카를 보장왕으로 세우고, 스스로를 위한 새 자리를 만든다 — 대막리지.

blocks.caption: The old king’s nephew. He has been given a crown and very little to do with it.
blocks.ko: 옛 임금의 조카. 왕관은 받았는데, 그걸로 할 일은 별로 받지 못했다.

blocks.caption: A chair he built himself, above every other chair in the room.
blocks.ko: 스스로 짠 자리. 방 안의 모든 자리 위에 있다.

blocks.title: Supreme Commander · 대막리지
blocks.caption: After the knives: the High Commander’s chair becomes Supreme; the king dims to a puppet note.
blocks.ko: 칼 다음. 막리지 자리가 대막리지가 되고, 임금은 꼭두각시 음이 된다.

blocks.html: He makes one more appointment before the blood is dry. Dosuryu — an old friend of the Yeon house, one of the few men who has ever told him no and lived — is named Grand Herald, a post that did not exist until the banquet needed a voice that was not the throne’s.
blocks.ko: 피가 마르기 전에 임명 하나를 더 한다. 도수류 — 연씨 집안의 오랜 벗, 그에게 아니라고 말하고도 살아남은 몇 안 되는 사람 — 을 대대로에 앉힌다. 연회가 왕좌가 아닌 목소리를 필요로 하기 전까지는 없던 자리이다.

lines: 내가 네 아버지 살아 계실 때부터 네 뒷덜미를 잡던 사람인데.
en: Grand Herald…
I have had you by the scruff since your father was alive.
And now you want that mouth to read the country aloud?
If you will not, who will.
That Bojang… I only need the name.
The one who speaks to the 겨레 is you.

lines: 다만 — 네가 내 말을 들을 때만이야.
안 들으면 나는 전령이지, 친구가 아니야.
en: Very well.
Only — for as long as you still listen to me.
If you stop, I am a herald, not a friend.

blocks.html: Yeon listens. Not always. Often enough that the court learns which door to fear besides his.
blocks.ko: 연은 듣는다. 늘은 아니다. 그래도 조정이, 그를 빼고도 두려워할 문이 하나 더 있다는 걸 배울 만큼은.

blocks.html: Autumn, ninth month. The great minister Iri Kasumi*, that is Gesomun, killed the great king, and with him Gusesa and more than a hundred and eighty others. Then he made the son of the king's younger brother king, and made Dosuryu and Geumryu, men of his own surname, great ministers.
blocks.ko: 가을 9월, 대신 이리가수미*가 대왕을 죽이고 아울러 이리거세사 등 180여 명을 죽였다. 이어 아우 왕자의 아들을 왕으로 삼고, 자기와 같은 성인 도수류와 김류를 대신으로 삼았다.
blocks.hanja: 秋九月，大臣伊梨柯須彌殺大王，并殺伊梨渠世斯等百八十餘人，仍以弟王子兒爲王，以己同姓都須流、金流爲大臣。
blocks.source: Nihon Shoki (日本書紀) bk. 24, Empress Kōgyoku, yr. 1 (642), 2nd month — report of the Goguryeo envoys

notes.html: Yamato wrote down what its ears caught: Iri for Yeon, Kasumi for Gaesomun.
notes.ko: 왜는 귀에 들린 대로 적었다. 이리는 연, 가수미는 개소문이다.

en: You there… what is your name?
M-my name? My surname is Go—
You there… what is your name?

blocks.hanja: 賓至盡殺之 凡百餘人 馳入宮弑王 立王弟子藏爲王 自爲莫離支 專國
blocks.ko: 손님이 이르자 모두 죽이니 무릇 백여 명이요, 궁으로 달려들어 왕을 시해하고, 왕의 아우의 아들 장을 세워 임금으로 삼고, 스스로 막리지가 되어 나라를 오로지하였다.
blocks.html: When the guests arrived he killed them all, some hundred men; he galloped into the palace and murdered the king, set up the king’s brother’s son Jang as sovereign, made himself Mangniji, and monopolized the state.
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 49, Biographies — Yeon Gaesomun · bk. 21, Goguryeo Annals — King Yeongnyu, yr. 25 (642), 10th month; Lee Byong-do ed., vol. 1, p. 312 · cf. Zizhi Tongjian Tang Zhenguan 16

blocks.html: After the blood dries Yeon does something the temples will not forgive and the chronicles barely record: he sends for Tang masters of the Way. The point is to starve the Buddhist monk aristocracy of the prestige they wear like armour. Incense changes. Halls cool. One young monk named Shinsung learns how to wait.
blocks.ko: 피가 마른 뒤 연은 절이 용서하지 않고 사가가 거의 적지 않는 일을 한다. 당의 도사를 부른다. 목적은 승려 귀족이 갑옷처럼 걸친 권위를 굶기는 데 있다. 향이 바뀌고 전각이 식는다. 신성이라는 젊은 스님은 기다리는 법을 배운다.

en: Pray quieter.
Or pray to something that does not own half the capital.
lines: 아니면 수도 절반을 소유하지 않은 것한테 기도해.

en: Amitabha.
blocks.art: Bows.

blocks.html: What has the most strength? Forbearance is the strongest. One who forbears bears no grudge, and is sure to be honoured among men.
blocks.ko: 무엇이 가장 힘이 센가? 참는 것이 가장 굳세다. 참는 이는 원한을 품지 않으니, 반드시 사람들의 존경을 받는다.
blocks.hanja: 何者多力？忍辱最健，忍者無怨，必為人尊。
blocks.source: Sutra of Forty-two Sections (四十二章經), attr. Kāśyapa Mātaṅga & Zhu Falan · T17n0784, p. 722c

blocks.label: AFTER THE KNIVES
blocks.ko: 칼이 마른 뒤

blocks.html: In the markets the news arrives the way all bad news arrives — ahead of the official word, behind the smell of smoke. Grain sellers count on their fingers. Children stop racing. Someone says banquet and means blood.
blocks.ko: 저잣거리에 소식이 닿는 법은, 나쁜 소식이 늘 닿는 법과 같다 — 공식 말보다 먼저, 연기 냄새보다 늦게. 곡식 장수가 손가락을 접는다. 아이들이 달리기를 멈춘다. 누군가 연회라 말하고 피를 뜻한다.

blocks.speaker: Vendor
lines: 대장들도. 백이 넘는다고. 평양의 붉은 해가 — 그 칼들을 자기 등에 맸대.
en: The king… they say he’s dead.
The commanders too. More than a hundred. And the Red Sun of Pyongyang — they say he strapped their blades to his back.

blocks.speaker: Wall sentry
lines: 어떤 이들은 영원의 대장군이 우리를 살렸다고 해.
조정에서 먼저 칼을 갈았대. 다음은 우리였을 거고. 평민들은… 연보다 그 이름을 먼저 불러.
en: Some say the Eternal General saved us.
The court was sharpening first. We were next. Commoners… we say that name before we say Yeon.

lines: 그 칼… 다섯 자루를 등에 맸다더라.
en: Those blades… they say he strapped five of them to his back.
The commanders’ swords. On his own spine.
By Haemosu’s light… incredible…
No — terrifying. Incredible, and terrifying.

blocks.speaker: Quiet man
lines: 그래도… 연회장에서 베는 게 나라를 구하는 거냐.
en: Still… is butchering a banquet the same as saving a country.
blocks.art: Low.

blocks.speaker: Wall sentry
en: Don’t say that on the wall.

blocks.html: On the barracks steps the same argument runs until the drum tells them to stop arguing and start marching.
blocks.ko: 병영 층계에서도 같은 논쟁이 돌다가, 북이 다투지 말고 행진하라 이른다.

blocks.html: The capital learns a new etiquette. Remaining officials swear loyalty not to the nephew-king’s smile but to the Supreme Commander’s door. Men who hesitate are removed before winter — titles stripped, names scratched from the rolls, a few bodies found where the river turns. The foreign hostels lock from the outside. Tribute missions that once bought another quiet decade are cancelled mid-packing; silk meant for Chang’an stays in the warehouses.
blocks.ko: 도읍이 새 예법을 배운다. 남은 관리들은 조카왕의 미소가 아니라 대막리지의 문에 충성을 맹세한다. 망설이는 자는 겨울이 오기 전에 걷힌다 — 직함 박탈, 명부에서 이름 지움, 강이 꺾이는 곳에서 발견되는 시신 몇. 사신 관사는 밖에서 잠긴다. 또 한 번의 평온한 십 년을 사던 조공 행렬은 짐 싸다 말고 취소되고, 장안으로 가려던 비단은 창고에 남는다.

blocks.html: March boots outrank court shoes. Drums outrank flutes. Monks keep their heads down while the new Taoist masters walk the halls Yeon starved of incense. Envoys who still ask for audience are told the kingdom is closed for inventory — of grain, of blades, of who belongs inside the walls. Goguryeo under Yeon watches the roads in and trusts almost none of them.
blocks.ko: 변경의 군화가 조정의 신보다 높다. 북이 피리를 이긴다. 연이 향을 굶긴 전각을 새 도사들이 걷는 동안, 스님들은 고개를 숙인다. 알현을 청하는 사신에게는 — 곡식과 칼과, 성 안에 남을 자격의 재고 조사 중이라 돌려보낸다. 연 아래의 고구려는 들어오는 길을 보고, 거의 아무도 믿지 않는다.

blocks.html: At night the house is quieter than the city. Yeon’s wife has kept three boys from the sound of cheering that is not quite cheer. She waits until the lamps are few enough that even a Supreme Commander looks like a husband.
blocks.ko: 밤이 되면 집은 도읍보다 고요하다. 연씨부인은 환호가 아닌 환호 소리로부터 아들 셋을 막아 두었다. 등불이 적어져 대막리지조차 남편처럼 보일 때까지 기다린다.

lines: 바깥에서 우리 겨레를 어떻게 부를지… 생각만 해도—
en: What will Tang say…
Silla too. Baekje.
Massacre. Traitor.
How those outside will name our people… even thinking of it—

lines: 들어… 저들이 우리에 대해 뭐라 하든, 상관없어.
들리냐? 전혀. 제로. 한 톨도 아니야.
en: Listen… it doesn’t matter what they’ll say about us.
Do you hear me? It doesn’t matter at all — zero. Not even one bit.

lines: 저들 조상이 이 흙을 위해 죽어 줬나?
우리가 피 흘릴 차례가 오면, 저들이 여기 서 있어 주나?
en: Did their ancestors die for this dirt?
Will they be standing here when it is our turn to bleed?

lines: 그러니 바깥에서 우리 겨레를, 우리 사는 법을 뭐라 하든 —
네 인생 단 일 초도 거기 쓰지 마. 제발.
en: So whatever they say out there about our people, our way of living —
not one second of your life. Please.
Look at me. Promise me.

lines: 다만 — 아이들이 자라면, 당신은 그 말도 해 줘요.
en: …I promise.
Only — when the boys are grown, tell them that too.

blocks.html: He nods. Outside, the drums keep time for a kingdom learning to live with its doors shut.
blocks.ko: 그는 끄덕인다. 바깥에서는, 문을 닫고 사는 법을 배우는 나라의 북이 박자를 맞춘다.

blocks.html: A kingdom with its doors shut, and a man with five swords on his back. Naturally, Chunchu wants to go and knock…!
blocks.ko: 문을 걸어 잠근 나라, 그리고 칼 다섯 자루를 등에 멘 사내. 그러니 당연히, 춘추는 그 문을 두드리러 가겠다고 한다…!

blocks.html: Since Daeya fell, Chunchu has had one request for the Queen: send him north to Pyongyang, to beg Goguryeo for troops against Baekje. She has not said yes.
blocks.ko: 대야성이 떨어진 뒤로 춘추가 여왕께 올리는 청은 하나뿐이다. 자기를 북쪽 평양으로 보내 달라는 것, 고구려에 가서 백제를 칠 군사를 빌려 오겠다는 것. 여왕은 아직 허락하지 않았다.

blocks.html: The news reaches Surabol about a month late, the way news from the north usually does.
blocks.ko: 소식은 한 달쯤 늦게 서라벌에 닿는다. 북쪽 소식이 으레 그렇듯이.

en: What…! The King of Goryeo, murdered by his own subject?

lines: 허 참… 난 우리나라가 먼저 망하는 줄 알았더니, 고려가 먼저 가는구먼. 그래, 그 신하는 또 누군가?
en: Well I never… I thought our country would fall first, and Goryeo goes ahead of us. So who is this subject?

lines: 영원의 대장군이라 부릅니다 — 연, 혹은 개소문. 평민들은 조정이 못 들을 때 평양의 붉은 해라고 하지요.
en: They call him the Eternal General — Yeon, or Gesomun. Commoners say Red Sun of Pyongyang when they think courts cannot hear.
“Yeon Gesomun”…

blocks.html: Chunchu asks again, and this time the Queen lets him go. Nobody offers to go instead.
blocks.ko: 춘추가 다시 청하고, 이번에는 여왕이 허락한다. 대신 가겠다는 사람은 없다.

lines: 공이 가서 돌아오지 않는다면, 한결의 말발굽이 반드시 고려 왕정을 짓밟을 것이오.
en: If you go and do not return, Hangyul’s hooves will trample Goryeo underfoot without fail.

lines: 60일 이내면 돌아올 것인데 이때에도 돌아오지 않는다면 다시 볼 기약이 없을 것입니다.
en: I will return within sixty days. If I have not returned by then, there will be no promise of meeting again.

blocks.html: He leaves by the west gate of Wolseong on Hadong, a lean red bay he named for summer and winter, because a diplomat’s horse, he says, has to stand in both. Yushin walks beside the bridle as far as the gate and no farther, which for Yushin is a speech.
blocks.ko: 그는 하동을 타고 월성 서문으로 떠난다. 여름과 겨울에서 이름을 딴 마른 적갈색 말. 사신의 말은 둘 다 견뎌야 한다고, 그는 말한다. 유신은 굴레 옆을 걸어 문까지만 따라오고 그 이상은 오지 않는다. 유신에게 그건 연설이다.

blocks.caption: Sixty days there and back, through a country that has just killed its own king. He packs light.
blocks.ko: 가고 오는 데 육십 일. 방금 제 왕을 죽인 나라를 지나는 길이다. 짐은 가볍게 꾸린다.

en: Sixty days.
He knows the way back. Even if you forget.
You’re saying he’s smarter than me.
…Hear that, Hadong? Yushin trusts you.
It’s you I don’t trust.

blocks.html: Pyongyang lets him in through the red gate and keeps him waiting on the stair. When someone finally comes down, it is Dosuryu, the Grand Herald.
blocks.ko: 평양은 붉은 문루로 그를 들이고, 층계에서 기다리게 한다. 마침내 누가 내려오는데, 대대로 도수류다.

en: Your Excellency…

blocks.html: Chunchu requests to see the king.
blocks.ko: 춘추가 왕의 알현을 청한다.

blocks.html: King Bojang makes his request — though the word his is doing generous work, and everyone in the room knows for whom.
blocks.ko: 보장왕이 요구를 내놓는다 — 그의라는 말이 꽤 후하게 쓰인 셈이고, 방 안의 모두가 그것이 실은 누구의 요구인지 안다.

en: Oi, Silla — why the long face?
And call it Goguryeo.
Not Goryeo. I am not tired enough to shorten my own country.
lines: 고려가 아니라. 내 나라를 줄일 만큼 지치지 않았다.

en: Goguryeo, then — if the chronicles insist.
Most men I meet have already shortened it.
lines: 제가 만난 대부분은 이미 줄여 부릅니다.
이 땅의 위기를 기회 삼아 영토를 내놓으라 하실 수 있습니까?
저는 신하이니 어쩔 수 없지요. 처분만 기다리겠습니다. 그럼, 이만…
en: You would take this land’s crisis as your chance, and demand territory?
As a subject I have no say, so I await your judgement. And now — I take my leave…

lines: 남의 집에 들어와 값을 거절하고도 눈을 피하지 않는구나.
신라엔 자존심이 없나? 아니면 자네만 없나?
en: You come into another man’s house, refuse his price, and still look me in the eye.
Has Silla no pride left? Or is it only you?

lines: 저는 제가 어디로 가는지만 압니다. 이 방에는 그 앞을 막아설 만큼 큰 것이 없습니다.
en: I know no such thing as pride.
Pride is a decoration for men who can afford to lose.
I know where I am going. There is nothing in this room large enough to stand in the way.

blocks.html: Outside the door, two Goguryeo soldiers have been listening the way soldiers listen — professionally, and for sport.
blocks.ko: 문 밖에서는 고구려 병사 둘이, 병사들이 듣는 방식으로 — 직업적으로, 그리고 심심풀이로 — 듣고 있다.

lines: …대막리지 면전에 대고 그러고도, 눈 한 번을 안 깜빡여.
en: Did you hear him?
…Said it to the Mangniji’s face. Didn’t blink once.

lines: 신라 놈들은 염라대왕 앞에 폼 나게 끌려가고 싶을 때 저런 소리를 하지.
en: Silla men talk like that when they want to walk into Yumla’s court stylishly.

lines: 말린 생선 하나 걸지. 무릎으로 기어 나올걸.
en: Bet you a dried fish he crawls out on his knees.
Bet you two he cries.

blocks.html: The door opens. Chunchu is escorted out between two attendants. His left hand is a red glove. Blood runs off the wrist and dots the stone like a trail someone meant to follow.
blocks.ko: 문이 열린다. 춘추가 시종 둘 사이에 호송되어 나온다. 왼손이 붉은 장갑이다. 피가 손목에서 흘러 돌바닥에 점점이 찍힌다. 누가 따라오라고 남긴 자국처럼.

en: …Ah?

lines: 왜 피야. 성왕의 활에 맹세코, 왜 이렇게 피가 많아.
en: Why is there blood. By the Holy King’s bow, why is there so much blood.
Did—— did the Mangniji cut him?
Move. Prison.

lines: 옥? 저승사자 코앞까지 갔다 온 놈이 얼굴은 그대로인데.
en: Prison? The man brushed past the death escort and he still has that face on.

blocks.html: They put him in a cell with a window. That is meant to be a courtesy. The courtesy does not include a physician.
blocks.ko: 그들은 창이 있는 방에 그를 가둔다. 나름의 예우라고 한다. 그 예우에는 의원은 포함되지 않는다.

en: (…Good. He looked. He will remember looking.)
blocks.art: Thought balloon.

blocks.html: What the guards do not know — what nobody in the corridor knows — is whose blade opened the hand. That answer waits in another man’s memory, for another meeting.
blocks.ko: 병사들이 모르는 것 — 복도의 그 누구도 모르는 것 — 은 누구의 칼이 그 손을 열었느냐다. 그 답은 다른 사람의 기억 속에, 다른 만남을 위해 기다려 둔다.

blocks.html: Chunchu has no physician, but he has a sleeve, and sewn into it is what a Silla envoy carries when he expects to be robbed. Somehow it reaches Seon Dohae, the king’s favourite, without passing through any door the Mangniji is watching.
blocks.ko: 춘추에게 의원은 없지만 소매는 있다. 그 안에는 털릴 각오를 한 신라 사신이 챙기는 것이 꿰매져 있다. 그것은 어찌어찌 막리지가 지키는 어느 문도 지나지 않고 왕의 총신 선도해에게 닿는다.

blocks.html: Chunchu secretly gave three hundred measures of blue cloth to the king’s favourite, Seon Dohae.
blocks.ko: 춘추는 푸른 베 삼백 보를 왕의 총신 선도해에게 몰래 주었다.
blocks.hanja: 春秋以靑布三百步 密贈王之寵臣先道解
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 41, Biographies — Kim Yushin; Lee Byong-do ed., vol. 2 (Chunchu in Goguryeo, 642)

blocks.html: Seon Dohae arrives with a jar of wine and no guards, which is either courage or an arrangement. He pours two cups, drinks both when Chunchu does not reach for his, and starts talking about the sea.
blocks.ko: 선도해는 술 한 단지를 들고 호위도 없이 온다. 배짱이거나, 이미 말이 된 일이거나. 그는 두 잔을 따르고, 춘추가 손을 뻗지 않자 두 잔을 다 마신 뒤, 바다 이야기를 꺼낸다.

lines: 손이 그래서야 잔을 들겠소. 내가 마셔 드리지.
……그런데 공, 거북이와 토끼 이야기 들어 보셨소?
en: Can’t hold a cup with a hand like that. I’ll drink it for you.
…Tell me, my lord. Ever heard the one about the turtle and the rabbit?

lines: ……들어 봤어도, 공의 입으로 다시 듣고 싶군요.
en: …Even if I had, I’d like to hear it from you.

lines: 동해 용왕의 딸이 가슴앓이를 했다지. 의원이 그러는 거요, 토끼 간이면 낫는다고.
바다에 토끼가 있나. 그래서 거북이가 뭍에 올라가 토끼한테 말을 걸어.
“저 바다 한가운데 섬이 있는데, 물 맑고 열매 많고, 매도 수리도 못 오는 데다. 가자, 내 등에 타라.”
en: The Dragon King of the Eastern Sea had a daughter with a sick heart. The physician said a rabbit’s liver would cure her.
No rabbits in the sea. So the turtle climbs up on land and strikes up a conversation with a rabbit.
“Out in the middle of the sea there’s an island. Clear water, fruit everywhere, no hawks, no eagles. Come on. Get on my back.”
And the rabbit got on.

lines: 탔지. 성왕께서 강 건너실 때도 거북이 등을 밟으셨으니, 거북이는 대개 믿을 만하거든. 대개는.
두어 리쯤 가서 거북이가 고개를 돌리고 실토를 해. 사실은 네 간이 필요하다고.
en: Got right on. The Holy King ran across a river on turtles’ backs, so turtles are generally trustworthy. Generally.
Two or three li out, the turtle turns his head and confesses. Actually, we need your liver.
And do you know what the rabbit said?

lines: “아이고, 나는 신령의 자손이라 오장을 꺼내 씻어 둘 수 있거든. 마침 요새 속이 답답해서 간을 꺼내 바위 밑에 말려 두고 왔지 뭐냐. 돌아가서 가져오자.”
거북이가 믿고 돌아갔지. 뭍에 닿자마자 토끼는 풀숲으로 쏙.
“멍청하긴. 간 없이 사는 놈이 어디 있냐.”
en: “Oh dear. I’m descended from spirits, I can take out my insides and wash them. My chest’s been tight lately, so I left my liver drying under a rock. Let’s go back and fetch it.”
The turtle believed him and turned around. The moment they touched the shore, the rabbit was into the grass.
“Idiot. Who lives without a liver?”

blocks.html: Seon Dohae refills his own cup and looks at nothing in particular. Chunchu looks at his ruined hand for a long time, then laughs once, quietly, the way a man laughs when a lock he has been picking turns over.
blocks.ko: 선도해는 제 잔을 다시 채우고 아무 데도 아닌 곳을 본다. 춘추는 망가진 손을 오래 내려다보다가, 한 번 조용히 웃는다. 붙들고 있던 자물쇠가 돌아갈 때 사람이 웃는 식으로.

en: …Could I trouble you for paper?
The left one’s in no state, so I’ll use the right.

blocks.html: The letter goes to the king, not the Mangniji. The passes were Goguryeo's to begin with, it says, and once Chunchu is home he will ask his sovereign to give them back. He signs with a flourish. He has no intention of doing any such thing. His drinking partner, finishing the jar, has no intention of mentioning it.
blocks.ko: 편지는 막리지가 아니라 왕에게 간다. 그 고개들은 본래 고구려 땅이니, 돌아가면 제 임금께 돌려드리라 청하겠다고 적혀 있다. 춘추는 멋들어지게 서명한다. 그럴 생각은 털끝만큼도 없다. 술단지를 비우던 술친구도 그 말을 꺼낼 생각이 털끝만큼도 없다.

blocks.html: On the sixtieth day Yushin starts counting out men. He does not ask the Queen first.
blocks.ko: 예순째 되는 날, 유신은 병사를 헤아리기 시작한다. 여왕께 먼저 여쭙지 않는다.

blocks.html: However, when the Eternal General hears of the Sword of Silla, he lets the most cunning man in Samhan go immediately.
blocks.ko: 그러나 신라의 도검 이름을 들은 영원의 대장군은 삼한에서 가장 교활한 자를 곧장 풀어 준다.

en: Huh?
Yushin is coming!

lines: 나도 잘 모르겠는데... 아마 자네가 온다는 소리를 듣고 쫄지 않았나!
en: I don’t quite know either… perhaps he lost his nerve when he heard you were coming!
(The Eternal General… a more fearsome man than I expected…)
blocks.art: Thought balloon.

blocks.html: On the Silla side of the border, in a camp that should not exist, Yushin has brought the horse. Hadong is tied at the front of the lines with an empty saddle, the way some armies carry an empty chair. When Chunchu comes down the last hill on foot, thinner, the left hand bound against his chest, the horse sees him before the men do.
blocks.ko: 국경 이쪽, 있어서는 안 될 진영에 유신은 그 말을 데려와 있다. 하동은 빈 안장을 얹은 채 대열 맨 앞에 매여 있다. 어떤 군대가 빈 의자를 메고 다니듯이. 춘추가 마지막 언덕을 걸어 내려올 때, 더 마르고, 왼손을 가슴에 동여맨 채, 사람들보다 말이 먼저 그를 알아본다.

lines: 너 살쪘다. 유신이가 나보다 잘 먹였네.
en: …Hadong.
You got fat. Yushin fed you better than they fed me.
Hand.
…Give it here. The right one.

blocks.html: Chunchu cannot close the left hand on a rein, so Yushin ties both reins around his right wrist himself, in a knot he learned in the drill yard for men who have been shot. He says nothing about the hand, and Chunchu says nothing about the camp.
blocks.ko: 춘추는 왼손으로 고삐를 쥘 수 없다. 그래서 유신이 두 고삐를 그의 오른 손목에 직접 묶는다. 화살 맞은 사람을 위해 연병장에서 배운 매듭으로. 그는 손에 대해 아무 말도 하지 않고, 춘추도 진영에 대해 아무 말도 하지 않는다.

blocks.caption: One envoy coming south, ten thousand Silla men coming north, and a border between them that has gone very polite.
blocks.ko: 남쪽으로 오는 사신 하나, 북쪽으로 가는 신라군 만 명. 그 사이의 국경은 갑자기 몹시 예의 바르다.

en: …What? The Sword of the Divine Country is coming?
…Let him go.
Sir?

lines: 그런데 진짜… 삼한에서 가장 교활한 자라는 이 춘추가 뭐길래, 신라의 도검이 직접 온다는 거냐?
en: Did you not hear me? Release Chunchu.
But truly… who is this Chunchu — the most cunning man in Samhan — that the Sword of Silla comes for him himself?

lines: 신라의 도검이 누군데 영원의 대장군께서 이러십니까?
en: Who is this Sword of Silla, that the Eternal General behaves so?
Surely… you are not afraid?

lines: 얘야, 아무리 죽을 각오를 한 자라도, 호랑이도 함부로 건드는 거 아니다.
우리도 언젠가 유신을 대적할 날이 오겠지...
하지만 춘추 같은거 가지고 이렇게까지 할 건 아냐.
en: Boy — even a man ready to die does not poke a tiger for no reason.
The day will come when we face Yushin…
but not over something like Chunchu.

blocks.html: One envoy left Pyongyang bleeding. Whose blade was it? Now the King of Baekje walks in on purpose, laughing…!
blocks.ko: 사신 하나가 피를 흘리며 평양을 떠났다. 누구의 칼이었을까? 이번엔 백제의 왕이 제 발로 걸어 들어온다. 웃으면서…!

images.alt: Caravaggio’s Supper at Emmaus: Euija flings both arms wide laughing, Gesomun leans in over the sword on the table
images.prompt: HEEWON STYLE. POSE: Caravaggio’s Supper at Emmaus. Low across a dark table in a closed Pyongyang room at night: a ring-pommel sword lies flat on the table between them, pointed at nothing. Right, Euija throws himself back in his chair with both arms flung wide, head tipped back, roaring with laughter. Left, Gesomun half-risen, leaning over the table on one fist beside the sword, glaring. One clay oil dish on the table edge is the only light, rakes across both faces from below and runs a bright streak down the blade; a wine jar and two cups catch it at the near edge; the walls are black. Encased in darkness: at least 80% of the frame is near-black umber void, the figures pulled out of it by one hard raking key. Old-master tenebrist canvas (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt): broken-colour oil brushwork, glazed umber-black darks, impasto on the brightest highlight, canvas grain; silk brushed in loaded strokes; only faces and hands keep clean webtoon ink line. The steel glistens: the key runs down every blade as one long white-hot streak with a tiny star-glint on the edge. Composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. CANON — KING EUIJA — FACE and garments from attached /ch_buyeo_euija.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Broad, bearded king; black hair in a topknot with a yellow-gold headband whose tails trail; heavy brows, cynical eyes. Dress: Crimson robe with a dark charcoal collar and gold trim; a steel lamellar pauldron peeking at one shoulder. Demeanor: Licensed wit: drinks, smirks, slumps on the throne, speaks in polished aphorisms. Fatalist. Fighting: Tiger-ring sword is ceremonial; he barely draws it. #e08a2e as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: heroic battle pose; smiling innocence. | YEON GESOMUN — FACE and garments from attached /ch_yeon_gesomun.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Massive, broad-chested; black hair in a tight topknot tied with red cord; thick black beard trimmed close to the jaw, heavy brows, glaring eyes. Dress: Dark charcoal robe and trousers under red-edged armor, a red cape falling off the shoulders. Demeanor: Arrogant, theatrical, loud; looks down at people (worm's-eye suits him). Laughs while fighting. Sword: High Commander Blade — Ring-pommel High Commander Blade — haetae carved beneath the crow stamp; the 막리지검 of the Summit’s first chair. Pommel motif crow inside the small ring (name only; do not attach the pommel ECU). Carry: FIVE crow-ring swords (身佩五刀): four crossed in a fan on his back with the hilts rising above his shoulders, plus one at the hip. Fighting: DUAL-WIELDS: a crow-ring sword in EACH hand, both forward one-hand grips, ring pommels at the heel of each fist. Wide aggressive stance, arms flung apart, scissoring cross-cuts and windmill slashes; lose one blade and he pulls another off his back. Each blade straight sw_bidam anatomy, 1:3. #d0362f as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: one sword in a fight; gold-plated armor; beardless face (except a flashback to youth). | SWORD ANATOMY: Copy attached sw_bidam.png. The ONLY circle on the sword is the small hollow RING at the pommel. When the blade hangs down: RING is UP (heel of the fist, little-finger side) → short gold band → palm-length diamond GRIP (one fist, not two-handed) → thin gold BAND (a collar, never a round tsuba, never a second ring) → long steel BLADE down toward the ankle → point. Handle:blade = 1:3 locked (handle = one quarter of the whole; blade = three quarters). Hip scale: hilt at hip, tip near ankle — never taller than the person, never a polearm. NEVER put the ring between the hand and the steel. NEVER point a giant blade at the camera as a graphic. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only. HEEWON STYLE: a Korean WEBTOON figure painted into a hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL world, in a SIMPLE, MINIMAL, ICONIC layout — the benchmark is a lone man in magenta silk walking down a storm-lit grass ridge toward his tied horse with an empty saddle: one diagonal, two subjects, half the frame storm sky, one cloud-break. FIGURES are webtoon / anime: clean digital-ink linework, simplified webtoon faces with expressive eyes, the face and hands keep that clean ink line, but the body and garments are PAINTED, never digitally shaded — broad loaded brushstrokes and dry-brush drag that follow each fold, the shading stepped in three or four painted value planes with soft broken edges, paper-and-canvas grain running right across the silk — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, never a smooth airbrushed gradient, never a 3D render (2.5D, see FORM). THE WORLD is WATERCOLOR FIRST, OIL SECOND: skies and ground in granulated wet-in-wet washes and short broken-colour dabs (Turner), dry-brush grass, dust and stone texture, soft bleeding edges, faint paper grain; the accent colour of the scene blooms into the wash near one frame edge and the frame edges dissolve into bare paper; oil only deepens the darks with rich umber-indigo glazes and adds a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. INTERIORS AND NIGHT SCENES are the webtoon figure painted into a European OLD-MASTER CANVAS — a Renaissance / Baroque TENEBRIST oil painting (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt): broken-colour brushwork, glazed umber-to-black darks, sfumato falloff, a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight, over faint watercolor blooms and paper grain; walls, timber, stone, drapery and tables pulled out of the darkness by the one lamp, window or shaft. The same oil-on-canvas texture covers EVERYTHING in the frame, the figures’ silk included — mottled plaster, gritty stone, brushed robes — so the webtoon figures sit INTO that painted space, lit by the same key and sharing its shadows, never pasted onto a flat backdrop. LAYOUT is MINIMAL AND ICONIC, staged like a Romanticist painting (Friedrich, Turner, Delacroix, Géricault): ONE device carries the frame (a ridge diagonal, a road, a waterline, a hall axis, a table ring, a gate) with ONE or TWO subjects placed on the thirds; at least half the frame is quiet negative space (storm sky, empty field, dark floor, bare wall); distant detail stays tiny and dissolving (a line of banners or roofs in haze); no crowds, no clutter, nothing competing with the subject. Heroic diagonal or pyramid, small figures against a sublime sky or vast field, or a bold worm’s-eye / straight-down angle. BLOCKING IS THE RELATIONSHIP: when two people share a frame, the still reads like a history painting with the faces covered — who stands higher and who kneels, the distance or contact between them, whose hand rests on whom, where each one looks (at each other, past each other, the same way), and how their cast shadows meet on the wall or floor; one gesture between them carries the whole bond. LIGHT is movie tenebrism at full strength: 70–85% of the frame sinks into deep painted shadow (oil-glazed umber, indigo, black), an extreme value range with near-white highlights right beside inky black and almost no middle grey; big dark masses (storm cloud, shadowed slope, umber room, black floor) against ONE bright break — a single cloud-break, low sun shaft, lamp or window — that lands on the subject; inky darks right beside small near-white highlights, few middle greys in the subject; ONE hard directional key carves the subject out of the dark. FORM IS 2.5D — drawn webtoon line on the outside, sculpted painted volume on the inside (the interior benchmark: a bearded emperor in yellow silk standing at a stone relief, under-lit by an oil lamp set on the floor beside the lens, palm on the carved horse, his shadow climbing the wall): the key is a PRACTICAL light IN or just outside the frame, CLOSE to the subject, RAKING ACROSS the surfaces the camera sees from below or from the side — never from behind them. So every silk fold protrudes, built the way an oil painter builds it: the lit side of each fold laid in with one opaque loaded stroke, the turn into shadow a crisp painted edge, the shadow side a thin transparent umber glaze with a little warm floor-light dragged into it, brush direction following the fold; gold thread and the brightest ridges flicked in with impasto; cheekbones, beard, knuckles, armor plates and horse muscle are painted the same way. The subject is large in frame (medium or closer, worm’s-eye or low three-quarter) so the folds resolve, and the light falls off into black across the body — that falloff is the darkness. Never a garment filled with one flat colour; never a subject backlit into a flat silhouette with only an edge line (if the camera is behind someone, the key still comes from the side and models their back and shoulder); never a wall flat to the lens — walls and floors recede at an angle so cast shadows can climb them. A thin edge of the same real light may graze the far side of the silhouette to lift it off the background (never a glow outline); long raking shadows. TEXTURE IS TACTILE RELIEF — the raking key exists to reveal it: thick oil impasto that stands up off the canvas on the lit side of every surface, loaded-brush and palette-knife ridges the eye can almost touch. Cloth: heavy silk in deep ridged folds, raised gold embroidery and brocade threads catching pin-point specular, quilted collars, layered sleeves with real thickness, beads and pins as small sculpted volumes. Buildings and ground just as sculpted: carved, weathered timber grain on pillars and brackets, every giwa roof tile and end-cap a rounded relief with its own shadow, rough-cut stone blocks, cracked lime plaster, lattice in deep relief throwing crisp little shadows, packed earth with grit and footprints. Never a smooth flat wall, never a plain colour-fill robe. Default hour is dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat overcast, never even daylight, never a bright open sky filling the frame. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. SEPARATION: subject and background never share a value — the lit subject sits in the one pool of light and everything behind it drops three or more steps to near-black (or, reversed, a dark figure against the single bright opening); foreground shapes almost black; the eye lands on the subject first. SHOT VARIETY AND NEGATIVE SPACE: across a set of stills alternate INTIMATE CLOSE-UPS (faces and hands filling the frame, the background a dark blur) with FAR WIDES (the figures small in a lower corner or third, 60% or more of the canvas left as quiet negative space — black hall, night sky, dark water, bare wall — that makes the small lit figures strike). RENAISSANCE CANVAS, CARTOON FIGURES: the world is composed and painted like a Renaissance / Baroque master (Leonardo’s sfumato, Titian’s glazes, Raphael’s pyramids, Caravaggio’s darkness), but every face stays a clean-lined webtoon / anime face — big expressive eyes, simple nose and mouth, smooth cel-like skin with one or two shadow tones — never photographic skin, pores or realistic facial anatomy. COLOR SYMBOLISM reads at a glance: each kingdom's colour lives in its banners and cloth (Silla blue, Baekje yellow, Goguryeo red, Tang vermilion and gold), each named person's hex in the key light on them, and the rest of the frame stays desaturated umber, slate and black so those few colours sing. FACES stay drawn: match the attached portrait's line weight, eye shape and simplification exactly — if a face starts to read as a photograph, flatten it back to ink line and wash; extras are drawn the same way, never photographic. HORSES are drawn to be admired: the whole body readable, arched neck, deep chest, round haunch, clean legs in a true gait, muscle modelled by the key with a bright edge along the topline. 2.5D painterly cinema — drawn webtoon faces, everything else brushed with visible strokes and canvas grain — not photoreal, not live-action, not a smooth digital airbrush or 3D render, not flat cel fill. Same film stock every still: a CAMERA in a real Korean place — anamorphic 2:1 movie frame, shallow DOF, creamy bokeh, rack-focus, film grain, crushed blacks, ONE hard key, long shadows, tenebrism. MOVIE FRAME of the scene a DP could stand in — NEVER a graphic poster, split-screen collage, 3D architectural visualization, black-triangle overlay, spotlight cone deleting the landscape, or neon outline. NO halo, bloom, glow aura, rim-aura, emissive skin, or god-ray envelope around people — character hex is the color of REAL LIGHT in the dark (key bounce, specular on silk/armor/wet stone, a lamp, a shaft, a floor reflection), never a body halo, never magic outline, never neon-painting the figure. FACE ONLY from the attached portrait — silk/hanbok may match; NEVER copy the portrait stance, clasped hands, 3/4 fashion lineup, or a standing clone. Invent a new DRAMATIC body every still (mid-stride, kneel, full-draw, turn, tumble, lean, count, dutch, worm’s-eye, lower-third). CINEMATOGRAPHY: name the shot — dutch angle, worm’s-eye, crane, over-shoulder, rack focus, shallow DOF / bokeh, chiaroscuro, mise-en-scène, long-shadow key. HIGH CONTRAST: crushed blacks + one hard key / long shadows / tenebrism — not even daylight wash, not a flat tourist postcard. ICONIC MINIMAL means one architectural device a lens can see (road, column, waterline, gate, hall axis) plus empty negative space — not deleting the world. COLOR SYMBOLISM: hex tints the hard key / catchlight / bounce — NEVER a glow aura, NEVER recolor the attached portrait’s garments (Sosuno stays dusty-rose hanbok, Geumwa stays red-burgundy court silk, not gold paint). FACE AND CLOTHES match the attached ch_*.png. One of each named person — NEVER clone or duplicate a character. People stand on packed earth at a well RIM — NEVER inside the well shaft. Jumong is fun-loving and laid-back: grin, laugh, wink, easy eyes — not a grim founder mask. BATTLE ARMOR: metallic GRAY steel lamellar (attached steel-armor ref); cloth peeks in the character hex — not gold-painted plate, not glowing armor, not a standing armor catalog. RING-POMMEL SWORDS: one-handed hip 환두대도 from attached sw_bidam.png — handle:blade 1:3; order is RING (pommel at heel of fist) → short grip → thin gold collar → long blade → point. Never reverse handle and blade. Never a tsuba disc in the middle. Never taller than the person. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only — do not attach it on full-blade stills. Ignore swords on face portraits. Two people = two garment-true figures against crushed black. Real Korean architecture or a locked dark room. No army. No readable text. No watermark. Copy: dynamic poses in a mythology-scale layout; dramatic poses in a mythology-scale one-device layout; one hard key / chiaroscuro; one gesture in empty space — iconic and simple. Never: white / pale studio void as a room; earth places stay real buildings, not color-plane furniture; no pasted portrait pose — new body every still; no floating logo — still must be a movie frame of the scene; unrealistic layout, reptitive; real bottle-shaped Cheomseongdae plus a story beat.

blocks.html: News of Yeon’s Massacre reaches Baekje.
blocks.ko: 연개소문의 난 소식이 백제에 닿는다.

en: What…! The King of Goryeo, murdered by his own subject?
This is an opportunity…

blocks.html: He asks for troops. He asks twice.
blocks.ko: 그는 군사를 청한다. 두 번 청한다.

en: Have you come to see the king?
No… I have come to see the one with real power.
He does not grant an audience to just anyone.
Tell him who I am, and he will come at once.

blocks.html: Yeon is surprised that the new King of Baekje has come personally.
blocks.ko: 백제의 새 임금이 몸소 왔다는 사실에 연도 놀란다.

lines: 벽은 왕과 귀족세력을 싹 다 갈아엎어버렸다지요? 그거 하나만은 조금 부럽네...
en: I hear you ploughed under the king and the whole noble faction? That one thing, I rather envy…
Could you not do the same on your side?

lines: 나는 폭군 소리 듣고 그다음 날 죽을 거요, 참.
en: Look here — I am the king myself.
General Gesomun—
I would be called a tyrant and killed the next day, ah.

lines: 그대들이 저 바깥 성벽에서 우리 임금을 죽였소. 이 방에서도 보이는 저기서.
en: Your people killed a king of ours on that wall out there. You can see it from this room.

lines: 그럼 한성은? 우리 임금 목을 그쪽 성벽에 걸어 놓고 한 철 농사라 하지 않았소.
en: And Hansung? You put our king’s head on your own wall and called it a season’s work.

blocks.html: Once, a Goguryeo king came south and took Baekje’s old capital. The Baekje king tried to run. They caught him and killed him at the foot of a mountain. Baekje has not forgotten. Goguryeo has not apologised.
blocks.ko: 한때 고구려 왕이 남으로 내려와 백제의 옛 도읍을 빼앗았다. 백제 왕은 달아나려 했다. 그들은 그를 붙잡아 산 아래에서 죽였다. 백제는 잊지 않았다. 고구려는 사과하지 않았다.

lines: 게다가… 이 방에 있는 둘 중, 실제로 고려왕을 시해해 본 자는 하나뿐이고. 나는 아니외다.
en: Besides… of the two men in this room, only one has actually murdered a king of Goryeo. It was not me.

blocks.html: Yeon puts the blade on the table between them. Not pointed at anything. Just there.
blocks.ko: 연이 칼을 둘 사이의 상 위에 올려놓는다. 겨눈 것도 아니다. 그냥 거기에 놓아둔다.

lines: 내가 지금 이 칼로 그대를 베지 말아야 할 이유를, 하나만 대 보시오…!
en: Give me one reason I should not cut you down with this blade where you stand…!
Pfft—hahahahahaha!!

lines: 개소문 자네… 군사는 통솔할 줄 알아도, 정치는 딱 봐도 초보구려. 정치가 뭔지 아나?
정치는 연금술이야. 내가 이미 하고 싶은 일에다, 명분을 만들어 붙이는 연금술.
지금 이웃 나라 백성들 사이에 자네를 우러르는 자가 얼마나 되는지 아나?
연개소문 — 탐관오리를 싹 갈아엎고 새 시대를 열 사내.
그런데… 여기서 백제왕을 죽이면, 그 나라들에 죄다 소문이 나겠지.
자네는 임금 죽이기를 즐기는 미친놈이 되는 거야. 그것뿐이고.
en: Gesomun… you may know how to command an army, but in politics you are plainly a novice. Do you know what politics is?
Politics is alchemy. The alchemy of manufacturing a justification for what I already want to do.
Do you know how many people in the surrounding countries admire you right now?
Yeon Gesomun — the man who ploughed under the corrupt officials and will bring a new age.
But… kill the King of Baekje now, and word reaches every one of those countries.
You become a madman who enjoys killing kings. Nothing else.

lines: 고구려는 태양신의 피를 이은 성스러운 임금이 세운 나라요.
성왕. 해모수의 아들. 하늘에서 내려온 줄기요.
en: This land is not just dirt.
Goguryeo is the land of the holy king, descended from the sun god.
The Holy King. Son of Haemosu. A line that came down from heaven.

lines: 잠깐… 잠깐만. 지금 한 나라의 대막리지가 —
다 큰 사내가, 나라를 이끄는 사내가 —
en: Pfft—!!
Hahahahaha!!
Wait… wait. The Supreme Commander of a country —
a grown man, a man who leads a kingdom —
still believes in spirits and sun chariots?

lines: 그는 하늘에서 내려왔다. 활로 나라를 열었다.
en: Do not laugh.
He came down from heaven. He opened a kingdom with a bow.
That blood — is the bone of this 겨레.

lines: 아, 물론. 활 잘 쏘는 사내는 하나 있었겠지.
나머지는 백성 줄 세우려고 지은 이야기고.
농부를 무릎 꿇리는 데는, 칼보다 태양신이 싸게 먹히거든.
en: Oh, certainly. There was probably a man who shot well.
The rest is a story for keeping people in line.
To make a farmer kneel, a sun god is cheaper than a sword.

lines: 나는 들에서 자랐소. 들에서 들은 건 — 거짓이 아니오.
en: …So that is what your palace teaches.
I grew up in the marches. What the marches tell — is not a lie.

blocks.html: Neither man yields. The room keeps both versions: a bowman who founded a country — and a heaven that may or may not have sent him.
blocks.ko: 둘 다 양보하지 않는다. 방 안에는 두 버전이 남는다 — 나라를 연 활잡이, 그리고 그를 보냈을 수도 있고 아닐 수도 있는 하늘.

blocks.html: Yeon asks for the same thing he asked Chunchu for. He has only ever had one price.
blocks.ko: 연은 춘추에게 요구했던 것과 똑같은 것을 요구한다. 그의 값은 언제나 하나뿐이었다.

lines: 죽령 이북 땅은 본래 고구려의 것이었다. 돌려주면 구원병을 보내 주겠다.
en: The land north of the pass was Goguryeo’s. Return it, and I will send relief troops.

lines: 도대체 무슨 배짱으로 저 앞에 나선 건지…!
en: What nerve, to come before him like that…!

lines: 이보게, 나는 한 나라의 왕일세. 왕은 사람이 아니야.
죽을 자리까지 다 정해 두고 왔고, 바깥에도 미리 일러 두었네.
나를 죽여 봐야, 더 젊고 더 성난 백제왕이 하나 앉을 뿐이지.
en: Listen — I am the king of a country. A king is not a man.
I made my arrangements even for death, and gave warning abroad beforehand.
Kill me and all you get is a newer, angrier King of Baekje on the throne.
Not a man, you say…

lines: 신라에는 «노비는 사람 수에 넣지 않는다»는 말이 있다더군.
우습지 않소? 맨 아래도 사람이 아니고, 맨 위도 사람이 아니야.
사람인 것들은 전부 그 사이에 끼어 있고.
en: They have a saying in Silla — that slaves are not counted as people.
Funny, is it not? The bottom is not a person, and the top is not a person either.
Everyone who gets to be a person is wedged in between.

lines: 신라에는 바닷길이 없어. 당이든 천축이든 서역이든, 나가려면 이 항구 하나뿐이야.
en: Look at this map.
Silla has no trade route at all — for Tang, for Tianzhu, for the western regions, there is only this one harbour.
Danghangseong would be the right target.

blocks.caption: One harbour. Silla’s only door to the Tang.
blocks.ko: 항구 하나. 신라가 당으로 나가는 단 하나의 문.

en: We have our own mouth — the White River under Sabi.
Clan berths stacked like teeth. Cut Danghangseong and Silla starves for partners; keep our river and we eat either way.
lines: 우리에겐 우리 하구가 있다 — 사비 아래 백강.
가문 선석이 이빨처럼 겹쳐 있지. 당항성을 끊으면 신라는 짝이 굶고, 우리 강만 지키면 우리는 어느 쪽이든 먹는다.

en: You sound like a harbour clerk.
Good. Kings who forget docks start wars they cannot feed.
lines: 좋다. 부두를 잊는 임금은, 먹일 수 없는 전쟁을 시작한다.

blocks.html: Eighth month. Baekje also plotted with Goguryeo to take Danghangseong and cut off the road to Tang.
blocks.ko: 8월, 또 고구려와 꾀하여 당항성을 빼앗아 당으로 가는 길을 끊으려 하였다.
blocks.hanja: 八月，又與高句麗謀，欲取党項城，以絶歸唐之路。
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 5, Silla Annals — Queen Seondeok, yr. 11 (642)

blocks.html: In the sixteenth year Euija raised troops, attacked more than forty Silla cities and sent men to hold them. He made peace and friendship with Goguryeo, and plotted to take Danghangseong and cut off Silla's road to court.
blocks.ko: 16년, 의자가 군사를 일으켜 신라의 40여 성을 치고 또 군사를 보내 지키게 하였다. 고구려와 화친하여 우호를 맺고, 당항성을 빼앗아 신라가 조정에 들어오는 길을 끊으려 꾀하였다.
blocks.hanja: 十六年，義慈興兵伐新羅四十餘城，又發兵以守之，與高麗和親通好，謀欲取党項城以絕新羅入朝之路。
blocks.source: Jiu Tangshu (舊唐書) bk. 199上, Eastern Barbarians — Baekje, Zhenguan 16 (642)

en: Do you know a “Kim Chunchu” of Silla?
Kim Chunchu? First I have heard of him… royalty? Why?

lines: 그냥… 궁금해서. 자네를 그리 좋아하는 것 같지가 않더군.
자네를 없애 달라고, 두 손 모아 빌더구먼.
en: Just… curious. He does not seem to care for you much.
He spoke of being rid of you, hands folded in prayer.

lines: 춘추라… 누군지는 몰라도, 그렇게 쌓아 두는 자는 만만치 않지.
허나 남에게 무릎 꿇는 자는 두렵지 않소이다.
en: Chunchu… whoever he is, a man who stores things up like that is no easy sort.
But I do not fear a man who kneels to others.

blocks.html: For a moment Yeon’s eyes go somewhere else — to a door, to a hand, to a stare that did not ask to be liked.
blocks.ko: 잠깐, 연의 눈이 다른 곳으로 간다 — 문과, 손과, 호감을 바라지 않던 눈빛으로.

blocks.html: After the territory talk the room had gone quiet in the wrong way. Yeon had asked if the man had no pride. The answer had been worse than no.
blocks.ko: 영토 이야기가 끝난 뒤 방은 잘못된 방식으로 조용해졌다. 연이 자존심이 없느냐고 물었다. 대답은 없다는 것보다 나빴다.

en: I know no such thing as pride.
I know only my goal.

blocks.html: Then Chunchu had reached to his own belt, drawn a short blade, and driven it through his own left hand — clean, deliberate, eyes never leaving Yeon’s face — and held the wound up like a seal.
blocks.ko: 그때 춘추는 제 허리에서 짧은 칼을 빼어, 제 왼손을 스스로 찔렀다 — 말쑥하고 고의적으로, 눈은 한 번도 연의 얼굴에서 떼지 않은 채 — 그리고 그 상처를 도장처럼 들어 올렸다.

lines: 제가 저를 얼마까지 쓸 수 있는지, 이것입니다.
자존심을 묻지 마십시오. 무엇을 망가뜨릴 각오인지 물으십시오.
en: This is how much of myself I will spend.
Do not ask me for pride. Ask me what I am willing to ruin.

blocks.html: Yeon remembers the stare more than the blood. Hot, dry, almost joyful. The stare of a man who had decided the room would believe him, and had paid in advance.
blocks.ko: 연은 피보다 그 눈빛을 더 오래 기억한다. 뜨겁고, 건조하고, 거의 기쁘기까지 한. 방이 자기를 믿게 되리라 결정한 사람의 눈빛. 값을 먼저 치른 사람의 눈빛.

lines: 제 손을 제 칼로 뚫어서 내 귀를 열더군.
그런 눈을 한 사람을 하나 더 만났소.
en: That Chunchu…
He put steel through his own hand to make me listen.
I have met one other man with eyes like that.
Oh?

lines: 둘 중 누가 더 무서운지는 아직 모르겠소.
en: You.
I do not yet know which of you frightens me more.
Flattery. Keep going.
It was not flattery.

lines: 올 때는 셋이더니, 갈 때는 다섯이구려.
en: You came with three. You’re leaving with five.
…Did Your Majesty come as an envoy, or to do some shopping?
blocks.art: Dusk in the guest-house yard: Gesomun looks over Euija’s retinue, two more faces than came with him.

lines: 나는 사람을 모으는 재주가 있소. 공은 사람을 줄이는 재주가 있고.
en: I have a gift for gathering people. You have a gift for reducing them.
Your Majesty. Goryeo is cold.
Shall we… warm you?
With mouths. With thighs.
Even while you look at the map.
I am aware.
…Both of you, come.
Quietly.
Before Commander Yeon… hears.
So tonight two of us will come in.
One body isn’t enough… to hold Your Majesty.
From both sides… at once.
…Don’t flatter.
The body… is already answering.
It isn’t flattery.

lines: 어제 밤 폐하가… 어디에 두라고 하셨는지.
en: The hands… remember.
Where Your Majesty… told them to go last night.

blocks.html: In the morning he rides south with all five. Nobody raises the subject of the extra two. He carries a map of Danghangseong in his head, and Yeon’s warning about Chunchu folded away like a knife he intends to use later.
blocks.ko: 아침에 그는 다섯을 모두 거느리고 남으로 떠난다. 늘어난 둘에 대해서는 아무도 입을 열지 않는다. 머릿속에는 당항성 지도가 있고, 춘추를 조심하라던 개소문의 말은 나중에 쓸 칼처럼 접어 품에 넣어 두었다.

blocks.html: Why does the Eternal General flinch at one Silla name? Go back to a ditch, a white horse, and an unknown captain…!
blocks.ko: 영원의 대장군은 왜 신라의 이름 하나에 움찔하는가? 참호 하나, 흰 말 한 마리, 이름 없는 대장 하나에게로 거슬러 가 보자…!

Behind him the white war horse, still nameless, steaming. Background: Nangbi Fortress walls on a hill in smoke, melting into bokeh. Storm light with one hard break, #2A5FB8 on his blue cloth. Now: Hwarang years (stage portrait): BEARDLESS, Silla-blue headband with a gold crescent moon, its tails trailing. Demeanor: Confucian: he STANDS — never sits in lotus. Weighs, counts, frowns at sums; tight jaw, rare dry half-smile. Grief shows as stillness, not tears. Fighting: Orthodox FORWARD one-hand grip, ring at the heel of the fist; square upright stance, short economical straight cuts and thrusts — the drill-yard form he teaches. Pommel motif fish inside the small ring (name only; do not attach the pommel ECU). #3E8EF0 as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. | SWORD ANATOMY: Copy attached sw_bidam.png. The ONLY circle on the sword is the small hollow RING at the pommel. When the blade hangs down: RING is UP (heel of the fist, little-finger side) → short gold band → palm-length diamond GRIP (one fist, not two-handed) → thin gold BAND (a collar, never a round tsuba, never a second ring) → long steel BLADE down toward the ankle → point. Handle:blade = 1:3 locked (handle = one quarter of the whole; blade = three quarters). Hip scale: hilt at hip, tip near ankle — never taller than the person, never a polearm. NEVER put the ring between the hand and the steel. NEVER point a giant blade at the camera as a graphic. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only. HEEWON STYLE: a hand-painted ANIME film frame composed like a Romanticist master painting. FIGURES are anime: clean ink linework, simplified anime faces with expressive eyes, shaded in soft watercolor washes and translucent oil glazes instead of flat cel fill — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, not 3D. THE WORLD is watercolor and oil: skies, dust, ground and light are visibly hand-painted — wet-in-wet blooms, pigment granulation, soft bleeding edges, dry-brush dust, rich oil glazes in the darks, faint paper grain; edges of the frame dissolve into wash. LAYOUT is Romanticism (Delacroix, Géricault, Friedrich, Goya, Turner): heroic diagonal or pyramid composition, small figures against a sublime storm sky or vast field, extreme foreshortening (worm’s-eye from the dirt or straight down from above), one break in the clouds or one shaft as the key. LIGHT is movie tenebrism at full strength (Caravaggio, Rembrandt, night-interior cinema): an extreme value range — inky blacks right beside small near-white highlights, almost no middle grey; 70–80% of the frame in deep painted shadow (oil-glazed umber, indigo and black); ONE hard directional key (a lamp, a single cloud-break, a low sun shaft, firelight) carves the subject out of the dark. Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. 2D animated cel-painterly cinema, not photoreal, not live-action, not 3D CGI. Same film stock: anamorphic movie frame, shallow DOF, creamy bokeh, rack-focus, film grain. A CAMERA in a real Korean place — NEVER a graphic poster, split-screen collage, 3D archviz, black-triangle overlay, spotlight cone deleting the landscape, or neon outline. NO halo, bloom, glow aura, rim-aura, emissive skin, or god-ray envelope around people — character hex is REAL LIGHT in the dark (key bounce, specular on silk/armor/wet stone, a lamp, a shaft, a floor reflection), never a body halo. FACE AND GARMENTS from the attached portrait — NEVER copy the portrait stance, clasped hands, 3/4 fashion lineup, or a standing clone. Invent a new DRAMATIC body every still (mid-stride, kneel, dutch, worm’s-eye, lower-third). CINEMATOGRAPHY: dutch, crane, worm’s-eye, over-shoulder, rack focus, shallow DOF / bokeh, chiaroscuro. HIGH CONTRAST: crushed blacks + one hard key + long shadows — not even daylight wash. ICONIC MINIMAL: ONE architectural device a lens can see; empty negative space; tiny figures or lower-third; the world stays in the shot. COLOR SYMBOLISM: hex tints the hard key / catchlight / bounce — NEVER a glow aura, NEVER recolor portrait garments gold. RING-POMMEL SWORDS: one-handed hip 환두대도 from attached sw_bidam.png — handle:blade 1:3; order is RING (pommel at heel of fist) → short grip → thin gold collar → long blade → point. Never reverse handle and blade. Never a tsuba disc in the middle. Never taller than the person. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only — do not attach it on full-blade stills. images.prompt: HEEWON STYLE. Intimate close 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. Late night, the same timber room in the High Commander's house, Pyongyang. ECU, dutch tilt: Yeon Gesomun at twenty-four, black close beard, heavy brows, holding the long pale report strip up between his face and a guttering clay oil lamp, so the lamp burns THROUGH the paper and the illegible brush marks show as dark shadows across his face. ONE DEVICE: the backlit paper as a glowing vertical plane splitting the frame, half his face behind it in silhouette-shadow, one eye and the corner of his mouth sharp in front of it, lips just parted on a name. Light #d0362f red-amber through the paper; the rest umber black, a few embers of bokeh. Webtoon ink face, old-master oil glaze on the room and robe. Contained, cold, the first grudge. No readable writing. No text. No watermark. CANON — YEON GESOMUN — FACE and garments from attached /ch_yeon_gesomun.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Massive, broad-chested; black hair in a tight topknot tied with red cord; thick black beard trimmed close to the jaw, heavy brows, glaring eyes. Dress: Dark charcoal robe and trousers under red-edged armor, a red cape falling off the shoulders. Headwear: the jougwan (see HEADWEAR). Demeanor: Arrogant, theatrical, loud; looks down at people (worm's-eye suits him). Laughs while fighting. #d0362f as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: gold-plated armor; beardless face (except a flashback to youth). | HEADWEAR: JOUGWAN (조우관, feather cap) — copy the SHAPE from the attached hat boards and ignore their Korean labels, museum photos, paper-craft gems and dragon medallion: a small black lacquered gauze cap (변형모, a peaked or square-topped crown no bigger than the topknot it covers) set high on the crown of the head over a small knot of gathered hair (any loose hair the portrait shows still falls beneath it); a thin black band round the head with a small square opening at the front; black cords tied under the chin; two long barred pheasant tail feathers (tan with umber bars), or a spray of bird plumes, rising straight up or sweeping back from either side of the cap, much taller than the cap itself. It replaces any other hat or cap on the portrait; headbands and ribbons stay. Real lacquer and feathers lit by the scene key, never a glow. | COSTUME CHARTS (attached): cut, collar, sleeve, sash, trouser and skirt shapes of every Samhan figure follow the chart for their kingdom; it is a style chart, so ignore its labels, captions, maps, poses and faces. Named people keep their portrait face and colours; extras and soldiers dress like the chart (a commoner like its commoners, an official like its officials, a soldier like its soldiers). Goguryeo: attached /ref_hanbok_goguryeo.png. HEEWON STYLE: a Korean WEBTOON figure painted into a hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL world, in a SIMPLE, MINIMAL, ICONIC layout — the benchmark is a lone man in magenta silk walking down a storm-lit grass ridge toward his tied horse with an empty saddle: one diagonal, two subjects, half the frame storm sky, one cloud-break. FIGURES are webtoon / anime: clean digital-ink linework, simplified webtoon faces with expressive eyes, the face and hands keep that clean ink line, but the body and garments are PAINTED, never digitally shaded — broad loaded brushstrokes and dry-brush drag that follow each fold, the shading stepped in three or four painted value planes with soft broken edges, paper-and-canvas grain running right across the silk — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, never a smooth airbrushed gradient, never a 3D render (2.5D, see FORM). THE WORLD is WATERCOLOR FIRST, OIL SECOND: skies and ground in granulated wet-in-wet washes and short broken-colour dabs (Turner), dry-brush grass, dust and stone texture, soft bleeding edges, faint paper grain; the accent colour of the scene blooms into the wash near one frame edge and the frame edges dissolve into bare paper; oil only deepens the darks with rich umber-indigo glazes and adds a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. INTERIORS AND NIGHT SCENES are the webtoon figure painted into a European OLD-MASTER CANVAS — a Renaissance / Baroque TENEBRIST oil painting (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt): broken-colour brushwork, glazed umber-to-black darks, sfumato falloff, a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight, over faint watercolor blooms and paper grain; walls, timber, stone, drapery and tables pulled out of the darkness by the one lamp, window or shaft. The same oil-on-canvas texture covers EVERYTHING in the frame, the figures’ silk included — mottled plaster, gritty stone, brushed robes — so the webtoon figures sit INTO that painted space, lit by the same key and sharing its shadows, never pasted onto a flat backdrop. LAYOUT is MINIMAL AND ICONIC, staged like a Romanticist painting (Friedrich, Turner, Delacroix, Géricault): ONE device carries the frame (a ridge diagonal, a road, a waterline, a hall axis, a table ring, a gate) with ONE or TWO subjects placed on the thirds; at least half the frame is quiet negative space (storm sky, empty field, dark floor, bare wall); distant detail stays tiny and dissolving (a line of banners or roofs in haze); no crowds, no clutter, nothing competing with the subject. Heroic diagonal or pyramid, small figures against a sublime sky or vast field, or a bold worm’s-eye / straight-down angle. BLOCKING IS THE RELATIONSHIP: when two people share a frame, the still reads like a history painting with the faces covered — who stands higher and who kneels, the distance or contact between them, whose hand rests on whom, where each one looks (at each other, past each other, the same way), and how their cast shadows meet on the wall or floor; one gesture between them carries the whole bond. LIGHT is movie tenebrism at full strength: 70–85% of the frame sinks into deep painted shadow (oil-glazed umber, indigo, black), an extreme value range with near-white highlights right beside inky black and almost no middle grey; big dark masses (storm cloud, shadowed slope, umber room, black floor) against ONE bright break — a single cloud-break, low sun shaft, lamp or window — that lands on the subject; inky darks right beside small near-white highlights, few middle greys in the subject; ONE hard directional key carves the subject out of the dark. FORM IS 2.5D — drawn webtoon line on the outside, sculpted painted volume on the inside (the interior benchmark: a bearded emperor in yellow silk standing at a stone relief, under-lit by an oil lamp set on the floor beside the lens, palm on the carved horse, his shadow climbing the wall): the key is a PRACTICAL light IN or just outside the frame, CLOSE to the subject, RAKING ACROSS the surfaces the camera sees from below or from the side — never from behind them. So every silk fold protrudes, built the way an oil painter builds it: the lit side of each fold laid in with one opaque loaded stroke, the turn into shadow a crisp painted edge, the shadow side a thin transparent umber glaze with a little warm floor-light dragged into it, brush direction following the fold; gold thread and the brightest ridges flicked in with impasto; cheekbones, beard, knuckles, armor plates and horse muscle are painted the same way. The subject is large in frame (medium or closer, worm’s-eye or low three-quarter) so the folds resolve, and the light falls off into black across the body — that falloff is the darkness. Never a garment filled with one flat colour; never a subject backlit into a flat silhouette with only an edge line (if the camera is behind someone, the key still comes from the side and models their back and shoulder); never a wall flat to the lens — walls and floors recede at an angle so cast shadows can climb them. A thin edge of the same real light may graze the far side of the silhouette to lift it off the background (never a glow outline); long raking shadows. TEXTURE IS TACTILE RELIEF — the raking key exists to reveal it: thick oil impasto that stands up off the canvas on the lit side of every surface, loaded-brush and palette-knife ridges the eye can almost touch. Cloth: heavy silk in deep ridged folds, raised gold embroidery and brocade threads catching pin-point specular, quilted collars, layered sleeves with real thickness, beads and pins as small sculpted volumes. Buildings and ground just as sculpted: carved, weathered timber grain on pillars and brackets, every giwa roof tile and end-cap a rounded relief with its own shadow, rough-cut stone blocks, cracked lime plaster, lattice in deep relief throwing crisp little shadows, packed earth with grit and footprints. Never a smooth flat wall, never a plain colour-fill robe. Default hour is dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat overcast, never even daylight, never a bright open sky filling the frame. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. SEPARATION: subject and background never share a value — the lit subject sits in the one pool of light and everything behind it drops three or more steps to near-black (or, reversed, a dark figure against the single bright opening); foreground shapes almost black; the eye lands on the subject first. SHOT VARIETY AND NEGATIVE SPACE: across a set of stills alternate INTIMATE CLOSE-UPS (faces and hands filling the frame, the background a dark blur) with FAR WIDES (the figures small in a lower corner or third, 60% or more of the canvas left as quiet negative space — black hall, night sky, dark water, bare wall — that makes the small lit figures strike). RENAISSANCE CANVAS, CARTOON FIGURES: the world is composed and painted like a Renaissance / Baroque master (Leonardo’s sfumato, Titian’s glazes, Raphael’s pyramids, Caravaggio’s darkness), but every face stays a clean-lined webtoon / anime face — big expressive eyes, simple nose and mouth, smooth cel-like skin with one or two shadow tones — never photographic skin, pores or realistic facial anatomy. COLOR SYMBOLISM reads at a glance: each kingdom's colour lives in its banners and cloth (Silla blue, Baekje yellow, Goguryeo red, Tang vermilion and gold), each named person's hex in the key light on them, and the rest of the frame stays desaturated umber, slate and black so those few colours sing. FACES stay drawn: match the attached portrait's line weight, eye shape and simplification exactly — if a face starts to read as a photograph, flatten it back to ink line and wash; extras are drawn the same way, never photographic. HORSES are drawn to be admired: the whole body readable, arched neck, deep chest, round haunch, clean legs in a true gait, muscle modelled by the key with a bright edge along the topline. 2.5D painterly cinema — drawn webtoon faces, everything else brushed with visible strokes and canvas grain — not photoreal, not live-action, not a smooth digital airbrush or 3D render, not flat cel fill. Same film stock every still: a CAMERA in a real Korean place — anamorphic 2:1 movie frame, shallow DOF, creamy bokeh, rack-focus, film grain, crushed blacks, ONE hard key, long shadows, tenebrism. MOVIE FRAME of the scene a DP could stand in — NEVER a graphic poster, split-screen collage, 3D architectural visualization, black-triangle overlay, spotlight cone deleting the landscape, or neon outline. NO halo, bloom, glow aura, rim-aura, emissive skin, or god-ray envelope around people — character hex is the color of REAL LIGHT in the dark (key bounce, specular on silk/armor/wet stone, a lamp, a shaft, a floor reflection), never a body halo, never magic outline, never neon-painting the figure. FACE ONLY from the attached portrait — silk/hanbok may match; NEVER copy the portrait stance, clasped hands, 3/4 fashion lineup, or a standing clone. Invent a new DRAMATIC body every still (mid-stride, kneel, full-draw, turn, tumble, lean, count, dutch, worm’s-eye, lower-third). CINEMATOGRAPHY: name the shot — dutch angle, worm’s-eye, crane, over-shoulder, rack focus, shallow DOF / bokeh, chiaroscuro, mise-en-scène, long-shadow key. HIGH CONTRAST: crushed blacks + one hard key / long shadows / tenebrism — not even daylight wash, not a flat tourist postcard. ICONIC MINIMAL means one architectural device a lens can see (road, column, waterline, gate, hall axis) plus empty negative space — not deleting the world. COLOR SYMBOLISM: hex tints the hard key / catchlight / bounce — NEVER a glow aura, NEVER recolor the attached portrait’s garments (Sosuno stays dusty-rose hanbok, Geumwa stays red-burgundy court silk, not gold paint). FACE AND CLOTHES match the attached ch_*.png. One of each named person — NEVER clone or duplicate a character. People stand on packed earth at a well RIM — NEVER inside the well shaft. Jumong is fun-loving and laid-back: grin, laugh, wink, easy eyes — not a grim founder mask. BATTLE ARMOR: metallic GRAY steel lamellar (attached steel-armor ref); cloth peeks in the character hex — not gold-painted plate, not glowing armor, not a standing armor catalog. RING-POMMEL SWORDS: one-handed hip 환두대도 from attached sw_bidam.png — handle:blade 1:3; order is RING (pommel at heel of fist) → short grip → thin gold collar → long blade → point. Never reverse handle and blade. Never a tsuba disc in the middle. Never taller than the person. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only — do not attach it on full-blade stills. Ignore swords on face portraits. Two people = two garment-true figures against crushed black. Real Korean architecture or a locked dark room. No army. No readable text. No watermark. Copy: dynamic poses in a mythology-scale layout; dramatic poses in a mythology-scale one-device layout; one hard key / chiaroscuro; one gesture in empty space — iconic and simple. Never: white / pale studio void as a room; earth places stay real buildings, not color-plane furniture; no pasted portrait pose — new body every still; no floating logo — still must be a movie frame of the scene; unrealistic layout, reptitive; real bottle-shaped Cheomseongdae plus a story beat.
