HEEWON STYLE: a Korean WEBTOON figure painted into a hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL world, in a SIMPLE, MINIMAL, ICONIC layout — the benchmark is a lone man in magenta silk walking down a storm-lit grass ridge toward his tied horse with an empty saddle: one diagonal, two subjects, half the frame storm sky, one cloud-break. FIGURES are webtoon / anime: clean digital-ink linework, simplified webtoon faces with expressive eyes, the face and hands keep that clean ink line, but the body and garments are PAINTED, never digitally shaded — broad loaded brushstrokes and dry-brush drag that follow each fold, the shading stepped in three or four painted value planes with soft broken edges, paper-and-canvas grain running right across the silk — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, never a smooth airbrushed gradient, never a 3D render (2.5D, see FORM). THE WORLD is WATERCOLOR FIRST, OIL SECOND: skies and ground in granulated wet-in-wet washes and short broken-colour dabs (Turner), dry-brush grass, dust and stone texture, soft bleeding edges, faint paper grain; the accent colour of the scene blooms into the wash near one frame edge and the frame edges dissolve into bare paper; oil only deepens the darks with rich umber-indigo glazes and adds a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. INTERIORS AND NIGHT SCENES are the webtoon figure painted into a European OLD-MASTER CANVAS — a Renaissance / Baroque TENEBRIST oil painting (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt): broken-colour brushwork, glazed umber-to-black darks, sfumato falloff, a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight, over faint watercolor blooms and paper grain; walls, timber, stone, drapery and tables pulled out of the darkness by the one lamp, window or shaft. The same oil-on-canvas texture covers EVERYTHING in the frame, the figures’ silk included — mottled plaster, gritty stone, brushed robes — so the webtoon figures sit INTO that painted space, lit by the same key and sharing its shadows, never pasted onto a flat backdrop. LAYOUT is MINIMAL AND ICONIC, staged like a Romanticist painting (Friedrich, Turner, Delacroix, Géricault): ONE device carries the frame (a ridge diagonal, a road, a waterline, a hall axis, a table ring, a gate) with ONE or TWO subjects placed on the thirds; at least half the frame is quiet negative space (storm sky, empty field, dark floor, bare wall); distant detail stays tiny and dissolving (a line of banners or roofs in haze); no crowds, no clutter, nothing competing with the subject. Heroic diagonal or pyramid, small figures against a sublime sky or vast field, or a bold worm’s-eye / straight-down angle. BLOCKING IS THE RELATIONSHIP: when two people share a frame, the still reads like a history painting with the faces covered — who stands higher and who kneels, the distance or contact between them, whose hand rests on whom, where each one looks (at each other, past each other, the same way), and how their cast shadows meet on the wall or floor; one gesture between them carries the whole bond. LIGHT is movie tenebrism at full strength: 70–85% of the frame sinks into deep painted shadow (oil-glazed umber, indigo, black), an extreme value range with near-white highlights right beside inky black and almost no middle grey; big dark masses (storm cloud, shadowed slope, umber room, black floor) against ONE bright break — a single cloud-break, low sun shaft, lamp or window — that lands on the subject; inky darks right beside small near-white highlights, few middle greys in the subject; ONE hard directional key carves the subject out of the dark. FORM IS 2.5D — drawn webtoon line on the outside, sculpted painted volume on the inside (the interior benchmark: a bearded emperor in yellow silk standing at a stone relief, under-lit by an oil lamp set on the floor beside the lens, palm on the carved horse, his shadow climbing the wall): the key is a PRACTICAL light IN or just outside the frame, CLOSE to the subject, RAKING ACROSS the surfaces the camera sees from below or from the side — never from behind them. So every silk fold protrudes, built the way an oil painter builds it: the lit side of each fold laid in with one opaque loaded stroke, the turn into shadow a crisp painted edge, the shadow side a thin transparent umber glaze with a little warm floor-light dragged into it, brush direction following the fold; gold thread and the brightest ridges flicked in with impasto; cheekbones, beard, knuckles, armor plates and horse muscle are painted the same way. The subject is large in frame (medium or closer, worm’s-eye or low three-quarter) so the folds resolve, and the light falls off into black across the body — that falloff is the darkness. Never a garment filled with one flat colour; never a subject backlit into a flat silhouette with only an edge line (if the camera is behind someone, the key still comes from the side and models their back and shoulder); never a wall flat to the lens — walls and floors recede at an angle so cast shadows can climb them. A thin edge of the same real light may graze the far side of the silhouette to lift it off the background (never a glow outline); long raking shadows. TEXTURE IS TACTILE RELIEF — the raking key exists to reveal it: thick oil impasto that stands up off the canvas on the lit side of every surface, loaded-brush and palette-knife ridges the eye can almost touch. Cloth: heavy silk in deep ridged folds, raised gold embroidery and brocade threads catching pin-point specular, quilted collars, layered sleeves with real thickness, beads and pins as small sculpted volumes. Buildings and ground just as sculpted: carved, weathered timber grain on pillars and brackets, every giwa roof tile and end-cap a rounded relief with its own shadow, rough-cut stone blocks, cracked lime plaster, lattice in deep relief throwing crisp little shadows, packed earth with grit and footprints. Never a smooth flat wall, never a plain colour-fill robe. Default hour is dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat overcast, never even daylight, never a bright open sky filling the frame. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. SEPARATION: subject and background never share a value — the lit subject sits in the one pool of light and everything behind it drops three or more steps to near-black (or, reversed, a dark figure against the single bright opening); foreground shapes almost black; the eye lands on the subject first. SHOT VARIETY AND NEGATIVE SPACE: across a set of stills alternate INTIMATE CLOSE-UPS (faces and hands filling the frame, the background a dark blur) with FAR WIDES (the figures small in a lower corner or third, 60% or more of the canvas left as quiet negative space — black hall, night sky, dark water, bare wall — that makes the small lit figures strike). RENAISSANCE CANVAS, CARTOON FIGURES: the world is composed and painted like a Renaissance / Baroque master (Leonardo’s sfumato, Titian’s glazes, Raphael’s pyramids, Caravaggio’s darkness), but every face stays a clean-lined webtoon / anime face — big expressive eyes, simple nose and mouth, smooth cel-like skin with one or two shadow tones — never photographic skin, pores or realistic facial anatomy. COLOR SYMBOLISM reads at a glance: each kingdom's colour lives in its banners and cloth (Silla blue, Baekje yellow, Goguryeo red, Tang vermilion and gold), each named person's hex in the key light on them, and the rest of the frame stays desaturated umber, slate and black so those few colours sing. FACES stay drawn: match the attached portrait's line weight, eye shape and simplification exactly — if a face starts to read as a photograph, flatten it back to ink line and wash; extras are drawn the same way, never photographic. HORSES are drawn to be admired: the whole body readable, arched neck, deep chest, round haunch, clean legs in a true gait, muscle modelled by the key with a bright edge along the topline. 2.5D painterly cinema — drawn webtoon faces, everything else brushed with visible strokes and canvas grain — not photoreal, not live-action, not a smooth digital airbrush or 3D render, not flat cel fill. Same film stock every still: a CAMERA in a real Korean place — anamorphic 2:1 movie frame, shallow DOF, creamy bokeh, rack-focus, film grain, crushed blacks, ONE hard key, long shadows, tenebrism. MOVIE FRAME of the scene a DP could stand in — NEVER a graphic poster, split-screen collage, 3D architectural visualization, black-triangle overlay, spotlight cone deleting the landscape, or neon outline. NO halo, bloom, glow aura, rim-aura, emissive skin, or god-ray envelope around people — character hex is the color of REAL LIGHT in the dark (key bounce, specular on silk/armor/wet stone, a lamp, a shaft, a floor reflection), never a body halo, never magic outline, never neon-painting the figure. FACE ONLY from the attached portrait — silk/hanbok may match; NEVER copy the portrait stance, clasped hands, 3/4 fashion lineup, or a standing clone. Invent a new DRAMATIC body every still (mid-stride, kneel, full-draw, turn, tumble, lean, count, dutch, worm’s-eye, lower-third). CINEMATOGRAPHY: name the shot — dutch angle, worm’s-eye, crane, over-shoulder, rack focus, shallow DOF / bokeh, chiaroscuro, mise-en-scène, long-shadow key. HIGH CONTRAST: crushed blacks + one hard key / long shadows / tenebrism — not even daylight wash, not a flat tourist postcard. ICONIC MINIMAL means one architectural device a lens can see (road, column, waterline, gate, hall axis) plus empty negative space — not deleting the world. COLOR SYMBOLISM: hex tints the hard key / catchlight / bounce — NEVER a glow aura, NEVER recolor the attached portrait’s garments (Sosuno stays dusty-rose hanbok, Geumwa stays red-burgundy court silk, not gold paint). FACE AND CLOTHES match the attached ch_*.png. One of each named person — NEVER clone or duplicate a character. People stand on packed earth at a well RIM — NEVER inside the well shaft. Jumong is fun-loving and laid-back: grin, laugh, wink, easy eyes — not a grim founder mask. BATTLE ARMOR: metallic GRAY steel lamellar (attached steel-armor ref); cloth peeks in the character hex — not gold-painted plate, not glowing armor, not a standing armor catalog. RING-POMMEL SWORDS: one-handed hip 환두대도 from attached sw_bidam.png — handle:blade 1:3; order is RING (pommel at heel of fist) → short grip → thin gold collar → long blade → point. Never reverse handle and blade. Never a tsuba disc in the middle. Never taller than the person. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only — do not attach it on full-blade stills. Ignore swords on face portraits. Two people = two garment-true figures against crushed black. Real Korean architecture or a locked dark room. No army. No readable text. No watermark. Copy: dynamic poses in a mythology-scale layout; dramatic poses in a mythology-scale one-device layout; one hard key / chiaroscuro; one gesture in empty space — iconic and simple. Never: white / pale studio void as a room; earth places stay real buildings, not color-plane furniture; no pasted portrait pose — new body every still; no floating logo — still must be a movie frame of the scene; unrealistic layout, reptitive; real bottle-shaped Cheomseongdae plus a story beat.

blocks.label: DAY 10
blocks.ko: 열째 날

blocks.html: Before the gate opens Bidam goes down to the lines and saddles Bisamun himself, which a High Councillor does not do. He slips nine beads off the end of his string and knots them to the bridle, under the horse’s jaw.
blocks.ko: 성문이 열리기 전 비담은 진영으로 내려가 비사문에 손수 안장을 얹는다. 상대등이 할 일은 아니다. 염주 끝에서 아홉 알을 빼내, 말 턱 아래 굴레에 매듭지어 묶는다.

en: Sangdaedeung, those are…

lines: 부리는 짐승은 죽이지 마라. 말, 소, 닭, 개.
……저쪽은 그저께 흰 말을 태웠지. 내가 지더라도 이 녀석은 누가 붙잡고 있어야 해.
en: Master Wongwang’s fifth precept. Be choosy about killing.
Never the animals that work for you. Horse, ox, chicken, dog.
…They burned a white horse over there the other day. Even if I lose, somebody should still be holding on to this one.

blocks.html: Bisamun is named for the guardian king who stands at the north of every temple with a pagoda in his hand. Bidam rubs the horse’s nose once and speaks to it in the voice he keeps for sutras.
blocks.ko: 비사문은 탑을 손에 들고 모든 절의 북쪽에 서 있는 천왕에게서 따온 이름이다. 비담은 말의 코를 한 번 쓰다듬고, 경을 욀 때의 목소리로 말한다.

en: You’re named for the one who guards the north.
Today just watch the west.

blocks.html: All conditioned things are like a dream, an illusion, a bubble, a shadow; like dew, and like lightning. So should you see them.
blocks.ko: 모든 유위법은 꿈과 같고 환상과 같고 물거품과 같고 그림자와 같으며, 이슬과 같고 번개와 같으니, 마땅히 이와 같이 볼지니라.
blocks.hanja: 一切有為法，如夢、幻、泡、影，如露亦如電，應作如是觀。
blocks.source: Diamond Sutra (金剛般若波羅蜜經) §32, tr. Kumārajīva · T08n0235, p. 752b · Sanskrit: Vajracchedikā §32 (Conze ed.)
blocks.native: तारका तिमिरं दीपो मायावश्याय बुद्बुदम् । सुपिनं विद्युदभ्रं च एवं द्रष्टव्यं संस्कृतम् ॥
blocks.nativeLatn: tārakā timiraṃ dīpo māyāvaśyāya budbudam | supinaṃ vidyud abhraṃ ca evaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ saṃskṛtam ||

blocks.html: They meet again between the camps — not as High Councillor and marshal, but as the yard’s two best. Dragon pommel against heavenly horse. The first exchanges are almost gentle. That is how Hwarang kill each other.
blocks.ko: 다시 진영 사이에서 만난다 — 상대등과 대장군이 아니라, 연무장의 두 최고로. 용 자루 머리와 천마. 처음 몇 수는 거의 다정하다. 화랑은 그렇게 서로를 죽인다.

blocks.html: Yushin wins the way a man wins when he would rather lose — late, ugly, through a guard he taught Bidam twenty years ago. The heavenly-horse blade drops. Blood finds the mud that used to be a scoreboard.
blocks.ko: 유신은 차라리 지고 싶은 사람이 이기듯 이긴다 — 늦게, 흉하게, 이십 년 전 비담에게 가르친 가드를 뚫고. 천마 칼이 떨어진다. 피가, 한때 점수판이던 진흙을 찾는다.

en: …One hundred and nine.
Finally.

blocks.html: Bidam smiles with blood in his teeth — the same boy who once offered a headband across a desk.
blocks.ko: 비담은 피에 젖은 이로 웃는다 — 한때 책상 너머로 머리띠를 건네던 그 아이.

en: Hwarang Kim Yushin…

blocks.html: Yushin does not move to finish it, and there is nothing left to finish. For as long as the breath lasts the two of them look at each other the way they used to across the yard, back when the score was even and neither one wanted to go home.
blocks.ko: 유신은 끝을 내려 움직이지 않고, 끝낼 것도 남아 있지 않다. 숨이 붙어 있는 동안 둘은 서로를 본다 — 점수가 비겼고 둘 다 집에 가기 싫던 시절, 연무장 건너로 보던 그 눈으로.

blocks.html: The body finishes falling after the name does.
blocks.ko: 몸은 이름보다 늦게 쓰러진다.

blocks.html: Kangrim reads his name three times where the body has not yet finished falling — Bidam. Bidam. Bidam. — the ledger catching up to the last word.
blocks.ko: 강림은 몸이 아직 완전히 쓰러지기 전 그의 이름을 세 번 부른다 — 비담. 비담. 비담. — 마지막 말에 명부가 따라잡도록.

blocks.html: Bisamun comes through the lines without a rider, at a walk, and stops over him. Nine beads swing under its jaw. When a Silla groom reaches for the bridle it lays its ears flat and shows him its teeth, and the groom, who has had a long ten days, steps back.
blocks.ko: 비사문이 주인 없이, 걸어서 대열을 지나와 그의 곁에 멈춰 선다. 턱 아래 아홉 알이 흔들린다. 신라 마부가 굴레에 손을 뻗자 말은 귀를 납작 젖히고 이를 드러내고, 열흘이 길었던 마부는 물러선다.

en: Leave it.
…Let it go. North.

blocks.html: Nobody asks him why north. The horse stands there until the body is taken, then turns and goes, past the Radiance wall and up the valley road, and afterwards the officers on the rampart cannot agree whether anyone opened the gate for it.
blocks.ko: 왜 북쪽이냐고 묻는 사람은 없다. 말은 시신이 옮겨질 때까지 서 있다가, 돌아서서 명활성 성벽을 지나 골짜기 길로 올라간다. 나중에 성벽 위의 장교들은 누가 그 말에게 문을 열어 주었는지를 두고 끝내 의견이 갈린다.

blocks.html: Yushin does not kneel. Mud still wet, he turns to the Hwarang behind him and names a house. Bidam’s own line. The one he carried in his jaw and never once claimed aloud.
blocks.ko: 유신은 무릎 꿇지 않는다. 진흙이 마르기도 전에 그는 뒤따른 화랑들을 돌아보고 한 집안의 이름을 댄다. 비담의 핏줄. 비담이 턱 안에 물고 다니면서도 한 번도 입 밖에 내지 않은 그 핏줄.

lines: 손씨 — 무산 일대, 구르마의 후예 전부.
en: Erase Bidam’s house.
The Son line — all Musan, all Gurema’s descendants.
Treason’s blood must be cut.

lines: 비담은 죽었다. 열흘 동안 차를 따르고, 칼을 맞았다.
그의 대청까지 태우면 — 우리가 지키려던 육촌 중 하나를 스스로 지운다.
en: Yushin…
Bidam is dead. He poured tea for ten days, then took the blade.
If you burn his hall — we erase one of the Six Elders with our own hands.

blocks.html: Yushin leans close — close enough that the officers hear only breath, and Alchun hears the sentence.
blocks.ko: 유신이 몸을 기울인다 — 장교들에게는 숨소리만 들릴 만큼, 알천에게는 문장이 들릴 만큼.

en: Blood is inevitable…

blocks.html: Alchun goes pale. Down the line an officer asks for the order to be repeated. Nobody repeats it. Yushin mounts, and the order stands.
blocks.ko: 알천의 얼굴이 창백해진다. 대열 저쪽에서 한 장교가 명령을 다시 내려 달라 청한다. 아무도 되풀이하지 않는다. 유신이 말에 오르고, 명령은 선다.

blocks.html: Then he urged on his generals and men to strike hard, and Bidam and the rest broke and fled. They were pursued and beheaded, and their kin to the ninth degree were wiped out.
blocks.ko: 이에 여러 장수와 군사를 독려하여 힘껏 치니, 비담 등이 패하여 달아났다. 뒤쫓아 베고, 그 구족을 멸하였다.
blocks.hanja: 於是，督諸將卒奮擊之，毗曇等敗走。追斬之，夷九族。
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 41, Biographies — Kim Yushin (Bidam’s rebellion, 647)

lines: 명부가 여기까지요. 함께 가십시다 — 폐하의 나라는 서라벌보다 회의록을 잘 남깁니다.
en: High Councillor.
Your list ends here. Walk with me — His Majesty’s kingdom keeps better minutes than Surabol.
High Councillor — before the minutes close.
The opposite kite. What do you want written?
…Write that I flew it.
The rest they can guess.
Tell the sacred country I loved it badly.

blocks.html: Bidam falls the way a Hwarang falls — eyes open, form unbroken. The kite burns out over the wall. Somewhere behind Yushin the queen is already slipping away.
blocks.ko: 비담은 화랑이 쓰러지듯 쓰러진다 — 눈 뜨고, 형 깨지지 않은 채. 연은 성 위에서 사그라든다. 유신 뒤에서 여왕은 이미 떠나가고 있다.

blocks.html: Rain finds the lattice before the physicians do. It is a small rain. It beads on the marshal’s sleeve and on the queen’s mouth, and neither of them has a hand free for it.
blocks.ko: 의원보다 비가 먼저 창살에 닿는다. 작은 비다. 원수의 소매에, 여왕의 입술에 맺힌다. 둘 다 그 비를 닦을 손이 없다.

en: Your Majesty.
General.
The physicians are in the corridor.
I told them the rain can wait.

lines: 작은 비야. 나를 데려갈 비는 아니네.
en: Leave them.
It is a small rain. It will not be what takes me.
Your Majesty—
The year I took the crown. You remember.
You said you would serve me to the end.
“I will serve you to the end.”
Yes.
And here we are.
Did I not promise to stay to the last moment.
You did. General.

lines: 네가 연무장에서 셈을 놓치던 때, 나는 공주였어.
en: …Princess.
Say it the old way.
When you lost the count on the yard, I was a princess.
Hwarang. That is what I was.
A hwarang who lost one count.
You do not lose counts.
I lost one.
Which one, I will not say.
Then stop being a general about it.
Dukman.
…Don’t.
Since the vote I have been Majesty.
Say the name I had before the room.
Dukman.
Yushin.
I am here.
I know.
Stay.
I can do a little rain.

blocks.html: The rain keeps on, small, on the lattice and on his sleeve. Her hand stays in his until it does not. The escort waits until the marshal’s hands have finished their work.
blocks.ko: 비는 그대로다. 창살에, 그의 소매에, 작게. 그녀의 손은 그의 손 안에 있다가, 어느 순간 아니게 된다. 호위는 원수의 손이 일을 마칠 때까지 기다린다.

blocks.html: Kangrim reads her name three times — Dukman. Dukman. Dukman. — the ledger’s habit before a Sacred Bone line closes.
blocks.ko: 강림은 그녀의 이름을 세 번 부른다 — 덕만. 덕만. 덕만. — 성골의 혈통이 닫히기 전 명부의 버릇대로.
blocks.art: One panel: the ledger closing in Kangrim’s hands, rain on the lattice behind.

blocks.html: The ministers did not know where that was, and asked, “Where?” The queen said, “South of Mount Nang.” On that very month and day the queen did die, and the ministers buried her on the sunny slope of Mount Nang.
blocks.ko: 신하들이 그곳이 어디인지 몰라 “어디입니까?” 하고 아뢰니, 왕이 “낭산 남쪽이다.” 하였다. 그 달 그 날에 이르러 왕이 과연 세상을 떠나니, 신하들이 낭산 남쪽 기슭에 장사 지냈다.
blocks.hanja: 群臣罔知其處，奏云：「何所？」王曰：「狼山南也。」至其月日王果崩，群臣葬於狼山之陽。
blocks.source: Samguk Yusa (三國遺事) bk. 1, Wonders 1 — Queen Seondeok knows three things in advance (善德王知幾三事)

blocks.html: That night Yushin remembers the first day of the rebellion, and it is not the way he has been telling it.
blocks.ko: 그날 밤 유신은 반란의 첫날을 기억한다. 그것은 그가 말해 온 방식이 아니다.

lines: 내 이름은 김유신! 신라의 대장군이 될 거요!!
en: It’s all right. I will overcome it myself.
My name is Kim Yushin! I will be the great general of Silla!!
Oh — and your name, hyung?
My name? Bidam.
That kid…. he’ll be someone great.

blocks.html: That night Yushin walks out alone to the pavilion between the old camp lines. The low table is still there, and on it the cup he never touched. He sits down across from no one.
blocks.ko: 그날 밤 유신은 혼자 옛 진영 사이의 정자로 걸어 나간다. 낮은 상은 그대로 있고, 그 위에 그가 끝내 손대지 않은 잔이 있다. 그는 아무도 없는 맞은편을 두고 앉는다.

en: You Gaya wretch…!

blocks.html: The one hand that said no is gone. Now the crown has to fit Seungman, and it was made for someone else…!

Censer smoke as ink wash in the near foreground. FIGURES are webtoon / anime: clean digital-ink linework, simplified webtoon faces with expressive eyes, shaded in soft watercolor washes and translucent oil glazes instead of flat cel fill — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, not 3D. INTERIORS are a Renaissance / Baroque TENEBRIST room (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt) painted in that same wash-and-glaze: a warm umber-to-black ground, walls, timber, drapery and tables pulled out of the darkness by the one lamp, window or shaft with soft sfumato falloff — the webtoon figures are set INTO that painted space, lit by the same key and sharing its shadows, never pasted onto a flat backdrop. blocks.html: The crown was made for her cousin and has to be padded at the temples. Seungman sits very still while the goldsmith does it, because somebody told her once that Dukman never fidgeted, and she has believed it for forty years.
blocks.ko: 왕관은 사촌 언니에게 맞춰 만든 것이라 관자놀이에 솜을 대야 한다. 금장이 그 일을 하는 동안 승만은 꼼짝 않고 앉아 있다. 덕만은 한 번도 몸을 비튼 적이 없다고 누가 말해 준 적이 있고, 그녀는 마흔 해 동안 그 말을 믿어 왔다.

blocks.html: Seungman is crowned Queen Jinduk before the blood on the yard dries. The bloodline’s last polite miracle, stamped and filed while the censers are still warm. The succession Bidam died objecting to passes at last. Unanimously.
blocks.ko: 마당의 피가 마르기도 전에 승만이 진덕여왕으로 즉위한다. 그 핏줄의 마지막 점잖은 기적, 향로가 식기도 전에 도장 찍혀 철해진다. 비담이 반대하다 죽은 계승이 마침내 통과된다. 만장일치로.

blocks.html: Taizong* of Tang sent an envoy bearing his tally to confer on the late queen the posthumous rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and to invest the new queen as Pillar of State and King of Lelang Commandery.
blocks.ko: 당 태종*이 사신에게 부절을 주어 보내, 앞 임금에게 광록대부를 추증하고, 이어 왕을 책봉하여 주국으로 삼고 낙랑군왕에 봉하였다.
blocks.hanja: 唐太宗遣使持節，追贈前王爲光祿大夫。仍冊命王爲柱國封樂浪郡王。
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 5, Silla Annals — Queen Jindeok, yr. 1 (647), 2nd month

notes.html: Taizong is the temple name Tang gave him after death. In this book he is the Second Emperor.
notes.ko: 태종은 죽은 뒤 받은 묘호다. 이 책에서는 ‘두 번째 황제’다.

blocks.html: In the twenty-first year, Sunduk died. She was posthumously made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, her other offices and fiefs left as they were. Her younger sister Jinduk was then set up as king, given the added title Pillar of State, and enfeoffed as King of Lelang Commandery.
blocks.ko: 정관 21년, 선덕이 죽으니 광록대부를 추증하고 나머지 관작과 봉호는 모두 예전대로 두었다. 이어 그 누이 진덕을 왕으로 세우고, 주국을 더하여 낙랑군왕에 봉하였다.
blocks.hanja: 二十一年，善德卒，贈光祿大夫，余官封並如故。因立其妹真德爲王，加授柱國，封樂浪郡王。
blocks.source: Jiu Tangshu (舊唐書) bk. 199上, Eastern Barbarians — Silla, Zhenguan 21 (647)

blocks.html: Alchun is not at the coronation. The court writes his absence down as illness. Everyone understands the illness’s true name: Day 1 through Day 10, unanswered.
blocks.ko: 알천은 즉위식에 없다. 궁은 그의 부재를 병으로 적는다. 모두가 병의 진짜 이름을 안다 — 첫째 날부터 열째 날까지, 답하지 않음.

blocks.html: The court does not mean to compare. It simply cannot stop. The old Queen read the peony seeds before they were planted. She heard frogs at Jade Gate Pond in midwinter and sent two thousand men to the exact valley where five hundred Baekje soldiers were hiding. She named the day of her own death and was right about it. The new Queen is gentle, and good at a loom, and has never once predicted anything.
blocks.ko: 조정은 견주려는 게 아니다. 그냥 멈출 수가 없다. 선왕은 모란씨를 심기도 전에 읽어 냈다. 한겨울 옥문지에서 개구리 우는 소리를 듣고 이천 군사를 꼭 그 골짜기로 보내 숨어 있던 백제군 오백을 잡았다. 제가 죽을 날을 짚었고, 그 날이 맞았다. 새 여왕은 온화하고, 베틀을 잘 다루고, 무엇 하나 예언한 적이 없다.

lines: 선왕마마셨으면 비 올 줄 아셨을 텐데.
en: The old Queen would have known it was going to rain.
Shh.
…She would have, though.
Yushin… preserve the sacred country…
Bidam…

lines: 유신… 설마 비담의 말이 마음에 걸리느냐…?
en: Yushin… surely Bidam’s words are not weighing on you…?
No — what could there be to weigh on me.
I am a loyal servant of the sacred country.

lines: 언니는 개구리보다 먼저 개구리를 알았네. 나는 비 올 날도 모르는데.
en: Chunchu.
Unni knew about the frogs before the frogs did. I can’t even tell when it’s going to rain.

lines: 전하, 누구도 달더러 해가 되라 하지 않습니다.
사람들이 달을 사랑하는 건 똑바로 쳐다보게 해 주기 때문이지요.
en: Majesty, nobody asks the moon to be the sun.
They love it because it lets them look straight at it.
…You had that ready.
Since the funeral, Majesty.

blocks.html: At night she sits at a loom, because her hands want work that nobody will compare. Three years from now she will weave an ode to the Tang emperor into a length of silk, and it will do more for Silla than any prophecy her cousin made. Nobody at court thinks to compare that.
blocks.ko: 밤이면 그녀는 베틀 앞에 앉는다. 누구도 견주지 않을 일을 손이 원해서다. 세 해 뒤 그녀는 당 황제에게 바치는 송시를 비단 한 필에 짜 넣을 것이고, 그것이 사촌 언니의 어떤 예언보다 신라에 더 큰 일을 해낼 것이다. 조정의 누구도 그것은 견주어 볼 생각을 하지 않는다.

blocks.html: Silla needs an army. Only one man alive can lend it. Chunchu goes west…!
blocks.ko: 신라에는 군대가 필요하다. 그것을 빌려줄 사람은 세상에 단 하나. 춘추가 서쪽으로 간다…!

images.alt: The doors close behind them: the emperor, a black silhouette against the last slit of gold light, steers Chunchu by the elbow into the endless dark of the horse gallery
images.prompt: 2:1 drama night shot, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop. THE GALLERY: a long dark corridor behind the palace hall, deep red plaster walls, one continuous band of long stone low-relief horse panels in carved frames at head height, dark polished stone floor. Camera LOW on the floor deep in the dark, looking back toward the entrance. ONE device: the great doors are swinging shut behind the two men — a last narrowing vertical slit of gold light between them, the only bright shape in the frame. Against it, THE SECOND EMPEROR is a vast black silhouette, broad shoulders and the wide robe spreading into the dark, taller than the doorway's light, one hand steering CHUNCHU by the elbow, the other holding a single bronze lamp low at his side that lights his beard and jaw from below and throws his shadow forward along the floor and up the wall over the stone horses, enormous. Chunchu smaller, lower, half-swallowed by that shadow, glancing up at him. The relief horses ghost out of the dark along the wall. No writing. CANON — THE SECOND EMPEROR — FACE and garments from attached /ch_taizong.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Bearded Tang emperor: black futou cap with an upright pin, thick black beard and moustache, fierce scowl; one hand flung out commanding. Dress: Imperial yellow robe-cape over black brocade. Demeanor: Commands; never asks. Conqueror's contempt that curdles at Ansi. Presence: THE SON OF HEAVEN — every frame he is in bends around him. He is SHROUDED IN DARKNESS: the black of the hall gathers around him like a mantle, most of his body sinks into shadow, and the one hard key finds only the edge of his black futou, a cheekbone, the beard, the eyes and the gold thread of the yellow robe; often half or more of his face is lost in black. The camera sits BELOW his eyeline (low angle or worm’s-eye) and he is always placed HIGHER than anyone near him — on the dais, on a step, standing while others kneel or sit. He reads larger than life through lens and staging, not as a giant: broad shoulders, the robe spreading wide and heavy into the dark like a mountain, his shadow enormous on walls and floor. Unhurried, heavy stillness — never fidgeting, never casual, never a colleague at someone’s shoulder; when he smiles or laughs it is a predator’s ease, and the room goes quiet around it. Everyone else in frame is smaller, lower, less lit, turned toward him. The aura is darkness, scale and the hush around him — never a glow, never a halo, never rays behind his head. #c97a2e as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: Korean ring-pommel sword; Korean lamellar. | KIM CHUNCHU — FACE and garments from attached /ch_chunchu.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Slim and elegant; shoulder-length loose black hair parted in the middle; thin moustache and goatee stubble; amused eyes, small knowing smile. Dress: Magenta-crimson silk po with a charcoal sash, dark layered collar. Silk even on campaign.
