blocks.label: Nightmares
blocks.ko: 악몽

blocks.html: He starts dreaming about the Rock of Politics. In the dream it is dry, and he is rubbing it with brine, and the brine will not stay. Every time he lifts the cloth the stone is dry again, and the eight elders are standing round it waiting for it to sweat.
blocks.ko: 그는 정사암 꿈을 꾸기 시작한다. 꿈속에서 바위는 말라 있고, 그는 소금물을 문지르는데 소금물이 배지 않는다. 천을 들 때마다 돌은 다시 말라 있고, 여덟 원로가 그 둘레에 서서 바위가 땀 흘리기를 기다린다.

blocks.html: Some nights it is the white deer, come back out of the dark it was kept in, and too big for the hunting ground. Some nights it is a boat on the water with a man sitting very straight in the stern, not rowing, counting.
blocks.ko: 어떤 밤은 흰 사슴이다. 가둬 두었던 어둠에서 다시 나왔는데, 사냥터에 들기엔 너무 크다. 어떤 밤은 물 위의 배 한 척이고, 고물에 한 사내가 아주 꼿꼿이 앉아 있다. 노는 젓지 않고, 센다.

lines: (잠에서 깨어, 어둠에 대고) 누가 세고 있느냐?
…거기 누구냐. 불. 누가 불 좀 가져와라!
en: (waking, to the dark) Who’s counting?
…Who’s there. Light. Somebody bring a light!
Majesty. It’s only us.
…You were saying numbers again.

lines: 아니. 물 타지 마라. 물 타면 다 안다.
en: Wine.
No. Don’t water it. I can tell when you water it.

blocks.html: Euija becomes increasingly paranoid about the aftershock of his purge. He beat eight houses in a single morning, and now he lives inside the winner’s arithmetic: eight grudges, forty-one sons, and not one loyalty left that he did not create by decree.
blocks.ko: 의자는 숙청의 여진을 두려워하며 점점 의심이 깊어진다. 하루아침에 여덟 가문을 꺾은 그는, 이제 승자의 셈법 속에 산다. 원한 여덟, 아들 마흔하나, 그리고 칙령으로 만들어 내지 않은 충성은 단 하나도 남지 않았다.

blocks.html: Among the first sent away, by decree this time, is Heungsu. He had the bad manners to say the purge would finish what Silla could not. Euija calls it a temporary posting. The court knows better. The paper names a county far to the south. Packed earth. A magistrate’s hut with a doorpost for a ring.
blocks.ko: 이번엔 배가 아니라 교지로, 맨 먼저 쫓겨난 사람 가운데 흥수가 있다. 이 숙청이 신라도 못 한 일을 마저 해 줄 거라고, 눈치 없이 말한 사람이다. 의자는 잠시 내려보내는 것이라 한다. 조정은 다 안다. 종이에 적힌 곳은 먼 남쪽 고을이다. 다져진 흙. 칼 고리를 걸 문설주가 남은 원님 오두막.

blocks.html: Gomamiji is a posting, not a retirement. He sits on the threshold until the dust on the hem looks like the hem. The hollow ring leans on the timber. Nobody from Sabi writes.
blocks.ko: 고마미지는 부임이지, 은퇴가 아니다. 자락의 먼지가 자락처럼 보일 때까지 문턱에 앉는다. 빈 고리는 나무에 기대 있다. 사비에서는 아무도 글을 보내지 않는다.

blocks.html: He stops holding court. The wine comes earlier each day, and then it stops being tied to the day at all.
blocks.ko: 그는 조회를 열지 않는다. 술은 날마다 조금씩 더 이른 시각에 올라오다가, 이윽고 시각과 상관없어진다.

blocks.html: Hundreds, by now. Nobody keeps the roll. They no longer have separate duties — only who pours, who steadies his wrist, who is still there when the wine runs out, and who is bold enough to speak while his mouth is busy elsewhere.
blocks.ko: 이제는 수백이다. 명부를 적는 사람이 없다. 소임은 없다 — 누가 따르는지, 누가 손목을 붙드는지, 술이 떨어지면 누가 남아 있는지, 그리고 폐하의 입이 다른 데에 있는 동안에도 감히 말하는 자가 누구인지뿐.

blocks.html: The hems keep time better than the roll. A pour, a step, a kneel — the long court silk opens, and he watches that before he watches the wine.
blocks.ko: 명부보다 자락이 시각을 지킨다. 따르고, 오르고, 무릎을 굽히면 — 긴 조정 비단이 열리고, 그는 술보다 그것을 먼저 본다.

blocks.html: The feast is no longer a feast. Robes open. Knees find laps. He is half-undressed and does not bother to hide what the wine has done to him. The maids show him their bodies the way other courts show tribute.
blocks.ko: 잔치는 이제 잔치가 아니다. 옷이 열린다. 무릎이 무릎을 찾는다. 그는 반쯤 벗은 채로, 술이 자기에게 한 일을 숨길 생각도 없다. 궁녀들은 다른 조정이 공물을 보이듯 몸을 보인다.

blocks.html: The stories say three thousand. The room is not that. It is still too many — a harem so packed the lamp never finds a wall. They kneel in ranks. They loosen the silk. They climb into his lap two at a time. He does not hide what the wine has done; the dark trousers tell it first.
blocks.ko: 전설은 삼천이라 한다. 이 방은 그게 아니다. 그래도 너무 많다 — 등이 벽을 찾지 못할 만큼 들어찬 후궁. 열 지어 무릎을 꿇는다. 비단을 푼다. 둘씩 무릎에 오른다. 술이 자기에게 한 일을 숨기지 않는다. 검은 바지가 먼저 말한다.

blocks.html: The hall is Sabi: vermilion columns, yellow wood, lamps on a wet floor. They fill it. They hike the silk. They turn their backs and laugh. They pour bent at the waist. They crowd a column. Ribbons come undone. They toast until the lamps blur. They compete to be seen.
blocks.ko: 전각은 사비다. 주홍 기둥, 누런 나무, 젖은 마루 위의 등. 그들이 채운다. 비단을 걷어 올린다. 등을 돌리고 웃는다. 허리를 숙여 따른다. 기둥을 에워싼다. 고름이 풀린다. 등이 흐려질 때까지 잔을 친다. 보이려고 다툰다.

blocks.html: A hand finds the silk at her own lap. Fingers rest on an inner thigh. One knee up. A twist. They show off for him.
blocks.ko: 손이 제 무릎의 비단을 찾는다. 손가락이 허벅지 안쪽에 머문다. 한쪽 무릎을 세운다. 몸을 비튼다. 그를 위해 몸을 보인다.

blocks.html: Jackets hang off the shoulders. The chima rides low. The robe hangs open.
blocks.ko: 저고리가 어깨에서 걸린다. 치마가 낮아진다. 도포가 열린다.

blocks.html: The headband is gone. The robe hangs off. They hike the silk to the hip. Inner thighs face him. A hem lifts. A maid finds his lap. His mouth finds the silk.
blocks.ko: 머리띠가 없다. 도포가 벗겨진다. 비단을 허리까지 걷는다. 허벅지 안쪽이 그를 향한다. 자락이 들린다. 궁녀가 무릎을 찾는다. 입이 비단을 찾는다.

blocks.html: They hike it as high as it will go. Two of them hike together. They sit with knees up. One knee high. She pulls the silk up. He looks up the silk. His mouth is at her hip. The robe hangs wider.
blocks.ko: 더 이상 걷을 데가 없을 때까지 걷는다. 둘이 함께 걷는다. 무릎을 세우고 앉는다. 한쪽 무릎이 높다. 비단을 끌어올린다. 그는 비단을 올려다본다. 입이 허리에 있다. 도포가 더 벌어진다.

blocks.html: They hike it to the last fold of silk. His mouth is along a thigh. The robe is open to the navel. Her hand on the silk at her lap. Jeogori slipping off the shoulders.
blocks.ko: 비단의 마지막 접힘까지 걷는다. 입이 허벅지를 따른다. 도포가 배꼽까지 열린다. 손이 제 무릎의 비단에 있다. 저고리가 어깨에서 미끄러진다.

blocks.html: The party does not sit still. Wine-wet silk clinging. His hands on her thighs. They sit with both knees up. She twists at the waist. One of them, both knees up in his lap.
blocks.ko: 잔치는 가만히 있지 않는다. 술에 젖은 비단이 붙는다. 손이 허벅지에 있다. 양쪽 무릎을 세우고 앉는다. 허리를 튼다. 하나는 양쪽 무릎을 세운 채 그의 무릎에 있다.

blocks.html: Moonlight through the lattice. One lamp from the side. Over her shoulder. On the night veranda. She pours clear wine down the silk. They laugh into the lamp.
blocks.ko: 창호로 달이 든다. 옆에서 등 하나. 어깨 너머로. 밤의 누마루에서. 맑은 술을 비단에 따른다. 등불 앞에서 웃는다.

blocks.html: Rain on the night veranda. A shaft of lamp in the dark. They take the night corridor. Moon on one side of his face.
blocks.ko: 밤 누마루에 비가 온다. 어둠 속 등 한 줄기. 밤 복도를 간다. 달빛이 얼굴 한쪽에만 있다.

blocks.html: She looks back, hip out. His hand finds the silk at her waist. The S-curve of a hip is the whole argument of the hall. Less clothes. More lamp. The robe hangs open. The jeogori does not stay on the shoulder.
blocks.ko: 그녀는 돌아보며 엉덩이를 내민다. 그의 손이 허리의 비단을 찾는다. 엉덩이의 S자가 전각의 전부다. 옷은 더 적다. 등은 더 많다. 도포가 열린다. 저고리는 어깨에 남아 있지 않는다.

blocks.html: His face finds a hip. He buries himself between them. He presses into the wet silk at her back. He goes face-first into the silk. An untied goreum. They gasp and laugh in his face.
blocks.ko: 얼굴이 허리를 찾는다. 그들 사이에 파묻힌다. 등쪽 젖은 비단에 얼굴을 민다. 비단 속으로 얼굴을 먼저 넣는다. 풀린 고름. 그의 얼굴 앞에서 헐떡이고 웃는다.

lines: 폐하. 어제 하신 말씀을 오늘 또 하셨습니다.
en: Your Majesty. You said that yesterday, and again today.
…With the same breath on us.
The same teeth… at our collarbones.
Was it good?
Or… was it a good night.

lines: 폐하가 멈추라고 하셔도… 허리가 먼저 대답해요.
en: …It was, yesterday.
The body still remembers.
Even if Your Majesty says stop… the hips answer first.

lines: 폐하. 젊으실 때 얘기 좀 해 주십시오.
en: Your Majesty. Tell us about when you were young.
Before you… undo anything.
No —
While you undo it.
One word per knot.
…What is it you want to know.

lines: 삼신께서 폐하 몫 장부를 따로 두시나 봐요. 부엌에선 그게 어찌 가능한가 내기까지 붙었어요.
en: They say you have more than fifty sons.
Samsin must keep a whole ledger just for Your Majesty. The kitchens have a wager going on how.
Nightly.
…That was the thirtieth Eraha. My father.

lines: 아, 그럼 폐하는 아직 여유가 있으시네요.
en: Ah. Then Your Majesty still has room to work with.
We can testify to it.
We knew already, in fairness.
Asking was only manners.

blocks.html: He laughs for the first time in four months. It is the last recorded instance.
blocks.ko: 넉 달 만에 처음으로 그가 웃는다. 기록에 남은 마지막 웃음이다.

blocks.html: Somewhere in the third year he stops going out to the hall, and some time after that they stop sending for him. The distance between those two things is the rest of the reign.
blocks.ko: 삼 년째 어느 무렵 그는 대전에 나가지 않게 되고, 그 얼마 뒤에는 부르러 오지도 않게 된다. 그 둘 사이의 거리가 남은 치세의 전부다.

en: Your Majesty…

lines: 계백 장군을 데려오는 게 최선 아니겠습니까?
en: Would it not be best to bring back General Gyebek?
That… who?
You there! Bring more wine!
Ahh~~ over here, Your Majesty~~
Your Majesty. The ministers are waiting outside.
…Let them wait.
Until when?

blocks.html: He does not answer. After a while the question stops being asked, and after a while longer the ministers stop coming to the door. He notices none of it, and it is the first thing in his life he has not arranged on purpose.
blocks.ko: 그는 대답하지 않는다. 얼마 뒤 그 물음이 사라지고, 다시 얼마 뒤 재상들이 문 앞에 오지 않게 된다. 그는 그중 아무것도 알아채지 못한다. 평생 처음으로, 그가 일부러 꾸미지 않은 일이다.

blocks.html: Seongchung comes while the wine is still being poured. He does not wait for a gap. The ring at his hip catches the lamp when he steps — a hollow circle, nothing poetic, just the office blade of a man who used to read tides.
blocks.ko: 성충은 술이 아직 따르는 중에 온다. 틈을 기다리지 않는다. 허리의 환두가 등을 받는다 — 빈 고리. 시가 아니다. 물때를 읽던 사내의 관직 칼일 뿐이다.

en: Your Majesty. Open court.
Today.
We opened it.
With the cup.
There is a tide.
If you miss it—

blocks.html: He does not finish. The king is already angry. The belt comes off in the aisle. After that, nobody else tries to speak.
blocks.ko: 끝내지 못한다. 왕은 이미 노한다. 허리띠는 복도에서 벗겨진다. 그 다음부터는, 감히 말하려는 자가 없다.

blocks.hanja: 王怒，囚之獄中，由是，無敢言者。
blocks.ko: 왕이 노하여 그를 옥에 가두었다. 이로부터 감히 말하는 자가 없었다.
blocks.html: The king was angry and threw him in prison. After that, nobody dared to speak.
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 28, Baekje Annals — King Uija, yr. 16 (656), third month

blocks.html: Seongchung starves in a cell within earshot of the feast. The ring hangs on the post. With the last of his ink he leaves the king one piece of paper.
blocks.ko: 성충이 연회 소리가 들리는 옥에서 굶어 간다. 환두는 기둥에 걸려 있다. 마지막 남은 먹으로, 왕에게 종이 한 장을 남긴다.

blocks.html: In the cell where he starved, Kangrim reads his name three times — Seongchung. Seongchung. Seongchung. — loud enough for the feast next door to hear, or not hear.
blocks.ko: 굶어 죽어 가던 칸 안에서, 강림은 그의 이름을 세 번 부른다 — 성충. 성충. 성충. — 옆 연회가 들을지, 못 들을지 모를 만큼 크게.

en: Councillor Seongchung.
You chose the cell over silence. Was that loyalty to the king — or loyalty to being right?
lines: 침묵 대신 옥을 고르셨군요. 임금에 대한 충성이었습니까 — 아니면 옳음에 대한 충성이었습니까?

en: …Being right is the only loyalty left when a king stops listening.
The paper is for him. Not for you.
lines: 종이는 그이를 위한 것이오. 공이 아니오.

en: I will keep the minutes. Walk.

blocks.hanja: 忠臣死不忘君，願一言而死。臣常觀時察變，必有兵革之事。凡用兵，必審擇其地，處上流以延敵，然後可以保全。若異國兵來，陸路不使過沈峴，水軍不使入伎伐浦之岸，擧其險隘以禦之，然後可也。
blocks.ko: 충신은 죽어도 임금을 잊지 않으니, 한마디 아뢰고 죽고자 합니다. 신이 늘 때를 보고 변화를 살폈는데, 반드시 전쟁이 있을 것입니다. 무릇 군사를 쓸 때는 반드시 그 땅을 잘 가려야 하니, 상류에 자리 잡고 적을 끌어들여야 보전할 수 있습니다. 만일 다른 나라 군사가 오거든, 육로로는 침현을 넘지 못하게 하고 수군은 기벌포 기슭에 들어오지 못하게 하여, 험하고 좁은 곳에 의지해 막아야 합니다.
blocks.html: A loyal servant does not forget his king even in death, so let me say one thing and die. I have always watched the times and studied their changes, and there will surely be war. Whoever uses soldiers must choose his ground with care: take the upper stream and draw the enemy to you, and you can keep the country whole. If foreign soldiers come, do not let them cross Chimhyeon by land, and do not let their ships into the banks of Gibeolpo. Hold the narrow, difficult places, and stop them there.
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 28, Baekje Annals — King Uija, yr. 16, dying memorial of Seongchung; Lee Byong-do ed., vol. 1, p. 384

blocks.html: The king does not take it in.
blocks.ko: 왕은 새겨듣지 않는다.

blocks.html: Foxes in the Assembly. Toads in the treetops. A river running red. Nine signs, and a king who swears he doesn’t believe in signs…!
blocks.ko: 정사암에 여우 떼. 나무 꼭대기에 두꺼비. 핏빛으로 흐르는 강. 징조가 아홉, 그리고 징조 따윈 믿지 않는다는 임금…!

images.alt: A blood-marked hand — first of the nine omens over Sabi
images.prompt: Historical manhwa: bloody omen hand / Nine Plagues. Match Euija era. Refs: Euija. No text, --ar 3:2

images.alt: Lightning breaks over Sabi palace as the people cry that Baekje falls
images.prompt: Historical manhwa: lightning over Sabi palace — Baekje falls omen. Refs: Euija, Sabi. No text, --ar 3:2

images.at: A ghost enters the palace and burrows into the ground.
images.alt: In a torchlit pit in the Sabi palace yard, diggers lift out a living turtle with faint carved marks on its shell where a ghost sank into the earth.
images.prompt: HEEWON STYLE. Minimal iconic 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. Ninth of the nine omens, 659. TOP-DOWN BIRD'S-EYE into a freshly dug square pit in the inner yard of Sabi palace at night (attached pl_sabi_palace board: stone paving and giwa eaves at the frame edges). ONE DEVICE: the square black pit as a hard frame-within-the-frame in the centre. At its bottom, two Baekje palace laborers in hemp hanbok with topknots, no brimmed hats, crouch with iron spades, recoiling, as one lifts a living turtle out of the dark soil; on its shell faint carved marks, illegible, not readable text. A thin trail of pale grey mist sinks into the earth at the pit's edge where the ghost went down. A pine torch jammed into the spoil heap is the practical key raking across the shell and the men's faces. Foreground: the blurred edge of a minister's dark sleeve at the rim. Crushed blacks, long torch shadows on the pit walls, gold #facc15 as the specular on the wet shell, NOT a glow aura. No text. No watermark. CANON — PLACE Sabi (사비 (부여)) — attached board /pl_sabi_palace.png; keep this exact architecture and ground. Sabi palace on the Baengma river bluffs; Baekje giwa halls and pavilions. | COSTUME CHARTS (attached): cut, collar, sleeve, sash, trouser and skirt shapes of every Samhan figure follow the chart for their kingdom; it is a style chart, so ignore its labels, captions, maps, poses and faces. Named people keep their portrait face and colours; extras and soldiers dress like the chart (a commoner like its commoners, an official like its officials, a soldier like its soldiers). Baekje: attached /ref_hanbok_baekje_gaya.png. HEEWON STYLE: a Korean WEBTOON figure painted into a hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL world, in a SIMPLE, MINIMAL, ICONIC layout — the benchmark is a lone man in magenta silk walking down a storm-lit grass ridge toward his tied horse with an empty saddle: one diagonal, two subjects, half the frame storm sky, one cloud-break. FIGURES are webtoon / anime: clean digital-ink linework, simplified webtoon faces with expressive eyes, the face and hands keep that clean ink line, but the body and garments are PAINTED, never digitally shaded — broad loaded brushstrokes and dry-brush drag that follow each fold, the shading stepped in three or four painted value planes with soft broken edges, paper-and-canvas grain running right across the silk — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, never a smooth airbrushed gradient, never a 3D render (2.5D, see FORM). THE WORLD is WATERCOLOR FIRST, OIL SECOND: skies and ground in granulated wet-in-wet washes and short broken-colour dabs (Turner), dry-brush grass, dust and stone texture, soft bleeding edges, faint paper grain; the accent colour of the scene blooms into the wash near one frame edge and the frame edges dissolve into bare paper; oil only deepens the darks with rich umber-indigo glazes and adds a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight. INTERIORS AND NIGHT SCENES are the webtoon figure painted into a European OLD-MASTER CANVAS — a Renaissance / Baroque TENEBRIST oil painting (Caravaggio, Georges de La Tour, Rembrandt): broken-colour brushwork, glazed umber-to-black darks, sfumato falloff, a touch of impasto on the brightest highlight, over faint watercolor blooms and paper grain; walls, timber, stone, drapery and tables pulled out of the darkness by the one lamp, window or shaft. The same oil-on-canvas texture covers EVERYTHING in the frame, the figures’ silk included — mottled plaster, gritty stone, brushed robes — so the webtoon figures sit INTO that painted space, lit by the same key and sharing its shadows, never pasted onto a flat backdrop. LAYOUT is MINIMAL AND ICONIC, staged like a Romanticist painting (Friedrich, Turner, Delacroix, Géricault): ONE device carries the frame (a ridge diagonal, a road, a waterline, a hall axis, a table ring, a gate) with ONE or TWO subjects placed on the thirds; at least half the frame is quiet negative space (storm sky, empty field, dark floor, bare wall); distant detail stays tiny and dissolving (a line of banners or roofs in haze); no crowds, no clutter, nothing competing with the subject. Heroic diagonal or pyramid, small figures against a sublime sky or vast field, or a bold worm’s-eye / straight-down angle. BLOCKING IS THE RELATIONSHIP: when two people share a frame, the still reads like a history painting with the faces covered — who stands higher and who kneels, the distance or contact between them, whose hand rests on whom, where each one looks (at each other, past each other, the same way), and how their cast shadows meet on the wall or floor; one gesture between them carries the whole bond. LIGHT is movie tenebrism at full strength: 70–85% of the frame sinks into deep painted shadow (oil-glazed umber, indigo, black), an extreme value range with near-white highlights right beside inky black and almost no middle grey; big dark masses (storm cloud, shadowed slope, umber room, black floor) against ONE bright break — a single cloud-break, low sun shaft, lamp or window — that lands on the subject; inky darks right beside small near-white highlights, few middle greys in the subject; ONE hard directional key carves the subject out of the dark. FORM IS 2.5D — drawn webtoon line on the outside, sculpted painted volume on the inside (the interior benchmark: a bearded emperor in yellow silk standing at a stone relief, under-lit by an oil lamp set on the floor beside the lens, palm on the carved horse, his shadow climbing the wall): the key is a PRACTICAL light IN or just outside the frame, CLOSE to the subject, RAKING ACROSS the surfaces the camera sees from below or from the side — never from behind them. So every silk fold protrudes, built the way an oil painter builds it: the lit side of each fold laid in with one opaque loaded stroke, the turn into shadow a crisp painted edge, the shadow side a thin transparent umber glaze with a little warm floor-light dragged into it, brush direction following the fold; gold thread and the brightest ridges flicked in with impasto; cheekbones, beard, knuckles, armor plates and horse muscle are painted the same way. The subject is large in frame (medium or closer, worm’s-eye or low three-quarter) so the folds resolve, and the light falls off into black across the body — that falloff is the darkness. Never a garment filled with one flat colour; never a subject backlit into a flat silhouette with only an edge line (if the camera is behind someone, the key still comes from the side and models their back and shoulder); never a wall flat to the lens — walls and floors recede at an angle so cast shadows can climb them. A thin edge of the same real light may graze the far side of the silhouette to lift it off the background (never a glow outline); long raking shadows. TEXTURE IS TACTILE RELIEF — the raking key exists to reveal it: thick oil impasto that stands up off the canvas on the lit side of every surface, loaded-brush and palette-knife ridges the eye can almost touch. Cloth: heavy silk in deep ridged folds, raised gold embroidery and brocade threads catching pin-point specular, quilted collars, layered sleeves with real thickness, beads and pins as small sculpted volumes. Buildings and ground just as sculpted: carved, weathered timber grain on pillars and brackets, every giwa roof tile and end-cap a rounded relief with its own shadow, rough-cut stone blocks, cracked lime plaster, lattice in deep relief throwing crisp little shadows, packed earth with grit and footprints. Never a smooth flat wall, never a plain colour-fill robe. Default hour is dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat overcast, never even daylight, never a bright open sky filling the frame. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. SEPARATION: subject and background never share a value — the lit subject sits in the one pool of light and everything behind it drops three or more steps to near-black (or, reversed, a dark figure against the single bright opening); foreground shapes almost black; the eye lands on the subject first. blocks.ko: 4. 유난히 큰 여인의 주검이 강가에 떠올랐다.

blocks.html: 5. The screams of ghosts can be heard from the palace.
blocks.ko: 5. 궁궐에서 귀신의 비명이 들렸다.

blocks.html: 6. The White River turns red with blood.
blocks.ko: 6. 백강이 핏빛으로 붉어졌다.

blocks.html: 7. Tens of thousands of toads gathered in the tops of the trees.
blocks.ko: 7. 수만 마리 두꺼비가 나무 꼭대기에 모였다.

blocks.html: 8. Storm winds, rain, lightning. Black clouds like dragons fought each other in the air.
blocks.ko: 8. 폭풍과 비와 벼락. 용 같은 검은 구름이 공중에서 서로 싸웠다.

blocks.html: 9. A ghost enters the palace and burrows into the ground. They dig, and find a turtle.
blocks.ko: 9. 귀신이 궁에 들어와 땅속으로 파고들었다. 파 보니 거북이 하나가 나왔다.

blocks.title: The nine omens, as the annals keep them
blocks.ko: 기록에 남은 아홉 가지 흉조

omens.hanja: 衆狐入宮中，一白狐坐上佐平書案。
omens.html: Foxes came into the palace in a pack, and one white fox sat down on the Senior Minister’s desk.
omens.ko: 여우 떼가 궁 안에 들어오고, 흰 여우 한 마리가 상좌평의 책상에 올라앉았다.
omens.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 28, Baekje Annals — King Uija, yr. 19 (659), second month

omens.html: In the Crown Prince’s palace, a hen mated with a sparrow.
omens.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 28, Baekje Annals — King Uija, yr. 19 (659), fourth month

omens.hanja: 王都西南泗沘河，大魚出死，長三丈。
omens.html: In the river at Sabi, southwest of the capital, a huge fish came up dead. It was three jang long.
omens.ko: 도성 서남쪽 사비하에서 큰 물고기가 나와 죽었는데, 길이가 세 장이었다.
omens.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 28, Baekje Annals — King Uija, yr. 19 (659), fifth month

omens.hanja: 有女屍浮生草津，長十八尺。
omens.html: A woman’s body floated up at Saengcho Ford. It was eighteen feet long.
omens.ko: 생초진에 여자 시체가 떠올랐는데, 길이가 열여덟 자였다.
omens.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 28, Baekje Annals — King Uija, yr. 19 (659), eighth month

omens.hanja: 宮中槐樹鳴，如人哭聲。夜，鬼哭於宮南路。
omens.html: A pagoda tree in the palace moaned like someone weeping. At night, ghosts wailed on the road south of the palace.
omens.ko: 궁 안의 회화나무가 사람이 우는 소리처럼 울었다. 밤에는 궁 남쪽 길에서 귀신이 곡하였다.
omens.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 28, Baekje Annals — King Uija, yr. 19 (659), ninth month

omens.html: The river at Sabi ran as red as blood.
omens.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 28, Baekje Annals — King Uija, yr. 20 (660), second month

omens.html: Tens of thousands of toads gathered in the trees.
omens.ko: 두꺼비 수만 마리가 나무 위에 모였다.
omens.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 28, Baekje Annals — King Uija, yr. 20 (660), fourth month

omens.hanja: 風雨暴至，震天王、道讓二寺塔，又震白石寺講堂。玄雲如龍，東西相鬪於空中。
omens.html: Wind and rain came all at once. Lightning struck the pagodas of Cheonwang and Doyang temples, and the lecture hall of Baekseok Temple. Black clouds like dragons fought, east against west, in the sky.
omens.ko: 비바람이 갑자기 몰아쳐 천왕사와 도양사 두 절의 탑에 벼락이 치고, 또 백석사 강당에 벼락이 쳤다. 검은 구름이 용처럼 동쪽과 서쪽에서 공중에서 서로 싸웠다.
omens.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 28, Baekje Annals — King Uija, yr. 20 (660), fifth month

omens.hanja: 有一鬼入宮中，大呼：「百濟亡，百濟亡！」卽入地，王怪之，使人掘地，深三尺許，有一龜。
omens.html: A ghost came into the palace and shouted, “Baekje is falling, Baekje is falling!” Then it went into the ground. The king thought it strange and had men dig. About three feet down, there was a turtle.
omens.ko: 귀신 하나가 궁 안에 들어와 크게 외쳤다. “백제가 망한다, 백제가 망한다!” 그러고는 땅속으로 들어갔다. 왕이 괴이하게 여겨 사람을 시켜 땅을 파게 하니, 석 자쯤 깊이에 거북이 한 마리 있었다.
omens.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 28, Baekje Annals — King Uija, yr. 20 (660)

blocks.title: A room in Surabol, some months earlier

lines: 의자는 스무 해 동안 백성한테 기적을 팔았소. / 용이니 흰 사슴이니 하는 것들.
en: For twenty years Euija has been selling his people miracles. / Dragons. White deer.
Knowing they were false?

lines: 만든 사람이 본인인데. / 그러니 이제 그자는 세상에서 징조를 제일 못 읽는 사람이오. / 한평생 징조가 사람 손으로 만들어진다는 걸 알면서 살았으니까.
en: He made them himself. / Which makes him the worst reader of signs alive. / He has spent his whole life knowing that signs are made by hands.
…Then why would it work on him?

lines: 그자한테 통할 필요가 없소. / 그자의 백성한테만 통하면 되지.
en: It doesn’t have to work on him. / It only has to work on his people.

blocks.html: He does not order any of it, exactly. He asks for men who can travel, he asks what the markets of Sabi are frightened of, and he asks how deep one has to bury a turtle shell for the finding of it to look like an accident.
blocks.ko: 그는 딱히 무엇을 명하지는 않는다. 다닐 만한 사람을 구하고, 사비의 저잣거리가 무엇을 무서워하는지 묻고, 거북 등껍질을 얼마나 깊이 묻어야 찾아낸 것이 우연처럼 보이는지를 묻는다.

lines: 나라를 무너뜨리는 데 군대는 마지막에나 필요하오. / 먼저 필요한 건 소문이고. / 소문은 백성이 이미 두려워하는 것으로 만들면 되지.
en: An army is the last thing you need to bring down a country. / First you need a rumour. / And you build a rumour out of what the people are already afraid of.
Baekje falls! Baekje falls!

blocks.html: He keeps a shaman on retainer the way other kings keep song-girls. He likes watching someone else believe the sky talks; he has told Gyebek the gods are cheap civil servants, and told Gesomun the same with wine on his breath. The shaman thinks he is frightened. He lets her.
blocks.ko: 그는 다른 임금들이 가창꾼을 두듯 무당을 둔다. 하늘이 말한다고 믿는 사람을 보는 재미가 있다. 계백에게는 신을 값싼 관리라 했고, 개소문에게도 술 취해 같은 말을 했다. 무당은 그가 겁먹었다고 생각한다. 그는 그냥 둔다.

blocks.html: King Euija goes to a shaman with the nine signs piled behind him and the turtle in his hands. He wants the sky to say something he can still use.
blocks.ko: 의자왕이 아홉 징조를 등 뒤에 두고, 거북을 들고 무당을 찾는다. 아직 쓸 수 있는 말을 하늘이 해 주기를 바란다.

en: I came for amusement today.
There are nine. / Read them.

lines: 큰 여인의 주검 — 백성이 그 탓에 신음합니다.
en: The foxes — the politicians are corrupt.
The hen and the sparrow — public morals have declined.
The great fish — the economy is in decline.
The great woman’s corpse — the people suffer for it.

lines: 나무 위의 두꺼비 — 거짓 장사치들만 목청이 큽니다.
용의 구름 — 나라가 저희끼리 싸우기 시작합니다.
en: The ghost-screams — the forgotten common man cries out.
The blood-red river — the public sphere is polluted.
The toads in the trees — only lying peddlers have loud voices.
The dragon-clouds — the nation begins fighting itself.
…The turtle. / From the shell.

blocks.hanja: 得一龜 背有文曰 百濟同月輪 新羅如月新
blocks.ko: 거북 하나를 얻으니, 등에 글이 있어 이르되, 백제는 보름달과 같고, 신라는 초승달과 같다.
blocks.html: They obtained a tortoise; on its back was writing that said: Baekje is like the full moon; Silla is like the new moon.
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 28, Baekje Annals — King Uija, yr. 20 (660); Lee Byong-do ed., vol. 1, p. 386

lines: 보름달 같다는 것은 가득 찬 것이니, 가득 차면 기울며 —
초승달 같다는 것은 가득 차지 못한 것이니, 가득 차지 못하면 점점 차게 됩니다.
en: To be like a full moon is to be full — and what is full must wane —
to be like a crescent is to be not yet full — and what is not yet full grows fuller.
Baekje wanes. Silla fills.

blocks.html: The blade is out before the last word cools. He cuts her down where she sits. The turtle’s sentence stays in the room.
blocks.ko: 마지막 말이 식기 전에 칼이 나온다. 그는 그가 앉은 자리에서 벤다. 거북의 말은 방에 남는다.

en: You wretch!!!

blocks.html: People start saying it out loud in the markets, which is how you know it is already over.
blocks.ko: 저잣거리에서 사람들이 그 말을 소리 내어 하기 시작한다. 그쯤 되면 이미 끝난 것이다.

blocks.html: All over Yamato, people took up weapons for no reason and went back and forth on the roads. The elders said: “Is this a sign that Baekje will lose its place?”
blocks.ko: 온 나라 백성이 까닭 없이 병기를 들고 길을 오갔다. 나라의 원로들이 말하였다. “백제가 제자리를 잃을 조짐인가.”
blocks.hanja: 舉國百姓無故持兵，往還於道。國老言：「百濟國失所之相乎。」
blocks.source: Nihon Shoki (日本書紀) bk. 26, Saimei 6 (660), fifth month — note

lines: 폐하. 지금 필요하신 건 술이 아닙니다.
en: Your Majesty. What you need right now is not wine.
Your Majesty…
Say one name.
I will go and bring him.
…That name was one I made up.
When I first took the throne.
…Your Majesty.
What are they saying in the markets these days.
…That Baekje is the full moon.
…Yes.
Well made.

blocks.html: He never says that the signs were made. He could name the price of every piece of it. To say a man made this one is to say it about the dragon over the Sabi, and the white deer, and the twenty years in between.
blocks.ko: 그는 그 징조들이 만들어졌다는 말을 하지 않는다. 한 조각 한 조각의 값까지 댈 수 있으면서도. 이것은 사람이 만든 것이다라고 말하는 순간, 사비강의 용에 대해서도, 흰 사슴에 대해서도, 그 사이 스무 해에 대해서도 그렇게 말하는 것이 되기 때문이다.

blocks.html: The best lie a man ever tells is the one he cannot afford to expose.
blocks.ko: 사람이 하는 가장 훌륭한 거짓말은, 스스로 들출 수 없게 된 거짓말이다.

blocks.html: That night he leaves the palace the way he left it as a boy — without asking, without banners. The White River is waiting where it always waited. The omen said it ran red. Under the moon it is only black water and the smell of wet stone.
blocks.ko: 그날 밤 그는 소년 때처럼 궁을 나선다 — 묻지 않고, 깃발 없이. 백강은 늘 기다리던 자리에 있다. 징조는 붉다 했고, 달 아래에서는 검은 물과 젖은 돌 냄새뿐이다.

blocks.html: He has spent years drowning on dry land — wine, women, and refusing to hear the name of the man he sent away. The river does not care. It knew him before the crown.
blocks.ko: 그는 마른 땅에서 몇 해를 익사하며 보냈다 — 술, 여인, 멀리 보낸 사내의 이름을 듣지 않는 것. 강은 상관하지 않는다. 왕관보다 먼저 그를 알았으니까.

en: (to the water, and to a boy who once would have died on the twentieth dive)
I named you here.
I will not die drunk on the bank of my own invention.
lines: (물에게, 그리고 스무 번째 잠수에서 죽었을 소년에게)
내 발명품 강둑에서 취해 죽지는 않겠다.

blocks.html: He jumps. The cold takes the wine off him. When he surfaces he is coughing, furious, awake — the promising prince the eight clans once feared, scraped clean by the same river that taught him friendship.
blocks.ko: 뛰어든다. 추위가 술을 벗겨 낸다. 물 밖으로 나올 때 그는 기침하고, 분노하고, 깨어 있다 — 대성팔족이 한때 두려워하던 촉망받는 왕자, 우정을 가르친 바로 그 강에 긁혀 깨끗해진.

en: Summon Gyebek…!

blocks.html: Before the last stand, the first road. To understand Baekje, we have to go back to two brothers and their mother, walking south…!
blocks.ko: 마지막 싸움에 앞서, 첫 길부터. 백제를 알려면 남쪽으로 걷던 두 형제와 그 어머니에게로 거슬러 가야 한다…!

images.alt: Over Biryu's drawn bow, a pale gold stag stands calm on the ridge path while Onjo pushes the bow down
images.prompt: 16:9 over-the-shoulder still from behind Biryu's drawn bow: sharp foreground of his shoulder, the bent bow and taut string, an arrow nocked. Midground on a narrow mountain ridge path, the pale white-gold stag Sinrok stands broadside, calm, looking straight back, antlers branching against a pale break in the clouds. Onjo's hand enters from the right, pressing down on Biryu's bow arm, his face urgent. Far peaks in blue wash bokeh. Low contre-jour sun catching the antlers as the key. CANON — BIRYU — FACE and garments from attached /ch_biryu.png (face only; invent a new pose). Demeanor: Elder brother, sea-hungry and proud; wants the coast at Michuhol and will not listen. #d8b276 as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. | ONJO — FACE and garments from attached /ch_onjo.png (face only; invent a new pose). Demeanor: Younger brother, steadier; listens to the ten ministers and stays inland at Wirye. The Sinrok deer stays with him. #f0c04a as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. | SINROK (신록, guardian deer of Baekje, guide of onjo and biryu) — attached board /obj_sinrok.png: Pale white-gold stag with tall branching antlers — match the board's animal, but ignore its glow outline: light catches the antlers and coat as real light. Owned by no one; leads the brothers south and stays with Onjo. HEEWON STYLE: a hand-painted ANIME film frame composed like a Romanticist master painting. FIGURES are anime: clean ink linework, simplified anime faces with expressive eyes, shaded in soft watercolor washes and translucent oil glazes instead of flat cel fill — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, not 3D. THE WORLD is watercolor and oil: skies, dust, ground and light are visibly hand-painted — wet-in-wet blooms, pigment granulation, soft bleeding edges, dry-brush dust, rich oil glazes in the darks, faint paper grain; edges of the frame dissolve into wash. LAYOUT is Romanticism (Delacroix, Géricault, Friedrich, Goya, Turner): heroic diagonal or pyramid composition, small figures against a sublime storm sky or vast field, extreme foreshortening (worm’s-eye from the dirt or straight down from above), one break in the clouds or one shaft as the key. LIGHT is movie tenebrism at full strength (Caravaggio, Rembrandt, night-interior cinema): an extreme value range — inky blacks right beside small near-white highlights, almost no middle grey; 70–80% of the frame in deep painted shadow (oil-glazed umber, indigo and black); ONE hard directional key (a lamp, a single cloud-break, a low sun shaft, firelight) carves the subject out of the dark. Form is modelled: the key wraps around cheekbones, armor plates, horse muscle and silk folds, then falls off at a hard terminator; a thin edge of that same real light grazes the far side of the silhouette to lift it off the background (never a glow outline); long raking shadows. Default hour is dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat overcast, never even daylight, never a bright open sky filling the frame. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. 2D animated cel-painterly cinema, not photoreal, not live-action, not 3D CGI. Same film stock: anamorphic movie frame, shallow DOF, creamy bokeh, rack-focus, film grain. A CAMERA in a real Korean place — NEVER a graphic poster, split-screen collage, 3D archviz, black-triangle overlay, spotlight cone deleting the landscape, or neon outline. NO halo, bloom, glow aura, rim-aura, emissive skin, or god-ray envelope around people — character hex is REAL LIGHT in the dark (key bounce, specular on silk/armor/wet stone, a lamp, a shaft, a floor reflection), never a body halo. FACE AND GARMENTS from the attached portrait — NEVER copy the portrait stance, clasped hands, 3/4 fashion lineup, or a standing clone. Invent a new DRAMATIC body every still (mid-stride, kneel, dutch, worm’s-eye, lower-third). CINEMATOGRAPHY: dutch, crane, worm’s-eye, over-shoulder, rack focus, shallow DOF / bokeh, chiaroscuro. HIGH CONTRAST: crushed blacks + one hard key + long shadows — not even daylight wash. ICONIC MINIMAL: ONE architectural device a lens can see; empty negative space; tiny figures or lower-third; the world stays in the shot. COLOR SYMBOLISM: hex tints the hard key / catchlight / bounce — NEVER a glow aura, NEVER recolor portrait garments gold. RING-POMMEL SWORDS: one-handed hip 환두대도 from attached sw_bidam.png — handle:blade 1:3; order is RING (pommel at heel of fist) → short grip → thin gold collar → long blade → point. Never reverse handle and blade. Never a tsuba disc in the middle. Never taller than the person. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only — do not attach it on full-blade stills. Ignore swords on face portraits. Not a katana, not a tsuba, not a short jian, not a ball pommel. Real Korean architecture: grey giwa, timber, packed earth. No army. No readable text. No watermark. Copy: movie frame in a real place, not a graphic poster; iconic one-device layout, empty frame, lower-third; high contrast chiaroscuro, not even wash; 2D animated cel-painterly, no photoreal; cinematography: dutch, wide, bokeh, mise-en-scène. Never: halo / bloom / glow aura / emissive skin around figures; graphic split-screen or black-triangle overlay; photoreal live-action or 3D archviz; busy extras crowding an iconic frame; copy-pasted reference as a fashion plate; flat even-daylight postcard wide; katana / tsuba / random sabre length instead of sw_bidam 환두대도.

images.alt: Bird's-eye view of a pale switchback path where three tiny travellers follow a white stag that has turned to look back

Three tiny figures and a small ox-cart far down the ribbon, readable as hanbok silhouettes (one dusty-rose). Near the top of the frame, ten paces ahead of them, the white-gold stag has stopped and turned its head back. Hair ornament matches attached /bn_sosuno.png when the head is visible. Never: gold robes; meek downcast pose. | SINROK (신록, guardian deer of Baekje, guide of onjo and biryu) — attached board /obj_sinrok.png: Pale white-gold stag with tall branching antlers — match the board's animal, but ignore its glow outline: light catches the antlers and coat as real light. Owned by no one; leads the brothers south and stays with Onjo. HEEWON STYLE: a hand-painted ANIME film frame composed like a Romanticist master painting. FIGURES are anime: clean ink linework, simplified anime faces with expressive eyes, shaded in soft watercolor washes and translucent oil glazes instead of flat cel fill — no skin pores, no photographic detail, not photoreal, not 3D. THE WORLD is watercolor and oil: skies, dust, ground and light are visibly hand-painted — wet-in-wet blooms, pigment granulation, soft bleeding edges, dry-brush dust, rich oil glazes in the darks, faint paper grain; edges of the frame dissolve into wash. LAYOUT is Romanticism (Delacroix, Géricault, Friedrich, Goya, Turner): heroic diagonal or pyramid composition, small figures against a sublime storm sky or vast field, extreme foreshortening (worm’s-eye from the dirt or straight down from above), one break in the clouds or one shaft as the key. LIGHT is movie tenebrism at full strength (Caravaggio, Rembrandt, night-interior cinema): an extreme value range — inky blacks right beside small near-white highlights, almost no middle grey; 70–80% of the frame in deep painted shadow (oil-glazed umber, indigo and black); ONE hard directional key (a lamp, a single cloud-break, a low sun shaft, firelight) carves the subject out of the dark. Form is modelled: the key wraps around cheekbones, armor plates, horse muscle and silk folds, then falls off at a hard terminator; a thin edge of that same real light grazes the far side of the silhouette to lift it off the background (never a glow outline); long raking shadows. Default hour is dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat overcast, never even daylight, never a bright open sky filling the frame. DEPTH is three planes in every still: a dark out-of-focus FOREGROUND shape near the lens (shoulder, rein, post, grass, smoke) framing the shot; the subject razor-sharp in the MIDGROUND; the BACKGROUND melting into soft wash and atmospheric haze, with round painted BOKEH discs wherever small lights sit behind the subject (lamps, torches, embers, sparks, rain, wet highlights). Shallow depth of field, overlapping shapes and receding haze so the frame goes back in space — never flat, never every plane in equal focus. 2D animated cel-painterly cinema, not photoreal, not live-action, not 3D CGI. Same film stock: anamorphic movie frame, shallow DOF, creamy bokeh, rack-focus, film grain. A CAMERA in a real Korean place — NEVER a graphic poster, split-screen collage, 3D archviz, black-triangle overlay, spotlight cone deleting the landscape, or neon outline. NO halo, bloom, glow aura, rim-aura, emissive skin, or god-ray envelope around people — character hex is REAL LIGHT in the dark (key bounce, specular on silk/armor/wet stone, a lamp, a shaft, a floor reflection), never a body halo. FACE AND GARMENTS from the attached portrait — NEVER copy the portrait stance, clasped hands, 3/4 fashion lineup, or a standing clone. Invent a new DRAMATIC body every still (mid-stride, kneel, dutch, worm’s-eye, lower-third). CINEMATOGRAPHY: dutch, crane, worm’s-eye, over-shoulder, rack focus, shallow DOF / bokeh, chiaroscuro. HIGH CONTRAST: crushed blacks + one hard key + long shadows — not even daylight wash. ICONIC MINIMAL: ONE architectural device a lens can see; empty negative space; tiny figures or lower-third; the world stays in the shot. COLOR SYMBOLISM: hex tints the hard key / catchlight / bounce — NEVER a glow aura, NEVER recolor portrait garments gold. RING-POMMEL SWORDS: one-handed hip 환두대도 from attached sw_bidam.png — handle:blade 1:3; order is RING (pommel at heel of fist) → short grip → thin gold collar → long blade → point. Never reverse handle and blade. Never a tsuba disc in the middle. Never taller than the person. sword_*.png is a pommel ECU only — do not attach it on full-blade stills. Ignore swords on face portraits. Not a katana, not a tsuba, not a short jian, not a ball pommel. Real Korean architecture: grey giwa, timber, packed earth. No army. No readable text. No watermark. blocks.html: Onjo and Biryu grow up princes in their father’s hall. Nobody there ever mentions Buyeo.
blocks.ko: 온조와 비류는 아버지의 궁에서 왕자로 자란다. 거기서는 아무도 부여 얘기를 꺼내지 않는다.

blocks.html: In Buyeo, Lady Ye has raised Jumong’s first son alone.
blocks.ko: 부여에서는 예씨부인이 주몽의 첫아들을 홀로 키워 왔다.

blocks.html: Yuri is a boy with a sling and bad aim, or good aim and bad luck. The pebble cracks a woman’s water jar on her way back from the well.
blocks.ko: 유리는 새총을 든 아이다. 겨냥이 나쁜 건지, 겨냥은 좋은데 운이 나쁜 건지. 돌멩이가 우물에서 돌아오던 여자의 물동이를 깬다.

blocks.caption: Yuri. Bad aim or bad luck, and a mother who will not answer one question.
blocks.ko: 유리. 조준이 나쁘거나 운이 나쁘거나. 그리고 질문 하나에 대답하지 않는 어머니.

lines: 어느 집 자식이야, 대체? 애비 없이 자라서 버릇도 없지.
en: Whose son are you, anyway? No father, no manners.
blocks.speaker: Water-carrier

lines: 우리 아버지는 어떤 사람입니까? 지금 어디에 계십니까?
en: What kind of man was my father? Where is he now?

lines: 너의 아버지는 평범한 사람이 아니라서 나라에 용납되지 못했다. 그래서 남지(南地)로 도망하여 개국(開國)하여 왕을 칭했단다. 떠날 때 나에게 말하기를 ‘당신이 아들을 낳으면 내가 남긴 물건이 있는데 그것을 7각형의 돌 위의 소나무 아래에 감추어 두었다고 말하시오. 만약 이것을 찾는다면 곧 나의 아들임을 알겠소.’라고 하셨다.
en: Your father was no ordinary man, and the country could not hold him. So he fled to the southern land, founded a kingdom, and called himself king. When he left he said to me: “If you bear a son, tell him I left something hidden beneath the pine on the seven-sided stone. If he finds it, I will know him for my son.”

blocks.html: There is no pine on any hill he climbs. He finds it at home: the house’s pine pillar stands on a seven-sided foundation stone, and in the crack beneath it lies half a sword.
blocks.ko: 오르는 산마다 소나무는 없다. 그는 집에서 찾는다. 집의 소나무 기둥이 일곱 모 주춧돌 위에 서 있고, 그 밑 틈에 부러진 칼 반쪽이 있다.

en: Yuri….!

blocks.html: With his friends, three boys as stubborn as he is, he walks his father’s road backwards, south.
blocks.ko: 그만큼 고집 센 친구 셋과 함께, 그는 아버지의 길을 거꾸로, 남쪽으로 걷는다.

blocks.html: In the hall at Jolbon he lays the half-sword on the boards. Jumong goes to a chest nobody has opened since the river, takes out the other half, and kneels. The two halves click.
blocks.ko: 졸본 대청에서 유리가 칼 반쪽을 마루에 놓는다. 주몽이 강을 건넌 뒤로 아무도 열지 않은 궤짝에서 나머지 반쪽을 꺼내 무릎을 꿇는다. 두 쪽이 딸깍 맞물린다.

en: Father…!

blocks.html: Onjo and Biryu watch from the porch rail. The rail already knows what the hall will decide.
blocks.ko: 온조와 비류가 누대 난간에서 본다. 대청이 무엇을 정할지, 난간은 이미 안다.

blocks.label: The Last Night
blocks.ko: 마지막 밤

blocks.html: When Yuri is named crown prince, Sosuno does not fight the hall. She packs the dusty-rose.
blocks.ko: 유리가 태자로 세워지자 소서노는 대청과 싸우지 않는다. 회분홍을 갠다.

blocks.html: She packs Little Sosuno’s silence, which is not silent.
blocks.ko: 작은 소서노의 침묵도 챙긴다. 조용한 침묵은 아니다.

blocks.html: Jumong finds her at the old well, two buckets that have outlived the argument. Twenty winters in the same yard. He is still grinning. She is still pretending she came for water.
blocks.ko: 주몽이 옛 우물에서 그녀를 찾는다. 싸움보다 오래 버틴 두레박 둘. 같은 마당에서 스무 겨울. 그는 아직 웃고 있다. 그녀는 아직 물 뜨러 온 척한다.

en: Hey.
You’re packed.
That’s… a lot of buckets for one road.
Not buckets.
Grain. Boys. Me.

lines: 소나무 밑에 쇠붙이 하나 두고 왔을 뿐인데. 그게 자라서 걸어 들어올 줄은—
en: I left iron under a pine. I didn’t think it would grow up and walk in—
Don’t— don’t make a speech. I’ll hit you.
Wasn’t going to.
Well’s still here.
I kept it. For you. Stupid, I know.
lines: 남겨 뒀어. 너 때문에. 바보인 거 알아.

en: Don’t be nice.
I’ll get stupid.
Yuri can have the chair. I’m not sitting in a footnote.
You know that. You always knew.
lines: 의자는 유리가 가져. 난 각주로 안 앉아.

en: Yeah.
South, then.
Take the glow. Leave me the well.
…Come here. Please. One night. I’m still thirsty.
Big idiot.
The boys are asleep.
If you compliment me I will scream.
…That’s not a no.

blocks.html: They do not make it to a feast. They make it to the grain room that has been theirs since the first night, and she kisses him before the door is shut.
blocks.ko: 잔치까지는 못 간다. 첫날 밤부터 둘의 것이던 곡식방까지 가서, 문이 닫히기도 전에 그녀가 입을 맞춘다.

blocks.html: Older. Hungrier. The hide has been off for years and she is worse now, not better.
blocks.ko: 나이가 들었고, 더 고프다. 껍질은 몇 해 전에 벗었고, 지금은 나아지기는커녕 더 심하다.

en: Still you.
Still that mouth.
Look at you. Older. Sexier. Sorry. Not sorry.
lines: 너 봐. 나이 들어. 더 섹시해. 미안. 안 미안.

en: Don’t— ha— don’t say sexy I’ll—
Little Sosuno listen— that’s him— that’s the noise— wet— god the wet— twenty winters and still that slap—
Look at you. Chest. Back. That ass. That man meat. Still. Still.
Take it and destroy my tight little ass. Beat her up. Beat up Little Sosuno till she’s dripping and there’s nothing left—
lines: 작은 소서노 들어— 저거 그거야— 그 소리— 젖은— 아 그 젖은 소리— 스무 겨울인데 그 철썩 아직—
봐봐. 가슴. 등. 그 엉덩이. 그 고기. 아직. 아직.
가져와서 내 꽉 끼는 엉덩이 박살내. 두들겨 패. 작은 소서노 패. 질질 흐르고 아무것도 안 남게—

en: Yours.
Always was.
Scream it. Last time. Louder.
I hate you I love you don’t you dare stop—
Fill her— ruin her— she’s been waiting—
DUMB BIG IDIOT— LAST— FILL—
AHH— LITTLE SOSUNO’S— CUMMING— DON’T YOU LEAVE THE ROOM—
lines: 이 멍청한 큰 바보야— 마지막— 채워—
아아— 작은 소서노가— 가— 방에서 나가지 마—

blocks.html: After, she is scarlet at what she heard herself say. Destroy. Beat her up. The whole book. He kisses the place on her temple that used to hide in a sleeve.
blocks.ko: 그 다음, 제 입이 한 말에 새빨개진다. 박살. 두들겨 패. 그 책 전부. 그는 예전에 소매로 숨기던 관자놀이에 입을 맞춘다.

en: I heard.
You can still talk like that.
I’m keeping both of you. Even from a chair away.

blocks.html: Before dawn the lamp is out, and neither of them has slept.
blocks.ko: 새벽이 오기 전에 등잔은 꺼져 있고, 둘 다 한숨도 자지 않았다.

en: Don’t be nice.
I’ll get stupid.
…I’m already stupid.
Keep the well. I’m taking the glow.
Take it.
You’re beautiful.
Go found the other one. I’ll be here. Grinning. Like an idiot.
lines: 가서 다른 거 세워. 난 여기 있을게. 웃으면서. 바보처럼.

blocks.html: At dawn ten men start packing carts before anyone tells them to. Onjo and Biryu take their mother south. She walks like a woman who has been thoroughly answered and will not explain it to a deer, a son, or a chronicle. She carries the glow all the way south.
blocks.ko: 새벽, 누가 시키기도 전에 열 사람이 수레에 짐을 싣기 시작한다. 온조와 비류가 어머니를 모시고 남쪽으로 간다. 그녀는 제대로 대답을 받은 여자처럼 걷고, 사슴에게도 아들에게도 편년에도 그걸 설명하지 않는다. 그 빛을 남쪽 끝까지 가져간다.

blocks.html: After wandering for a while they find a Heavenly Deer at what the older priests will call a heavenly door, a threshold between the yellow earth and the starred sky, and decide to settle there. Loyalty, they say later, is what you owe the door that let you in.
blocks.ko: 한참을 헤매다 천록을 만난다. 뒷날 늙은 제사장들이 천문(天門)이라 부를 자리, 누런 땅과 별 하늘 사이의 문턱이다. 그들은 거기 자리를 잡는다. 충성이란, 훗날 그들 말로는, 들여보내 준 문에 빚진 것이다.

blocks.html: It happens like this. Three days south of the river, on a ridge path too narrow for the cart, a stag is standing in the way. Pale as mulberry paper, gold wherever the light touches it, antlers branching like a winter tree somebody decided to keep. It does not run. It looks at the three of them as if it had been told to expect three.
blocks.ko: 일은 이렇게 된다. 강을 건너 남으로 사흘, 수레가 지나기엔 좁은 능선 길에 수사슴 한 마리가 길을 막고 서 있다. 닥종이처럼 희고, 빛이 닿는 데마다 금빛이고, 뿔은 누가 베지 않기로 한 겨울나무처럼 갈라져 있다. 달아나지 않는다. 셋이 올 거라고 미리 들은 것처럼 세 사람을 쳐다본다.

lines: 열 신하 저녁거리다. 저 뿔만 해도 한 달은—
en: Don’t move.
That’s dinner for ten ministers. The antlers alone, a month of—
Hyung. Hyung, wait.
…That look like dinner to you? Really?
Looks like antlers to me. Meat with antlers.
Biryu. Lower it.
…Listen to your mother. Bow down.

blocks.html: Biryu lowers the bow the way an elder son does, slowly enough that everyone understands it was his own idea. The stag turns, walks ten paces up the ridge, and stops to look back. When they do not follow, it waits. When they do, it walks on. It keeps that up for nine days.
blocks.ko: 비류는 맏아들답게 활을 내린다. 제 생각이었다는 걸 모두가 알아볼 만큼 천천히. 사슴은 돌아서서 능선을 열 걸음 오르더니 멈춰 서서 돌아본다. 따라가지 않으면 기다린다. 따라가면 다시 걷는다. 그렇게 아흐레를 간다.

en: It wants us to follow, right?
…A deer knows the way, Mother?

lines: 너희 아버지는 거북이 등 밟고 강 건넜어.
en: Your father crossed a river on turtles’ backs.
A deer’s practically civilised.

blocks.html: On the ninth day it takes them up Mount Buak, and from the top the brothers see all of it: a river looped across the plain like a belt somebody has unbuckled, high peaks at their backs, wet green flats to the south and, somewhere past the haze, the sea. Biryu smells the salt before he sees it.
blocks.ko: 아흐레째 사슴은 그들을 부아악 위로 데려가고, 꼭대기에서 형제는 그 모두를 본다. 누가 풀어 놓은 허리띠처럼 들판을 감아 도는 강, 등 뒤의 높은 봉우리들, 남쪽의 젖은 푸른 벌, 그리고 안개 너머 어딘가의 바다. 비류는 바다를 보기도 전에 소금 냄새부터 맡는다.

blocks.html: At length they reached Hansan and climbed Mount Buak to look for land fit to live on. Biryu wished to live by the sea. The ten ministers remonstrated: “This land south of the river is belted by the Han to the north, held by high mountains to the east, looks out on fertile marshes to the south, and is barred by the great sea to the west. Such natural defences and advantages of ground are hard to come by. Would it not be fitting to make the capital here?” Biryu would not listen; he divided the people and went to Michuhol to live.
blocks.ko: 드디어 한산에 이르러 부아악에 올라 살 만한 땅을 바라보았다. 비류는 바닷가에 살고자 하였다. 열 신하가 간하였다. “오직 이 하남의 땅은 북으로 한수를 띠고, 동으로 높은 산에 의지하며, 남으로 기름진 못을 바라보고, 서로 큰 바다에 막혀 있습니다. 하늘이 내린 험함과 땅의 이로움은 얻기 어려운 형세이니, 여기에 도읍하는 것이 마땅하지 않겠습니까.” 비류는 듣지 않고 그 백성을 나누어 미추홀로 돌아가 살았다.
blocks.hanja: 遂至漢山 登負兒嶽 望可居之地 沸流欲居於海濱 十臣諫曰 惟此河南之地 北帶漢水 東據高岳 南望沃澤 西阻大海 其天險地利 難得之勢 作都於斯 不亦宜乎 沸流不聽 分其民 歸彌鄒忽以居之
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 23, Baekje Annals — King Onjo, founding; Lee Byong-do ed., vol. 1

lines: 바다 냄새 나지. 나 저기로 간다.
강 끼고 산 등지고, 다 좋아. 근데 배를 못 띄우잖아.
en: Smell that? Sea. I’m going there.
River in front, mountains behind, sure, lovely. You can’t float a ship on it.

lines: ……열 사람이 다 틀릴 수도 있긴 한데, 열 사람이 다—
en: Hyung, all ten of them say here.
…I mean, ten people can all be wrong, but all ten—

lines: 그럼 열 사람은 여기 살라 그래.
en: Then the ten can live here.
And Mother? Who’s Mother coming with?
…Don’t ask me that.

blocks.html: Nobody answers him. The stag, which has stood a little apart all morning, crosses the summit and lies down in the grass at Onjo’s feet, facing the river. Biryu laughs too loudly and says the deer has no taste, and takes his half of the people down to Michuhol and the salt flats. The stag stays. Baekje will call it Sinrok, the guardian deer, for as long as Baekje has anything to call.
blocks.ko: 아무도 대답하지 않는다. 아침 내내 조금 떨어져 서 있던 사슴이 꼭대기를 가로질러 와서, 강을 바라보며 온조의 발치 풀밭에 엎드린다. 비류는 너무 크게 웃으며 사슴이 보는 눈이 없다고 하고, 제 몫의 백성을 이끌고 미추홀의 소금벌로 내려간다. 사슴은 남는다. 백제는 그것을 신록, 나라를 지키는 사슴이라 부를 것이다. 백제가 무언가를 부를 수 있는 동안은.

blocks.html: Salt flats and sea wind. Biryu calls it a view.
blocks.ko: 갯벌과 바닷바람. 비류는 그걸 경치라 부른다.

lines: 열 부족의 땅이라… 십제라! 이봐, 더 크게 가자고. 백 부족의 땅… 백제! 그래, 그게 낫지….
en: The land of ten tribes… Sipje! Hey, c’mon… we can think bigger than that. The land of a HUNDRED tribes… Baekje! Now that’s more like it….
“Baekje” — how does that sound?

blocks.hanja: 以十臣爲輔翼 國號十濟 後以來時百姓樂從 改號百濟
blocks.ko: 열 신하를 보필로 삼아 나라 이름을 십제라 하였다. 뒤에 올 때의 백성이 즐겨 따랐으므로, 고쳐 백제라 하였다.
blocks.html: With ten ministers as wings he named the country Sipje. Later, because the common people had gladly followed at the time of coming, the name was changed to Baekje.
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 23, Baekje Annals — King Onjo, founding; Lee Byong-do ed., vol. 1, p. 334

blocks.html: Back to Sabi. Two armies are already on the road, and the only plan anyone has is a dead man’s letter…!
blocks.ko: 다시 사비. 두 나라 군대가 이미 길 위에 있다. 쓸 만한 계책이라곤 죽은 자가 남긴 편지 한 장뿐이다…!

images.alt: Seongchung, Heungsu, and Gyebek — the three loyalists of Baekje
images.at: In the Baekje court, there is panic as the Silla/Tang ar
images.prompt: Historical manhwa: Seongchung, Heungsu, Gyebek — three loyalists. No text, --ar 3:2

blocks.html: Word reaches Euija. Two armies are coming for his capital, one by sea and one over the hills. The markets already call it the Chunchu Army. He scrambles for troops.
blocks.ko: 소식이 의자에게 닿는다. 군대 둘이 도성을 향해 온다. 하나는 바다로, 하나는 산을 넘어. 저잣거리는 벌써 그걸 ‘춘추군’이라 부른다. 그는 허겁지겁 군사를 긁어모은다.

blocks.html: The Red Fowl set out from Laizhou, his ships stern to prow for a thousand li, coming east on the current.
blocks.ko: 정방이 내주에서 떠나니, 뱃머리와 뱃고물이 천 리에 이어져 물결을 따라 동쪽으로 내려왔다.
blocks.hanja: 定方發自萊州，舳艫千里，隨流東下。
blocks.source: Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 5, Silla Annals — King Muyeol, yr. 7 (660), sixth month

blocks.html: Loyalty, in Baekje, is a star you steer by after the door has already been opened against you.
blocks.ko: 백제에서 충성이란, 이미 문이 열린 뒤에야 길잡이로 삼는 별이다.

blocks.html: In the Baekje court, there is panic as the Silla/Tang army is approaching the borders.
blocks.ko: 백제 조정은 나당연합군이 국경에 이르자 공황에 빠진다.

lines: 폐하, 온조대왕 사당에 걸고, 계백 장군을 보내기엔 군사가 아직 부족합니다!
en: Your Majesty, by Onjo’s shrine, we have too few troops to send General Gyebek!
Better to wait for Lord Satek’s men…
Who is the Eraha of this country?!
Buyeo Euija?
Or Minister Satek?
Send him NOW!

blocks.html: At the back of the hall, the lord of Bear Fortress says nothing. Ye Sikjin is doing the sum every provincial lord is doing. How many days from the river mouth to the capital? And how many from the capital to his own gate?
blocks.ko: 대전 뒤편에서 웅진성 성주는 한마디도 없다. 예식진은 방 안의 지방 성주들이 다 하는 셈을 하고 있다. 강어귀에서 도성까지 며칠인가. 그리고 도성에서 제 성문까지는 며칠인가.

blocks.html: One man might still know what to do. Euija sent him away too. Somebody ride. Now…!
blocks.ko: 어찌해야 할지 아는 사람이 하나 남았을지 모른다. 그도 의자가 내쫓았다. 누가 말을 달려라. 지금…!

images.at: The matter is urgent. What then.
images.alt: Over-shoulder: a courier in Heungsu’s packed-earth yard; the worn ring-pommel between them
images.prompt: Minimal iconic 16:9 still. OTS courier toward Heungsu mid-turn at Gomamiji. ONE device: hollow ring-pommel as a sun circle. #b98f33 real bounce, not a glow. No text. No watermark.

images.at: Hold the White River mouth and the Tanhyeon pass
images.alt: Two-shot at the White River: Heungsu and Gyebek; two hollow ring-pommels overlapping at their belts
images.prompt: Minimal iconic 16:9 still. Close two-shot White River bank. Heungsu and Gyebek FACE from portraits, NEW bodies. ONE device: two hollow rings as overlapping circles. Real specular, not glow. No text. No watermark.

images.at: You… you truly mean to march?
images.alt: Dutch two-shot: Heungsu and Gyebek at the berth, ring-pommels catching the dusk
images.prompt: Minimal iconic 16:9 still. DUTCH two-shot at White River. Two hollow ring-pommels as geometry. Faces from portraits. No glow. No text. No watermark.

images.alt: Worm’s-eye empty Sabi hall: Euija slumped, agreeing to the wrong plan
images.prompt: Minimal iconic 16:9 still. Worm’s-eye empty Sabi hall. Euija FACE from portrait, NEW slumped body. Amber #e08a2e lamp bounce, not a glow. No text. No watermark.

images.alt: Wide Tanhyeon: the pass empty of a defense, a forgotten ring-pommel in the packed earth
images.prompt: Minimal iconic 16:9 still. Wide Korean mountain pass. Forgotten hollow ring-pommel in the foreground. Tiny Silla over the crest. No army catalog. No text. No watermark.

images.at: Tang keels are already in the mud of Gibeolpo
images.alt: Gibeolpo mudflat: a Baekje ring-pommel in the wet silt, Tang keels on the White River
images.prompt: Minimal iconic 16:9 still. White River estuary. Hollow ring-pommel in wet mud as the one device; Tang keels as stamps. No text. No watermark.

images.at: Yushin is already on the switchback
images.alt: Yushin climbing Tanhyeon, hip-scale 환두대도 hanging at his side — fish-ring pommel at the heel of the fist
images.prompt: Minimal iconic 16:9 still. LOW ANGLE Tanhyeon climb — real Korean rock, pines, grey giwa on the switchback. Yushin FACE from attached portrait; NEW climbing body, steel lamellar, #2A5FB8 cloth. Sword hangs at the hip like sw_bidam.png: small RING at the heel of the fist, short grip, thin gold band, blade DOWN toward his feet along the rock — not at the camera. Handle:blade 1:3. ONE small circle — the pommel. No tsuba. Ignore the portrait katana. #2A5FB8 bounce. No text. No watermark.

blocks.html: Heungsu is not in the hall. He is still at Gomamiji, where the posting put him. The king sends a man anyway, because the Chunchu Army is no longer a rumour and the rock has run out of plans.
blocks.ko: 흥수는 전각에 없다. 부임이 데려간 고마미지에 있다. 왕은 그래도 사람을 보낸다. 춘추군이 이미 소문이 아니고, 반석에는 계책이 떨어졌기 때문이다.

blocks.html: The last time the two of them spoke was at the water, before the paper named a county.
blocks.ko: 둘이 마지막으로 말한 것은 물가였다. 종이에 고을 이름이 적히기 전.

en: You… you truly mean to march?
With so few men—
I am a loyal servant of Baekje.
The king—
Our country has stood firm for seven hundred years.
His Majesty gave me a name.
A name — to a child who had none.
Today I go to give it back to him.
…Do you know the story of the Guardian of Ansi?

lines: 아끼는 사람 하나, 섬기는 사람 하나.
en: I do.
One person to cherish. One person to serve.

lines: 저는 그 둘이 같은 사람이라 문제입니다.
en: My trouble is that for me they are the same person.
Then hear one thing that is not a story.
Hold the White River mouth and the Tanhyeon pass — or there will be no Sabi left to be loyal to.
The Tang do not need our clans’ permission to land. They need our absence.
lines: 그러면 이야기가 아닌 것 하나만 들으시오.
백강 하구와 탄현을 지키시오 — 그렇지 않으면 충성할 사비가 남지 않소.
당은 상륙에 우리 가문의 허가가 필요 없소. 우리의 빈자리가 필요할 뿐.

en: I know the roads.
Yellow Mountain first — if that door holds, the river still has a kingdom behind it.
If it does not… then the berths you all fought over will belong to whoever can spell our names.
lines: 황산이 먼저요 — 그 문이 버티면, 강 뒤에 아직 나라가 있소.
못 버티면… 당신들이 싸우던 선석은, 우리 이름을 받아 적을 줄 아는 자의 것이 되오.

blocks.html: The county is a day’s ride from the sea and a month from anyone who matters. Heungsu arrives with one chest and the office blade, hangs the blade on the doorpost by its ring, and on the first morning, before the clerk has finished his bow, scratches a map into the packed earth of the yard with the end of a broom handle.
blocks.ko: 고을은 바다에서 하루, 중요한 사람들에게서는 한 달 거리다. 흥수는 궤짝 하나와 관도 한 자루를 들고 와서, 칼은 고리째 문설주에 걸고, 첫날 아침 향리가 절을 다 마치기도 전에 빗자루 자루 끝으로 마당 흙바닥에 지도를 긁는다.

blocks.html: A coastline. One river mouth, the White River’s, drawn twice as wide as it is. One notch in the eastern hills for Tanhyeon. Sabi as a thumbprint. Every morning the chickens and the children walk it out of shape, and every morning he sweeps it flat and draws it again, the same lines in the same order, like a monk at his morning sutra.
blocks.ko: 해안선 하나. 강어귀 하나, 백강의 것을 실제보다 두 배 넓게. 동쪽 산줄기에 홈 하나, 탄현. 사비는 엄지 지문 하나. 아침마다 닭과 아이들이 밟아 모양을 흐트러뜨리고, 아침마다 그는 바닥을 쓸어 평평하게 한 뒤 같은 선을 같은 순서로 다시 긋는다. 아침 독경을 하는 중처럼.

en: Mister, is that a snake?
A river.
What river?
One I hope you never see.
lines: 네가 평생 안 봤으면 하는 강.

blocks.html: Nobody from Sabi writes. The news about Seongchung comes a season after the cell, on a salt boat, folded in between the price of salt and the price of rice, and the clerk reads it out because he reads everything out.
blocks.ko: 사비에서는 아무도 편지하지 않는다. 성충의 소식은 옥에서 한 철이 지나 소금배에 실려 온다. 소금값과 쌀값 사이에 접혀서. 향리는 무엇이든 소리 내어 읽는 사람이라 그것도 소리 내어 읽는다.

en: The councillor in Sabi. The one who— in the cell.
…Was he someone you knew, sir?
lines: 사비의 그 좌평 나리요. 옥에서 그—

en: …Better handwriting than mine.

blocks.html: That morning he does not draw the map. The next morning he does, and adds nothing to it, which the clerk takes as grief and the children take as permission to walk on Tanhyeon.
blocks.ko: 그날 아침 그는 지도를 긋지 않는다. 이튿날 아침에는 긋는다. 아무것도 보태지 않고. 향리는 그것을 슬픔으로 읽고, 아이들은 탄현을 밟아도 된다는 허락으로 읽는다.

blocks.html: In the last year the rumours come down the coast faster than the salt: foxes in the Ministers’ Assembly, a river gone red. Heungsu hears each one out and goes back to his broom.
blocks.ko: 마지막 해에는 소문이 소금보다 빨리 해안을 타고 내려온다. 대신 회의장에 여우 떼, 핏빛이 된 강. 흥수는 하나하나 끝까지 듣고는 다시 빗자루로 돌아간다.

blocks.html: The courier does not sit. Dust still on him. Heungsu’s ring is the first bright thing in the yard.
blocks.ko: 사자는 앉지 않는다. 먼지가 아직 있다. 마당에서 먼저 빛나는 것은 흥수의 환두다.

blocks.html: He has stopped in the middle of the yard, which is to say in the middle of the map.
blocks.ko: 그는 마당 한가운데 멈춰 서 있다. 말하자면 지도 한가운데.

en: His Majesty asks.
The matter is urgent. What then.
…Seongchung already wrote it.
Same paper. I don’t have a second one.

blocks.hanja: 事急矣奈何 對曰 大槪與佐平成忠之言同
blocks.ko: 일이 급하게 되었으니 어찌하면 좋으냐. 대답하기를, 대개 좌평 성충의 말과 같습니다.
blocks.html: The matter is urgent — what then? He answered: It is generally the same as Jwapyeong Seongchung’s words.
blocks.source: Samguk Yusa (三國遺事) bk. 1, Taejong Chunchu-gong — Uija asks the exile Heungsu

en: …That is all?
His Majesty asked for a plan, sir. Not a—
lines: 폐하께서는 계책을 물으셨습니다. 그런 게 아니라—

en: You’re standing on Tanhyeon.

blocks.html: The courier looks down and steps off a notch in the dirt, as if it might give way under him.
blocks.ko: 사자는 발밑을 내려다보고, 흙바닥의 홈에서 발을 뗀다. 꺼지기라도 할 것처럼.

en: Tell His Majesty—
…No. He has the paper.

blocks.html: The answer comes back to Sabi. The ministers do not like the source.
blocks.ko: 대답이 사비로 돌아온다. 대신들은 출처가 마음에 들지 않는다.

blocks.hanja: 興首被縛怨君無愛國之心 其言不可用 寧使唐兵從白江而下不得方舟 新羅兵登炭峴不得竝馬 然後擊之 如籠中之雞 網中之魚 王曰然
blocks.ko: 흥수는 결박되어 있는 중이어서 임금을 원망하고 나라를 사랑하는 마음이 없습니다. 그러므로 그 의견을 마땅히 쓸 수 없습니다. 오히려 당군으로 하여금 백강을 따라 내려오게 하되 배를 벌리지 못하게 할 것이며, 신라의 군사로 하여금 탄현을 올라서 좁은 길을 따라 말을 나란히 하고 오지 못하게 할 것이며, 이런 때에 군사를 풀어서 그들을 치게 되면 삼태기 속에 든 닭이며 그물에 든 고기와 같을 것입니다. 왕이 이르되, 그렇도다.
blocks.html: Heungsu is bound; he resents his lord and has no love of country. His words must not be used. Better to let the Tang come down the White River without spreading their boats, and let Silla climb Tanhyeon by a path too narrow for horses abreast — then strike, and they will be as chickens in a basket, fish in a net. The king said: So it is.
blocks.source: Samguk Yusa (三國遺事) bk. 1, Taejong Chunchu-gong — ministers dismiss Heungsu; Uija agrees

en: So it is.

blocks.html: The next courier is shorter. Tang keels are already in the mud of Gibeolpo. Yushin is already on the switchback. The White River and the Tanhyeon pass are already theirs.
blocks.ko: 다음 파발은 더 짧다. 당의 배가 이미 기벌포 진흙에 박혀 있다. 유신은 이미 고갯길을 오르고 있다. 백강도 탄현도 벌써 저들 손에 있다.

blocks.html: No second courier comes to Gomamiji. Heungsu sweeps the yard and draws the map for eleven more mornings, the river mouth still twice as wide as it is, because nobody has told him it is already full of Tang keels.
blocks.ko: 고마미지로는 두 번째 사자가 오지 않는다. 흥수는 열하루 아침을 더 마당을 쓸고 지도를 긋는다. 강어귀는 여전히 실제보다 두 배 넓다. 그 강어귀가 이미 당의 용골로 가득하다고 말해 주는 사람이 없으니까.

blocks.html: On the twelfth it rains, and he stands under the eave and watches the White River and Tanhyeon run together into one brown puddle. He does not draw them again. He lifts the blade off the doorpost by its ring and starts north on foot, toward a pass that has already been crossed.
blocks.ko: 열이틀째 아침에는 비가 온다. 그는 처마 밑에 서서 백강과 탄현이 한데 흘러 갈색 웅덩이 하나가 되는 것을 지켜본다. 다시 긋지 않는다. 문설주에서 칼을 고리째 들어 내리고, 걸어서 북쪽으로 나선다. 이미 넘어간 고개를 향해.

blocks.html: The histories do not mention him again.
blocks.ko: 사서는 그를 다시 적지 않는다.

blocks.html: Across the sea, a boat is coming for the Turtle. He is on the shore before they finish tying it up…!
blocks.ko: 바다 건너, 거북이를 데리러 배가 온다. 밧줄을 다 매기도 전에 그는 이미 물가에 서 있다…!
